title: AI Use Case Business Lead - Trade and Working Capital - Vice President
description:
Join the Trade and Working Capital (T&WC) Business!

As the AI Use Case Business Lead (VP), within T&WC, you will serve as the owner of the AI use case book of work across Trade and Working Capital, responsible for interfacing with all business functions to enable product development, commercialization, and productivity AI applications. This role is accountable for translating business needs into clear technical requirements through close partnership with central AI, data science, and technology teams, and for driving end-to-end delivery from ideation through value realization.

Job responsibilities
  • Own and manage the end-to-end AI use case book of work across Trade and Working Capital, from ideation through delivery and value realization
  • Serve as the primary interface between business functions and central AI, data science, and technology teams, translating business needs into clear technical requirements
  • Drive AI enablement across product development, commercialization, and internal productivity use cases, managing delivery from concept through adoption
  • Lead use case prioritization using a structured framework that weighs business value, data readiness, feasibility, and strategic alignment
  • Champion upskilling and AI literacy initiatives within the business to build capability and accelerate adoption across functions
  • Link Trade and Working Capital AI priorities to firmwide AI initiatives and enterprise programs, ensuring product-specific requirements are properly represented and addressed
  • Partner with the Data and Infrastructure Lead to ensure data foundation, governance, and tooling needs for AI use cases are identified and sequenced into the infrastructure roadmap
  • Track and communicate portfolio progress, value realization, and lessons learned to senior leadership and stakeholders


Required qualifications, capabilities and skills
  • Demonstrated ability to define, prioritize, and manage an AI or advanced analytics use case pipeline within a complex, matrixed financial services organization
  • Strong business acumen in trade finance, transaction banking, or corporate banking with the ability to identify and size high-impact AI opportunities
  • Experience translating business requirements into technical specifications and partnering effectively with data science, AI engineering, and technology teams
  • Familiarity with AI/ML concepts, generative AI, and large language model applications sufficient to engage credibly with technical specialists and challenge assumptions
  • Proven stakeholder management across business functions, product, technology, and senior leadership in a global environment
  • Track record of leading upskilling or change management programs to drive adoption of analytical or AI-enabled capabilities
  • Strong prioritization and program management skills across a multi-workstream portfolio with competing demands
  • Ability to connect business-specific initiatives to enterprise governance frameworks, responsible AI standards, and firmwide delivery programs


Preferred qualifications, capabilities and skills
  • Direct experience with AI or advanced analytics product development in trade finance, transaction banking, or wholesale banking
  • Familiarity with firmwide AI governance, responsible AI frameworks, or model risk management practices
  • Experience working with data science or AI engineering teams in an agile or product delivery model
  • Experience in commercial or product strategy roles with exposure to AI-driven revenue generation or efficiency use cases
  • Prior experience operating across multiple geographies in a global banking environment


JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.

We offer a competitive total rewards package including base salary determined based on the role, experience, skill set and location. Those in eligible roles may receive commission-based pay and/or discretionary incentive compensation, paid in the form of cash and/or forfeitable equity, awarded in recognition of individual achievements and contributions. We also offer a range of benefits and programs to meet employee needs, based on eligibility. These benefits include comprehensive health care coverage, on-site health and wellness centers, a retirement savings plan, backup childcare, tuition reimbursement, mental health support, financial coaching and more. Additional details about total compensation and benefits will be provided during the hiring process.

We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. title: Business Graduate – Operations & AI
description:
About Us

Zweck is the internal Group Services division supporting a group of businesses across construction, insurance repairs and finance.

We are recruiting a Business Graduate to work within Roof Ninjas, our specialist metal roofing business. You will join a practical team spanning administration, estimating, supervision and eight tradespeople.

Across the broader group, we are using AI and automation to improve how our businesses operate. We value curiosity, ownership and people who are willing to test better ways of working.

About the Role

Learn how the business runs, take ownership of the work, then help us automate it.

This is a hands-on graduate role combining operations, administration and applied AI.

You will first learn and perform the day-to-day work that keeps Roof Ninjas moving. Once you understand a process and can manage it reliably, you will help document, improve and automate it.

Learn it. Do it. Automate it.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Maintaining trade and job schedules

  • Collecting, checking and following up timesheets

  • Setting up jobs and preparing job packs

  • Maintaining project and compliance documentation

  • Supporting supervisors with administration and resourcing

  • Following up outstanding information and actions

  • Communicating with office staff, supervisors and trades

  • Documenting recurring processes

  • Identifying repetitive or error-prone work

  • Building and testing practical automations

  • Improving forms, templates and reporting

  • Monitoring automated processes and handling exceptions

You may use tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, Claude Code, Codex, n8n, Power Automate, Quickbase and Microsoft 365.

The goal is not to automate work you do not understand. You will learn the process, become accountable for it and then find a better way to deliver it.

About You

We are looking for a recent or soon-to-be graduate who is:

  • Curious about how businesses operate

  • Organised, dependable and willing to follow things through

  • Comfortable performing detailed administrative work

  • An active user of AI tools

  • Interested in automation, systems and process improvement

  • Able to create structure when instructions are not perfect

  • Comfortable communicating with both office staff and tradespeople

  • Keen to take on real responsibility early in their career

You do not need roofing or construction experience. We can teach you how the operation works.

Bonus points if you have:

  • Built an automation, workflow or AI tool

  • Used Claude Code, Codex, n8n, Power Automate, Make or Zapier

  • Created a useful spreadsheet, dashboard, form or small application

  • A university, work or personal project you can show us

Apply Today

Please apply through SEEK with your resume and a short statement covering:

  • Why this role interests you

  • How you currently use AI

  • Something you have built, improved or automated

  • An example of a repetitive task you would improve and how you would approach it

We are not looking for a perfect background. We are looking for curiosity, initiative and someone who wants to learn how a business works before helping us build a better version of it.

title: Administratör till Välfärdsförvaltningen, Kramfors kommun
description:
Kramfors kommun är det naturliga navet i Höga Kusten, format under årtusenden. Hos oss kan människor, platser och miljöer växa efter sina egna förutsättningar. 

Tillsammans skapar vi välfärden och ett fungerande samhälle som är jämställt och rättvist för alla som bor och vistas i kommunen. Vi brukar med stolthet säga att vi har Sveriges viktigaste jobb! Det är en bra utgångspunkt för att en arbetsdag hos oss ska kännas meningsfull.



1 plats(er). 

ARBETSUPPGIFTER
Som administratör inom Välfärdsförvaltningen har du en central roll i att stödja verksamheten och bidra till en väl fungerande organisation. Du arbetar självständigt samtidigt som du är en del av ett team där ni gemensamt bidrar till att utveckla och kvalitetssäkra administrativa rutiner och arbetssätt. Arbetet innebär många kontaktytor, både internt och externt, vilket ställer krav på god samarbetsförmåga, servicekänsla och ett professionellt bemötande. 

Du arbetar med en bred variation av administrativa uppgifter och utgör ett viktigt stöd för chefer, medarbetare och verksamheter inom förvaltningen.

En central del av arbetet är att använda verksamhetens administrativa system och digitala verktyg för att säkerställa effektiva, rättssäkra och kvalitativa administrativa processer. Rollen präglas av samverkan, service och ansvarstagande, och arbetsuppgifterna anpassas och utvecklas löpande utifrån verksamhetens behov.

KVALIFIKATIONER
Vi söker dig som har erfarenhet av administrativt arbete, gärna inom  kommunal verksamhet. Erfarenhet av ekonomiadministration samt arbete i verksamhetssystem inom socialtjänsten är även det meriterande.

Du kommunicerar obehindrat och professionellt på svenska i både tal och skrift, eftersom det utgör en central del av arbetsuppgifterna.

Du har god datorvana, trivs med att arbeta i digitala miljöer och har erfarenhet av Microsoft 365 (Outlook, Word, Excel och Teams). Erfarenhet av andra system som Personec, Treserva, Tes och MultiAcess är meriterande.

Som person är du serviceinriktad och har ett professionellt och förtroendeingivande bemötande. Du kan arbeta självständigt, ta ansvar för dina arbetsuppgifter och känner dig trygg i att driva ditt arbete framåt på egen hand. Samtidigt har du en god samarbetsförmåga och trivs med att skapa och upprätthålla goda relationer, både inom och utanför organisationen.

Du är strukturerad, noggrann och kvalitetsmedveten, med god förmåga att prioritera och hantera flera arbetsuppgifter parallellt. Rollen ställer krav på flexibilitet och att du kan anpassa dig efter verksamhetens behov. Eftersom du kommer att hantera känslig information är det viktigt att du har hög integritet, gott omdöme och ett ansvarsfullt arbetssätt.

Vi lägger stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet.

Anställningsform: Tillsvidareanställning.
Varaktighet: Tillsvidare, tillträde: Tillträde enligt överenskommelse.

Urval sker löpande och intervjuer kan hållas innan sista ansökningsdag. Skicka därför in din ansökan redan idag!

För att kvalitetssäkra rekryteringsprocessen samt möjliggöra god kommunikation med våra sökande ber vi dig skicka in din ansökan digitalt och inte via e-post eller pappersformat.

Ange referensnummer och löneanspråk i ansökan. Referenser lämnas vid begäran och inför vissa anställningar i kommunens verksamheter krävs utdrag från belastningsregistret. I vår kommun är ett antal tjänster placerade i säkerhetsklass så säkerhetsprövning kan komma att ske.

Vi har gjort vårt medieval för rekrytering och undanber oss därför kontakt med säljare av rekryteringstjänster.

Varmt välkommen med din ansökan till ett av Sveriges viktigaste jobb!

Här kan du läsa mer om att flytta till och bo i Kramfors kommun: https://www.kramfors.se/bygga-bo--miljo/flytta-till-kramfors.html

title: Project Associate – Reporting
description:
Since the inception of IOM in 1951, Movement Operations have been and continue to be a fundamental pillar of the Organization’s work. The organized movement of persons in need of international migration assistance is a primary mandate of the Organization and a cornerstone of IOM’s operations. Movement Operations units in various IOM Country Offices (COs), coordinated under the Resettlement and Movement Management (RMM) Unit in the Division of Movement, Resettlement and Labour Pathways (MRLP) at IOM’s Headquarters, are responsible for all aspects of travel for migrants and refugees under IOM’s auspices, in accordance with the various framework agreements with resettlement and receiving Governments and partners across the spectrum of the Organization's programmes.

Migrant Training activities - including Pre-Departure Orientation (PDO), Cultural Orientation (CO), and Post-Arrival Orientation (PAO) - are an integral component of IOM’s MRLP Division, equipping migrants with essential knowledge and skills to support their successful integration and self- sufficiency in destination countries. Training programmes are implemented globally under the framework of the MRLP Division and are tailored to meet the specific needs of beneficiaries, in close coordination with partner organizations and governments.

Under the overall supervision of the AUSCO Global Coordinator and the direct supervision of the National Project Officer, the Project Associate – Reporting will be responsible for supporting programme monitoring and reporting activities of the Australian Cultural Orientation Programme (AUSCO). The position will assist in compiling, verifying and maintaining programme data and records, preparing routine statistical and programme reports, coordinating information requests, and monitoring reporting schedules and deadlines. The incumbent will work closely with programme staff, delivery locations, country offices and implementing partners to facilitate the timely and accurate provision of programme information and reporting outputs, in accordance with established procedures, systems and reporting requirements.sufficiency in destination countries. Training programmes are implemented globally under the framework of the MRLP Division and are tailored to meet the specific needs of beneficiaries, in close coordination with partner organizations and governments.

1. Assist in the implementation and monitoring of programme reporting activities, maintaining programme records, reporting databases and information management systems to support effective programme delivery.

2. Compile, verify, reconcile and maintain participant training data received from delivery locations, facilitating the accuracy, completeness and timely processing of information within Home Affairs reporting systems, internal databases and other relevant platforms.

3. Produce routine statistical reports, dashboards, data summaries and performance tracking tools, identifying discrepancies and shortfalls for review by the supervisor.

4. Support the preparation of contractual, donor and management reports, including compiling narrative and statistical inputs, consolidating reporting annexes in accordance with IOM and donor reporting requirements.

5. Facilitate knowledge management by contributing to central repositories of programme documentation, training records, reporting outputs, reference materials and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), ensuring accessibility and version control.

6. Coordinate information requests from country offices, implementing partners, delivery locations and other stakeholders, supporting the timely collection, and dissemination of programme information and key performance indicators.

7. Monitor reporting calendars, reporting schedules and contractual deadlines, liaising with relevant programme staff to facilitate the timely submission of reports, updates and supporting documentation.

8. Provide administrative and technical support related to reporting, information management and programme monitoring activities, maintaining effective coordination with project staff, delivery partners and relevant support units.

9. Demonstrate an in-depth understanding of applicable SOPs, reporting requirements, related systems and databases, and IOM Standards of Conduct. Maintain confidentiality, accuracy and integrity of all programme data and documentation in accordance with IOM policies and relevant data protection requirements.

10. Uphold RMM Protection Mainstreaming Minimum Standards while carrying out all duties and responsibilities and demonstrate the ability to remain professional, impartial and unbiased during all interactions with migrants and colleagues in accordance with the IOM Standards of Conduct and the Instruction on Prevention of Sexual Exploitation Abuse and Harassment (PSEAH).

11. Perform such other relevant duties as may be assigned.

EDUCATION

• Bachelor’s degree in Political Science, Social Sciences, Business Administration, Refugee and Migration Studies, International Relations, Law or a related field from an accredited academic institution with three years of relevant professional experience; or,

• High School diploma with five years of relevant professional experience.

EXPERIENCE

• Experience in data management, reporting and/or information management;

• Experience in working with migrants, civil society and government is an advantage;

• Prior experience working for IOM, a UN agency, or another international organization is an advantage; and,

• Applicants must have the ability to obtain and maintain an AGSVA Baseline security clearance.

SKILLS

• Knowledge of migration-related issues;

• Proven ability to work with vulnerable individuals;

• Excellent written and oral communication skills;

• Attention to detail and ability to organize work; and,

• Good communication, organizational and interpersonal relationship skills.

title: Junior Systems Engineer
description:
Essa posição é para atuar em regime presencial, em Contagem, MG.

Who will you be working with?

Wabtec's Train Handling solutions include Trip Optimizer® and Locotrol®, which work together to optimize train performance and automate freight operations. Trip Optimizer creates and executes fuel-efficient operating plans that meet schedule and train-handling requirements, while Locotrol enables coordinated control of distributed locomotives throughout the train. Together, these technologies improve train handling, fuel efficiency, operational safety, and the ability to operate longer and heavier trains.

As a Systems Engineer, you will work closely with engineering teams, product management, and railroad customers to support the development of innovative solutions that advance automation within the rail industry.

How will you make a difference?

As a Systems Engineer, you will support the design, development, testing, and deployment of Wabtec's Train Handling portfolio. Working under the guidance of experienced engineers, you will contribute to requirements development, system analysis, verification activities, and product enhancements while adhering to established engineering processes and standards.

The successful candidate will demonstrate an AI-enabled mindset, leveraging AI tools to improve research, problem-solving, productivity, and technical decision-making. You will continuously learn emerging technologies and apply data-driven insights to help deliver high-quality solutions that meet customer and business needs.

What do we want to know about you?

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering, Mathematics or Computer Science from an accredited college or university.
  • Hands-on design experience, requirements development and implementation experience involving; Engineering Systems, Hardware / Software Engineering, and/or Data Information Systems.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong oral and written communication skills.
  • Ability to work in a cross-functional, global environment.
  • Willingness and ability to travel domestically and internationally.

What will your typical day look like?

  • Support the design, development, testing, and enhancement of Train Handling solutions while applying sound engineering principles and established development processes.
  • Assist in gathering, documenting, and analyzing customer and system requirements to support product development and continuous improvement activities.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including Product Management, Software Engineering, Train Control, Office Systems, Safety, Validation, and Applications Engineering, to support project execution and successful product delivery.
  • Participate in requirements reviews, design reviews, verification activities, and technical discussions throughout the product development lifecycle.
  • Assist in troubleshooting technical issues, analyzing system behavior, and supporting resolution efforts under the guidance of senior engineers.
  • Contribute to field testing, validation, and evaluation activities for train automation and optimization solutions.
  • Support the preparation of technical documentation, reports, project updates, and engineering deliverables.
  • Work with railroad subject matter experts and engineering teams to learn operational concepts and apply them to product development efforts.
  • Develop knowledge of industry standards, engineering best practices, and emerging technologies relevant to train automation, optimization, and distributed control systems.
  • Utilize AI-enabled tools and technologies to improve productivity, accelerate learning, support analysis activities, and enhance engineering outcomes.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Foundational understanding of systems engineering principles and product development processes.
  • Exposure to software, controls, automation, transportation, or embedded systems through coursework, internships, or project experience.
  • Familiarity with systems architecture concepts and distributed systems is a plus.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  • Interest in applying AI-enabled tools and data-driven approaches to engineering challenges.
  • Knowledge of railroad operations, AAR standards, CENELEC standards, or safety-critical systems is preferred but not required.

Benefícios:

title: Simulation Workbench Principal Engineer
description:
Principal Engineer, Simulation Workbench

Concurrent Real-Time is part of HBK’s Virtual Test Division, which focuses on providing real-time software, simulators, and hardware-in-the-loop solutions to virtually test products throughout the development cycle, helping companies accelerate innovation and reduce time-to-market, and improve their competitive advantage. With 250 highly skilled employees, HBK’s Virtual Test Division has offices in Germany, Italy, France, UK, China, Japan, and the USA as well as a broad network of worldwide channel partners. Concurrent Real-Time is the industry’s foremost provider of high-performance, real-time Linux software, hardware and professional services. Our mission is to be the leading provider of best-in-class real-time Linux solutions and support for time-critical applications, and to inspire technological advancements worldwide. For more than 50 years, we have been providing real-time solutions for mission-critical applications worldwide. With offices in 6 countries, our core competencies include:

  • Real-time Linux and RTOS platforms engineered for deterministic, time-critical workloads
  • X-in-the-Loop simulation: hardware-in-the-loop, man-in-the-loop, and AI-in-the-loop
  • Custom engineered systems for aerospace and defense programs, from concept through fielded delivery
  • High-speed data acquisition and signal conditioning
  • High-performance visual systems and process control
  • Low-latency signal processing

Concurrent Real-Time is currently seeking a full-time Principal Engineer for the Simulation Workbench team!


Must be a US citizen. Unable to hire dual citizens, green card holders or visa holders for this position.

About the Role

We are looking for a deeply experienced software engineer to serve as the technical lead for our Simulation Workbench (SimWB) team. SimWB is our real-time hardware-in-the-loop simulation platform, running on real-time Linux and driving a wide range of I/O hardware. As the most senior engineer on the team, you will work in the core of the product, including the real-time scheduler and configuration server, own significant subsystems end to end, and set the technical direction the rest of the team builds on. You will partner with the team’s Manager on roadmap and architecture decisions. This is a hands-on senior individual contributor role with broad technical authority and no direct reports.


What You’ll Do

  • Own and evolve core SimWB subsystems, including the real-time scheduler and the configuration server
  • Design, implement, and debug I/O support for our own cards, including our FPGA cards, as well as for protocols such as EtherCAT, ARINC 429, MIL-STD-1553, CAN, and serial and Ethernet interfaces.
  • Develop and maintain the SimWB SDK and API surfaces used by customers and by internal teams
  • Diagnose and resolve complex real-time issues involving timing, determinism, and hardware/software integration
  • Provide the deepest level of technical escalation support for customer issues, working with the Support and Applications Engineering teams
  • Produce and maintain design documentation so that critical product knowledge is retained by the team
  • Serve as the technical lead for the team: set coding and design standards, review designs and code, mentor Lead and Senior Engineers, and raise the technical bar of the group
  • Partner with the SimWB Manager on roadmap and architecture decisions, and help assess the feasibility and effort behind proposed features
  • Evaluate new technologies and translate future product needs into engineering feasibility

What We’re Looking For

  • 10+ years of software development experience in a Linux environment
  • Expert-level C and C++, with solid working knowledge of Java
  • Demonstrated experience with real-time systems, including scheduling, determinism, and performance analysis
  • Hands-on experience with I/O boards and device-level software, including reading hardware documentation and bringing up new boards
  • Experience owning a significant subsystem or product area end to end
  • Hands-on experience with MATLAB and Simulink, including integrating Simulink models into a real-time execution environment (highly preferred)
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent experience

Nice to Have

  • Experience with hardware-in-the-loop or man-in-the-loop simulation platforms
  • Linux kernel or device driver development experience, including real-time kernel variants
  • Experience with other third-party modeling and simulation tools such as Dymola, Adams, or rFpro, and with model exchange standards such as FMI/FMU
  • FPGA exposure, or experience integrating FPGA-based I/O into software products
  • Experience with Python and Java client or GUI development, including Swing or Qt
  • Master’s degree in Computer Science or Electrical Engineering

Compensation:

The pay range for this position is $145K - $160K annually plus 10% bonus. Please note that the pay range provided is a good faith estimate for the position at the time of posting. Actual compensation will be dependent on factors, including but not limited to the individual’s qualifications, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities, as well as physical work location within the state.

Where applicants provide multiple location preferences, reserve lists will be managed in accordance with location preference/s, as indicated in your application. We will appoint in merit list order for each location outlined in the vacancy and hold a separate locational reserve list for each of these locations. After appointments have been made using this locational appointment process, any remaining candidates who met the benchmark for the role will remain on a locational reserve list in accordance with their preferences for 12 months.

Please only indicate preferences where you are prepared to work. If you are subsequently offered a role from the reserve list for a location preference indicated in your application and decline it, you will be removed from the reserve list for the vacancy, across all locational preferences.

All offers of employment will be made strictly in merit order, based on your performance throughout the recruitment process. Candidates at the top of the merit list will be offered vacancies as they arise in their chosen locations.

Once you have accepted an offer for a role, you will be withdrawn from any other lice applications for the same role and will no longer be considered for those vacancies.

The addresses listed in the job advertisement are not an exhaustive list of potential base locations, they give an indication of some of the potential locations you could be based at.

We will therefore endeavour to offer you a vacancy within a 60-minute commute of your home location.

New entrants to the Civil Service will be expected to join at the entry point salary for the advertised band.

Existing Civil Servants will have their salary calculated in accordance with the Departments pay on transfer / pay on promotion rules.

Due to the length of this recruitment campaign, we will endeavour to inform you of your outcome following the interview. Successful candidates will be placed on a reserve list and will be allocated or offered roles once the campaign has fully concluded.

Working Arrangements & Further Information

The MoJ offers Hybrid Working arrangements where business need allows. This is an informal, non-contractual form of flexible working that blends working from your base location, different MoJ sites and / or from home (please be aware that this role can only be worked in the UK and not overseas). Some roles will not be suitable for Hybrid Working. Similarly, Hybrid Working will not suit everyone’s circumstances. Arrangements will be discussed and agreed with the successful candidate(s) and subject to regular review.

For nationally advertised roles, the successful candidate(s) will be appointed to a MoJ office location, which may include their nearest Justice Collaboration Centre or Justice Satellite Office. This will be discussed and agreed on the completion of pre-employment checks.

Some of MoJ’s terms and conditions of service are changing as part of Civil Service reform. The changes will apply to staff joining MoJ who are new to the Civil Service. Details will be available if an offer is made.

Standard full time working hours are 37 hours per week excluding breaks which are unpaid. HMPPS welcomes part-time, flexible and job-sharing working patterns, where they meet the demands of the role and business needs. All applications for part-time, flexible and job-sharing working patterns will be considered in accordance with the HMPPS’ Flexible Working policy.

title: Japanese Service Desk Analyst
description:
Role Overview
The Japanese Service Desk Analyst provides technical and application support to internal and external clients through phone, email, and service portals. The role is responsible for managing incidents and service requests from initial contact through resolution or escalation, while maintaining agreed service levels and delivering a high-quality client experience.

The role requires strong technical troubleshooting, structured problem solving, excellent client communication, and proficiency in both Japanese and English. The analyst will support enterprise applications, SaaS platforms, managed hosting services, and related end-user technologies.

Key Responsibilities

Service Desk & Technical Support

  • Provide technical and general application support to clients through phone, email, and customer service portals.
  • Receive, triage, diagnose, and resolve incidents and service requests within defined SLAs.
  • Troubleshoot software errors, application issues, and basic technical failures, resolving issues where possible or recommending appropriate remediation.
  • Support clients using enterprise applications, SaaS platforms, and managed hosting services.
  • Apply knowledge of supported technologies, applications, and configurations to deliver effective technical assistance.
  • Utilize available technical tools and resources to investigate and resolve reported issues.


Incident & Request Management

  • Own client technical issues from initial report through resolution or appropriate escalation.
  • Record, process, track, and manage incidents and service requests in accordance with established procedures.
  • Provide clear and timely updates on ticket status, progress, expected resolution, and next steps.
  • Escalate unresolved or complex issues to the appropriate next-level support team in line with defined SLAs and escalation thresholds.
  • Identify potential major incidents or recurring problems and proactively communicate them to management or relevant support teams.


Client Experience

  • Manage client expectations regarding response and resolution timelines.
  • Communicate effectively with different audiences, adjusting the level of technical detail according to the client’s needs.
  • Demonstrate active listening, empathy, professionalism, and a strong customer-service mindset in every interaction.
  • Communicate with clients through phone, email, and other designated support channels.
  • Balance technical resolution with a positive and consistent customer experience.


Service Improvement & Knowledge Management

  • Contribute to the development and improvement of standardized support processes, tools, and methodologies.
  • Document solutions, troubleshooting steps, and known issues within the knowledge base.
  • Identify opportunities for innovation and automation that can improve service quality and support efficiency.
  • Apply structured problem-solving and efficient support practices to achieve faster and more consistent resolutions.


Productivity & Service Performance

  • Manage call handling time, after-call activities, ticket workload, and competing priorities effectively.
  • Achieve established service desk productivity and performance targets while maintaining service quality.
  • Resolve technical and software-related inquiries efficiently to minimize service disruption and operational impact.
  • Maintain accurate and timely ticket documentation throughout the support lifecycle.


Required Qualifications & Experience

  • At least 2 years of experience in IT support, end-user support, service desk, or a related IT support role.
  • Experience working in an SLA-driven service desk or technical support environment.
  • Hands-on experience using BMC Helix, ServiceNow, or a similar ITSM/ticket management platform.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to ask effective diagnostic questions.
  • Strong client service orientation with the ability to balance technical troubleshooting and customer experience.
  • Strong organizational, time-management, and workload-prioritization skills.
  • Structured problem-solving and analytical thinking skills.
  • Fluent in English.
  • Proficiency in Japanese.
  • Willingness to work rotating shifts, including weekends and holidays.


Technical Skills
Basic knowledge or troubleshooting experience with some or all of the following:

  • Windows OS
  • Microsoft Office 365
  • Microsoft SQL
  • MFA
  • VPN
  • Citrix
  • Microsoft Azure
  • Active Directory
  • Exchange Server
  • Enterprise and cloud-based applications
  • SaaS platforms
  • Managed hosting services
  • ITSM / ticket management platforms


Preferred Qualifications

  • Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.
  • ITIL Foundation certification.
  • CompTIA certification.
  • Microsoft Azure certification.
  • Experience supporting enterprise-scale or cloud-based applications.

description:
Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all.

Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.

About Our Team

Our team builds and enables scalable, cloud-native software platforms that power critical manufacturing and business operations. We use modern full stack engineering practices and AI-driven technologies to create innovative solutions that improve automation, decision making, and operational efficiency.


Position Overview

We are seeking an AI-Centric Full Stack Software Engineer to design, build, and support modern software solutions with a strong focus on AI-enabled applications and intelligent automation. This role goes beyond simply using AI coding assistants. You will have strong understanding of Prompt Engineering, Vibe Coding, Rework Rate Reduction and leverage Custom Agents, and integrations built around the Model Context Protocol (MCP). You will apply strong software engineering fundamentals to assemble, integrate, and operationalize AI capabilities into real production systems being accountable for Full-Stack solutions.


The goal of this role is to significantly shorten development and feedback cycles by automating routine engineering work, augmenting human decision-making, and embedding intelligence directly into our development workflows and the applications we deliver!


Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain scalable full stack applications and platform services. Own software solutions end-to-end, including system design, architecture, implementation, testing, observability, deployment, and lifecycle support.
  • Develop and implement custom AI agents to support workflow automation, decision support, summarization, and multi-step reasoning capabilities.
  • Integrate AI services, large language models (LLMs), embeddings, search technologies, and external tools through secure and scalable APIs.
  • Build and maintain MCP-based integrations to enable structured communication between AI models, tools, and business systems.
  • Collaborate with engineering, product, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into reliable, maintainable, and scalable solutions.
  • Apply AI-assisted development practices while ensuring code quality, architectural integrity, security, reliability, and long-term maintainability.
  • Harden AI components for 24x7 critical physical manufacturing systems with attention to reliability and resiliency, latency and performance, security, permissions, and data boundaries, and observability and maintainability


Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field, with 5+ years of full-stack or backend software development experience.
  • Strong expertise in API design, service integration, data persistence, and building production-grade applications.
  • Hands-on experience with cloud-native architectures, CI/CD pipelines, containerization, and Kubernetes-based deployments.
  • Proven experience working with relational and NoSQL databases, including data modeling and storage architecture design.
  • Demonstrated success designing and deploying AI-enabled solutions, including AI agents, RAG systems, prompt engineering, AI tool integration, and evaluation of AI reliability, security, and failure modes.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 7+ years of experience building and scaling enterprise-grade distributed applications in cloud environments.
  • Strong expertise in modern development technologies, including C#, ASP.NET, Angular, SQL, NoSQL, Kubernetes, and cloud-native architectures.
  • Proven experience developing AI-powered solutions, including MCP integrations, AI agent skills, tool invocation frameworks, and multi-agent workflows.
  • Deep understanding of prompt engineering, context management, AI workflow optimization, and enabling interoperability between AI models, tools, and agents.
  • Demonstrated success architecting highly available, secure, and resilient systems while leading architecture reviews, code quality initiatives, and engineering best practices.

title: Client Care Agent
description:
Collette is currently seeking Client Care Agents to join our Client Care Team. This is a remote role.

About Collette: Let Us Show You the World

There has never been a better time to be in the travel industry. See the world, connect with others, and experience the immersive benefits of one of the trendiest industries when you join the Collette team! As the longest-running tour operator in North America, our family-owned business leads the industry in innovation and expertise. Collette’s passionate team works hard to fulfill travel dreams and is always looking for talent that will help to shape the company’s future. Being part of the Collette team means having a willingness to grow, a desire to learn and ask questions, and a zest for seeing the world. From giving back to local communities to creating incredible experiences for a world of travelers and being part of a value-oriented team that cares for one another – Collette is all about the people. So, what are you waiting for? Your journey starts here.

Job Summary:

Do you enjoy working in a fast-paced environment? We are seeking an exceptional Client Care Agent who will service the needs of Collette customers in an inbound and outbound telephone contact environment. Our Client Care Agents are responsible for supporting our sales team and product line under the Retail division of our Client Care Center. Consistent and flawless execution of the booking process is strived for, while upholding a high level of professionalism and friendly interactions with direct consumers, travel agents, and group leaders. The ideal candidate must have a desire to become part of a growing team within a dynamic environment and industry. Exceptional customer service skills and the ability to work nights and weekends is a must.

Primary Functions:

  • Answer inbound calls and route to the correct team within the company
  • Educate customers on our product offerings and the advantages of travelling with Collette
  • Build and confirm tour packages within our internal reservation system
  • Effectively explain offers and upgrades available across all tour components
  • Review and complete Retail booking notations which require action by the Client Care Center. This includes but is not limited to; tour changes, flight schedule changes, re-booking components, requests for additional information, & follow up notes entered by other members of the Client Care Center team
  • Perform to and exceed qualitative and quantitative performance goals and standards

Knowledge and Skills:

  • Call Center and/or travel industry experience is a plus
  • Strong attention to detail with an ability to organize and prioritize day-to-day activities in a fast-paced environment is required
  • Strong computer skills are necessary, and a working knowledge of Microsoft Excel, Outlook and Word is ideal
  • Ability to handle customers with a high level of continuous professionalism
  • Ability to work effectively with all members of the team
  • Embraces a mindset of curiosity and continuous learning, actively exploring and leveraging AI and other emerging technologies to improve processes, elevate content, and drive efficiency across the organization.
  • Some higher education preferred, but not necessary.

Compensation & Benefits

We believe in taking care of our team—inside and outside of work.

The pay range for this position is $18.00 - $20.00/hr.

What We Offer:

  • Health & Wellness: Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage—plus a Peloton One Membership to keep you moving
  • Time Off: Generous PTO, paid holidays, and your birthday!
  • Volunteer Time: Paid hours to give back to causes you care about
  • Financial Security: 401(k) with company match
  • Family Support: Paid parental leave, paid bereavement leave and access to our Employee Assistance Program
  • Career Growth: Tuition reimbursement to help you level up your skills
  • Exclusive travel discounts, incentives and more!

title: Retention Agent
description:
Retention Agent: Support Customers. Protect Policies. Make a Real Difference.

Location: Sydney CBD (Barangaroo)

Base Salary: $70,000 + Super

Schedule: Full-time, Monday to Friday

At Neilson, we're dedicated to helping families secure financial protection for their loved ones with a range of life insurance options. We have evolved from our origins in the UK, where the business was launched in 2012, to become an award-winning international operation and leader in the global life insurance market. Today, we have offices in the USA, Canada, Ireland, and Australia and New Zealand.

Why join us?

This role is about protecting what matters. As a Retention Agent, you'll help customers keep their life insurance policies active by retrieving failed payments and preventing unnecessary cancellations. You'll use empathy, strong communication, and problem-solving skills to support families when they need it most.

  • Free lunch: enjoy lunch on us every Wednesday and Friday, with options changing weekly

  • Central Barangaroo location: run past the Opera House before work, explore Darling Harbour's food scene or shop Pitt Street Mall on your break

  • Structured training and support: we'll equip you with everything you need to succeed

  • Welcoming, high-energy team environment: work with people from all walks of life

What you'll be doing

  • Speak with existing life insurance customers whose premiums have failed or policies are at risk of cancellation

  • Recover missed payments and work to retain the customer's policy

  • Understand and respond to each customer's unique situation with empathy and care

  • Educate customers on the importance of continued coverage and the options available

  • Maintain accurate records and follow regulated scripts and processes

  • Work towards individual and team retention goals in a supportive, call centre environment

What we're looking for

  • Strong customer service background, ideally in a contact centre or financial services environment

  • Excellent verbal communication and active listening skills

  • High emotional intelligence, able to connect, de-escalate and problem-solve

  • Resilience: calm and professional under pressure, even in challenging conversations

  • A team-first mindset with a focus on doing the right thing for the customer

What to expect from the interview process

  1. 30-minute video call with our recruitment team: a relaxed conversation to learn more about you and share details about the role

  2. One-hour in-person interview at our Barangaroo office: includes a competency-based interview and a chance to meet team leaders

We want you to feel confident and informed. This process is as much about you getting to know us as it is the other way around.

If you are passionate about making a difference, you thrive in a fast-paced and entrepreneurial environment, and you want to be part of a high performing team, we would love to hear from yo

Accessibility For Job Applicants

We strive to make our job application process accessible to all individuals, including those with disabilities. If you require accommodation at any stage of the application, interview, or selection process, please contact our Human Resources department. Our team will work with you to provide suitable accommodations to ensure your participation.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Neilson Financial Services is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome and encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds and abilities. Our commitment to diversity and inclusion is fundamental to our company culture.

Teledyne Technologies Incorporated provides enabling technologies for industrial growth markets that require advanced technology and high reliability. These markets include aerospace and defense, factory automation, air and water quality environmental monitoring, electronics design and development, oceanographic research, deepwater oil and gas exploration and production, medical imaging and pharmaceutical research.​

We are looking for individuals who thrive on making an impact and want the excitement of being on a team that wins.

The Sr. Linux Software Engineer will design, develop, and maintain applications and embedded software for advanced analytical instrumentation systems. This role spans the full software development lifecycle and requires expertise in Linux-based embedded systems, application development, instrument control, and software architecture for complex scientific products.

Primary Duties & Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, test, and maintain software applications and embedded systems throughout the software development lifecycle.

  • Implement innovative user interfaces, data analysis capabilities, and instrument troubleshooting and debugging
  • Support new product development and sustain existing products through troubleshooting, enhancements, and defect resolution.

  • 8+ years of software development experience.
  • Hands-on experience with embedded Linux development, including Linux system configuration, Bash scripting, Yocto/BitBake, Linux kernel and driver development, device trees, U-Boot, software package management, and deployment/update frameworks such as SWUpdate.
  • Strong proficiency in C#, .NET, and object-oriented software design.
  • Experience with Git and collaborative software development practices.
  • Experience developing software for embedded systems and distributed architectures.
  • Strong understanding of multi-threaded programming, debugging, and software security principles.
  • Programming experience in C and C++; Rust experience is a plus.
  • Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, and communication skills.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. Government security clearance, if required.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Blazor, WebSockets, and GraphQL.
  • Experience with Docker or other containerization technologies.

title: Station Design Coordinator
description:
SYSTRA Canada is part of the SYSTRA group, an international consulting and engineering group, a world leader in the design of transport infrastructures. SYSTRA Canada is an engineering and consulting firm whose primary focus is to offer transportation solutions, whether for passengers or goods: feasibility studies of building a new railway line, increasing the capacity of the existing infrastructure, privatization of a railway.

Context

Reporting to the Stations Design Manager, the Station Design Coordinator supports the technical coordination and design governance of assigned station projects. The role is responsible for coordinating multidisciplinary deliverables with internal and external stakeholders, supporting design reviews, and helping maintain alignment between project scope, schedule, and technical requirements.

The Station Design Coordinator works closely with multidisciplinary teams to support integrated project delivery across all phases, from concept through commissioning. The role also assists with interface management, stakeholder coordination, and responses to client, authority, and partner comments.

Missions/Main Duties

  • Support multidisciplinary technical coordination across all project phases, from concept to commissioning.
  • Coordinate deliverables across disciplines including architecture, structural, MEP, utilities, fire/life safety, vertical transportation, civil interfaces, and systems integration.
  • Assist with design governance activities, including design reviews, coordination meetings, meeting minutes, change control, configuration management, and design assurance processes.
  • Support the implementation of project delivery plans, including design strategy, milestones, review stages, interface planning, and risk management.
  • Help ensure alignment of station design with project objectives, client requirements, operational needs, passenger experience goals, and sustainability objectives.
  • Assist with interface management across disciplines, stakeholders, and third parties.
  • Support responses to comments from clients, authorities, and key stakeholders.
  • Assist with stakeholder engagement, including regulatory authorities, municipalities, utility providers, and other external partners.
  • Help ensure compliance with applicable Canadian codes, standards, and project requirements.
  • Support the integration of operational requirements, capacity considerations, and commercial or functional planning into the station design.
  • Assist in the identification and monitoring of design, constructability, interface, and approval risks.
  • Support alignment of station scope with budget, schedule, and performance targets.
  • Assist with procurement support activities, including scope definition, technical specifications, bidder engagement, technical review, and delivery coordination.
  • Support the maintenance of design intent during project delivery and help resolve technical and interface issues.

Profile/Skills

Education: Accredited degree in Architecture, Engineering, or a related discipline

Years of experience: Minimum 5 years of experience in major infrastructure or other complex multidisciplinary projects.

Technical competencies:

  • Professional Engineer (P.Eng.) or Registered Architect, or eligibility for registration in Canada.
  • Experience in station design, transportation infrastructure, or other complex building and infrastructure projects.
  • Experience working in multidisciplinary project environments.
  • Strong understanding of design coordination and project delivery for complex infrastructure or building projects.
  • Knowledge of construction documents, technical specifications, and multidisciplinary building systems.
  • Familiarity with structural, MEP, utilities, fire/life safety, vertical transportation, and systems integration principles.
  • Understanding of interfaces between buildings, civil infrastructure, utilities, operations, maintenance, safety, and regulatory requirements.
  • Knowledge of passenger flow, operational integration, multimodal connectivity, sustainability, and climate resilience principles is an asset.
  • Familiarity with BIM, digital engineering, interface management, and configuration control.
  • Clear verbal and written communication skills, both in French and in English*

*Reasons for requiring bilingualism: You will have the opportunity to work with a varied clientele, including both French- and English-speaking companies. Bilingualism is therefore fundamental to building strong relationships with our customers, understanding their specific needs, communicating effectively in their preferred language and facilitating strategic meetings.

Personal and soft skills :

  • Strong coordination and organizational skills.
  • Ability to synthesize complex multidisciplinary information.
  • Clear and professional communication with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Sound judgment, accountability, and a proactive approach to problem-solving.
  • Ability to work effectively in fast-paced project environments.
  • Collaborative mindset and ability to support integrated team delivery.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office and other standard business software tools.

title: Tech Architect Practitioner
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Tech Architect Practitioner based in France.

This is a senior technical consulting role focused on helping investors, portfolio companies, and technology leaders make effective architecture decisions that support measurable business outcomes. You will lead complex architecture engagements across applications, cloud, infrastructure, integration, data, security, and software delivery. The role combines deep technical expertise with strategic thinking, requiring you to translate business priorities into pragmatic and scalable technology solutions. You will assess current technology environments, define target architectures, identify risks and constraints, and establish practical transition roadmaps. You will work closely with senior technology and business stakeholders, communicating complex technical topics with clarity and confidence. The environment is collaborative, fast-moving, and focused on solving complex technology challenges through practical, evidence-based recommendations.

Accountabilities

  • Lead technical architecture workstreams across complex client engagements, assessing applications, infrastructure, cloud environments, integration patterns, data platforms, and technical constraints.
  • Define pragmatic target-state architectures that align business priorities with application, infrastructure, data, security, scalability, resilience, and delivery requirements.
  • Advise clients on technology platform and architecture decisions, including cloud platforms, application modernisation, infrastructure, integration, software delivery tooling, data platforms, and analytics environments.
  • Translate business and technology requirements into clear architecture principles, technical designs, transition approaches, and delivery priorities.
  • Develop and present architecture recommendations that are credible to senior technology leaders while remaining accessible and actionable for non-technical stakeholders.
  • Identify technical risks, dependencies, technical debt, architectural constraints, and delivery challenges, recommending practical mitigation strategies.
  • Collaborate with client teams and multidisciplinary specialists to ensure architecture decisions support product, engineering, cloud, security, data, and broader transformation objectives.
  • Challenge assumptions and pressure-test proposed designs, balancing strategic ambition with cost, complexity, resilience, and time to value.
  • Develop prioritised technology roadmaps that help clients move from current-state limitations toward scalable, resilient, and fit-for-purpose technology capabilities.

    • Requirements

    • Significant experience in technical, solutions, or enterprise architecture, software engineering, or related technical leadership roles, with a proven track record of designing and delivering complex technology solutions.
    • Strong practical knowledge of modern technology architectures and platforms, including cloud services, application architecture, infrastructure, integration patterns, software delivery practices, security, and reliability.
    • Demonstrated experience assessing existing technology estates and defining target-state architectures, transition strategies, and delivery roadmaps.
    • Strong understanding of cloud technologies, security, resilience, observability, performance, scalability, and operational considerations.
    • Meaningful expertise in data architecture and modern data platforms, including data warehouses, data lakes, lakehouses, integration patterns, data modelling, data governance, data quality, and analytics.
    • Ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, practical recommendations for senior business, data, and technology stakeholders.
    • Credibility when working with senior technology leaders, including CTOs, CIOs, CDOs, Heads of Engineering, Heads of Data, and enterprise architects.
    • Experience across the full technology lifecycle, from architecture and platform design through software delivery, deployment, operations, modernisation, and continuous improvement.

The IMT SC Large Program AI and Data Platform Lead is responsible for overseeing the design, development, testing, deployment and management of enterprise technology AI products and IMSC integrated data platform. This role leads work across multiple Technology Product and Platform Management families, with accountability for AI end‑user applications, and AI‑enabled platforms supporting the IMSC Transcend program. The Manager ensures alignment between business objectives, AI‑ready data maturity enabled by SAP BDC and AI capabilities enabled by SAP Joule, and scalable technology solutions integrated with broader IMSC Data and AI platforms (Aspire.ai) , while driving measurable business outcomes through disciplined software engineering, platform governance, and innovation.

Scope of Responsibilities

• Design, develop, test, and manage technology products and platforms, including enterprise applications, systems software, mobile/web solutions, databases, and AI/data platforms.
• Lead requirements analysis and high‑level solution design by converting internal and external customer needs into scalable software and platform architectures.
• Define and govern overall solution structures, core elements, interfaces, dependencies, and non‑functional requirements across complex technology landscapes.

• Direct planning and execution of software and platform testing strategies, including automation, risk tracking, defect analysis, and quality reporting.

• Manage work across multiple Technology Product and Platform Management families, ensuring prioritization, dependency alignment, and consistent delivery standards.

AI, Data, and Platform Leadership

• Lead engineering and operationalization of AI‑enabled products (SAP Joule), decision intelligence solutions, and data platforms (SAP BDC) integrated with SAP and IMSC ecosystems.
• Align AI capabilities with data maturity to ensure deterministic and auditable business outcomes.
• Define platform strategy, architecture decisions, and build/buy/blend approaches in partnership with enterprise architecture and business AI leadership.
• Ensure responsible AI practices including data privacy, security, explainability, fairness, and regulatory compliance.

Governance, Risk, and Compliance

• Establish and enforce technology, data, and AI governance frameworks across product and platform portfolios.
• Ensure compliance with regulatory and ethical standards (e.g., GDPR, CCPA, EU AI Act).
• Track and report technology and delivery risks throughout development and testing lifecycles.

People, Portfolio, and Financial Management

• Lead, mentor, and develop multidisciplinary engineering, data, and AI teams.
• Manage complex portfolios with accountability for delivery, value realization, and budget outcomes.
• Drive AI literacy, change management, and workforce enablement across the Transcend program.

Education:

Bachelor's or master's degree in information technology, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Engineering, or related field; equivalent experience considered.

Required :
  • 8+ years of IT experience, including 3 years in SAP ,AI, Data and Analytics
  • Hands‑on experience with SAP BDC, SAP BTP and Integration suite
  • Practical experience delivering Agentic AI solutions using SAP Joule and/or Microsoft Copilot.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills.


Preferred :

  • Experience in Vectorization of enterprise data

title: Senior Database Administrator
description:
• Computer Systems Officer Level 5
  • Temporary Full-Time up 30 June 2029
  • Parramatta


About us

The NSW Police Force (NSWPF) is one of the largest police forces in the western world, with more than 20,000 employees, including more than 4,000 administrative employees who support the sworn officers that provide a range of law and order services 24 hours a day, seven days a week to the socially, geographically and culturally diverse community of NSW.

About the role

We are seeking an experienced Senior Database Administrator to join our database support team. In this role, you will provide 24x7 support for NSWPF’s mission‑critical systems across multiple database technologies, ensuring the performance, availability, and security of databases platforms.

To be successful in this role, you will have hands-on experience with at least two of the following database technologies\: Oracle, SQL Server, Informix, and Adabas. While your level of expertise may vary across these platforms, you should be capable of supporting and working across a diverse range of database technologies and environments.

Key Responsibilities of the Role\:

  • Plan, schedule, and apply database patches, upgrades, and routine maintenance activities.
  • Diagnose and resolve complex database issues promptly; escalate unresolved problems to vendors to minimize downtime.
  • Monitor database performance and implement tuning strategies to optimize system efficiency.
  • Provide technical support for incident resolution and problem management.
  • Support and participate in disaster recovery planning, testing, and execution.
  • Implement and maintain robust backup, recovery, and disaster recovery procedures.
  • Perform day-to-day support and administration of multiple database environments, ensuring their stability, reliability, and optimal performance.
  • Participate in on-call roster to provide 24 hours/7 days per week support for database systems to maintain high availability and system resiliency.
  • Maintain system documentation, standards, and procedures.

To be successful in this role, you will have\:

  • Extensive experience in day-to-day management and administration of at least two of these database systems – Oracle, SQL Server, Informix and Adabas.
  • Demonstrated experience in supporting mission critical, high availability systems including participation in a 24/7 on-call support roster to ensure continuous database availability.
  • Extensive experience and expertise in database performance tuning, monitoring, and optimization.
  • Demonstrated experience in planning, scheduling, and applying database patches, upgrades, and routine maintenance activities.
  • Highly experienced in diagnosing and resolving complex database issues including incident resolution and problem management.
  • Demonstrated experience in implementing high-availability database system.
  • Demonstrated experience in disaster recovery planning, testing, and execution.
  • Demonstrated experience in planning, implementing, and maintaining robust database backup and recovery procedures.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to engage technical and non-technical stakeholders.

View the relevant role description for more information on this role (e.g essential requirements, key accountabilities, key challenges and capabilities required for the role).

What we can offer you

At NSWPF our people have access to a range of benefits that help balance life at work and at home. Some of the benefits available when you join the NSWPF include\:

  • competitive salary;
  • flexible work options;
  • opportunity to purchase leave;
  • annual leave loading;
  • corporate wellbeing programs including seminars and the Fitness Passport;
  • free annual influenza vaccination;
  • salary packaging options via superannuation contributions or a novated vehicle lease;
  • convenient location for public transport and to shops etc; and
  • in-house gym facilities.

How to Apply

Applications can only be submitted electronically via the I Work for NSW website.

To be considered for this role, attach a cover letter (2 pages maximum) and an up-to-date resume that clearly details your skills & experience as relevant to this role.

Please do not attach copies of qualifications, certificates or documentation (other than what has been requested) - you can bring these if called for interview.

Your application must stand on its own merits, and the completeness and relevance of your application will determine if you proceed through to the selection process.

If you require any further information about this opportunity, please contact the hiring manager Devi Mishra via 0404 067 886.

To be eligible to apply for this role, you must meet one of the following statuses\:

  • an Australian Citizen;
  • a permanent resident of Australia; or
  • a New Zealand citizen.

Prior to commencement, the successful candidate will be required to undergo a rigorous National Police (criminal history) Check and obtain and maintain a Security Clearance as determined by the NSW Police Force.

Our commitment to Diversity

At the NSW Police Force, we are proud to be an employer of a diverse range of people. We are committed to reflecting the diverse community we serve and creating an inclusive and respectful workplace for all employees where differences are embraced, contributions are valued, and everyone has a sense of connection and belonging.

We welcome applications from individuals with diverse skills, experiences, and backgrounds including Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples, LGBTQIA+ individuals, people with disability, neurodiverse individuals, those from culturally and linguistically diverse communities, and people of all ages.

We understand that the recruitment journey may present unique challenges. If you\:

  • Identify as Aboriginal or Torres Strait Islander and would like support with your application, please contact the NSWPF Aboriginal Employment & Engagement team at PCC-AEET@police.nsw.gov.au
  • Identify as a person with disability and require further information on the role or adjustments to participate in the recruitment process, please contact the Inclusion & Diversity team at PCC-INCLUSION@police.nsw.gov.au
  • Are transgender or gender diverse and want to learn more about our support options, please contact the Inclusion & Diversity team at PCC-INCLUSION@police.nsw.gov.au

This recruitment may be used to create a Talent Pool for similar future roles (ongoing or temporary) that may arise over the next 18 months.

For more information on applying for roles with the NSW Police Force click here

For Technical assistance please contact\: taleosupportexterna@police.nsw.gov.au (Please include the word Taleo in the subject line)

Thank you for your interest in this role. We look forward to receiving your application.

title: Medicinsk Sekreterare, Geriatriskt centrum, Umeå
description:
Region Västerbotten arbetar för att god hälsa och hållbar utveckling ska stärka varandra. Vi tar ansvar för en jämlik välfärd och för att forskning och innovation ger resultat.

Geriatriskt centrum är en specialistklinik för patienter med behov av både akut och planerad geriatrisk vård och rehabilitering. En bred bedömning av den äldre patientens medicinska, fysiska, psykiska och sociala funktionsförmåga vid sjukdom utförs av interprofessionella team. Diagnostik, behandling och rehabilitering bedrivs i sluten- och öppenvård med patientens individuella behov i fokus.

Nu söker vi en medicinsk sekreterare för en tillsvidareanställning - Är det dig vi söker?

Tillträde enligt överenskommelse. 

Urval och intervjuer sker löpande så välkommen med din ansökan så snart du kan!

1 plats(er). 

ARBETSUPPGIFTER
Som medicinsk sekreterare hos oss ger du viktig service och möjliggör insatser som påverkar många.

Arbetet hos oss innebär bland annat journalskrivning, patientadministration, receptionsarbete, hantering av remisser, journaler och 1177. Beroende på din kompetensprofil och ditt intresse, kan andra uppdrag tilldelas som möjliggör fortsatt utveckling av vår verksamhet.

Vi har nära samarbete med andra medarbetare och avdelningar inom Geriatriskt centrum och du kommer att ingå i ett team med erfarna medicinska sekreterare. Arbetet innebär även att ge god service till kollegor.

KVALIFIKATIONER
Vi söker dig som är utbildad medicinsk sekreterare eller vårdadministratör. Har du tidigare yrkeserfarenhet och/eller erfarenhet av receptionistarbete och diagnosklassificering är det meriterande. Information och kommunikation är en stor del av jobbet och du behöver därför ha goda kunskaper i det svenska språket.

Du är en självgående person som tar ansvar för dina arbetsuppgifter på ett strukturerat sätt. Ditt förhållningssätt är serviceinriktat, vilket innebär att du är lyhörd och bemöter både kollegor och patienter på ett hjälpsamt sätt. Du lägger stor vikt vid att hålla en hög kvalitet i ditt arbete, till exempel vid diktatskrivning. Eftersom vi arbetar i team nära många andra kollegor och olika yrkesgrupper är det viktigt att du har en god samarbetsförmåga.

Stor vikt kommer att läggas vid personlig lämplighet.

title: Vulnerability Management Specialist
description:
Description

At AppFolio, we paddle as one. We ride and make waves together, with a relentless focus on building great products for the way our customers work and live today – and tomorrow. AppFolio is a destination organization where careers are made and accelerated. Here, innovation is a team sport.

As a Vulnerability Management Specialist, you will contribute to security initiatives and work on high-impact projects as a member of the security engineering team. You will provide expertise and support to your team members in your areas of strength. Staying abreast of industry trends and technology is key to this role, and you will actively seek to continue to develop your skills and competencies with our support.

Success in this role requires a strong passion for computer, network, and application security. Experience in vulnerability management at a Software-as-a-Service company is preferred.

Your impact

  • You will validate, prioritize, communicate, and track vulnerabilities to continuously improve the overall security posture of AppFolio technology systems and applications.

  • You will respond to emerging threats and potential security events as 0-day vulnerabilities are released.

  • You will work to ensure compliance with our vulnerability management policies, processes, and procedures, and drive the adoption of emerging industry best practices.

  • You will help streamline the vulnerability management process through the use of Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, and automation, improving the end-to-end process and reducing the time-to-action for known vulnerabilities.

  • Through an exceptional vulnerability management program, you will build trust and confidence with our customers and partners.

Qualifications

  • BS in Computer Science or a related technical discipline, or equivalent industry experience

  • Cybersecurity-relevant certifications, such as but not limited to GCIA, GCIH, CEH, CISSP, CISM, or OSCP

  • Project management-relevant certifications, such as but not limited to CAPM or PMP

Must have

  • 2-5 years of experience in a related cybersecurity role, preferably with a focus on Vulnerability Management, Penetration Testing, or Incident Response.

  • Ability to write scripts in Ruby, Python, or other scripting languages

  • Hands-on experience with Vulnerability Management tools such as DefectDojo, Invicti, Wiz, or Cycode.

  • Hands-on experience with manual testing tools, especially validating vulnerabilities

  • Understanding the capabilities and limitations of SAST, DAST, SCA, and pen test tools.

  • Proficiency in various operating systems (Linux, MacOS, Windows)

  • Ability to assess security risks associated with vulnernabilities and prioritize them using existing frameworks like CVSS, accounting for local environmental factors.

  • Strong communication skills and an ability to explain complex security issues to technical and non-technical stakeholders

  • Ability to maintain strict organization while overseeing complex security findings, applying structured project-style oversight to guide multiple simultaneous vulnerabilities to remediation or risk acceptance.

Nice to Have

  • Hands-on experience with network protocol vulnerabilities

  • Experience identifying and managing vulnerabilities during CI/CD

  • Hands-on experience in cloud environments (AWS, GCP, Azure)

  • Hands-on experience with Burp Suite and Tenable or similar

  • Hands-on experience with Metasploit Framework or similar

Compensation & Benefits

The compensation that we reasonably expect to pay for this role is: $104,000 - $130,000 base pay. The actual compensation for this role will be determined by a variety of factors, including but not limited to the candidate’s skills, education, experience, and internal equity.

Please note that compensation is just one aspect of a comprehensive Total Rewards package. The compensation range listed here does not include additional benefits or any discretionary bonuses you may be eligible for based on your role and/or employment type.

Regular full-time employees are eligible for benefits - see here.

Grow | We enable a culture of high performance, where delivering results is recognized by opportunities for growth and compelling total rewards. Our challenging and meaningful work drive the growth of our business, and ourselves.

We do this by innovating with purpose while cultivating a culture of impact. We learn as much from each other as we do our customers and our communities.
