title: Commercial Reviewer
description:
HOW YOU’LL MAKE A DIFFERENCE:

This Commercial Reviewer fills a remote role (work from home) in MountainSeed’s Appraisal Review Department. The Commercial Reviewer will be performing Standard 3 and 4 appraisal reviews for commercial properties. The appraisal reviews are conducted on MountainSeed’s review form. The scope of work consists of a desk review and does not include an opinion of value and there is no confirmation of data. All communications, including uploading and downloading of reports, occurs via email or our web portal. There is no printing, mailing, hard copies, etc.

IN THIS ROLE, YOU’LL GET TO:

  • Perform detailed technical and compliance reviews on commercial real estate appraisals, USPAP Standards 3 & 4
  • Ensure that valuations are reasonably supported, credible and compliant with federal and state regulations, USPAP, FIRREA, bank policies and guidelines, and industry standards
  • Ensuring all communication is conducted in ValuTrac system
  • Communicate with appraisers for any report corrections and/or revisions
  • Evaluate appraiser quality of work and provide feedback for maintenance of the Bank’s appraisal panel
  • Respond to inquiries from production staff, underwriters, and members of management regarding review decisions to resolve issues
  • Provide support to all areas of real estate lending as needed; demonstrate superior customer service to appraisers and employees
  • Attend ongoing training for Commercial Real Estate Appraisal and Appraisal Reviews
  • Attend Weekly team meetings

THIS OPPORTUNITY IS FOR YOU IF YOU HAVE/ARE:

  • At least ten (10) years of commercial real-estate appraisal review experience working with or for regulated financial institutions
  • Bachelor’s degree in accounting, finance, economics or related field
  • Certified General Appraiser
  • Familiarity with Commercial Real Estate Appraisal terminology and the appropriate application of appraisal valuation techniques, appraisal methodology and understanding of appraisal theory.
  • Knowledge of commercial mortgage operations.
  • Attention to detail for the identification of Errors and Omissions.
  • Manage difficult problems involving multiple facets and variables in non-standardized situations.
  • Successfully prioritize work assignments of varying complexities, track progress of said assignments, demonstrate strong organizational skills and complete work within established deadlines.
  • Software proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and Outlook.
  • Establish and maintain effective and professional working relationships.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills.
  • Maintain confidentiality.

WHAT WE OFFER:3 weeks of PTO, 13 company paid holidays, paid parental leave, and a flexible work environment. Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, Disability, and 401K plans begin the first of the month after 30 days of employment.

OUR PURPOSEis to provide opportunities that help people thrive using their God-given abilities.

OUR CORE VALUES:

  • Be a Self-Starter.Continuously seek ways to improve yourself and the business, take responsibility, and act with urgency to solve problems.
  • Be a Team Player.Prioritize team success over individual achievements, support your colleagues, and contribute to creating high-performing teams.
  • Be a Patriot. Focus on the greater good of the organization, be honest about what’s working, and passionately work towards making the company better.
  • Do it Right.Uphold high standards and integrity, even when no one is watching, and always aim to do the right thing.
  • Be Humble. Lead by serving others, value diverse perspectives, and remain open to new ideas and feedback.

WHAT WE DO:

As the largest commercial real estate services marketplace in the nation, MountainSeed MarketPlaceoffers a comprehensive range of appraisal management, review services, and more. MountainSeed Analyticsplatform provides real-time, accurate real estate data insights, helping clients make informed decisions in markets across the U.S. MountainSeed’s Capital Markets Solutions including Loan Sale Advisory and Sale Leaseback Programs assist in enhancing an institution’s financial health.

MountainSeed is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, disability, veteran status, pregnancy, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Inspector - QC I
description:
Quality Inspector
Location: Fort Worth Alliance, TX Department: Quality Assurance Reports To: QA Supervisor Employment Type: Full-Time Position Summary
The Quality Inspector is responsible for inspecting and testing manufactured products, documenting defects, and verifying corrective actions in the production process. This role works closely with production staff, engineers, and other departments to ensure compliance with quality standards and drive continuous improvement. Key Responsibilities
•
Inspection and Testing: Conduct regular inspections and tests on PCBA and other components to ensure compliance with quality standards and specifications.
•
Defect Identification: Identify and document defects or issues in the manufacturing process and products.
•
Corrective Actions: Verify the implementation of corrective actions to address identified defects and prevent recurrence.
•
Continuous Improvement: Participate in KAIZEN projects and other initiatives to enhance manufacturing processes and product quality.
•
Training and Guidance: Provide training and guidance to production staff on quality standards and procedures.
•
Record Keeping: Maintain accurate records of inspections, tests, and corrective actions.
•
Reporting: Prepare reports on quality issues and improvements for management review.
•
Scheduling QC Personnel: Plan and coordinate QC staffing schedules to ensure adequate coverage across production lines and shifts.
•
Audit and Inspection Accuracy: Ensure QC auditors and inspectors perform inspections accurately and in compliance with SOPs and quality requirements.
•
Initial Investigation: Support initial investigation of process or product abnormalities and assist in root cause identification.
•
Overtime Arrangement: Coordinate overtime schedules for QC staff as needed.

After appointments have been made using this locational appointment process, any remaining candidates who met the benchmark for the role will remain on a locational reserve list in accordance with their preferences for 12 months.

Please only indicate preferences where you are prepared to work. If you are subsequently offered a role from the reserve list for a location preference indicated in your application and decline it, you will be removed from the reserve list for the vacancy, across all locational preferences.

All offers of employment will be made strictly in merit order, based on your performance throughout the recruitment process. Candidates at the top of the merit list will be offered vacancies as they arise in their chosen locations.

The addresses listed in the job advertisement are not an exhaustive list of potential base locations, they give an indication of some of the potential locations you could be based at.

Once you have accepted an offer for a role, you will be withdrawn from any other live applications for the same role and will no longer be considered for those vacancies.

We will therefore endeavour to offer you a vacancy within a 60-minute commute of your home location.

New entrants to the Civil Service will be expected to join at the entry point salary for the advertised band.

Existing Civil Servants will have their salary calculated in accordance with the Departments pay on transfer / pay on promotion rules.

The post is currently advertised without VISOR Vetting to enable appointment to take place as soon as possible, however, VISOR vetting will be required to be completed post offer.

Working Arrangements & Further Information

The MoJ offers Hybrid Working arrangements where business need allows. This is an informal, non-contractual form of flexible working that blends working from your base location, different MoJ sites and / or from home (please be aware that this role can only be worked in the UK and not overseas). Some roles will not be suitable for Hybrid Working. Similarly, Hybrid Working will not suit everyone’s circumstances. Arrangements will be discussed and agreed with the successful candidate(s) and subject to regular review.

For nationally advertised roles, the successful candidate(s) will be appointed to a MoJ office location, which may include their nearest Justice Collaboration Centre or Justice Satellite Office. This will be discussed and agreed on the completion of pre-employment checks.

Some of MoJ’s terms and conditions of service are changing as part of Civil Service reform. The changes will apply to staff joining MoJ who are new to the Civil Service. Staff joining MoJ from other civil service employers will transfer onto the new MoJ terms if they are already on 'modernised' terms in their current post or onto 'unmodernised' MoJ terms if they are on 'unmodernised' terms at their current post. Details will be available if an offer is made.

Standard full time working hours are 37 hours per week excluding breaks which are unpaid. HMPPS welcomes part-time, flexible and job-sharing working patterns, where they meet the demands of the role and business needs. All applications for part-time, flexible and job-sharing working patterns will be considered in accordance with the HMPPS’ Flexible Working policy.

Benefits

The MoJ offers a range of benefits:

Annual Leave

Annual leave is 25 days on appointment and will increase to 30 days after five years’ service, plus public holidays. Leave for part-time and job share posts will be calculated on a pro-rata basis

Pension

The National Probation Service is covered by the Local Government Pension Scheme (LGPS) run through the Greater Manchester Pension Fund (GMPF). Please visit www.gmpf.org.uk for further information.

Please note: Any current Civil Servant who is a member of the PCSPS, by accepting an offer of employment to the National Probation Services will be opted out of the PCSPS and auto enrolled into the Local Government Pension Scheme.

Training

The Ministry of Justice is committed to staff development and offers an extensive range of training and development opportunities.

Networks

The opportunity to join employee-run networks that have been established to provide advice and support and to enable the views of employees from minority groups to be expressed direct to senior management. There are currently networks for employees of minority ethnic origin, employees with disabilities, employees with caring responsibilities, women employees, and lesbian, gay, bisexual and transgender.

Eligibility

All candidates are subject to security and identity checks prior to taking up post

Support

  • A range of ‘Family Friendly’ policies such as opportunities to work reduced hours or job share.
  • Access to flexible benefits such as voluntary benefits, retail vouchers and discounts on a range of goods and services.
  • For moves to or from another employer or moves across the Civil Service this can have implications on your eligibility to carry on claiming childcare vouchers. You may however be eligible for alternative government childcare support schemes, including Tax Free Childcare. More information can be found on or Childcare Choices. You can determine your eligibility at .
  • Paid paternity, adoption and maternity leave.
  • Free annual sight tests for employees who use computer screens.

Working for the Civil Service

The Civil Service Code sets out the standards of behaviour expected of civil servants.

We recruit by merit on the basis of fair and open competition, as outlined in the Civil Service Commission's recruitment principles. Should you feel that the recruitment process has breached the recruitment principles you are able to raise a formal complaint in the following order

  • To Transformative Business Services (0345 241 5358 (Monday to Friday 8am - 6pm) or e mail moj-recruitment-vetting-enquiries@resourcing.soprasteria.co.uk);
  • To Ministry of Justice Resourcing team (resourcing-management-office@justice.gov.uk);
  • To the Civil Service Commission (details available here)

As a Disability Confident employer, MoJ are committed to providing everyone with the opportunity to demonstrate their skills, talent and abilities, by making adjustments throughout all elements of the recruitment process and in the workplace. MoJ are able to offer an interview to disabled candidates who meet the minimum selection criteria, except in a limited number of campaigns.

You will be able to request reasonable adjustments to the recruitment process within the application form. If you need additional help completing the application form, please contact the TBS Recruitment Enquiries Team.

For more information on applying for a role as a candidate with a disability or long-term condition, please watch our animated videos.

Diversity & Inclusion

The Civil Service is committed to attract, retain and invest in talent wherever it is found. To learn more please see the Civil Service People Plan and the Civil Service Diversity and Inclusion Strategy.

A Great Place to Work for Veterans

The "Making the Civil Service a Great Place to work for veterans" initiative includes a guaranteed interview scheme to those who meet the minimum criteria to provide eligible former members of the Armed Forces with opportunities to secure rewarding jobs. Allowing veterans to continue to serve their country, and to bring highly skilled individuals with a broad range of experience into the Civil Service in an environment, which recognises and values your previous service in the Armed Forces.
For further details about the initiative and eligibility requirements visit:

Redeployment Interview Scheme

Civil Service departments are expected to explore redeployment opportunities before making an individual redundant. The MoJ is committed, as part of the Redeployment Interview Scheme, to providing opportunities to those who are 'at risk of redundancy'.

MoJ is able to offer an interview to eligible candidates who meet the minimum selection criteria, except in a limited number of campaigns. Candidates will not be eligible for the Redeployment Interview Scheme if they are applying on promotion.

Civil Service Nationality Rules

This job is broadly open to the following groups:

  • UK nationals
  • nationals of the Republic of Ireland
  • nationals of Commonwealth countries who have the right to work in the UK
  • nationals of the EU, Switzerland, Norway, Iceland or Liechtenstein and family members of those nationalities with settled or pre-settled status under the European Union Settlement Scheme (EUSS) (opens in a new window) https://www.gov.uk/settled-status-eu-citizens-families

  • individuals with limited leave to remain or indefinite leave to remain who were eligible to apply for EUSS on or before 31 December 2020
  • Turkish nationals, and certain family members of Turkish nationals, who have accrued the right to work in the Civil Service

Further information on nationality requirements (opens in a new window) https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/nationality-rules

Reserve list

A reserve list may be held for up to 12 months from which further appointments may be made for the same or similar roles.

title: Staff Product Designer, Core Treatments
description:
Hims & Hers is the leading health and wellness platform, on a mission to help the world feel great through the power of better health. We are redefining healthcare by putting the customer first and delivering access to care that is affordable, accessible, and personal, from diagnosis to treatment to delivery. No two people are the same, so we provide access to personalized care designed for results. By normalizing health & wellness challenges and innovating on their solutions, we’re making better health outcomes easier to achieve.

Hims & Hers is a public company, traded on the NYSE under the ticker symbol “HIMS.” To learn more about the brand and offerings, you can visit and . For information on the company’s outstanding benefits, culture, and its talent-first flexible/remote work approach, see below and visit .

About the Role:

This is one of the most consequential design roles on the team. Core treatments—sexual health, testosterone, hair loss, and labs—are categories where trust is everything, and where good design changes whether someone asks for help at all. We're looking for a Staff Product Designer who understands that and brings the skill, judgment, and range to act on it.

You'll own the end-to-end experience across these categories: the intake flows, the treatment journeys, the moments of reassurance, and the points where someone decides to stay or leave. You'll work closely with Product, Engineering, Clinical, and Research—and you'll be expected to lead, not just execute. That means shaping the problem before the brief is written, pushing back when something isn't right, and setting the bar for what "good" looks like on your surface.

We also want someone who is genuinely curious about AI—not as a talking point, but as a working tool. How you use AI in your process, your prototyping, your research synthesis—that matters to us.

You Will:

  • Own the design of core treatment categories from end to end—intake through ongoing care—with a clear point of view on what each experience should feel like

  • Lead large, complex initiatives autonomously. Define the problem, set the direction, bring the team along

  • Translate clinical complexity into experiences that feel clear, calm, and human—not clinical. These are sensitive categories. The design has to earn trust quickly

  • Use AI tools actively in your workflow: faster prototyping, richer research synthesis, generative ideation, interaction exploration. We're not prescriptive about which tools—we care that you're experimenting and finding what works

  • Push the standard of what's possible. Not just "this flow works"—but "this experience is something people won't forget”

  • Partner with Product, Engineering, Research, and Clinical to navigate hard tradeoffs. Be the person who makes the work better by being in the room

  • Contribute to design systems and shared patterns. Your work should raise the floor for the whole team

  • Mentor and shape the culture of the design org. Lead by example on craft, process, and how to give feedback

You Have:

  • 8+ years in product design on consumer-facing products, with clear examples of owning complex, high-stakes experiences end to end

  • Holistic design thinking—you move fluidly between system-level strategy and pixel-level craft. Neither bores you

  • Strong UX instincts in sensitive or high-trust contexts—health, finance, identity. You know how to design for someone who is nervous or uncertain

  • AI fluency as a practitioner. You're already using AI tools in your daily process—for prototyping, ideation, or research synthesis—and you have opinions about what's actually useful versus hype

  • Exceptional communication. You can walk a room through a hard design decision and make them understand why

  • Expert Figma proficiency. Fast, clean, and systematic

  • Comfort with ambiguity and a bias toward doing. You don't wait for perfect briefs

Nice to Have:

  • Experience in telehealth, pharma, or healthcare—especially categories with stigma or emotional weight.

  • Background in 0–1 product building at a startup.

  • Hands-on experience building or evaluating AI-powered product features—not just using AI as a workflow tool.

Our Benefits (there are more but here are some highlights):

  • Competitive salary & equity compensation for full-time roles

  • Unlimited PTO, company holidays, and quarterly mental health days

  • Comprehensive health benefits including medical, dental & vision, and parental leave

  • Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP)

  • 401k benefits with employer matching contribution

  • Offsite team retreats

We are committed to building a workforce that reflects diverse perspectives and prioritizes ethics, wellness, and a strong sense of belonging. If you're excited about this role, we encourage you to apply—even if you're not sure if your background or experience is a perfect match.

title: Fysioterapeut til Regional Afdeling for Retspsykiatri
description:
Vil du bruge din faglighed aktivt og være med til at skabe meningsfulde forløb for patienter i retspsykiatrien? Retspsykiatrisk Afdeling SL9 i Slagelse søger en engageret fysioterapeut, der brænder for kropsterapi, sundhedsfremme og relationelt arbejde. Her får du mulighed for at gøre en reel forskel i et specialiseret felt, hvor både faglighed og menneskelighed er afgørende.

Om stillingen

Som fysioterapeut på SL9 bliver du en central del af et tværfagligt team, hvor du arbejder tæt sammen med sygeplejersker, ergoterapeuter, psykologer, læger og socialfaglige medarbejdere. Du kommer til at arbejde med patienter med komplekse psykiatriske problemstillinger, hvor fysisk aktivitet, kropsbevidsthed og motivation er vigtige elementer i behandlingen.

Dine primære opgaver

  • Individuelle og gruppebaserede fysioterapeutiske forløb
  • Kropsterapeutiske tilgange, der understøtter mental trivsel og kropslig regulering
  • Sundhedsfremmende og sygdomsforebyggende indsatser
  • Motivationsarbejde med patienter, der ofte har begrænset erfaring med fysisk aktivitet
  • Aktiv deltagelse i hverdagen – du skal kunne lide at bruge dig selv fysisk i arbejdet
  • Samarbejde om helhedsorienterede behandlingsplaner
  • Dokumentation og faglig sparring

Vi søger dig, der

  • er uddannet fysioterapeut
  • har interesse for – eller erfaring med – psykiatri og kropsterapi
  • motiveres af at arbejde med sundhedsfremme og sygdomsforebyggelse
  • trives med at være fysisk aktiv og bruge kroppen som et professionelt redskab
  • kan tage en årlig livredderprøve
  • har en stærk relationel tilgang og kan skabe tryghed og struktur
  • er tålmodig, robust og god til at motivere mennesker med komplekse udfordringer
  • gerne har interesse for gaming, som kan være en værdifuld indgang til relation og aktivitet

Vi tilbyder

  • et stærkt fagligt miljø med både mono- og tværfaglig sparring
  • daglige refleksioner, hvor der er plads til faglig undren, læring og udvikling
  • et godt arbejdsmiljø med medbestemmelse, humor og kollegial støtte
  • mulighed for kompetenceudvikling og specialisering
  • en arbejdsdag med både struktur, variation og plads til at sætte dit præg

Om afdelingen

Retspsykiatrisk Afdeling SL9 er en del af Psykiatrien Region Sjælland og modtager patienter indlagt under retslige foranstaltninger. Vi arbejder recovery-orienteret og vægter relationer, tryghed og meningsfulde aktiviteter højt.

Retspsykiatrien

Retspsykiatrien i Region Sjælland består af fem lukkede afsnit med i alt 62 pladser, den højt specialiserede Sikringsafdeling med i alt 35 pladser og Retspsykiatrisk Ambulatorie Slagelse, hvor der er tilknyttet 150 patienter.

Patienter er indlagt af undersøgelses-, behandlingsmæssige og/eller sikkerhedsmæssige årsager. Vi modtager patienter, der har en anbringelses- eller behandlingsdom, en kendelse om mentalobservation under indlæggelse eller er anbragt i varetægtssurrogat.

Vores rammer gør det muligt at tilbyde en meningsfyldt og sammenhængende behandling, der skaber trivsel for både patienter og personale.

Retspsykiatrien er en del af Psykiatrien i Region Sjælland, hvor kompleksiteten og udfordringerne gør afsnittene til noget særligt. Der er særlig bevågenhed i forhold til at opkvalificere personalet og derfor også gode muligheder for efter- og videreuddannelse. Sikkerheden vægtes højt – det er fundamentet for det videre relations arbejde, der er det bærende element i behandlingen.

Ansættelsesvilkår

  • Stillingen er på 37 timer pr. uge, ønskes lavere time antal bedes dette anført. Du skal forvente og have 2 sene vagter om ugen, ligesom du arbejder hver 4 weekend.
  • Tiltrædelse er pr 1/12 2026 eller efter aftale.
  • Ansøgningsfrist er 8/10 2026 og samtaler afholdes i uge 43 den 20/10 2026.

Stillingen er omfattet af overenskomst for ikke-ledende ergoterapeuter, fysioterapeuter og jordemødre (33.21.1)

Vil du være med?

Send din ansøgning, CV, uddannelsesbevis og relevante kursusbeviser via Region Sjællands rekrutteringssystem.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte:

Oversygeplejerske Maibritt Vadstrup tlf.: 9356 6889, eller

Fysioterapeut Nanna Krause tlf.: 9357 6697 eller

Fysioterapeut Lasse Hansen tlf.: 9356 7982

Ansættelsen er betinget af modtagelse af tilfredsstillende straffeattest til offentligt brug

Ansættelsesområde

Region Sjælland og Region Hovedstaden bliver den 1. januar 2027 til Region Østdanmark som følge af sundhedsreformen. Dit ansættelsesområde vil være Region Østdanmark med alle tilhørende organisatoriske enheder.
Læs mere om betydningen af ansættelsesområdet på Region Østdanmarks hjemmeside.

Startløn for overenskomstansatte

Regionen er forpligtet til at oplyse dig om startlønnen for stillingen. Du får oplyst grundløn, centralt fastsatte tillæg og pension i den relevante overenskomst. Udover startlønnen, kan lønnen indeholde eventuelt forhandlede tillæg afhængigt af stillingen, dine erfaringer og kvalifikationer.
Se startlønnen på regionens hjemmeside

Om Midt- og Vestsjællands Hospital

På Midt- og Vestsjællands Hospital arbejder vi hver dag for at fremme det sunde liv ved at forebygge og behandle i en sammenhængende sundhedsindsats. Som hospital forener vi psykiatri og somatik. Vores mål er, at patienter og borgere oplever gode og trygge forløb af høj kvalitet.

Som medarbejder bliver du en del af et nytænkende, fagligt og organisatorisk robust hospital, hvor vi gør en forskel for de mennesker, der har brug for os. Læring og udvikling er en del af hverdagen og sker i fagligt forpligtende fællesskaber. Også på tværs af afdelinger.

Midt- og Vestsjællands Hospital dækker et opland på ca. 230.000 borgere. Vi har 766 sengepladser og er omkring 5.000 ansatte fordelt på 20 afdelinger, herunder 16 somatiske og psykiatriske specialer.

Vi tilbyder et solidt forskningsmiljø med 13 professorer og et stærkt fagligt uddannelsesmiljø, hvor vi hvert år byder cirka 2.700 studerende, elever og læger i videreuddannelsesforløb velkommen.

title: 2027-2029 CASETiFY Management Trainee - Your Journey. Your Impact. Your Story.
description:
CASETiFY Management Trainee Program 2027–2029


Are you ready to stop training and start owning?

At CASETiFY, we don’t believe in "trainees." We believe in future business owners. Our 2-Year Management Trainee Program is customized the CASETiFY way to allow you to truly "Show Your Colors" - not just in your ideas, but in your tangible business impact.

The Program: An Owner’s Journey

This is an accelerated pathway designed to test your judgment, resilience, and commercial acumen through hands-on business assignments. You won't be shadowing, you will be contributing.

  • Front-Line Operations: You begin where the magic happens. Understanding the heartbeat of our operations is the only way to build the credibility needed to lead.
  • Stretch Business Assignments: You will be placed into real-life business projects. These are not hypothetical case studies; these are active business challenges.
  • The Owner's Mindset: We are looking for individuals who diagnose the real problem, take accountability for the solution, and demonstrate the judgment of a true business owner.

What We’re Looking For: The Business Owner Profile

We are seeking high-potential talent with the ambition to evolve from an Executor to a Business Owner. To thrive here, you should embody our core ownership standard: strong commercial and strategic vision, a system-building mindset, high-agency accountability, and a proven path of fast-tracked growth.

The Future: A Continuous Path into General Management

This program is the talent pipeline for our future General Management path. Success here is earned through results, not negotiated. Upon completing your 2-year journey, you will be seamlessly transition into the General Management Track. Governed directly by the CEO Office, this path is a continuity of your development, is designed to further stretch our leaders to become a future executive or strategic leader through ongoing rotations across different business pillars, functions, and country teams, consistently tackling new, complex business challenges.

Eligibility

  • A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree from a top-tier university.
  • Recent graduates (graduating in 2026/2027) with less than two years of full-time, post-graduation work experience.
  • A strong academic record (GPA 3.3/4.0 or Second Class Upper Division equivalent).
  • Full professional proficiency in English (written and spoken).


WHAT WE OFFER

  • Direct CEO Office Exposure: High visibility and direct alignment with executive leadership.
  • Global Mobility: International exposure and opportunity to work across CASETiFY's global hubs.
  • Accelerated Growth: Performance-driven career progression with no ceiling on your impact.
  • Relocation Support: Full work visa sponsorship and a relocation allowance for top overseas talent.
  • Vibrant Culture: A fast-moving, inclusive, and creative environment built around self-expression.


HOW TO APPLY

Ready to Show Your Colors? Placement is earned, not given. If you possess the drive, the judgment, and the appetite to be held accountable for real business results, you are exactly who we are looking for.

  1. Submit your resume in English, portfolio, or any relevant previous work that showcases your skills and experience
  2. Upload a 1-minute video in either MOV or MP4 format, where you address two questions in English:
    a) A brief introduction of yourself and
    b) Why you are driven to join the CASETiFY Management Trainee Program.

Discover More: 🔗 Program Overview

ONBOARDING PERIOD: Mid-late July 2027

title: Transformation and Change Management Practitioner
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Transformation and Change Management Practitioner based in Italy.

This is a senior consulting role focused on helping private equity investors, portfolio companies, and technology businesses turn strategic ambitions into measurable business outcomes. You will lead complex transformation and change-management programmes spanning operating models, technology, processes, people, and governance. The role combines strategic thinking with hands-on programme leadership, requiring you to engage senior stakeholders and maintain momentum through delivery. You will help organisations build compelling cases for change, align teams around priorities, and embed new ways of working. Your work will directly support growth, operational performance, resilience, customer outcomes, and value creation. You will operate in a collaborative, entrepreneurial environment alongside investment, commercial, operational, financial, and technology specialists.

Accountabilities

  • Lead complex, multi-workstream transformation programmes from initial diagnosis and mobilisation through delivery and the achievement of measurable outcomes.
  • Develop clear transformation roadmaps covering the case for change, target operating model, initiative sequencing, accountabilities, investment requirements, risks, and expected benefits.
  • Establish effective programme governance, delivery rhythms, decision-making structures, and accountability mechanisms to keep transformation initiatives on track.
  • Engage senior stakeholders and build organisational commitment through credible communication, structured facilitation, and practical approaches to change adoption.
  • Design and implement change-management strategies covering stakeholder alignment, communications, organisation design, capability building, adoption, and benefits realisation.
  • Translate technology and operational challenges into commercial implications relating to growth, customer outcomes, margins, resilience, investment risk, and value creation.
  • Support post-deal value creation by helping portfolio-company leadership teams execute transformation priorities at pace while maintaining business continuity.
  • Connect transformation priorities with product, engineering, data, platforms, delivery capabilities, and technology operating models.
  • Build trusted client relationships, contribute to new propositions and business development, and mentor colleagues in transformation, programme leadership, and change management.

    • Requirements

title: Studiejob: Bogholderi & økonomiadministration
description:
Løbende rekruttering

Vi rekrutterer løbende til vores stillinger. Dette betyder at vi ikke opererer med en fast ansøgningsfrist. Stillingerne kan dog blive besat til enhver tid, så hvis du er interesseret i én specifik stilling, så anbefales det at ansøge med det samme.

Studiejob: Bogholderi & økonomiadministration

Er du typen, der har styr på detaljerne og godt kan lide, når tallene stemmer? Har du interesse for regnskab og bogholderi, og trives du med at arbejde struktureret med fakturaer, bilag og afstemninger? Så er dette studiejob måske noget for dig!

Studerende der smiler mens hun er til workshop

Hvem er Cand?

Cand skaber udviklingsmuligheder i samspillet mellem studerende og virksomheder. Vi gør det nemt for virksomheder at opnå positive resultater med studerende i studierelevante jobs - og det er her, du kommer ind i billedet. Du bliver nemlig ansat som konsulent hos Cand. Vi ansætter studerende fra mange forskellige uddannelser, og det er både for bachelor- og kandidatstuderende. Det vigtigste for os er, at du brænder for at vise, hvordan du - med din personlighed, dine talenter og din faglige profil - skaber værdi i et studierelevant job hos vores samarbejdspartnere.

Studiejobbet

I dette studiejob skal du hjælpe vores samarbejdspartner med den daglige bogføring og de praktiske økonomiadministrative opgaver. Du får en vigtig rolle i at sikre, at økonomifunktionen hele tiden er ajourført, og at fakturaer, bilag, betalinger og registreringer bliver håndteret korrekt.

Du kommer også til at arbejde med både kreditor- og debitorbogholderi samt løbende bogføring og afstemninger. Derudover bliver du en del af de praktiske opgaver omkring månedsafslutning, hvor du blandt andet hjælper med afstemninger og fremsøgning af dokumentation.

Rollen er først og fremmest udførende, så du behøver ikke komme med erfaring inden for controlling eller økonomistyring. Det vigtigste er, at du har lyst til at få fingrene ned i det daglige bogholderi og skabe struktur og orden i økonomien.

Eksempler på opgaver

  • Håndtere kreditorbogholderi, herunder modtagelse, kontrol, kontering og klargøring af leverandørfakturaer

  • Arbejde med debitorbogholderi, herunder fakturering, registrering af indbetalinger og opfølgning på åbne og forfaldne poster

  • Varetage løbende bogføring samt registrering og kontrol af bankposteringer

  • Foretage bank-, debitor-, kreditor- og udvalgte balanceafstemninger

  • Håndtere bilag, medarbejderudlæg, kreditnotaer og elektronisk dokumentation

  • Bidrage praktisk til månedsafslutning og fremsøgning af dokumentation til økonomifunktionen og revisor

  • Vedligeholde kunde- og leverandørstamdata samt hjælpe med øvrige administrative økonomiopgaver

Virksomheden

Du bliver i studiejobbet en del af en mindre og jordnær virksomhed inden for entreprenørbranchen med ca. 56 medarbejdere, hvoraf omkring 6 arbejder på kontoret og ca. 50 er en del af den daglige drift ude i marken. Virksomheden ligger lidt uden for Lystrup, og du kan nemt komme dertil med letbanen på omkring 20 minutter fra Aarhus, hvorefter der er en kort gå- eller cykeltur det sidste stykke.

Sådan kommer du i betragtning til denne studiestilling

Hvis du gerne vil i betragtning til det her studiejob, skal du deltage i Cands rekrutteringsevent. Vi kalder det ‘Get to Know You’. Hos Cand kigger vi hverken på dine karakterer eller dine tidligere erfaringer. Vi møder dig der, hvor du er i dit studieliv. Vi ansætter engagerede studerende, der er klar til at udvikle deres talenter i et fagligt og socialt talentforløb, der åbner karrieremuligheder. title: QLD Year 7-10 Maths Tutors
description:
What you'll do

We hire for two tracks and assess every application for both, then place you where you'll shine brightest as a tutor:

  • Tutors run the group classes. You intuitively teach subject content to a full class of students, coach study skills and exam strategy, mentor students through your personal experiences, and form genuine connections that inspire.
  • Assistant Tutors work with students one at a time. You support the lead tutor in class, run video consults with students who need extra help, answer questions by text between classes, write worked solutions, and verify learning materials for quality.

For example, you might teach two classes on Monday and two on Tuesday (4:15–6:15pm and 6:45–8:45pm), plus two on Saturday morning (10:00am–12:00pm and 12:30–2:30pm).

What you'll bring

  • Strong communication and a knack for making hard concepts click
  • Knowledge of [SUBJECT] at first-year university level or above
  • A 90+ in QCE Methods (highly desirable, not required)
  • 6+ classes per week, committed across a full academic year (around 12+ hours weekly)
  • Energy, empathy, and a desire to help students

Why you'll love it

You'll work alongside high-achieving university peers who study similar degrees to you and are at Contour for the same reason: to give back and help the next generation of students.

  • The pay: classes run two hours. Tutors start at $90/class and reach $140+/class, plus super and bonuses. Most Tutors earn $130 to $220+/class including bonuses. Assistant Tutors start at $55/class and rise to $70/class, plus super.
  • You don't build the material: every class runs on a workbook our subject team writes, with homework, practice assessments and exams already built into our learning portal. We provide you with what to teach, and all you have to do is prep how to teach it.
  • Real (paid) training: qualification through Contour Tutor Academy, class sit-ins, regular check-ins with your team lead, and honest feedback on your tutoring.
  • A schedule you choose: pick your days, campuses, and times. Evenings and weekends, built around your uni timetable.
  • A full learning ecosystem behind you: students get workshops, practice assessments and exams, one-on-one consults, text support, and the learning portal.
  • Somewhere to go: grow with Contour into senior tutoring roles, team leads, or full-time career opportunities.
  • Perks: $60 monthly wellbeing allowance, birthday leave, loyalty leave, exam-study leave, novated leasing, and an employee assistance program (EAP).

How to apply

  1. Submit your CV, ATAR/raw study scores, and a short paragraph on why you'd make a great tutor at Contour
  2. Submit a short video (10–15 minutes) of you tutoring with a sample workbook we provide
  3. Attend an in-person interview, which includes a Q&A and teaching a mock small-group class

One thing to know: all tutoring roles at Contour include a non-compete agreement. We heavily invest in your development as a tutor and ask for the same commitment to our mission in return. We'll walk you through the details before you sign any offer.

title: Legislative Counsel
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Legislative Counsel based in Canada.

This role sits at the intersection of law, public policy, regulatory strategy, and a rapidly evolving digital marketplace. You’ll help interpret legislation and regulatory developments affecting gig economy platforms, marketplaces, labour practices, retailers, and consumers. Your legal analysis will support business teams in responding to emerging requirements while strengthening compliance frameworks and reducing operational risk. You’ll collaborate closely with Policy, Government Affairs, Operations, Product, and Communications teams to provide clear and actionable legal guidance. The role also involves working with external counsel, trade associations, and industry partners on broader regulatory initiatives. It offers an opportunity to develop expertise in emerging areas of law while helping shape practical strategies for navigating complex legislative environments.

Accountabilities:

  • Analyze emerging legislation and regulatory developments affecting marketplace platforms, gig economy participants, labour practices, retailers, consumers, and related areas, translating legal developments into clear and actionable guidance for internal stakeholders.
  • Partner with Policy, Government Affairs, Operations, Product, Communications, and other cross-functional teams to coordinate regulatory responses and establish consistent legal perspectives on legislative matters affecting business operations.
  • Develop, implement, and document legal frameworks and compliance best practices that support adherence to evolving legislative and regulatory mandates across relevant areas of the business.
  • Provide precise legal advice by synthesizing complex legislative updates, identifying potential operational implications, and helping business partners understand compliance requirements and associated risks.

description:
COMPANY OVERVIEW

KKR is a leading global investment firm that offers alternative asset management as well as capital markets and insurance solutions. Our passion for technology and innovation fuels our commitment to creating high-quality, impactful solutions that address complex challenges and meet the evolving needs of our sophisticated businesses.

POSITION SUMMARY

We are seeking an Assistant Vice President (AVP), Software Engineering to join our Operations Systems team. This role blends senior individual contribution with emerging technical leadership: you will design and deliver robust backend services and data pipelines while helping guide the technical direction of your team. The ideal candidate is a strong Python developer with hands-on experience in distributed data processing (Spark), infrastructure-as-code (Terraform), and deep data engineering fundamentals spanning data modeling, ETL, and data distribution. You will own significant workstreams end-to-end, raise the engineering bar through code reviews and design input, and mentor junior engineers as you continue to grow toward a lead or vice president level.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Design, build, and own scalable backend services and data pipelines primarily in Python.
  • Develop and optimize large-scale data processing workflows using Apache Spark for batch and near-real-time use cases.
  • Lead data modeling and schema design decisions that support reliable analytics and downstream consumption.
  • Architect and maintain robust ETL/ELT workflows with strong data quality, lineage, and observability.
  • Design and implement data distribution patterns to serve data efficiently across internal systems and consumers.
  • Provision and manage cloud infrastructure using Terraform and infrastructure-as-code best practices.
  • Own delivery of significant workstreams end-to-end, from technical design through production and operations.
  • Drive engineering quality through design reviews, code reviews, and clear technical standards.
  • Mentor and support the growth of analysts and junior engineers on the team.
  • Partner with product, data, and platform leaders to shape roadmap and translate requirements into scalable solutions.
  • Lead root-cause analysis for complex production issues and drive continuous improvements in reliability and performance.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 4–7 years of professional software engineering experience with a strong backend focus.
  • Expert-level proficiency in Python for building production services and data pipelines.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Apache Spark for distributed data processing at scale.
  • Proficiency with Terraform for infrastructure-as-code and cloud resource management.
  • Deep data engineering fundamentals, including data modeling, ETL/ELT design, and data distribution patterns.
  • Solid command of relational and non-relational data stores and SQL.
  • Experience with version control (Git), CI/CD pipelines, and modern software development practices.
  • Demonstrated ability to own complex workstreams and mentor other engineers.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate across technical and business teams.

PPREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and their data services.
  • Familiarity with workflow orchestration tools (e.g., Airflow, Dagster).
  • Experience with streaming technologies (e.g., Kafka, Spark Structured Streaming).
  • Exposure to containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Prior experience in financial services or another data-intensive, regulated industry.
  • Experience with Palantir Foundry or similar data integration and analytics platforms.

WHAT WE OFFER

KKR offers a collaborative, high-performance culture where engineers work on meaningful problems at scale. We provide competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, and significant opportunities for professional growth, technical leadership, and impact.

title: Software Developer til udvikling af end-to-end løsninger i Fraud Detection & AI Solutions
description:
Er du interesseret i et job, hvor du kan arbejde med softwareudvikling, avanceret dataanalyse og end-to-end-løsninger? Så kan det være dig, vi leder efter som vores nye Software Developer i Fraud Detection & AI Solutions.

Som Software Developer vil du være med til at forme fremtidens løsninger, der både gør administrationen af velfærdsydelser mere smidig og brugervenlig og styrker indsatsen for, at offentlige ydelser udbetales korrekt.

Du får rig mulighed for at omsætte din tekniske viden til praksis ved at udvikle modeller og applikationer, der understøtter en sikker og effektiv administration af velfærdsydelser.

Vi udvikler på en Python-baseret platform, hvor der er styr på versionsstyring, review-processer, test af kode, og hvor vi tager vores modeller seriøst ved at sikre et højt niveau af MLops.

Dine opgaver:

  • End-to-end-løsninger
    Du kommer til at udvikle og implementere end-to-end løsninger med fokus på robuste dataflows, automatiserede processer og intelligent brug af data for at reducere fejl og svig. Dermed sikrer du en korrekt udbetaling af ydelser, så de når de rette modtagere.

  • Udvikling af vores Python-baserede platform
    Du videreudvikler og optimerer vores platform til registersamkøring, så vi kan samle og analysere store mængder data fra forskellige kilder.

  • Implementering af nye teknologier
    Du vil spille en central rolle i arbejdet med implementering af nye teknologier, der kan være med til forbedre vores løsninger til gavn for slutbrugeren.

  • Udvikling af applikationer og værktøjer
    Du skal bygge og vedligeholde softwareløsninger herunder API’er, websites, pipelines, kodekvalitetstjek og andre støtteværktøjer. På den måde sikrer du, at vores løsninger er skalerbare og lette at vedligeholde.

  • Samarbejde med forretningen
    Sidst men ikke mindst, så kommer du til at arbejde tæt sammen med forretningen for at forstå krav og behov, som kan omsættes til enkle og effektive IT-løsninger. Det sætter krav til din evne til at tale med interessenter og til at formidle komplekse problemstillinger på en klar og tydelig måde.

Hvem er du?
Der kan være flere veje til jobbet som Software Developer hos os.

Vi forestiller os, at du har en relevant uddannelse som fx ingeniør, fysiker, matematiker, datalog, cand.it eller lignende. Du kan enten have flere års erfaring eller være nyuddannet med erfaring fra et relevant studiejob.

Det vigtigste ift. jobbet er dog, at du har:

  • interesse for avanceret dataanalyse og er helt hjemme i et objektorienteret kodesprog (fx Python)
  • kendskab til softwareudviklingsprincipper som twelve-factor og kan anvende dem i praksis
  • erfaring med cloud services og værktøjer som fx SQL, Splunk, Git, Azure DevOps, Pandas, Flask, SQLalchemy.

Som person er du empatisk og struktureret, og du bruger naturligt dine analytiske og kommunikative evner i hverdagen. Du trives med at samarbejde tæt med dine kolleger, men kan også arbejde selvstændigt og tage ansvar for dine opgaver. Samtidig motiveres du af at udvikle dig fagligt og styrke dine kompetencer inden for software- og applikationsudvikling.

Hvem er vi?
I Fraud Detection & AI Solutions bliver du en del af en afdeling med cirka 43 kolleger fordelt på tre sektioner: Data & Software Development, Advanced Analytics og Customers & Deliveries. Du bliver en del af Data & Software Development, men samarbejder tæt med kolleger på tværs af afdelingen i mindre, tværfaglige teams, der arbejder agilt.

Sammen udvikler vi data- og softwareløsninger, der understøtter offentlige myndigheders administration af velfærdsydelser. Nogle løsninger bidrager til en mere enkel og effektiv sagsbehandling, mens andre understøtter myndighedernes arbejde med at sikre korrekt udbetaling af ydelser. Fælles for dem er, at de bygger på et tæt samspil mellem data, analyse og softwareudvikling.

Vi opererer blandt andet med softwareudvikling, webservices og data science, og vi har som central specialenhed fokus på at forebygge og identificere fejludbetalinger, så de hurtigst muligt korrigeres og undgås i fremtiden.

Derudover arbejder vi med effektivisering af forretningens processer ved brug af både klassiske NLP- og Computer Vision-teknikker men også LLM’er.

Du bliver en del af et engageret team, hvor samarbejde og faglig sparring er i centrum. Vi arbejder tæt sammen om at nå vores fælles mål og lægger vægt på at dele viden, støtte hinanden og udvikle de bedste løsninger i fællesskab.

I ATP tilbyder vi et arbejdsliv i balance. Det kræver fleksibilitet med plads til den enkelte. Og det har vi. Vi ser fleksibilitet som en gensidig interesse, hvor vi sammen har fokus på trivsel, opgaveløsning og kundernes behov.

Sådan ansøger du
Søg senest søndag den 4. oktober.

Når du ansøger, skal du besvare fire spørgsmål om din erfaring med Python, Git og CI/CD, udviklingsprincipper og samarbejde. Derudover beder vi også om dit CV og eksamenspapirer.

I ATP arbejder vi for en fair rekrutteringsproces, og derfor beder vi dig om ikke at vedhæfte billede i dit CV eller angive din alder, når du søger.

Vi ansætter på baggrund af kompetencer og potentiale og opfordrer alle til at søge stillingen – uanset køn og kønsidentitet, etnicitet, national, social og kulturel baggrund, religion eller tro, seksuel orientering, funktionsnedsættelse og alder.

Du kan læse mere om rekrutteringsforløbet her:

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte sektionschef Lotte Reumert på tlf. 24 59 49 34 eller mai.lore@atp.dk.

Af sikkerhedsmæssige årsager og for at beskytte værdier og datainfrastruktur indhenter ATP straffeattest på alle inden ansættelse, ligesom vi i forbindelse med indgåelse af kontrakten beder om at se en kopi af dit pas. Straffeattesten må ikke give anledning til bemærkninger og slettes umiddelbart efter, at den er vurderet.

Til annoncører og rekrutteringsbureauer: ATP frabeder sig uopfordrede henvendelser om annoncering, kandidater, produkter og ydelser i forbindelse med stillingsopslag og rekrutteringer. Vi beder om, at dette respekteres, og at vores ledere og medarbejdere ikke kontaktes i den henseende.

title: Shipping & Receiving Clerk 1
description:
It's not just about your career or job title...It's about who you are and the impact you will make on the world. Because whether it's for each other or our customers, we put People First. When our people come together, Expand the Possible and continuously look for ways to improve what we create and how we do it. If you are constantly striving to grow, you're in good company. We are revolutionizing the way the world moves for future generations, and we want someone who is ready to move with us.

PRIMARY PURPOSE

The Shipping And Receiving laborer performs daily delivery, order fulfillment, packaging, receiving, and shipment duties of component boxes and materials. Conducts scheduling of orders, ensures accuracy of packaging products, and scans bar codes within the SAP system. Works with other employees and departments to resolve shipping and receiving matters. This position is responsible for using a variety of hand and power tools, fixtures, work instructions to perform a series of operations to correctly disassemble components.

Who will you be working with?

You will be part of our Shipping and Receiving Materials Handling team, collaborating closely with production leaders to ensure the accurate and efficient movement of materials throughout the plant. You will also work with Quality, Inventory control and Manufacturing teams to meet production schedules, resolve Shipping and Receiving issues and support inventory accuracy.

How will you make the difference?

As a shipping & receiving clerk you will be a key link in our supply chain, ensuring the safe, accurate, and efficient handling of materials and components for the production/remanufacturing of railroad equipment. You will help us to keep a safe, clean and organized work environment using 5s approach, ensure accurate and timely receiving, storage and delivery of parts and materials. Support the production team by producing materials to the correct locations, collaborating with other departments to resolve inventory and shipping and receiving discrepancies.

This is a 1st shift position with standard hours Monday-Friday 8am-4:30pm. Variations in this schedule will be communicated upon hire.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

• Medium level of manual labor.

• Follow detailed instructions, processes, and procedures.

• Maintain a clean and safe workplace in accordance with 5S protocol.

• Pulls schedules to be ran by production exactly as they are listed.

• Operate within standard operating procedures (SOPs) and Job Safety Analysis (JSAs).

• Attention to detail in a fast-paced environment.

• Completes daily inbound receiving of product and packages.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Backend
description:
About Nutrient

  • At Nutrient, we're revolutionizing how the world works with documents. Our tools transform static files into intelligent, secure workflows, empowering businesses to innovate faster and smarter. Trusted by thousands of organizations across 80 countries, including Fortune 500 companies and public sector leaders, our platform supports nearly a billion end users globally in industries where documents aren't just files, they're mission-critical.

Your Role at Nutrient...

We’re looking for a backend engineer passionate about building robust and scalable systems, excited about working with modern cloud technologies and distributed systems to power our Document Engine and SaaS products.

You find satisfaction in architecting high-performance solutions, optimising system reliability, caring for the cloud infrastructure our products run on, and creating efficient backend services that handle complex document processing workflows at scale.

What You'll Work On...

  • Execute on the design and implementation of high-performance Elixir/Phoenix-based systems such as Nutrient's Document Engine and Web Services API
  • Design and build declarative infrastructure, robust, scalable and easy to observe and maintain (we are currently using Terraform, Terramate and FluxCD on Kubernetes, with Helm charts powering both our managed cloud and customer self-hosted deployments)
  • Operate and evolve our managed cloud platform: cluster lifecycle and upgrades, GitOps workflows, observability, and database operations, keeping it reliable, secure, and costefficient
  • Share ownership for architecture, tools and services, contribute to product development and customer success
  • Collaborate closely with a small, remote-first engineering team to ship features, debug hard problems, and continuously improve reliability
  • Meet in person with the team periodically to align and reflect

What You'll Bring...

  • Experience in backend services and distributed systems
  • A track record running production workloads on Kubernetes and public cloud (we use AWS), ideally with infrastructure-as-code and GitOps practices
  • Strong coding skills: Elixir experience isn't required, we'll help you learn
  • A pragmatic approach to code: you appreciate clean architecture but know when good enough is the right call
  • A culture of direct feedback: you speak up when something isn't right and take feedback just as well

Who Thrives Here...

At Nutrient, we’re not just hiring for skills — we’re hiring for mindset. The people who thrive here are:

  • Collaborators: You collaborate openly, listen actively, and prioritize team success over ego.
  • Hungry Learners: Rapid learning fuels progress and career growth.
  • Curious Thinkers: You dig deep to uncover the “why,” valuing understanding over simply being right.
  • Self-Starters: You take action without waiting for direction, turning obstacles into opportunities with creativity and persistence.
  • Owners: You take responsibility for solutions and outcomes, always looking for ways to improve what’s within your control.
  • Doers: You’re energized by progress, motivated to create meaningful impact, and eager to tackle challenges.

Why You'll Love Working Here...

At Nutrient, we build tools that reshape how businesses and developers work with documents. Our culture is centred on continuous growth and collaboration. Every team member has room to learn, innovate, and drive meaningful impact.

  • Real platform ownership: You’ll help run and evolve the managed cloud behind Document Engine (cluster lifecycle, GitOps, and observability), not just ship services on top of it.
  • Modern stack end to end: Elixir and Phoenix for the product, Kubernetes with Terraform, Helm, and FluxCD for the infrastructure it runs on.
  • Fully remote and async-first: Minimal meetings, strong writing culture, and the independence to manage your own work.
  • Mission-critical product: Nutrient's platform is trusted by 15%+ of the Global 500 across 80+ countries.
  • Strong growth trajectory: ARR grown from $28M to $49M over the past two years, backed by Insight Partners, with a $100M+ investment fuelling further growth.

Nutrient believes in equal opportunity. We employ people from many cultures and countries, celebrate diversity, and are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, skill sets, and perspectives. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, age, marital status, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other non-merit factor.

title: Applications/Systems Engineer, Senior
description:
Position Description

Tacoma Power's Power Management division is looking for an Applications/Systems Engineer, Senior to join their team! This position is responsible for the development and maintenance of the departmental computing and functional systems capability for the Resource Operations & Trading Group, which is a mission critical 24/7 operation. The Resource Operations and Trading Group optimizes Tacoma Power's resource portfolio through efficient, reliable dispatch of generation resources to maximize wholesale energy sales revenue. The wholesale energy trading activities directly impact Tacoma Power's ability to maintain low and stable rates to our customers.

This position develops new software tools, helps troubleshoot production issues, implements defect fixes, and adds new features. The individual within this role will also be called upon to assist in software project quality assurance, business analyst activities and/or other support tasks. As one of the developers on the team, this position is responsible for the systems as used by the business users within Power Management. This position is extremely customer focused, relies on experience and industry best practices for support and judgment to plan and accomplish goals. This role reports to the Power Management Systems Engineering Manager.

The Power Management Systems Engineering workgroup is a small team that develops custom software, integrates vendor solutions and supports the technical systems implemented for the power management operations at Tacoma Power. This is a busy workgroup that is often taking on specific technical industry challenges to solve the fast-paced problems emerging in the new energy markets.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop, implement, and maintain software and system solutions for data collection, processing, and reporting, ensuring compliance with NERC and CIP requirements.
  • Provide production support for internal systems and third-party platforms, ensuring reliability and resolving user issues promptly.
  • Integrate third-party solutions into existing system architecture and software platforms.
  • Implement and maintain data warehousing and reporting solutions to support Resource Operations & Trading activities.
  • Facilitate secure and effective data sharing with utilities, regulatory agencies, and internal stakeholders.
  • Research, analyze, and prepare technical reports, specifications, and documentation to support system development and operations.
  • Continuously evaluate and adopt emerging technologies to enhance applications, tools, and processes.

Qualifications

Minimum Education*
Bachelor's degree

Minimum Experience*
4 years of software development, software architecture and database/data warehouse experience

*Relevant education and experience may substitute for one another on a year-for-year basis

Licensing, Certifications and Other Requirements
As Assigned: Washington State Driver's License

Depending on assignment, some positions may require the ability to pass additional background checks and/or obtain additional certifications, with maintenance thereafter

Desirable Skills & Qualifications
  • SQL Server & SQL Server Reporting Services
  • Data Warehousing / SQL Server Analysis Services
  • ETL, Dataflows, Service Oriented Architecture Software Development & Support
  • REST, WCF, SOAP, XML, gRPC
  • Scheduler Based Integration Platforms
  • Azure DevOps, Octopus, Git & other Source Control tools
  • CI/CD Pipeline architecture & deployment
  • .Net Framework / C#, .NET Core, Blazor, Entity Framework, ORM Tools
  • Nuget Package management
  • EIM & ETRM systems & software (OATI & PCI)
  • Stored procedures
  • Software Architecture
  • Infrastructure, Windows Server Maintenance, Certificate Management, VMWare

Knowledge & Skills

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Perform code reviews and provide constructive feedback and coaching to other developers to develop their skillsets.
  • Research, document, and apply new technologies
  • Multitask and prioritize multiple complex workplace projects.
  • Establish and maintain cooperative and effective working relationships with co-workers and peers in the electric industry.
  • Analyze situations accurately and adopt and effective course of action.
  • Integrate information from various sources and develop solutions that effectively satisfy competing objectives.
  • Plan and organize work.
  • Manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.
  • Build a strong sense of teamwork and purpose within work groups.
  • Clearly communicate, orally and in writing, complex or contentious issues.
  • Establish and maintain cooperative working relationships across Tacoma Power.
  • Independently coordinate and facilitate discussions between work groups to resolve technical problems requiring diverse knowledge areas.

Selection Process & Supplemental Information

Apply

All interested individuals must apply online and attach a resume and cover letter that includes major responsibilities and accomplishments related to the position.

Appointment is subject to references and passing a background check.

A Commitment to Equity & Diversity
At the City of Tacoma, we're on a mission to make our workforce as diverse and inclusive as the community we serve. We actively seek out candidates from a wide range of backgrounds and cultures. Join our team at the City of Tacoma and help us build a more vibrant, inclusive, and equitable community for all.

If you have a less traditional background, we want to hear about your transferrable skills and experience. We value a variety of perspectives and are excited to see what you bring to the table.

Tacoma Power
Tacoma Power is an almost 100% hydroelectric, municipally-owned public power utility, located in Tacoma. We serve approximately 180,000 customers as one of the three operating divisions of Tacoma Public Utilities, alongside Tacoma Water and Tacoma Rail. As one of the most livable, walkable cities in the country, you'll find that Tacoma is a great fit for all interests with places to bike, run, hike, and explore, the perks of a big city, and the charm of a small town.

Compensation & Benefits
Pay Details:
Annual Salary: $113,568.00 - $159,910.40

Employee Benefits | City of Tacoma

Get Assistance

For technical difficulties using the Neogov system, call the applicant support line at 1-855-524-5627 between 6:00 a.m. and 5:00 p.m. Pacific Standard Time. This will allow us to assist you before the job announcement closes.

title: Part- Time Security Officer
description:
STATUS: Part-Time, Non-Sworn
SCHEDULE: Primarily Friday and Saturday evenings/nights, with additional event-support shifts as needed


BASIC PURPOSE:


The Part-Time Security Officer supports the safety and security of the Assumption University campus by providing a visible security presence and assisting with access control, perimeter security, traffic management, and University events.

The position is primarily assigned to campus entrances and access-control locations during high-traffic evening and weekend periods. The Security Officer monitors vehicle and pedestrian access, assists with traffic flow, and supports campus operations in coordination with sworn Assumption University Police Officers.

  6. Maintain effective radio communication with University Police Dispatch and sworn personnel.
  7. Provide courteous directions, information, and assistance to students, employees, visitors, vendors, and guests.
  8. Complete activity logs, incident documentation, or other reports as required.
  9. Perform other related security, access-control, parking, traffic, and event-support duties as assigned.

title: Sagsbehandler til tildeling af og vejledning om SU til studerende i udlandet
description:
Vil du hjælpe studerende med at få deres SU med til hele uddannelser i udlandet? Trives du med at kombinere sagsbehandling og vejledning? Og motiveres du af at gøre regler og muligheder forståelige for dem, der har brug for hjælp?

Når en studerende vælger at tage en hel uddannelse i udlandet, er det afgørende, at de kan få en korrekt behandling af deres ansøgning og klar vejledning om deres muligheder for at modtage SU. Her får du en central rolle i at sikre, at ansøgninger bliver behandlet korrekt, og at de studerende oplever en god og professionel service.

Du bliver en del af området, der arbejder med tildeling af SU til hele uddannelser i udlandet. Hverdagen består af både sagsbehandling og kontakt med studerende, og du får hurtigt opbygget en solid viden om et regelområde, der har stor betydning for mange mennesker.

Dine opgaver

Dine primære arbejdsopgaver er at behandle ansøgninger om tildeling af SU til studerende, der skal læse en hel uddannelse i udlandet samt yde vejledning til studerende om reglerne på mail og telefon. Der vil også kunne være andre opgaver på uddannelsesstøtteområdet.

Du får ansvar fra start, men du står ikke alene. Du bliver en del af et fagligt miljø, hvor kolleger deler viden, hjælper hinanden og samarbejder om at finde de rigtige løsninger.

Hvem er du?

Vi forestiller os, at du har erfaring med sagsbehandling og vejledning af kunder eller borgere på mail og telefon, og at du trives med at arbejde inden for et område, hvor regler og lovgivning spiller en central rolle.

Derudover ser vi gerne, at du:

  • Arbejder struktureret og har blik for detaljer, også når opgaverne er tilbagevendende
  • Kan planlægge og drive dine opgaver selvstændigt frem
  • Har lyst til at sætte dig ind i komplekse regler og omsætte dem til klar vejledning
  • Er vant til at arbejde i digitale systemer og administrative processer
  • Bidrager positivt til samarbejdet med kolleger og hjælper til, når opgaverne kræver det

Det er en fordel, hvis du har erfaring fra offentlig administration, kendskab til uddannelsesstøtteområdet eller erfaring med sagsbehandlingssystemer. Har du engelskkundskaber er det også et plus.

Hvem er vi?

Du bliver en del af et område, der arbejder for at sikre korrekt administration af uddannelsesstøtte til studerende. Vores opgaver har direkte betydning for mennesker, der ønsker at udvikle sig gennem uddannelse i udlandet.

I teamet er vi fem engagerede kolleger, som aktivt deltager i prioritering og planlægning af opgaveløsningen og har fokus på løbende at forbedre og effektivisere vores arbejdsgange.

Vi lægger vægt på faglig kvalitet, videndeling og et godt samarbejde. Du får kolleger med forskellige erfaringer og kompetencer, og vi hjælper hinanden med at løse både de enkle og de mere komplekse sager.

Hos ATP arbejder vi med samfundskritiske opgaver, der gør en forskel for millioner af mennesker. Derfor prioriterer vi både høj faglighed, udvikling i jobbet og en hverdag, hvor der er plads til samarbejde, sparring og balance.

Sådan ansøger du

Send os dit CV senest søndag den 18. oktober. Når du sender dit CV via vores system, får du mulighed for kort at beskrive din motivation for at søge stillingen.

I ATP arbejder vi for en fair rekrutteringsproces, og derfor beder vi dig om ikke at vedhæfte billede i dit CV eller angive din alder, når du søger.

Vi ansætter på baggrund af kompetencer og potentiale og opfordrer alle til at søge stillingen – uanset køn og kønsidentitet, etnicitet, national, social og kulturel baggrund, religion eller tro, seksuel orientering, funktionsnedsættelse og alder.

Du kan læse mere om rekrutteringsforløbet her:

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte afdelingschef Thomas Fogtmann på tlf. 4147 3172 (fra 1. oktober) eller mail thfg@atp.dk.

Af sikkerhedsmæssige årsager og for at beskytte værdier og datainfrastruktur beder vi om straffeattest, kopi af dit pas og eventuelt eksamensbevis. Straffeattesten må ikke give anledning til bemærkninger, og dokumenterne slettes umiddelbart efter vurdering.

Til annoncører og rekrutteringsbureauer: ATP frabeder sig uopfordrede henvendelser om annoncering, kandidater, produkter og ydelser i forbindelse med stillingsopslag og rekrutteringer. Vi beder om, at dette respekteres, og at vores ledere og medarbejdere ikke kontaktes i den henseende.

title: Director, Product Ownership
description:
JOB SUMMARY:

The Product Ownership Director serves as the strategic liaison between the business, technology, and technical vendors for a portfolio of business-critical technology products and capabilities. This role partners with senior leaders to understand ATC’s needs and identify opportunities to improve efficiency, support growth, mitigate risk, and drive competitive advantage. The Director owns and governs product roadmaps, translates business priorities into technology initiatives, influences investment decisions, and ensures measurable business value is delivered. The Director also leads and develops Product Owners by setting priorities, coaching performance, and aligning team resources with business and technology objectives.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:

Collaboration

• Leads strategic discussions with business and technology leaders to understand business problems, enterprise priorities, and workable solutions.

• Creates a collaborative environment that encourages team member participation and open discussion of risks, tradeoffs, and opportunities.

• Integrates multiple perspectives into technically sound, scalable solutions that align with enterprise strategy.

• Obtains executive and stakeholder buy-in for product roadmaps, project plans, and strategic initiatives.

• Provides leadership, guidance, and development opportunities to Product Owners, supporting their continued growth and success.

Change Management

• Fosters continuous improvement across assigned business areas and capabilities.

• Works with leaders to ease concerns, build buy-in, and support adoption of organizational and technology changes.

• Connects ATC’s mission and business drivers to technology strategy, data, and roadmaps.

• Leads change initiatives by communicating impacts, addressing concerns, and driving sustained adoption.

• Drives major implementations, removes barriers, and ensures business readiness.

Functional Analysis

• Provides leadership and review for product owner, analyst, and cross-functional team work to ensure requirements, recommendations, and solution designs meet business, technical, and strategic expectations.

• Directs the translation of ambiguous business requirements into clear strategies, technical requirements, epics, user stories, acceptance criteria, and measurable outcomes.

• Uses deep functional knowledge of assigned business verticals to influence strategy, prioritization, and scalable solution design.

• Oversees prioritization of business tickets, corrections, enhancements, and capability gaps to ensure alignment with roadmap, risk, and business value.

• Conducts product reviews, build/buy/remediate analysis, ROI analysis, business cases, and recommendations for budgeting and steering committee review.

Project Management

• Directs work breakdown, resource planning, team assignments, and use of project management tools to ensure visibility and accountability.

• Keeps project teams, business sponsors, and executive stakeholders aligned on deliverables, dependencies, risks, and decisions.

• Communicates executive-level status, risks, financial impacts, tradeoffs, and recommendations.

• Recommends adjustments to scope, timeline, budget, and sequencing to maintain delivery of the highest business value.

• Develops and governs multi-year roadmaps aligned to IT strategy, business strategy, budget priorities, and enterprise architecture.

• Establishes team goals, monitors progress, removes barriers, and holds team members accountable for execution and business value delivery.

Agile Development

• Establishes solution management and agile delivery practices that support strategic business outcomes.

• Collaborates with stakeholders, architects, and delivery teams to prioritize initiatives and align delivery with roadmap objectives.

• Ensures quality, release readiness, and operational preparedness for deployments.

• Oversees review of completed work and incorporates stakeholder feedback into future roadmap planning.

Vendor Management

• Leads strategic technical vendor relationships to ensure products, services, and roadmaps deliver business value.

• Reviews vendor contracts and partners with Procurement, Legal, Finance, and IT leadership to align service expectations, risk considerations, and business outcomes.

• Provides direction to internal team members supporting vendor engagements to manage roles, accountabilities, issues, and deliverables.

• Manages vendor engagements to ensure project success, vendor accountability, and alignment to product roadmap and budget objectives.

• Ensures vendor deliverables meet agreed quality, adoption, and operational readiness expectations.

Data & Technology

• Stays current on emerging technologies, products, and data capabilities that may add value to the organization.

• Applies knowledge of digital-first companies to help ATC remain competitive, scalable, secure, and efficient.

• Identifies, proposes, and sponsors technology or data opportunities that differentiate ATC or accelerate growth, market share, and/or margins.

ESSENTIAL QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor’s Degree in Business, Information Technology, Management Information Systems or related field.

• Minimum of 7+ years of progressive experience in product ownership, product management, business technology, information technology, or related functional experience.

• Certificates in project management, change management, agile product ownership, six sigma, or related discipline a plus.

• 9+ years of progressive experience in one or more functional areas and three or more core technologies preferred, including demonstrated experience leading product roadmaps, enterprise initiatives, vendors, cross-functional teams, or technology portfolios:

o Manufacturing / WHMS / Forecast / Planning ERP

o Finance System / Procurement

o Cloud data warehousing and analytics (Azure / Synapse preferred)

o CRM (SF.com preferred)

o PLM (Centric preferred)

o HRMS

o DTC (Google Analytics, Amazon, Shopify, etc.)

o CLM

• Experience leading, coaching, developing, and managing technical or product management professionals.

• Experience with budget planning, ROI analysis, vendor management, contract review, prioritization frameworks, and enterprise delivery practices preferred.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS:

title: Ejendomsservicetekniker-elev søges til Enner Mark Fængsel.

Enner Mark Fængsel er et lukket fængsel beliggende 10 km vest for Horsens med plads til 236 indsatte. Fængslet er et af Danmarks mest moderne og bedst sikrede fængsler. Det består bl.a. af et arrestafsnit, fællesskabsafsnit, et behandlingsafsnit, afsnit for banderelaterede indsatte, et særligt sikret afsnit og et isolationsafsnit. Der er tale om en elev-stilling på 37 timer om ugen. Hvor du gennemfører skoleforløbet sideløbende. Vi kan tilbyde en anderledes læreplads, hvor vi har erfaring i at uddanne personale inden for mange forskellige faggrupper.

  • Ad-hoc opgaver

  • Er selvstændig, moden, ansvarsbevidst og serviceorienteret
  • Er samarbejdsvillig og kan arbejde både i teams og selvstændigt
  • Er indstillet på faglige og menneskelige udfordringer
