description:
Colorado’s premier mobile fleet cleaning company is expanding its Commerce City team. We are seeking a reliable, high-performing individual for a dynamic, mobile role servicing premium commercial clients.


This is not a stagnant wash-bay job. As a Mobile Fleet Detailer, you will operate a company vehicle, utilize specialized equipment, and handle a mix of precision interior auto detailing and commercial property cleaning.


If you take deep pride in your work, love an active outdoor lifestyle, and want a clear path to career advancement, we want to invest in you.


Pay & Premium Benefits Starting Pay:

  • Competitive hourly rate with paid on-the-job trade training.
  • Health Insurance: Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance available the 1st of the month after 60 days.
  • Paid Time Off: Up to 48 hours per year of accrued paid sick and mental health time.


Company Provided Assets:

All specialized detailing equipment, safety gear, and mobile service vehicles are provided.


Scope of Work (Responsibilities)

  • Precision Interior Detailing: Execute meticulous interior detailing of commercial vehicle cabs, sleeper berths, and trailers according to strict client work orders.
  • Facility Maintenance: Perform high-quality exterior property cleaning, including commercial concrete, driveways, spills, and building exteriors.
  • Mobile Operations: Safely operate company vehicles and box trucks to move between client locations efficiently.
  • Digital Logistics: Utilize a modern smartphone application to log completed jobs, track progress, and communicate with dispatch.


Candidate Requirements & Qualifications

  • Strict Insurance Compliance: Must be 21+ years old with a valid, unrestricted driver’s license and a clean Motor Vehicle Record (MVR required prior to hire).
  • Driving Experience: Previous experience operating box trucks or large commercial vehicles is preferred, but not required.
  • Physical Stamina: Comfortable working actively outdoors in all Colorado weather conditions. Must be able to lift a minimum of 25 lbs.
  • The Detailing Mindset: Basic knowledge of automotive detailing is a plus, but a strong desire to learn, an obsession with quality control, and strict adherence to trained procedures are required.
  • Customer Facing Attitude: Exceptional communication skills and a professional "people-first" demeanor when interacting with clients on-site.


We will provide training for motivated individuals with the right work ethic. If you are dependable, detail-oriented, and ready for steady, year-round work, apply today.

title: Cybersecurity Lead
description:
🧡 Coverflex

Work changed. Pay didn’t.

Coverflex exists to make compensation work for everyone.
Pay is still rigid, fragmented, and hard to feel.
We turn compensation into choice — one platform, one card, one app — for benefits, meal allowance, insurance and more.

Our platform is simple for HR and meaningful for employees.
We provide choice, smarter compensation tools and empowerment.

⚙️ TL;DR (The Essentials)

Role: Cybersecurity Lead
Seniority Level: Lead
Type: Individual Contributor
Languages: English (main) / Portuguese or Spanish or Italian a plus
Main Tools: AWS and/or GCP security tooling, SIEM, detection/response, EDR/MDM, identity/SSO/MFA, and privileged-access tooling, Vulnerability scanning, application security testing, and penetration-testing workflows, Jira/Notion or equivalent risk, remediation, evidence, and roadmap tracking, Scripting/automation for control operation and evidence collection
Location: Remote (Europe only)
Compensation:

  • Base Salary: 65.000€ to 95.000€ gross yearly

  • Bonus / Commissions: No

  • Equity: Yes – Stock Options under our Equity Incentive Plan

  • Benefits: All Coverflex benefits apply

  • Contract Type: Permanent

💥 Your Impact

Your role will play a major role in our success because…

The Cybersecurity Lead will help Coverflex grow as a trusted, resilient multi-market fintech. By identifying material risks earlier, strengthening security operations and third-party assurance, and making security evidence reusable, this role will protect customers and company data, support reliable payment and benefits services, preserve ISO 27001 and contractual commitments, and reduce friction in launches, enterprise sales, renewals, and audits.

You’ll know you’re successful if, after 90 days...

  1. 100% of material security risks have an owner, treatment decision, due date, and monthly review; a monthly dashboard and quarterly Management Team risk review are in place; and all required ISMS, cybersecurity, and related privacy documentation has a named owner, review cadence, and current approved version.

  2. At least one executive risk exercise and one technical control validation are completed, with ≥90% of resulting actions closed by their due dates; ≥95% of critical/high vulnerabilities are remediated within policy SLA and all exceptions are formally approved and time-bound.

  3. 100% of defined high-risk changes receive a risk-based review before launch; 100% of critical suppliers are tiered and the highest-risk suppliers are assessed, with contractual and technical gaps tracked.

How we’ll measure success:

  • Establish ownership and visibility: consolidate material security risks, findings, exceptions, critical suppliers, security actions, tooling, spend, and key-person dependencies; own and maintain the core ISMS and cybersecurity documentation, including the Information Security Policy and Cybersecurity Risk Management Plan; and publish a risk-ranked 12-month roadmap and management dashboard. Privacy- and GDPR-specific documentation remains jointly coordinated with the DPO and Legal/Compliance, with explicit ownership agreed for each document.

  • Operationalise security governance and resilience: clarify escalation roles, risk thresholds, control ownership, evidence requirements, vulnerability SLAs, and the risk-exception workflow; run an executive risk exercise and technical control validation covering a critical payment partner.

  • Embed proportionate assurance into growth: establish review gates for high-risk launches, architecture changes, and critical vendors; introduce repeatable threat-modelling patterns; tier critical third parties and track material gaps to closure.

⚡ Reality Check - What Makes This Role Hard

Let’s be real - here’s what makes this role challenging:

This is a broad, hands-on role in a scaling, regulated, multi-market environment. The person must move comfortably between technical investigation, cloud and product security, risk and assurance, partner management, and executive communication. They will need to influence teams without taking ownership away from Engineering, Product, Legal/Compliance, the DPO, or business leaders; prioritise ruthlessly with limited dedicated capacity; and build useful guardrails without becoming a gatekeeper. Third-party dependencies, an evolving threat surface, remote-first operations, and fragmented security ownership add complexity.

👤 You

Must-haves (evidence, not years)

  • Senior, hands-on security experience in a regulated fintech, payments, SaaS, or similarly high-trust environment

  • Personally conducted security investigations, tuned detections, assessed cloud and identity controls, reviewed architectures, and validated vulnerability remediation

  • Strong cloud, application/product security, IAM, detection/response, vulnerability management, and third-party risk judgement

  • Experience owning ISO 27001 or comparable assurance while keeping the programme outcome-focused

  • Ability to build a proportionate security programme in a scaling company, not only operate within a mature enterprise function

  • Credibility with engineers and the ability to translate technical detail into clear business recommendations

  • Fluent professional English

Nice-to-have

  • Experience with payment processors, card ecosystems, regulated partners, or multi-market fintech operations

  • Experience using managed security services and specialist providers effectively

  • Security automation and evidence-collection experience

  • Experience with executive risk exercises and supplier resilience scenarios

  • Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CCSP, OSCP, or ISO 27001 Lead Implementer/Auditor; practical evidence matters more than certificates

🧬 Your DNA

Pragmatic, calm under pressure, curious, and evidence-driven. You combine sound judgement with a bias for action, challenge constructively, and communicate risk without fearmongering. You are comfortable doing the work yourself while creating leverage through standards, automation, and collaboration. You understand commercial trade-offs, make clear recommendations, and escalate material risks appropriately rather than seeking universal control.

You should add dedicated security depth and consistent ownership while preserving clear accountability in the teams that own systems and decisions. You will make Engineering, Product, IT, Legal/Compliance, the DPO, and leadership more effective through prioritisation, expert challenge, reusable patterns, direct technical support, and reliable follow-through. You should reduce key-person dependency on Technology Leadership and become the trusted bridge between technical evidence and business risk decisions.

👥 Manager & Team

Meet Your Manager

Hiring Manager: Tiago Fernandes, CTO
Location: Portugal
LinkedIn Profile

Profile Snapshot:

  • Who you are as a person: Curious and motivated by solving meaningful problems with durable systems rather than theatre. My approach can be pragmatic, but I also enjoy exploring a problem deeply before converging on the answer.

  • Who you are as a manager: I give experienced people autonomy and trust them to bring judgement, ownership, and a point of view. I do not always provide perfectly clear context at the outset, so I value people who ask questions, help structure ambiguity, and confirm shared outcomes and priorities.

  • Your type of energy: Calm, analytical, low-ego, and action-oriented—particularly in high-pressure and ambiguous situations.

  • Your communication style: Candid and context-rich. I sometimes provide more context than necessary or do not land the clearest version immediately, so I appreciate people who synthesise, ask clarifying questions, and help turn discussion into explicit decisions and next steps.

  • Your feedback style: Thoughtful and conversational, focused on learning and improving the work rather than assigning blame. I value a two-way dialogue and expect people to ask for clarification when the feedback is not sufficiently clear or actionable.

What is it like to work with you?

You will have meaningful autonomy, access to leadership, and support when a risk requires escalation. I expect you to bring a point of view, go deep enough to understand the facts, and be comfortable creating structure from ambiguity. We will not always begin with perfectly packaged context, so asking questions, summarising what you heard, and making decisions explicit are important. Healthy challenge is welcome, as is helping me simplify or sharpen the framing. The goal is to build a trusted security function that enables the business while being honest about material risk.

Your Team

  • Team structure: This is initially a senior individual-contributor role reporting to the CTO and owning the cybersecurity function. It is a hands-on position rather than a people-management layer. You will maintain the security roadmap, backlog, operating metrics, tooling, targeted specialist support, and core ISMS and cybersecurity policies and plans. You will partner with the DPO and Legal/Compliance on GDPR- and privacy-related documentation, with explicit ownership agreed per document. Engineering and other system-owning teams remain responsible for implementation, remediation, service ownership, and recovery.

  • Other stakeholders: Technology Leadership; Engineering and Infrastructure/Platform; Product; IT; Legal/Compliance; the DPO/Privacy; Finance and Procurement; People; Customer-facing teams; the Management Team; external auditors, penetration testers, managed security providers, cloud/SaaS vendors, and critical regulated/payment partners. The Management Team remains the final decision-maker for material residual-risk acceptance and major business trade-offs.

💜 Access & Belonging (Equal Opportunity)

We hire for impact and potential, not pedigree.
We welcome applications from people with non-linear careers, career breaks, caregiving gaps, and those changing fields.

No discrimination on the basis of age, disability, gender identity/expression, marital or family status, pregnancy, neurodivergence, race/ethnicity, religion/belief, sexual orientation, or any other protected ground.

Assessment fairness:
We anchor on evidence of outcomes (what you shipped, moved, or influenced).
We actively de-bias by using structured rubrics, multiple assessors, and blind screening most of the time (we won’t know your name, gender, or personal info until the interview stage).

📬 Application Clarity

No cover letter required.

Apply with your LinkedIn or upload your CV.
You may be asked a few short, relevant questions.

Total candidate time investment: ~3–5 hours end-to-end.

🧩 Hiring Stages (What to Expect, Why & How Long)

1. CV / LinkedIn Screen — Signal check vs must-haves

• Done by People + Hiring Manager.

• You’ll hear from us within 7 business days.

2. Role-Fit Questionnaire (async)
Purpose: capture signals your CV can’t (languages, tools, scenario judgement) and calibrate seniority.

Format: multiple choice + short answers.

Accessibility: prefer a call? Tell us - we’ll swap for a short chat.

3. Hiring Manager Interview - Deep dive into your work • 45–60 min
Structured around outcomes, decisions, and collaboration.

4. Behavioural Interview - Show how you think • 45-60 min
Use our case or bring a real artefact (deck, PR, analysis, playbook).
We assess clarity, decision quality, stakeholder thinking, and ethics.

5. Case / Work Sample - Show how you think • ≤90 min
Use our case or bring a real artefact (deck, PR, analysis, playbook).
We assess clarity, decision quality, stakeholder thinking, and ethics.

6. Case Review & Team Chat - Walkthrough + Q&A • 20–30 min
You’ll get actionable feedback either way.

7. Final Conversation (CEO / C-Level) — Values, strategy, and your growth • 30–45 min

Optional: References (2–3 people who’ve seen your recent work) - async.

🤖 AI & Hiring Tools Transparency

We use a few tools to reduce bias and improve documentation, not to make hiring decisions.

  • Teamtailor anonymisation: profiles are reviewed without relying on names/personal identifiers.

  • Meeting recording tools (e.g., ): may be used to capture interviews so we can focus on the conversation.

  • ChatGPT: may be used to turn interview notes/transcripts into clear, structured summaries.

Important: every application is reviewed by a human, and no decision or rejection is made by AI. If recording is used, we’ll be transparent and (where required) ask for consent.

⏱️ Speed & Communication

  • Decision: within 4 weeks of your application.

  • Updates: weekly if the process runs longer.

  • Scheduling:interviews between 10:00–16:00 CET (flexible across Europe).

  • Feedback:from the Case stage onwards, you’ll always receive written or verbal feedback - what went well, and what to strengthen next time.

title: Product Manager (Brake Control)
description:
Product Line Overview

Wabtec Transit Brakes & Couplers is a world leader in the supply of braking systems and couplers for all types of trains, on all continents. With more than a century of expertise, our braking systems range from brake manipulators to friction materials, air treatment and generation, brake control and bogie brake equipment. We deliver the widest range of couplers, covering most world standards.

How will you make a difference?

As Brake Control Product Manager, you will own the strategy, competitiveness, and lifecycle performance of Wabtec's Brake Control portfolio. Your mission is to connect customer needs, market trends, business objectives, and technology evolution to develop products that win in today's market while preparing the next generation of brake control systems for tomorrow.

You will define and drive the product roadmap, product architecture evolution, modularization strategy, and platform development for the portfolio. Working closely with Sales, Technical Sales, Engineering, Sourcing, Quality, Operations, and R&D teams, you will translate market opportunities into tangible product and business outcomes.

What will your typical day look like?

  • Define and drive the product strategy, roadmap, and technology vision for the Brake Control portfolio, aligning customer needs, market trends, and business objectives.
  • Own the complete product lifecycle and portfolio performance, from introduction to retirement, ensuring competitiveness, profitability, and relevance in the market.
  • Lead modularization and platforming initiatives to improve scalability, reduce complexity, accelerate development, and increase product re-use.
  • Drive product excellence and cost competitiveness, leading quality, reliability, lifecycle optimization, value engineering, and cost reduction initiatives.
  • Translate market and customer insights into future product requirements, technology roadmaps, and innovation programs.
  • Support profitable business growth by maximizing product positioning, re-use, and competitiveness in customer bids and projects.
  • Lead through influence, aligning Engineering, R&D, Quality, Sourcing, Operations, Service, and Commercial teams around portfolio objectives.
  • Monitor market, competitive, and portfolio performance, driving corrective actions and continuous improvement where required.

What do we want to know about you?

Hard Skills

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a related technical discipline; Master's degree is an advantage.
  • Strong technical foundation in complex engineered systems, product architectures, and lifecycle management; knowledge of brake systems or railway vehicle subsystems is strongly preferred.
  • Ability to translate customer needs, market insights, and business objectives into product strategies, roadmaps, and requirements.
  • Experience with business cases, cost optimization, value engineering, product improvement, or industrial competitiveness initiatives.

Soft Skills

  • Strong ownership mindset with a demonstrated ability to convert ideas into tangible business results.
  • Strategic thinker capable of balancing long-term vision with pragmatic execution.
  • Ability to lead and influence multidisciplinary and multicultural teams without direct authority.
  • Sound judgment, entrepreneurial spirit, and willingness to challenge the status quo while driving continuous improvement.

Others:

  • Fluent English is required (other EU languages are considered a plus)
  • Willingness and ability to travel internationally as required.

Successful candidates may come from Product Management, Engineering, Technical Sales, Quality, Operations, or other relevant functions. More important than prior job title is the ability to combine technical understanding, business acumen, ownership, and cross-functional leadership to deliver results.

Location: this role can be located close to any Wabtec Transit site.

Please, attach your CV in English.

Legal authorization to work in EU is required. We will not sponsor individuals for employment visas, now or in the future, for this job opening.

Please note that we do not accept agency candidate submissions without a formalized agreement with Wabtec Talent Acquisition. If you are an agency/third party Recruiter and have not been engaged by Wabtec for this search, we do not owe you a fee if you submit a candidate to the applicant tracking system that is ultimately hired.

#LI-LF1

What could you accomplish in a place that puts People First?

At Wabtec, it’s not just about a job - it’s about the impact you make. When our people come together, we’re Expanding the Possible by continuously improving what we do and how we do it - for our clients and each other.

If you’re ready to revolutionize how the world moves for future generations, Wabtec is the place for you.

Who are we?

Wabtec is a leading global provider of equipment, systems, digital solutions, and value-added services for the freight and transit rail sectors. Drawing on more than 150 years of experience, we are leading the way in safety, efficiency, reliability, innovation, and productivity. Whether it’s freight, transit, ports, logistics, mining, industrial, or marine, our expertise, technologies, and people together – are accelerating the future of transportation. With roots that date back to George Westinghouse, Thomas Edison, and Louis Faiveley, Wabtec has always built technologies and implemented solutions for a variety of sectors that are critical to meeting the needs of customers and governments alike.

Our global team of about 30,000 employees worldwide delivers performance that moves the world forward. We’re lifelong learners, obsessed with better. Learn more at www.WabtecCorp.com.

Culture powers us and the possibilities.

We believe the best ideas come from a mix of experiences and backgrounds. At Wabtec, we strive every day to create a place where everyone belongs. We’re building a culture where leadership, inclusion and your unique perspective fuel progress.


We’re proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We welcome talent of all backgrounds, experiences, and identities, including race, gender, age, disability, veteran status and more.

Need accommodation? Just let us know - we’ve got you.

title: Systems Analyst Strategic Portfolio Management
description:
Job Description:

The Systems Analyst collaborates with business, clinical, and technical subject matter experts,
Strategic Portfolio Management (SPM) leaders and stakeholders, IT/DTS partners, and other shared
support teams across Intermountain Health to analyze, design, build, test, implement, and
technically and functionally support a spectrum of digital solutions. The role supports the end-to-end
SPM lifecycle, including intake, idea, demand, project, resource, and agile work management such
as enhancements, defects, stories, epics, and sprints. The position applies problem solving, learning
agility, interpersonal communication, project management, documentation proficiency, process
improvement, and technical ServiceNow expertise. The ideal candidate proactively identifies
opportunities, recommends innovative solutions, and coaches process owners through discovery,
documentation, development, deployment, and continuous improvement to achieve strong business,
clinical, and operational outcomes.

We are committed to offering flexible work options where approved and stated in the job posting. However, we are currently not considering candidates who reside or plan to reside in the following states: California, Connecticut, Hawaii, Illinois, Maine, Massachusetts, Minnesota, New York, Pennsylvania, Rhode Island, Virginia, Vermont, Washington.


This position is fully remote. Minimal travel may be expected for trainings or meetings. | Schedule: Monday - Friday, 8AM - 5PM MST. *Expected to support business hours in Mountain Time Zone & occasional off-hours availability may be required to support implementations.




Essential Functions


• User support: Performs operational systems tasks and maintenance. Supports user’s dayto-day needs. Solves low to moderately complex issues, incidents, and problems according

to agreed upon service levels and according to IT/DTS standards.


• Requirements gathering: Gathers and documents requirements through stakeholder

identification and interviews, research, competitive analysis, and user feedback. Works to

align requirements against best practices, system KPIs and technology capabilities.


• Analytics: Under supervision, collaborates on implementation of analytics services,

including creation, distribution, and management of dashboards and reports. Works to

translate customer metrics and KPI requirements into reports and dashboards.


• Project management: Participates in the creation and management of project management

schedules and activities. Consistently meets agreed upon deadlines or escalates issues,

concerns, and barriers to key project leaders. Assists with the prioritization of

tasks/assignments.


• Digital and ServiceNow SME: Applies strong knowledge of digital tools, ServiceNow

capabilities, and leading practices to help the product team and stakeholders understand

what is possible, shape practical solutions, and identify where ServiceNow capabilities can

add value. Proactively brings forward ideas and recommendations, guides solution

conceptualization, strategy, design, configuration, implementation, adoption, and

measurement, and performs light ServiceNow development and configuration within

established platform standards and governance.


• Usability: Under supervision, applies usability best practices, usability research, data

analysis, and quality improvement principles in the development of solutions.


• Quality Assurance: Follows standard testing methodologies, ensuring digital tools and

solutions meet requirements.


• Training: Participates and collaborates in the development and delivery of training, as well as

knowledge-based materials for use by peers or end users.


Skills


• Domain and lifecycle modeling: Uses systems-thinking skills to identify interactions and

relationships among people, processes, data, and technology across the SPM lifecycle,

including intake, idea, demand, project, resource, and agile work management.


• Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including experience

building clear, executive-ready slide decks and presenting concepts, recommendations, and

impacts to senior and executive-level stakeholders and leaders, as well as technical and nontechnical staff.


• Collaboration: Experience working collaboratively within a product team, across technology

teams, and with vendors, vendor partners, key stakeholders, and all levels of system leaders

and caregivers.


• Consensus: Experience building consensus and working effectively within a cross-functional

team.


• Proactive solutioning and innovation: Anticipates needs, investigates root causes, evaluates

new ServiceNow releases and capabilities, and brings forward practical, scalable, and

innovative recommendations.


• Workflow management: Prioritizes and executes work in a high-pressure environment,

manages competing requests, and supports backlog, sprint, and delivery practices to achieve

timely, high-quality outcomes.


Required Qualifications

  • Demonstrated experience providing analysis, design, configuration, implementation (technical and functional) and support of business/financial or clinical information systems or as an expert user of the targeted systems(s)



Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in an information technology field
  • Experience supporting Service Management processes, especially within HR or Healthcare IT environments
  • Experience translating business requirements into clear functional specifications that meet project goals for UX designers, software developers, data architects, QA testers, usability evaluators, and other technical stakeholders.
  • Proficiency with ServiceNow, especially in HR Case Management, Lifecycles and Journeys, and reporting/analytics capabilities
  • Familiarity with Workday and its relationship to functional HR business processes
  • Experience with AI prompt engineering and workflow automation, including tools such as Automation Anywhere, Power Automate, or similar platforms
  • Related certifications such as ITIL Foundations, Lean, Six Sigma, Agile or Scrum

Physical Requirements

  • Interact with others by effectively communicating, both orally and in writing
  • Operate computers and other office equipment requiring the ability to move fingers and hands
  • See and read computer monitors and documents
  • Remain sitting or standing for long periods of time to perform work on a computer, telephone, or other equipment

title: Lead Materials Specialist
description:
How will you make a difference?

As a Material Specialist – Scheduling & Inventory you will play a critical role in ensuring the efficient flow of materials, optimized inventory levels, and on-time delivery performance across the cabs manufacturing operation. Through collaboration with operations, engineering, sales, quality, and supply chain teams, you will drive continuous improvement initiatives that enhance production planning, improve inventory accuracy, reduce operational variances, and strengthen supplier performance. This role will use data-driven decision making to identify opportunities for greater efficiency, improved customer delivery performance, and year-over-year inventory optimization.

What do we want to know about you?

Do you have:

  • A minimum two current years’ experience in a production or materials role in manufacturing industry.
  • Comprehensive knowledge of manufacturing techniques and processes.
  • Bachelor's Degree, required in Engineering, Supply Chain, or Business (or equivalent demonstrated combination of education and experience).
  • Strategic and creative thinking to analyze issues that may arise and create solutions.
  • Experience with MRP systems.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment while having a high degree of attention to details.
  • Knowledge of production/materials control system.
  • Understanding of continuous improvement, lean manufacturing concepts and production schedules preferred.
  • Strong organizational skills.
  • Demonstrates effective communication skills and interpersonal skills.
  • Strong interpersonal skills with demonstrated ability to influence, motivate, coach, and drive accountability.
  • Experience working with Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel and Access.

What will your typical day look like?

  • Oversees Production Scheduling and Material Planning
  • Work with various MRP, quality, and MES software systems to manage material and other systemic requirements.
  • Collaborates with warehouse team to review and improve inventory accuracy and cycle counting programs
  • Lead material presentation on all the production lines.
  • Ensure work order and transactional accuracy as our customers and internal stakeholders change material requirements for modernization and new build locomotive programs.
  • Meet inventory targets including month-end and quarter-close processes for inventory in addition to achieving an elevated level of accuracy during yearly physical inventory.
  • Drive YOY inventory reduction and accuracy improvements & customer on-time performance.
  • Provide clear communication and technical materials guidance to management and other Wabtec employees daily.

title: Data Analyst

Reporting and campaign data

  • Prepare campaign data selections and produce forecasts to support next-year planning
  • Build, maintain and improve Power BI reports and dashboards and action change requests from teams
  • Validate reporting outputs and investigate discrepancies before information is distributed to stakeholders.

Data quality and reconciliation

  • Own repeatable data quality rules and reconciliation processes
  • Investigate exceptions and work with data owners to resolve them
  • Match and reconcile supporter records across systems and support data cleanup

Working with teams

  • Explain data, trends and limitations in plain language so teams can make informed decisions
  • Write user guides and technical documentation so what you build can be used, supported and handed over

Ways of working

  • Keep all code, report logic and definitions in source control and documented, so no data product depends on one person's knowledge
  • Handle supporter and personal information securely and in line with ChildFund's privacy obligations
  • Manage your work with the team, raising risks and blockers early


QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE

  • Strong SQL skills, including writing and debugging multi-step transformation queries
  • Experience building Power BI reports, including data modelling and DAX
  • Demonstrated accuracy: reconciling figures, validating outputs and tracing discrepancies back to source
  • Experience gathering requirements from non-technical stakeholders and delivering against them
  • Tertiary qualification in a relevant discipline or equivalent practical experience


DESIRABLE

  • Experience with Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, Spark or another lakehouse platform

We are seeking an exceptional Technical Product Manager, Chemistry IT Systems, to join our team in Beerse, Belgium or Spring House, Pennsylvania. Our Business Technology team delivers leading-edge technology solutions that advance J&J Innovative Medicine's molecule discovery organization. As a strategic information technology partner, the team supports key scientific functions across medicinal chemistry, computational chemistry, analytical chemistry, DMPK, discovery data sciences, computational sciences, screening, and compound logistics.

Please note that this role is available across multiple countries and may be posted under different requisition numbers to comply with local requirements. Team members partner directly with business stakeholders to analyze business processes, define scientific IT requirements, and build strong partnerships across research and business technology groups. Through these collaborations, the team delivers complex, cross-site, multidisciplinary projects and programs that create meaningful impact across discovery sciences.

In this Technology Product role, the successful candidate will help shape and deliver enterprise-wide discovery informatics platforms that modernize and support lead discovery and optimization across multi-modality research. The role will enable data-driven, AI-augmented discovery workflows across Design-Make-Test-Analyze cycles by translating scientific needs into scalable technology capabilities, integrated data flows, and product roadmaps. The role focuses on applying best-in-class technology to design high-performing platforms that help business partners pursue scientific opportunities that were previously out of reach.

Key Responsibilities
  • Discovery Informatics Strategy and Delivery
    • Contribute to the global delivery of cheminformatics and broader discovery informatics platforms for the Innovative Medicine research organization.
    • Define, evaluate, implement, and champion new data-driven and scientific IT approaches across discovery sciences globally.
    • Identify and drive opportunities to modernize chemistry-centric decision-making through advanced digital capabilities.
  • Portfolio and Product Leadership
    • Lead and support portfolio strategy for assigned product areas by identifying gaps, overlaps, retirement opportunities, and performance improvement recommendations.
    • Define project goals, manage risks and budgets, and ensure measurable impact through effective execution and post-project evaluations.

  • AI, Data, and Technology Enablement
    • Understand the global deployment of AI and machine learning capabilities for molecular invention, including AI-enabled search experiences that allow chemists to retrieve information using natural-language prompt statements and emerging AI agent capabilities that proactively surface relevant information, support workflow automation, and enable alert-based notifications.
    • Apply a strong understanding of data management principles, including data governance, data quality, data integration, and lifecycle management.
    • Support technology adoption and change management across diverse teams and organizational levels.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration and Engagement
    • Lead cross-site, multidisciplinary projects with internal and external partners.
    • Promote team member engagement and commitment while ensuring clear, effective communication between researchers, developers, and engineers.


Required Experience and Qualifications
  • Bachelor's is required preferably in Chemistry or relevant life science or data science field of study.
  • Graduate degree preferred.
  • 5+ years in pharmaceutical R&D molecular discovery with strong exposure to small molecule, peptide and large molecule chemistry research.

Strong technical expertise would be a significant advantage, enabling the individual to provide informed guidance and contribute strategically to solution design and implementation.
    • Experience with pipelining applications such as KNIME or Pipeline Pilot.

title: Product Analyst II
company: MX Build Technologies India Private Limited
description:
We are fueled by a moral imperative to advance mankind, and it all begins with our people, our product, and our purpose. Passion isn’t something we turn on and off; it’s woven into everything we do. If you thrive in high-challenge environments, are inspired by exceptional teammates, and are driven to grow beyond what you thought possible, MX is where you belong.

Come build the future with us. Join an award-winning company that isn’t just shaping the financial industry, but transforming it in ways that create meaningful, lasting impact for millions of people.

Introduction to the Position

MX is on a mission to improve the financial lives of everyone and, for this reason, we’re creating innovative software designed to bring financial freedom to the lives of individuals, families, and communities. Our products help consumers understand and manage their financial data, improve their financial decision-making, and strengthen connections between financial institutions and their customers. We believe that data are central to every important financial action and we’re looking for smart, driven, creative individuals to come build with us!

The MX Product team is responsible for building world-class financial tools that leverage our unrivaled data assets. As consumers and institutions interact with these tools, new insights and information are created that can be transformed into even better products. In service to creating the industry's most compelling products, the Operational Analytics Team takes the lead on the company’s most computationally and analytically complex problems. If you’re keen to conduct careful analyses focused on core business problems, operational analysis, and instrumentation in an intellectually engaging environment, you’ll enjoy working at MX as a Product Analyst.

As a Product Analyst, you’ll partner with colleagues from the Product and Analytics teams to complete a variety of computational activities, including analyzing customer journey and end-user metrics, data mining exercises, data stratification and quality control, and dashboard and KPI development. Your work will inform new product development and help us understand how to maximize our product portfolio’s marketplace effectiveness. As a talented “data wrangler”, you’ll leverage your analytical skills to discover new correlations and predictive relationships using MX’s expanding, world-class data assets. Eager to learn, you’ll also look for ways to enhance your analytical toolbox through side-by-side training and self-directed study. The ability to interpret and communicate analytical results will be important for success, as will patience in the face of analytic uncertainty. Your computational background, collaborative spirit, and hands-on approach to solving problems will mark you as an ideal candidate for this role.

As part of MX’s thriving analytics organization, you’ll enjoy autonomy and the ability to make a real difference in a successful and high-growth company. As you partner with other creative and enthusiastic team members, you’ll be rewarded and recognized for your high-caliber work. MX’s values are central to the company’s success, and you’ll live by questioning assumptions and taking initiative, advancing our data-driven approach to solving problems, and showing empathy and a commitment to radical honesty in equal measure.

Job Responsibilities

  • Work with colleagues from the product and analytics functions to design customer and procedural metrics, complete operational and segmentation analyses, predict end-user behavior, and make data-driven recommendations about product features

  • Evaluate product effectiveness (including versus industry peers), complete market analyses, refine customer value propositions, and collect customer feedback

  • Write scripts to support hypothesis-based and theory-free data mining projects (e.g., create new pattern recognition algorithms and find hidden relationships between features)

  • Create new data assets, modeling features, and dashboards in service to MX’s product platform

  • Monitor data platform system performance to identify and address challenges to data quality (e.g., accuracy, completeness, and reliability) and availability

  • Lead data exploration work to generate insights on product effectiveness, institutional client results, and end-user (consumer) financial health

  • Develop presentations and memoranda to communicate key messages and insights based on rigorous analyses

  • Serve as a subject matter expert on analytical best practices and data visualization

Basic Qualifications (Must-Have)

  • Bachelor’s degree, including quantitative coursework (e.g., Mathematics, Physics, Statistics, Computer Science, or similar)

  • 1-3 years’ experience with operational, financial, or marketing analytics (likely including building dashboards and KPIs and analyzing product performance metrics)

  • Proficiency with at least one database query language (e.g., SQL); familiarity with Python and exposure to modern data science environments (e.g., cloud, Jupyter, and git) is preferred

  • Critical thinking skills, attention to detail, and focus on results

  • Drive to tackle demanding goals with enthusiasm, tenacity in the face of stubborn obstacles, and interest in pursuing personal and technical development alongside other commitments

  • Commitment to client needs and satisfaction, humility in the face of constructive feedback, and production of high-quality work that builds trust and confidence with stakeholders

  • Proven experience presenting analytical results to managers and teammates

Preferred Qualifications

  • Familiarity with Python or other statistical programming languages for data manipulation, analysis, and visualization.

  • Hands-on experience working in modern data science environments (e.g., cloud platforms like AWS/GCP, Jupyter notebooks, version control systems like git).

  • Prior professional experience in fintech, financial services, or high-growth SaaS environments.

  • Proficiency with Excel, including complex formulas, pivot tables, and data modeling.

  • Experience building or optimizing analytics infrastructure, ETL pipelines, or data warehouse implementations.

Compensation

The expected earnings for this role could be comprised of a base salary and other forms of cash compensation, such as bonus or commissions as applicable.

This pay range is just one component of MX’s total rewards package. MX takes a number of factors into account when determining individual starting pay, including job and level they are hired into, location, skillset, peer compensation.

**Please note applicants applying for this position must have the legal right to work in India without the need for sponsorship. We are unable to provide work sponsorship for this role, and candidates should be able to verify their eligibility to work in the country independently. Proof of eligibility to work in India will be required as part of the hiring process.

Work Environment

In this role, a significant aspect of the job involves working in the office for a standard 40-hour workweek. We believe that the collaborative nature of our work and the face-to-face interactions among team members are essential for fostering a dynamic and productive work environment. Being present in the office enables seamless communication, facilitates quick decision-making, and encourages spontaneous collaboration that contributes to the overall success of our projects. We value the synergy that comes from having our team members physically together, allowing for immediate problem-solving, idea exchange, and team building.

As IT Application & Delievery Manager you will be working from our headquaters in Lem, Denmark, but will be a part of a global team located at our sites in Europe and Asia.

Reporting directly to the Vice President, Information Technology, you will play a central role in defining how applications, data, integrations, and AI capabilities support Baettr’s growth strategy.

The job opportunity

As IT Application & Delivery Manager, you will be responsible for ensuring that digital opportunities are translated into measurable business value across the organization.

You will be leading a team of specialists and will be driving the governance, prioritization, and delivery of Baettr's digital portfolio to ensure that business priorities and delivery execution remain aligned.

The role combines leadership, architecture governance, digital transformation, stakeholder management, and operational execution in an international environment.

You will contribute by

  • Set direction for Baettr’s application and enterprise architecture roadmap and ensure coherence across ERP, business applications, integrations, data platforms and AI capabilities in collaboration with the relevant solution architects.
  • Ensure architecture decisions support business priorities, enterprise architecture principles and the digital roadmap.
  • Lead the Applications & Delivery team and ensure successful execution of digital initiatives across the organization.
  • Manage, coach and develop team members, fostering accountability, ownership and cross-functional collaboration.
  • Establish and govern a structured portfolio management process that transforms business opportunities into prioritized digital initiatives.

You have a proven track record of working with Cloud/SaaS-first architecture principles and Best-of-Breed application strategies. You know how to balance business requirements, architecture principles and delivery execution to ensure the right solutions are selected and successfully implemented.

You are an inspiring people leader who creates clarity, empowers teams and drives accountability. You are equally comfortable engaging with executive stakeholders, business leaders and technical specialists.

We offer a position in a dynamic, futureoriented, and international organization with flexible working routines. Our business is growing across all areas, and we live by our values: Stand Accountable, Imagine Better, and Be Respectful.

We are an equal opportunity employer, committed to providing a positive and comfortable working environment where differences are embraced and individuals are supported. Your impact, where you’re really needed.

As our highly valued Technology Operations and Assurance Coordinator, you’ll use your expertise in technology operations, supplier management and information security assurance to ensure SWSPHN's technology environment remains secure, reliable and fit for purpose while enabling our people to deliver meaningful impact across South Western Sydney.


You’ll make an impact at scale by:

  • Coordinating day-to-day technology operations across internal stakeholders, managed service providers and specialist technology partners.

  • Monitoring technology risks, incidents, service performance and improvement activities to ensure issues are resolved and opportunities are acted upon.

  • Supporting information security, business continuity and technology assurance activities, including audits, control reviews and remediation programs.

  • Managing technology supplier relationships and holding providers accountable for agreed service standards, deliverables and outcomes.

  • Maintaining visibility of technology assets, systems, documentation and operational processes to strengthen organisational resilience and reduce reliance on supplier-held knowledge.


What you’ll bring
To succeed in this role, you will have:

  • Demonstrated experience coordinating technology operations, IT service management, technology projects or supplier-delivered technology services.

  • Strong understanding of contemporary technology environments, including cloud platforms, identity and access management, cyber security and business systems.

  • Well-developed stakeholder engagement, problem-solving and organisational skills, with the ability to coordinate competing priorities and drive actions to completion.

  • The ability to analyse information, identify risks and opportunities, and provide clear, practical recommendations to support sound decision-making.


A healthy community. A healthy career.

Are you ready to be part of something bigger, something good?


At South Western Sydney Primary Health Network (SWSPHN), our mission is simple: we’re building healthier communities. Through connection and care, we tackle the region's healthcare challenges by supporting primary health providers. As a not-for-profit, we’re passionate about improving services to meet the diverse and evolving needs of our community.


That really matters. And so do you.

Why South Western Sydney PHN?

We’re a values-driven organisation that sees and supports you as a whole person. What we do isn’t easy, there are many moving parts, but we’re deeply invested in the health of our region, and in your wellbeing.


Here’s what you can expect when you work with us:

Make a Real Impact

As our Technology Operations and Assurance Coordinator, you’ll play a hands-on role in strengthening primary care and improving outcomes for thousands. Every day, you’ll help move the dial on healthcare and make a meaningful difference in people’s lives.

Work in a Way That Works for You

We understand that life doesn’t always fit a 9-to-5. Whether it’s a school drop-off, a family celebration, or hybrid working, we trust you to do your best work—your way. And you’ll find approachable leaders who are genuinely committed to your growth and success.

Be Part of a Kind and Talented Team

The people you work with matter. At SWSPHN, you’ll join a team of dedicated, passionate professionals who collaborate, support one another, and share a deep commitment to primary health.


Are you ready to be part of something bigger?

Join SWSPHN and build a healthy career that works for you.

To apply, please submit your resume and cover letter by Friday 16th October 2026. To find out more, contact Nick McGhie, Executive Manager – Digital Health & Technology, (02) 4632 3019.


Contract until 30 June 2028 with possible extension dependent on funding.

The communities we support are very diverse, and so are their healthcare needs. This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Bilingual Vocational Rehabilitation Specialist based in Canada.

This role focuses on helping eligible Canadian Armed Forces members successfully return to meaningful employment following periods of disability. You will develop individualized, goal-oriented vocational rehabilitation strategies in collaboration with clients, healthcare professionals, policyholders, and care providers. The position combines case management, rehabilitation planning, stakeholder coordination, budget management, and return-to-work program implementation. You will manage a regional caseload covering Ottawa-Gatineau and surrounding areas while occasionally supporting other regions. The role requires strong communication skills, sound judgment, creativity, and the ability to manage competing priorities. It is primarily home-based, with regional travel required and opportunities to work in a flexible and inclusive environment.

Accountabilities:

  • Develop, implement, and monitor innovative, goal-oriented vocational rehabilitation strategies for members receiving disability benefits.
  • Build customized return-to-work plans in collaboration with clients, colleagues, healthcare professionals, policyholders, and other care providers.
  • Coordinate rehabilitation activities and services to support smooth, timely, and sustainable returns to employment.
  • Work with policyholders and other stakeholders to develop creative and practical return-to-work solutions tailored to individual circumstances.
  • Manage an assigned rehabilitation caseload across the Ottawa-Gatineau region and surrounding areas, with potential responsibility for additional geographic areas.
  • Manage rehabilitation-related budgets and ensure resources are used effectively and appropriately.
  • Communicate clearly with members, policyholders, healthcare professionals, and other stakeholders, including when presenting complex or sensitive information.
  • Coordinate and manage external vendors and service providers to ensure appropriate, effective, and efficient rehabilitation treatments and services.
  • Participate in mediation and negotiation sessions when required to help align the interests of clients, care providers, policyholders, and other parties.
  • Balance multiple cases, deadlines, stakeholder needs, and competing priorities while maintaining a high standard of service and documentation.

title: Intermediate Infrastructure Engineer
description:
At Centrapay, we're revolutionising how you spend money both in-store and online. We allow businesses to create digital assets and loyalty programmes so that you can spend and be rewarded anywhere. Some of our partners include Coca-Cola, BNZ, and Farmlands, and we process payments in New Zealand and Australia.

Our payments platform is the heartbeat of what we do. On top of this, we're building our hero app, Payap (), that brings all of our best capabilities to life.

👩‍💻 What you'll actually be working on

These aren't abstract responsibilities. These are real projects from our roadmap:

  • Stress-testing our systems before reality does : chaos engineering and load testing that deliberately breaks things in controlled ways, so we know exactly what happens when traffic spikes 10x on a public holiday or a dependency quietly falls over at 2am.
  • Rolling out an AI Harness across engineering: not a chatbot bolted onto the sidebar, but tooling and workflows that change how we actually ship, review, and debug code day to day.
  • Building disaster recovery that actually recovers: complete regional failover, so if an entire cloud region disappears mid-transaction, our system keeps moving people's money and nobody but us ever notices.

🏋️‍♀️ How we actually work

  • You build it, you run it, you own it. Engineers at Centrapay ship features end-to-end and see them through production. When something breaks or could be better, you have the context and autonomy to fix it - no waiting for permission or handoffs to other teams.
  • Learn by building. We give you business problems, not specs. "Partners need faster onboarding" is your starting point, and how you solve it is up to you. You'll do market research, run spikes, and explore the solution space. No ticket grooming, no story pointing. We also have 10% time and hackathons where you can experiment with new tech you wouldn't normally get to use.
  • Progress over perfection. We deploy to production daily, and you'll push code on your first day. We believe in shipping early, iterating fast, and learning from real usage.
  • Work across the stack. Backend, frontend, infrastructure. Whatever it takes to deliver amazing experiences for our customers.

📚 Our stack

Don't stress if you haven't touched some of these, we'll help you bridge the gaps:

  • AI tools:Claude Code, Cursor, Github Copilot
  • Backend & data:Node.js, DynamoDB, Redis, Vitest
  • Frontend:Vue.js, Tailwind CSS, Astro, Testing Library, Playwright
  • Infrastructure & operations:AWS, Kubernetes, Terraform, Honeycomb, OpenTelemetry
  • Tooling:Claude, Github, Slack, Notion, Figma

Requirements

👀 Who we're looking for

  • At least 3 years shipping real code to users - we're looking for people who've learned from real mistakes and know what it takes to build reliable systems
  • Clear writing: since we're async-first and most of our communication happens in writing
  • Comfortable with ambiguity: you’ll be expected to talk to users and figure out what to build

🏌️ Why you might not apply (and why you should anyway)

  • "I don't have AWS experience" - We care more about how you think than what cloud services you have used. If you can build on GCP or Azure, you can learn AWS in a week, and we'll pair with you to help you get up to speed.
  • "I don't live in Auckland" - No problem, we want you work to where you work best.

👋 The interview process

We believe in being open and transparent, so here’s exactly what to expect:

  1. First chat (1 hour video call) - an opportunity to get to know you, talk about the role and Centrapay
  2. Take-home task - 2-4 hours on your schedule
  3. Code review session (1 hour video call) - discuss your task, design decisions, and trade-offs together
  4. Final chat (30 minutes) - an opportunity to connect with our CEO and CTO

🚀 Why Join Us?

  • Be part of a fast-growing fintech shaping the future of payments
  • Work with a team that values innovation, collaboration and ambition
  • Competitive compensation, growth opportunities, and a chance to make a real impact

Benefits

We look after our people at Centrapay, a key focus is our culture and ensuring we create a positive and healthy work environment. We continuously look at ways to make improvements and regularly ask for employee feedback and input.

🏄 Your key benefits

  • We offer flexible working
  • Awesome office location at City Works Depot (if you're in Auckland)
  • 6 weeks annual leave
  • A Macbook Pro
  • We have a down-to-earth, open culture that values inclusion
  • In-person and online social activities to keep you connected
  • Training and development opportunities
  • Sick leave from day one
  • Free health insurance via Southern Cross
  • Free Life insurance
  • Additional parental leave entitlements

For more information on Centrapay please visit

BNZ and Centrapay are partnering together to lead the charge in payment innovation and push the boundaries of what’s possible.

title: AI engineer for agentic AI
description:
Are you passionate about building sophisticated AI agents that solve real customer problems? We are looking for an AI Engineer to join our Conversational AI unit in the Personal Customers AI Centre of Excellence, where you will design and implement multi-agent workflows that power next-generation self-service experiences for our customers.

About the role

In this hands-on engineering role, you will combine deep LLM expertise with strong software engineering fundamentals. You will design and implement AI agents, enhance our existing AI Assistant with advanced actionable flows and build multi-agent sets that enable customers to resolve queries and complete tasks independently.

You will work with AWS Bedrock, AWS Agent Core and orchestration frameworks such as LangChain and LangGraph, connecting to internal information sources in AWS and Databricks to deliver intelligent, multi-agent conversational experiences.

What will you do:

  • Design and implement AI agents, including tool definitions, action groups and knowledge base integrations for conversational workflows, and engineer RAG pipelines that connect agents to internal structured and unstructured data
  • Design and build multi-agent sets with orchestration patterns such as routing, delegation, parallelisation and result aggregation to deliver end-to-end self-service capabilities
  • Develop prompt engineering strategies, system prompts, memory systems and evaluation frameworks to ensure consistent, hallucination-resistant agent outputs and good performance on relevance, faithfulness, latency and cost
  • Write production-grade Python code with full test coverage, structured logging, observability hooks and robust error handling, and contribute to CI/CD pipelines, containerisation and cloud-native development on AWS
  • Collaborate with domain experts and product teams to translate customer journeys into agent task decompositions and evaluation rubrics and maintain agent evaluation frameworks to detect regressions as models and prompts evolve

Your skills and experience

You have:

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience, including at least 2 years focused on LLM or AI systems, and experience building and deploying AI-powered applications using Python
  • Hands-on experience with AWS Bedrock and at least one orchestration framework (for example LangChain, LangGraph or similar), and a strong understanding of RAG architectures, vector databases (for example FAISS, Pinecone, OpenSearch), embedding models and tool-use or function-calling patterns
  • Proficiency in prompt engineering (system prompts, few-shot prompting, chain-of-thought reasoning), familiarity with LLM evaluation frameworks and metrics (relevance, faithfulness, hallucination detection) and experience with MCP servers, APIs and working with data more broadly
  • Experience with CI/CD, containerisation (Docker, Kubernetes), cloud-native development on AWS and solid software engineering practices including testing, logging, observability and version control (Git)

It is a plus if you have hands-on AWS Agent Core experience, a background in financial services or other regulated industries, experience with multi-agent systems and complex orchestration patterns or customer-facing chatbots.

You will work primarily with:

  • Cloud and AI platforms such as AWS Bedrock, AWS Agent Core and Databricks, Python for implementation, LLM and agentic frameworks including LangChain, LangGraph, Strands, MCP and OpenAI APIs, and DevOps tooling including Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD and observability solutions

What we offer

You will work on cutting-edge GenAI projects with real-world impact for millions of customers in a department with a solid track record of scaled solutions. You will join a collaborative, cross-functional team with room for autonomy and a flexible working environment, and you will work in our new headquarters with great facilities.

Interested?

Apply now or reach out to Gry Bærentzen at CGBA@danskebank.dk for more information. Let us build the future of AI together.

title: Instructional Design Lead
description:
With more than 225 branch offices across North America, Associa is building the future of community for nearly five million residents worldwide. Our 11,000+ team members lead the industry with unrivaled education, expertise, and trailblazing innovation. For more than 43 years, Associa has brought positive impact and meaningful value to communities. To learn more, visit .



Job Description

The Instructional Design Lead is a hands-on people leader responsible for guiding a small team of Instructional Designers in the creation of high-quality, outcome-driven learning experiences for internal and customer-facing audiences. This role combines deep instructional design expertise with strong leadership, communication, quality assurance, and coaching skills to elevate the capability, consistency, and professionalism of the centralized Learning & Development team.

The Instructional Design Lead is accountable for strengthening instructional design standards, improving content quality, developing team capability, and ensuring learning solutions are aligned to business needs, learner outcomes, and adult learning principles. This leader partners closely with L&D program leaders, facilitators, Product Enablement, Operations, and other cross-functional stakeholders to translate complex needs into clear, engaging, scalable learning solutions.

Work location & model: Richardson, TX, on-site, 5 days per week

Job Duties and Responsibilities

Leadership & Team Management

  • Supervise, coach, and develop a small team of Instructional Designers, setting clear expectations for quality, timeliness, collaboration, and professional standards.
  • Provide consistent mentoring, feedback, and skill-building support to grow the team’s instructional design capability, attention to detail, and ownership of quality.
  • Model strong people leadership, emotional intelligence, professional communication, accountability, and constructive problem solving.
  • Manage team workload, project assignments, priorities, and capacity across multiple learning initiatives while ensuring quality is not sacrificed for speed.
  • Create a culture of design excellence, curiosity, innovation, collaboration, continuous improvement, and thoughtful execution.

Instructional Design Strategy & Learning Outcomes

  • Lead the design of learning experiences that are grounded in clear learning outcomes, adult learning principles, learner needs, and business objectives.
  • Establish and reinforce instructional design standards, development workflows, quality criteria, templates, and review checkpoints for the centralized L&D team.
  • Translate complex business processes, role expectations, system workflows, and stakeholder needs into structured, engaging, and scalable learning solutions.
  • Guide the team in selecting the right learning modality, including eLearning, instructor-led training, blended learning, performance support, video, simulations, and job aids.
  • Ensure learning solutions move beyond task completion and are intentionally designed to build knowledge, confidence, behavior change, and measurable performance outcomes.

Content Governance & Quality Assurance

  • Conduct detailed quality reviews of instructional design deliverables, including eLearning modules, facilitator guides, participant materials, videos, graphics, assessments, job aids, and ILT/VILT course materials.
  • Provide constructive, specific, and actionable feedback that improves the work product while developing the designer’s judgment, design skill, and attention to detail.
  • Develop and maintain content standards, templates, visual design expectations, accessibility expectations, and review protocols for all L&D training materials.
  • Ensure learning materials are accurate, polished, learner-centered, instructionally sound, and ready for professional delivery to internal or client-facing audiences.
  • Lead periodic reviews of the content library to improve consistency, relevance, usability, and alignment to current business processes.

Learning Analytics & Outcomes Evaluation

  • Partner with L&D leaders and stakeholders to define measurable learning outcomes, success criteria, and evaluation approaches for training programs.
  • Embed appropriate assessments, knowledge checks, practice activities, feedback loops, and performance indicators into instructional design deliverables.
  • Use learner feedback, facilitator observations, performance data, and stakeholder input to identify content improvements and strengthen learning effectiveness.
  • Translate evaluation insights into practical recommendations that improve content quality, learner engagement, and business impact.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Stakeholder Alignment

  • Partner professionally with L&D program leaders, facilitators, Product Enablement, Operations, Implementation, Client Experience, Support, and other stakeholders to clarify needs, align priorities, and plan learning solutions.
  • Represent the instructional design function in meetings, demos, project planning sessions, and stakeholder discussions with confidence, clarity, and credibility.
  • Ask effective discovery questions, synthesize input, identify learning implications, and recommend appropriate design approaches.
  • Serve as an advocate for learner needs, usability, instructional quality, and practical application in cross-functional discussions

Requirements

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree required — Education, Instructional Design, Learning Sciences, Organizational Development, Educational Technology, or related field.
  • Master’s degree preferred in Instructional Design, Learning Experience Design, Adult Learning, Organizational Development, or Learning Technologies.
  • Professional certifications (preferred):
    • ATD CPTD or APTD
    • Instructional design, learning experience design, or adult learning certification
    • Advanced eLearning authoring, video development, graphic design, accessibility, or facilitation design credentials preferred

Experience

  • 5+ years of progressive instructional design, learning experience design, curriculum development, or related L&D experience.
  • Demonstrated experience supervising, leading, mentoring, or coaching Instructional Designers or comparable learning roles.
  • Advanced hands-on experience with instructional design tools and methods, including eLearning authoring tools (Articulate—Rise & Storyline), video development, graphic design, instructor-led training design, facilitator guides, simulations, assessments, and job aids.
  • Deep knowledge of adult learning theory, learning science, curriculum architecture, learning outcomes, assessment design, and blended learning methodologies.
  • Proven ability to review complex learning deliverables, identify quality gaps, and provide clear, constructive feedback that improves both the work product and the designer’s capability.
  • Strong professional presence with the ability to present recommendations, facilitate design conversations, influence stakeholders, and represent L&D with credibility.
  • Demonstrated success designing scalable training programs in a SaaS, technology, product, operations, or process-transformation environment preferred.

  • Customer Focus & Impact: Understands how server, identity, storage, and cloud reliability affect end users and business units; resolves Tier III incidents and problems in ways that minimize disruption and rebuild confidence in IT; delivers infrastructure projects and migrations that create lasting value rather than short-term fixes.

title: Psykologer til Pædagogisk Psykologisk Rådgivning
description:
Har du lyst til at være en del af et stærkt tværfagligt fællesskab og være med til at gøre en forskel for Gladsaxe Kommunes børn og unge og deres familier fra et bredt tværprofessionelt PPR-perspektiv?

Vi søger tre nye psykologkolleger pr. 1. december eller snarest derefter. For to af stillingerne er der tale om fastansættelser, den tredje er et barselsvikariat med mulighed for forlængelse.

Om os
PPR’s primære opgave er at kvalificere og understøtte såvel professionelle som forældre, og i samarbejde med skoler og børnehuse være med til at etablere stærke lærings- og udviklingsmiljøer for kommunens børn og unge. Det gør vi bl.a. gennem konsultative indsatser, på netværksmøder, gennem iagttagelse og observation, målrettet supervision og sparring, hjælp til kvalificering af individuelle handleplaner og gennem etablering af sampraksisforløb og undervisning af professionelle. Derudover har nogle psykologer også opgaver indenfor lettilgængelige behandlingstilbud, hvor de fx varetager forældreworkshops eller har afgrænsede samtaleforløb om fx tristhed, bekymringer, selvskade.

I Gladsaxe Kommune har vi de seneste år været igennem en større og spændende forandringsproces, som vi har kaldt ”Deltagelsesmuligheder for alle”. Vi er rykket ud af rådhuset i tværprofessionelle teams og er aktivt ude på skolerne mindst to dage om ugen. Vores vision er at arbejde på tværs af fagprofessioner og afdelinger, sammen med bl.a. familiebehandlere og rådgivere, for at skabe de bedste betingelser for gode lærings- og deltagelsesmuligheder i fællesskabet og for det enkelte barn.

Som psykolog i PPR bliver du tilknyttet et fast tværprofessionelt team og en skole.

Dine opgaver vil bl.a. være
  • Yde konsultativ vejledning og rådgivning til skoler og børnehuse
  • Observation og sparring med fagprofessionelle i børnehuse og/eller på skolen
  • Arbejde med sampraksis - praksisnært samarbejde med fagprofessionelle i barnets kontekst
  • Udarbejde pædagogisk psykologiske vurderinger
  • Deltage i supervisionsopgaver af fagprofessionelle sammen med andre PPR-medarbejdere

Om dig/jer
Vi søger tre fagligt stærke psykologer, der kan passe godt ind, men som også gerne må tilføre psykologgruppen, på cirka 35 psykologer, og dit kommende tværprofessionelle team nye ideer, perspektiver, kompetencer og kvaliteter. Det vigtigste er, at du:
  • Brænder for kompleksiteten i PPR-arbejdet, hvor to dage sjældent er ens
  • Ønsker at arbejde i et tæt tværprofessionelt fællesskab
  • Har lyst til at arbejde tæt på praksis i klasserummet og i børnehusene
  • Har erfaring med specialpædagogiske tilgange og metoder
  • Er engageret i det pædagogisk psykologiske arbejde med professionelle, børn og deres familier
  • Holder af at arbejde både selvstændigt og sammen med andre

Du vil blive tilknyttet en mentor og modtage intern supervision. Vi lægger vægt på løbende opkvalificering i relation til vores opgaver i PPR. Er du på vej mod autorisation/praksisuddannelse, vil der blive lagt en plan for et uddannelsesforløb i samarbejde med din nærmeste leder.

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår
Ansættelse sker efter gældende overenskomst.

Vil du vide mere
For yderligere information se eller kontakt teamleder Martin Louv på telefon 24 48 71 25.

Ansøgningsfrist
18. oktober 2026.
Ansættelsessamtaler forventes afholdt 23. oktober 2026.

I Gladsaxe tager vi udgangspunkt i borgernes og virksomhedernes behov og trivsel i alt, hvad vi gør. Bæredygtig velfærd og udvikling er en mærkesag for os og vi arbejder for både social, miljømæssig og økonomisk bæredygtighed. Med FN’s verdensmål som ramme ser vi en bæredygtig fremtid som noget, vi skaber sammen – med borgere, virksomheder, foreninger og lokalsamfundet. Du kan læse mere om vores mål i Gladsaxestrategien.

Ingen ansatte i Gladsaxe Kommune må ryge eller bruge tobaksrelaterede produkter i arbejdstiden, som for eksempel snus og vapes.

Vi opfordrer alle interesserede uanset alder, køn/identitet, seksualitet, handicap, religion eller etnisk tilhørsforhold til at søge stillingen.
