title: Sr. Digital Designer, Creative Marketing
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Sr. Digital Designer, Creative Marketing based in Brazil.

This role is focused on creating compelling digital experiences and visual storytelling across a broad range of marketing channels. You will translate strategic marketing concepts into innovative creative assets for social media, email, display, websites, and other digital platforms. As a senior designer, you will take the lead on high-visibility projects and help establish creative direction and design standards. You will collaborate closely with internal stakeholders, creative teams, and business partners to develop customer-focused solutions. The position combines hands-on design, art direction, creative strategy, and trend awareness in a fast-paced retail environment. You will also have the opportunity to influence long-term digital experiences and contribute to continuous innovation across the organization.

Accountabilities:

  • Collaborate with internal agency teams, marketing stakeholders, and business partners to understand creative requirements and translate strategic objectives into innovative digital design solutions.
  • Lead the development of best-in-class digital marketing assets across social media, email, display advertising, homepage experiences, and other digital channels.
  • Provide creative direction and art direction for photo and video shoots, ensuring concepts remain customer-focused, aligned with creative briefs, and consistent with established brand standards.
  • Lead creative ideation sessions and design discussions, developing strong concepts, layouts, animations, and visual storytelling that elevate digital marketing initiatives.
  • Establish and communicate creative direction, design standards, and visual approaches while helping guide other designers and presenting recommendations to senior leadership.
  • Identify opportunities to improve and innovate digital creative output by monitoring competitors, emerging design trends, technologies, and evolving customer expectations.
  • Manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously while meeting strict deadlines and maintaining a high standard of creative quality.
  • Contribute to long-term initiatives designed to enhance digital platforms, customer experiences, and overall creative capabilities.
  • Advocate for customer-focused design decisions and ensure creative solutions effectively address business objectives and audience needs.
  • Continuously explore new creative approaches and opportunities that can strengthen digital engagement and position the organization as a leader in creative marketing.

    • Requirements:

    • 6+ years of professional experience in digital marketing design, creative design, or a closely related field.
    • Degree in a related discipline or equivalent combination of formal training, certification, and professional experience.
    • Extensive experience with Adobe Creative Suite, Figma, digital asset management systems, and collaborative design tools.
    • Strong experience developing advertising concepts and integrated creative campaigns within a corporate, agency, retail, or comparable environment.
    • Significant experience in retail and/or eCommerce design, with an understanding of customer-focused digital experiences.
    • Experience creating digital-ready artwork and adapting creative assets for multiple platforms and formats.
    • Familiarity with tools and platforms such as Apple-based systems, Adobe Creative Suite, Figma, Dropbox, and DAM platforms such as Brandfolder.
    • Advanced visual design, creative conceptualization, layout, animation, and art-direction capabilities.
    • Strong ability to present creative concepts, communicate design rationale, and influence stakeholders at different organizational levels.
    • Excellent relationship-building and business communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across creative and non-creative teams.
    • Strong organizational and prioritization skills, with the ability to manage competing projects and shift focus quickly when business needs change.
    • Strong problem-solving skills, ownership, initiative, and urgency when addressing complex creative challenges.
    • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, remote environment and collaborate with distributed teams.
    • Willingness and ability to travel by car or plane, including occasional overnight stays, and work extended hours when project requirements demand it.

      • Benefits:

      • Full-time opportunity based in Brazil with a remote work environment.
      • Opportunity to work on high-visibility digital marketing initiatives across social, email, display, web, and other digital channels.
      • Senior-level ownership of creative direction, design concepts, and customer-focused digital experiences.
      • Opportunity to influence design standards and creative strategy across multiple projects and stakeholders.
      • Exposure to retail and eCommerce environments with complex, high-volume digital marketing needs.
      • Opportunity to work across modern design and collaboration tools, including Figma, Adobe Creative Suite, and digital asset management platforms.
      • Collaborative environment with opportunities to work closely with marketing, creative, business, and leadership teams.
      • Professional growth through exposure to emerging creative trends, digital innovations, art direction, and long-term platform initiatives.
      • Opportunity to contribute to continuous innovation and help shape compelling digital experiences across multiple customer touchpoints.

title: Head of Data Practitioner
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Head of Data Practitioner based in United Kingdom.

This is a senior consulting leadership role focused on helping private equity investors and portfolio companies turn data opportunities into measurable business outcomes. You will lead complex data engagements from strategic diagnosis through transformation planning and practical execution. The role combines deep expertise in data strategy and modern data platforms with strong commercial judgment and executive-level communication. You will build trusted relationships with senior technology and business leaders while shaping data strategies, operating models, investment priorities, and delivery roadmaps. You will translate complex data challenges into clear recommendations and actionable plans that support value creation. The position is fully remote from anywhere in Europe, offering an international and collaborative environment with exposure to high-impact transformation initiatives.

Accountabilities

  • Own senior client relationships across data engagements, building trusted partnerships with CDOs, CTOs, CIOs, and other executive stakeholders.
  • Lead the development of data strategies that connect business priorities and value-creation opportunities with target data capabilities, technology choices, operating models, and delivery roadmaps.
  • Lead complex data transformation initiatives from initial diagnosis through implementation planning, including data-platform modernisation, data governance, data quality, data products, analytics, and AI enablement.
  • Structure ambiguous data and business challenges by defining key questions, developing workplans, managing workstreams, and maintaining focus on the issues with the greatest impact.
  • Develop compelling executive-level narratives that bring together analysis, stakeholder input, and specialist perspectives into clear recommendations and decisions.
  • Bridge commercial, business, technology, and data perspectives to ensure recommendations reflect business priorities, technical realities, architectural considerations, delivery feasibility, and execution risks.
  • Connect data initiatives to value-creation economics, including opportunity sizing, business cases, investment requirements, benefits, dependencies, and strategic trade-offs.
  • Challenge assumptions, pressure-test recommendations, and identify where specialist expertise is required across data engineering, architecture, governance, analytics, AI, and transformation.
  • Drive engagements beyond analysis by establishing prioritised actions, accountable delivery plans, and practical pathways from strategy to execution.

    • Requirements

    • Experience at a level comparable to a high-performing consulting Director, Associate Director, or Senior Consultant, with a proven record of leading complex data engagements and managing senior client relationships.
    • Strong consulting capabilities, ideally gained within a leading strategy, digital, data, or transformation consultancy, or through comparable high-stakes advisory and transformation environments.
    • Deep expertise in data strategy and transformation, with practical experience across modern data platforms, data architecture, governance, data quality, data products, analytics, or AI enablement.
    • Demonstrated ability to structure ambiguous business and data problems, develop hypotheses, lead rigorous analysis, manage teams, and turn findings into compelling executive-level narratives.
    • Strong credibility with senior executives and functional leaders, including CDOs, CTOs, CIOs, CEOs, and leaders across data, technology, product, and transformation.
    • Strong commercial and financial acumen, including experience sizing opportunities, developing business cases, quantifying benefits, assessing investment requirements, and evaluating strategic trade-offs.
    • Experience leading complex data programmes or transformations, with sufficient technical depth to challenge decisions around architecture, platforms, governance, operating models, and delivery approaches.
    • Hands-on leadership style, combining executive-level presence with the ability to guide analysis, challenge team thinking, and personally shape strategy and key deliverables.
    • Practical, action-oriented approach with strong collaboration, communication, curiosity, and the ability to operate effectively in complex and ambiguous environments.

      • Benefits

      • Fully remote position, with the flexibility to work from anywhere in Europe.
      • Opportunity to lead high-impact data strategy and transformation engagements with private equity investors and portfolio companies.
      • Direct exposure to senior executives and decision-makers, including CDOs, CTOs, CIOs, and CEOs.
      • Opportunity to shape data strategies and transformation programmes that connect technology investments to measurable business value.
      • Broad exposure to modern data platforms, data architecture, governance, analytics, AI, and operating-model transformation.
      • Collaborative, international working environment with multidisciplinary teams and complex client challenges.
      • Opportunity to develop trusted senior client relationships and contribute to strategic advisory and value-creation initiatives.
      • Scope to influence engagements from initial strategy and diagnosis through prioritisation and implementation planning.

Customer Services Division

Information & Communication Technology Services (ICTS)

The division is responsible for the IT Service Desk, student computer lab management services, IT installations, classroom support services, service level agreements, training, and communicating with the University community on behalf of ICTS. The IT Service Desk offers phone services (including the University’s switchboard) as well as desktop support for UCT staff and students.

  • At least 2 years' relevant work experience in a customer-focused IT support position.
  • An unendorsed code 8 driver’s licence.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Capturing support requests.
  • Researching and providing accurate and comprehensive solutions to customers via telephone and onsite.
  • Participating in team projects, as well as research and development of services and products.

title: Campaign Organizer- Ottumwa
description:
Role: Campaign Organizer

Location and Timeline: We are hiring full-time Campaign Organizers to begin immediately and continue through the end of the year. The locations are Sioux City, Ottumwa, Waterloo/Cedar Falls, and Dubuque.

Who We Are: Vote Blue is a field firm specializing in face-to-face canvassing operations. At Vote Blue, we mobilize voters to get to the polls. Our field campaigns have provided the margin of victory in close elections at the local, state, and national levels. Trump and Republicans at all levels of government are stomping on our rights, making everything unaffordable so a few billionaires can get even richer, and dismantling the very fabric of our nation. Vote Blue’s sole focus is on mobilizing and engaging voters to participate in the elections this fall and fight back at the ballot box.

General Overview:

Organizers will be responsible for driving a high-volume field program in key counties across Iowa, with a primary focus on petition collection and door-to-door canvassing to talk to voters. Organizers will engage Iowans around corporate polluter accountability, health care, big ag, affordability, and the 2026 election, including supporting Josh Turek for U.S. Senate, Rob Sand for Governor, and Christina Bohannan (IA-01), Lindsay James (IA-02), and Sarah Trone Garriott (IA-03) for Congress.

Organizers will spend the majority of their time collecting petitions, knocking doors, and building relationships with voters and community members. They will also recruit, train, and coordinate volunteers to support canvassing efforts, helping build a consistent team of volunteers who can join organizers in the field.

What You’ll Do:

  • Generate Campaign Actions
    • Gather over a thousand petitions from the community in support of key campaign issues
    • Knock over a thousand doors in support of Josh Turek for U.S. Senate, Rob Sand for Governor, and Christina Bohannan (IA-01), Lindsay James (IA-02), or Sarah Trone Garriott (IA-03) for Congress (depending on your district).
    • Recruit and train volunteers to generate more petitions and volunteer engagement at events.
  • Recruit and Train a Community of Volunteer Activists
    • Call and text supporters and recruit them into grassroots actions.
    • Identify new supporters and volunteers by knocking doors, gathering petitions, flyering, and conducting in-field recruitment efforts in the community and on local campuses
    • Run grassroots skills trainings to develop effective campaigners among volunteers.
    • Keep meticulous track of a volunteer list so that no potential volunteer falls through the cracks.
  • Manage Digital Campaign, Data Management, and Reporting Tools
    • Demonstrate public support by recruiting volunteers to post on their own social media platforms including Facebook, Instagram, and Twitter.
    • Use peer-to-peer texting services and relational organizing tools to communicate with community members.
    • Send timely and compelling email campaigns to recruit activists to campaign activities.
    • Track every interaction with detailed notes in order to report numbers daily and write weekly reports on the results of the campaign.

Who You Are & Keys to Success (the must-haves):

To be successful in this job, you will excel in these areas:

  • Relationship Building: You develop and maintain strong, collaborative relationships with a diverse group of local and statewide community members. You are attentive and empathetic to the communities we serve, regardless of race, ethnicity, class, gender, or ability, and can identify shared values across communities for collective growth. You can build authentic relationships through authenticity and reliability, continuously uplifting others and their goals. You are comfortable and experienced in public speaking to a group about environmental, jobs, health care issues and climate change.
  • Inclusive and Collaborative Leadership: You approach leadership with a “power with” mindset that recognizes the impact power hierarchies have in different settings. You can learn from others, see and hear other perspectives, and step in or step back as necessary. You are reliable and accountable, always transparent about your abilities, capacities, and expectations. You honor the time and commitments of others while inspiring them to meet goals.
  • Commitment to Equity and Inclusion: You have a proven ability to develop meaningful connections with diverse communities, including a wide range of community organizations, community leaders, and community members. You work with the community and within the workplace to identify areas of improvement for a more equitable environment. You take continued action and efforts to improve your REI knowledge, skills, and tools.
  • Drive to Achieve Results: You have experience accomplishing ambitious goals and getting results, even when there are obstacles. You have the experience or ability to plan backwards to meet multiple goals timely and effectively. When there are unexpected changes, you bounce back and adjust quickly, learning and improving from any mistakes.

Skills and Experiences we Expect of all Vote Blue employees:

  • Commitment to equity and justice, with an agreement to our North Star (below).
  • Experience bringing a lens of inclusivity to all of your interactions with colleagues and community members.
  • Passion for the role that your work plays in creating change in the world.
  • Kindness and consideration for others.
  • Drive to work collaboratively: learning from others; stepping-in or stepping-back when needed.
  • Transparency: comfort admitting what you do and don’t know, your capacity, and abilities.
  • Task management: Able to adapt to the evolving needs of a project. Able to tackle big-picture projects and break them down into smaller pieces.
  • Organized and efficient: Experience or demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects or goals at once in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
  • Acute attention to detail: Track interactions and tasks with detailed notes. Plans ahead for roadblocks and bounces back quickly when problems arise.
  • Effective communication skills (written or spoken) that are clear, concise and honest.
  • Comfortable and excited to speak about the campaign publicly.
  • Coach and learning mentality: successful experience or willingness to learn new things and pick up new skills on the job. Able to learn from mistakes and try again.
  • Understanding of how your words and actions affect others, including an awareness of power language and communication accessibility.
  • Ability to work weekends and weekday evenings, occasional holidays.

Nice-to-Haves, but Not Required:

  • Organizing experience within or around Iowa.
  • Experience working for nonprofits and issue campaigns.
  • Data Management and Evaluation Experience: Experience working with various data management systems and tools, mainly Google Suite.
  • Experience with Relevant Campaign Tools and Technologies: VAN, Action Network, ThruText, MailChimp, eCRMs like EveryAction, or social media tools (Twitter, Facebook, Instagram).
  • Event or Project Planning & Management, Implementation or Evaluation.
  • Knowledge or previous experience working on this issue is a plus, but not required.

If you were here right now, you would be:

  • Recruiting, training and developing activist leaders in your community to collect supporter petitions, educate others on key campaign issues, and recruit constituents to in-district events and actions.
  • Planning and executing events around corporate accountability, climate action, and health care including, but not limited to: door knocking, phonebanking, petitioning, visibility events, educational events, and more.
  • Developing relationships with community and campus leaders on corporate accountability, health care, and justice for collaborative recruitment, event planning, and power building.
  • Engaging and expanding our support network through public visibility actions, voter outreach, and relationship-building.

Salary, Benefits and Perks:

The salary for this position is $55,000 to $67,000 for full-time at 50 hours per week. Pay within this range is determined through an equity calculator. As part of The Vote Blue’s commitment to compensation equity and transparency, we have a no-negotiation policy. Salary negotiations can introduce bias and perpetuate wage inequality. At the end of the campaign, there may be opportunities for advancement. We do offer a monthly cell phone stipend of $50.

Apply Here: https://www.theoutreachteam.net/jobs

What Else You Should Know:

Our organization is inclusive of POC, ethnic/culture minorities, LGBTQIA+ individuals, individuals with disabilities, who are neurodivergent, regardless of educational backgrounds, previous incarceration or convictions. Our leadership team reflects our inclusivity and is reflective of the progressive community we work in and serve.

Please note: We want to hire people of all gender identities. This hiring platform (JazzHR) does not allow us to add in specific options for gender identities outside of the binary, but we are currently working with them to find a solution.

title: Systems Engineer IV
description:
Who will you be working with?

Wabtec's Train Handling solutions include Trip Optimizer® and Locotrol®, which work together to optimize train performance and automate freight operations. Trip Optimizer creates and executes fuel-efficient operating plans that meet schedule and train-handling requirements, while Locotrol enables coordinated control of distributed locomotives throughout the train. Together, these technologies improve train handling, fuel efficiency, operational safety, and the ability to operate longer and heavier trains.

As a Systems Engineer, you will collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams, product management, program leadership, and railroad customers to develop and deliver advanced train automation solutions that drive operational efficiency and business value.

How will you make a difference?

As a Systems Engineer, you will lead portions of the design, development, integration, and deployment of Wabtec's Train Handling portfolio. You will define and manage system requirements, perform trade studies, coordinate verification and validation activities, and contribute to product strategy and feature development.

The successful candidate will bring an AI-native mindset, proactively leveraging AI technologies throughout the engineering lifecycle to accelerate innovation, improve product quality, and enhance customer outcomes. You will identify opportunities to apply advanced analytics, automation, and AI-enabled capabilities to solve complex operational challenges and improve system performance.

What do we want to know about you?

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering, Mathematics or Computer Science from an accredited college or university
  • Minimum of 5 years hands-on design, requirements development and implementation experience involving; Engineering Systems, Hardware / Software Engineering, and/or Data Information Systems
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Strong oral and written communication skills
  • Ability to work in a cross-functional, global environment
  • Willingness and ability to travel domestically and internationally

What will your typical day look like?

· Lead the design, development, integration, testing, and enhancement of Train Handling solutions while applying sound systems engineering principles and established product development processes.

· Elicit, analyze, define, and manage customer and system requirements, ensuring alignment with product objectives, operational needs, and business priorities.

· Partner with cross-functional teams, including Product Management, Software Engineering, Train Control, Office Systems, Safety, Validation, and Applications Engineering, to deliver high-quality solutions on schedule.

· Drive requirements reviews, design reviews, technical assessments, and verification and validation activities throughout the product lifecycle.

· Investigate and resolve complex technical issues by analyzing system performance, identifying root causes, and implementing corrective actions.

· Plan and execute field testing, validation, and operational evaluations to ensure solutions meet customer expectations and performance requirements.

· Develop and maintain technical documentation, engineering deliverables, project status updates, and system specifications.

· Collaborate directly with railroad customers, subject matter experts, and internal stakeholders to understand operational challenges and translate them into effective technical solutions.

· Apply industry standards, engineering best practices, and emerging technologies to continuously improve product capabilities, reliability, and performance.

· Leverage AI-enabled tools and technologies to accelerate analysis, improve engineering productivity, support decision-making, and enhance product innovation.

Preferred Qualifications

· Demonstrated experience applying systems engineering principles throughout the product development lifecycle.

· Experience working with software, controls, automation, transportation, embedded, or safety-critical systems.

· Familiarity with systems architecture, requirements management, verification and validation, and systems integration activities.

· Strong analytical, problem-solving, organizational, and communication skills with the ability to influence technical decisions.

· Experience collaborating across multiple engineering disciplines and managing competing priorities in a dynamic environment.

· Demonstrated ability to apply AI-enabled tools, advanced analytics, or data-driven approaches to improve engineering outcomes.

· Working knowledge of railroad operations, train control systems, AAR standards, CENELEC standards, or other transportation industry regulations is preferred.

Relocation assistance may be provided if eligibility requirements are met.

[US Only] Wabtec will only employ those who are legally authorized to work in the U.S. for this opening. Any offer of employment is conditioned upon the successful completion of a drug screen (as applicable) and fitness for duty test (as applicable).

What could you accomplish in a place that puts People First?

At Wabtec, it’s not just about a job - it’s about the impact you make. When our people come together, we’re Expanding the Possible by continuously improving what we do and how we do it - for our clients and each other.

If you’re ready to revolutionize how the world moves for future generations, Wabtec is the place for you.

Who are we?

Wabtec is a leading global provider of equipment, systems, digital solutions, and value-added services for the freight and transit rail sectors. Drawing on more than 150 years of experience, we are leading the way in safety, efficiency, reliability, innovation, and productivity. Whether it’s freight, transit, ports, logistics, mining, industrial, or marine, our expertise, technologies, and people together – are accelerating the future of transportation. With roots that date back to George Westinghouse, Thomas Edison, and Louis Faiveley, Wabtec has always built technologies and implemented solutions for a variety of sectors that are critical to meeting the needs of customers and governments alike.

Our global team of about 30,000 employees worldwide delivers performance that moves the world forward. We’re lifelong learners, obsessed with better. Learn more at www.WabtecCorp.com.

Culture powers us and the possibilities.

We believe the best ideas come from a mix of experiences and backgrounds. At Wabtec, we strive every day to create a place where everyone belongs. We’re building a culture where leadership, inclusion and your unique perspective fuel progress.


We’re proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We welcome talent of all backgrounds, experiences, and identities, including race, gender, age, disability, veteran status and more.

Need accommodation? Just let us know - we’ve got you.

title: Business Systems Analyst - Retail
description:
Overview

The Business Systems Analyst will assist in the support, development, and administration of systems used or managed by the Retail Banking division. This position will also be involved in working on or managing retail related projects, development of procedures and training, and related activities to support the Retail Banking division and other day-to-day bank functions.

**This position may be filled as a Level I, II, or III based on additional responsibilities and qualifications required.**

Responsibilities

  • Perform routine administrative functions and associated responsibilities for retail systems, coordinate enhancements, revise procedures, as necessary, and provide training and communication to the frontline.
  • Work closely with others to understand and support the daily operations of the Retail Bank. Document and map workflows and processes to aid in projects. Lead, write, or perform testing initiatives for Retail. Along with writing procedures and identify opportunities for efficiency improvements.
  • Work closely with vendors, IT and other associates in the software design and development process, including identifying and documenting business requirements, testing, tracking defects, reporting, changing control, and other tasks, as necessary.
  • Provide direct review, research, and response to retail platform support, as necessary; escalate and report issues as appropriate; recommend changes to systems or procedures from identify issues.
  • Create, develop or update procedures, guidelines, training materials, or other resources, related retail systems and operations in conjunction with stakeholders.
  • Grant and maintain appropriate end-user access to systems according to established framework or policies; obtain approval and document exceptions; conduct ongoing user access reviews and provide reporting when needed.
  • Perform additional duties and special projects as assigned.

Level II Additional Responsibilities:

  • Studies existing information processing retail related systems to evaluate effectiveness and propose new solutions.
  • Leads and coordinates work of others to develop, test, enhance, and implement projects.

Level III Additional Responsibilities:

  • Lead testing initiatives for Retail systems to ensure all project audit requirements are being met.
  • Identifies, gathers, analyzes and documents business requirements for business application and information technology projects; translates work processes into business and functional requirements; writes business and functional specifications; develops departmental forms and templates; identifies and provides business rules, quality standards, policies and procedures.
  • Function as a liaison between IT and users and have both business and technical expertise.
  • Determines cause of application and system problems; develops, recommends and implements solutions.
  • Assists with the training of other departmental business systems analyst staff; supports professional and technical capabilities of team members; guides business systems analyst staff in analyzing, testing, and implementing information technology projects.
  • Leads interactions with vendors on accountability and project initiatives.
  • Identify and resolve gaps in the project lifecycle.
  • Independently leads system conversions/upgrades and projects from beginning to end.
  • Managing and executing all aspects of business User Acceptance Testing (UAT).
  • Familiarity with integrating retail systems with other business tools and databases.

Qualifications

  • Two-year college degree in business or finance, with 3 years of retail banking or banking systems experience.-OR-
  • 6 years of retail banking or banking systems experience.
  • Ability to work flexible hours including evenings and weekends
  • Advanced knowledge of retail banking and teller functions and workflows (deposit account opening/maintenance, loans, transaction processing).
  • Advanced knowledge of retail products and services offered to customers.
  • General knowledge of the software development lifecycle; ability to communicate and understand technical and logical reasoning concepts.
  • Excellent oral, written, and visual communication skills.
  • Knowledge and application of basic math and accounting concepts.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and critical thinking skills.
  • Ability to document business processes.
  • Ability to perform routine check and balance reconciliation and thorough data validation.
  • Detail oriented but flexible to manage concurrent tasks/projects and fluctuating requirements.
  • Excellent organizational and prioritization skills to meet tight deadlines.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Word, Excel and PowerPoint.
  • Trustmark platform systems experience preferred.
  • Knowledge of change management processes and workflow analysis preferred

Level II Additional Qualifications Required:

  • Two-year degree and 5 years of retail banking or banking systems experience.-OR-
  • 7 years of retail banking or systems related work experience; system related experience must include 3 or more years of retail implementation of systems.
  • Advanced knowledge of retail banking and branch operations functions and workflows.
  • Excellent oral, written, and visual communication skills.

Level III Additional Qualifications Required:

  • Two-year degree and 7 years of retail banking or banking systems experience.-OR-
  • 10 years of retail banking or systems related work experience; system related experience must include 3 or more years of retail implementation of systems.
  • Expert knowledge of the software development lifecycle; ability to communicate and understand technical and logical reasoning concepts.
  • Expert level experience in automating processes
  • Ability to manage all aspects of the User Acceptance Testing (UAT)
  • Experienced at independently leading systems conversions/upgrades from beginning to end

Physical Requirements/Working Conditions: Must be able to sit for extended periods of time and use computer keyboard and/or mouse, while viewing computer screens.

title: Leder til team af kunderådgivere på pensionsområdet
description:
Har du erfaring med personaleledelse og kan du motivere og engagere dygtige medarbejdere? Har du blik for at skabe gode kundeoplevelser og effektiv administration? Så er du den sektionschef, vi leder efter i Holstebro.

Som vores nye leder får du ansvaret for den daglige ledelse og udvikling af et team af 25 kunderådgivere, der vejleder borgere og behandler sager inden for pensionsområdet.

Du videreudvikler teamet og sørger for en effektiv og driftssikker sagsbehandling, som medvirker til, at teamet når de mål, der er sat.

Du optimerer den daglige drift gennem læring, tavlestyring og via din interesse for at anvende ny teknologi i driften. Du har et helheds- og udviklingsorienteret perspektiv på opgaverne, så du sammen med dine kolleger og ledelse i de øvrige sektioner lykkes med den samlede opgave.

Se Kristian, en af dine kommende lederkolleger, fortælle om jobbet som leder i ATP:

Hvem er du?

Du har en relevant uddannelsesbaggrund og solid erfaring med personaleledelse fra eksempelvis en kundeservicefunktion kombineret med sagsbehandling.

Du har forudsætningerne for at skabe gode kundeoplevelser for de borgere, vi er i kontakt med, og så er det vigtigt, at du kan bidrage til en effektiv administration.

I rollen som personaleleder er du nærværende og motiverende. Du skaber en positiv holdånd i teamet og samarbejder på tværs af organisationen.

Derudover er du den rigtige til jobbet, hvis du:

  • sætter prioriterede mål for dine medarbejdere og skaber sammenhæng mellem mål og strategi
  • sikrer åbenhed og godt samarbejde
  • kommunikerer mening og retning klart og tydeligt
  • har en reflekterende og procesorienteret tilgang til opgaveløsningen
  • er nysgerrig på at tilegne dig fagligheden til at kunne forstå processerne på dit fagområde, så du også kan være med til at optimere og udvikle dem.

Hvem er vi?
I ATP går vi på arbejde for den enkelte og samfundet. Du får et job med stor betydning for de mange borgere, der modtager ydelser fra ATP, herunder de 1,5 mio. pensionister, der hver måned får udbetalt deres pensioner korrekt og til tiden. Med ansvaret følger et meningsfuldt arbejdsliv, og det er vi stolte af at kunne tilbyde.

I Holstebro er vi omkring 225 medarbejdere, hvoraf størstedelen beskæftiger sig med sagsbehandling på pensionsområdet.

Du bliver en del af en stor organisation i en spændende forandring. Vi er i gang med en omskolingsproces, som forsætter de næste år, hvor flere både skal afgive og modtage nye opgaver. Her kommer du som leder sammen med sektionen til at have en vigtig rolle.

Du bliver en del af en ledergruppe på tværs af boligstøtte- og pensionsområdet fordelt på vores lokationer i Holstebro og Frederikshavn.

Vi er engagerede, drifts- og løsningsorienterede og optagede af hele tiden at udvikle os. Vi har et tæt samarbejde på tværs og en uformel omgangstone, hvor videndeling, sparring og læring fylder meget.

Og så lægger vi vægt på, at det også skal være sjovt at gå på arbejde.

Sådan ansøger du
Send os dit CV senest søndag den 11. oktober. Når du sender dit CV via vores system, får du mulighed for kort at beskrive din motivation for at søge stillingen.

I ATP arbejder vi for en fair rekrutteringsproces, og derfor beder vi dig om ikke at vedhæfte billede i dit CV eller angive din alder, når du søger.

Vi ansætter på baggrund af kompetencer og potentiale og opfordrer alle til at søge stillingen – uanset køn og kønsidentitet, etnicitet, national, social og kulturel baggrund, religion eller tro, seksuel orientering, funktionsnedsættelse og alder.

Du kan læse mere om rekrutteringsforløbet her:

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte afdelingschef Kasper Nielsen på tlf. 2056 2351 eller mail kpn@atp.dk.

Af sikkerhedsmæssige årsager og for at beskytte værdier og datainfrastruktur beder vi om straffeattest, kopi af dit pas og eventuelt eksamensbevis. Straffeattesten må ikke give anledning til bemærkninger, og dokumenterne slettes umiddelbart efter vurdering.

Til annoncører og rekrutteringsbureauer: ATP frabeder sig uopfordrede henvendelser om annoncering, kandidater, produkter og ydelser i forbindelse med stillingsopslag og rekrutteringer. Vi beder om, at dette respekteres, og at vores ledere og medarbejdere ikke kontaktes i den henseende.

title: Amenities Attendant (Luxury High Rise in Downtown Miami)
description:
With more than 225 branch offices across North America, Associa is building the future of community for nearly five million residents worldwide. Our 11,000+ team members lead the industry with unrivaled education, expertise, and trailblazing innovation. For more than 43 years, Associa has brought positive impact and meaningful value to communities. To learn more, visit .



Job Description

Position Summary

The Wellness Attendant is responsible for providing an exceptional luxury wellness experience while supporting the daily operations of the spa, fitness center, locker rooms, relaxation areas, pool, and other wellness amenities.

This position serves as a visible and welcoming presence within the Wellness Department and is expected to anticipate resident needs, maintain impeccable presentation standards, and ensure all wellness areas are clean, organized, properly stocked, and operating according to established standards.

The ideal candidate is polished, attentive, proactive, service-oriented, and committed to creating a warm and personalized experience for every resident and guest.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

Resident Experience & Hospitality

  • Warmly greet and acknowledge all residents and approved guests entering the wellness areas.
  • Provide attentive, personalized, and professional service consistent with luxury hospitality and Forbes service standards.
  • Anticipate resident needs and provide assistance without waiting to be asked.
  • Become familiar with resident preferences and, when appropriate, names of residents, children, and pets to create a personalized experience.
  • Assist residents with general questions regarding spa services, fitness offerings, wellness programming, amenities, and upcoming events.
  • Answer telephone calls professionally and assist with appointment scheduling, class reservations, and general inquiries.
  • Maintain resident privacy and confidentiality at all times.
  • Communicate resident requests, concerns, feedback, or service opportunities promptly to management.

Wellness Operations

  • Conduct regular walkthroughs of all assigned wellness areas throughout the shift.
  • Maintain the cleanliness, organization, and presentation of the fitness center, spa areas, treatment rooms, locker rooms, relaxation areas, fitness studio, pool areas, and other wellness amenities.
  • Ensure towels, robes, water, refreshments, toiletries, and other amenities are properly stocked and presented.
  • Collect used towels and robes and coordinate laundry throughout the shift.
  • Prepare, open, recover, and close wellness areas according to established procedures.
  • Assist with treatment room setup and recovery as needed.
  • Ensure equipment and amenities are returned to their proper locations after use.
  • Monitor wellness spaces to ensure residents and guests are following established amenity rules and procedures.
  • Maintain front desk coverage and remain readily available to assist residents.

Fitness & Spa Support

  • Maintain fitness equipment in a clean, organized, and presentable condition.
  • Ensure weights and fitness accessories are returned to their designated locations.
  • Assist residents with locating equipment and understanding available wellness amenities when appropriate.
  • Support spa appointment scheduling, provider coordination, and treatment-room preparation.
  • Assist with wellness classes, resident events, activations, and special programming.
  • Help prepare event spaces before programming and restore spaces immediately afterward.

Safety & Facility Awareness

  • Maintain awareness of surroundings and immediately report maintenance, safety, cleanliness, or operational concerns.
  • Identify and report damaged equipment, spills, facility issues, or potential hazards.
  • Follow established procedures for wet areas, steam rooms, pools, fitness areas, and other wellness amenities.
  • Monitor wellness spaces for unauthorized access and professionally communicate established policies when necessary.
  • Immediately escalate incidents, injuries, resident concerns, or unusual situations to management.
  • Complete required operational logs, checklists, and reports accurately.

Teamwork & Accountability

  • Work collaboratively with fellow Wellness Attendants, the Wellness Supervisor, Director of Spa & Wellness, and other departments.
  • Arrive on time, in proper uniform, and prepared to begin the scheduled shift.
  • Review the daily schedule, appointments, classes, events, resident requests, and departmental notes at the beginning of each shift.
  • Communicate effectively with teammates regarding outstanding tasks, resident requests, maintenance concerns, and shift transitions.
  • Take initiative in identifying tasks that need attention rather than waiting for direction.
  • Maintain professional behavior and appearance throughout the shift.
  • Limit personal cell phone use to approved break periods and designated areas.
  • Follow all departmental SOPs, building policies, safety procedures, and service standards.
  • Participate in departmental meetings, training sessions, and Forbes service-standard refresh

Requirements

Qualifications

  • Previous experience in luxury hospitality, spa, fitness, residential, hotel, or private club environments preferred.
  • Strong customer service and interpersonal skills.
  • Professional, polished, and welcoming demeanor.
  • Ability to anticipate needs and demonstrate strong attention to detail.
  • Ability to communicate professionally with residents, guests, management, and coworkers.
  • Dependable, punctual, and able to work independently while remaining part of a team.
  • Comfortable using scheduling, reservation, or point-of-sale systems; Mindbody experience is a plus.
  • Ability to maintain discretion and confidentiality in a luxury residential environment.
  • Flexibility to work weekends, holidays, and varying shifts based on operational needs.

A Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Commerce or a related discipline, and CA or CPA membership, are essential.

  • Proven ERP implementation and post-go-live support experience; prior Finance lead role on a D365FO implementation highly regarded.
  • Strong grounding in GL, subledger reconciliation, consolidation, AP/AR, Treasury and Project Accounting.

MinRes is a leading diversified resources company with extensive operations in lithium, iron ore, energy and mining services across Western Australia. With a focus on people and innovation, MinRes has become one of the ASX’s best-performing companies since listing in 2006.

Our headquarters at 20 Walters Drive sets a new standard for workplace wellness. World class facilities include a café, restaurant, commercial gym, crèche, daycare and health centre, including GP.

This role involves helping residents with daily activities, maintaining a clean and comfortable environment, and ensuring that their needs are met in a compassionate and respectful manner. The Hospitality Aide supports the nursing and care teams by providing excellent customer service, engaging with residents, and enhancing their overall quality of life.

title: Data Scientist
description:
The Data Scientist turns plant, finance, and retail data into actionable analyses, reporting, and tools that help teams run the business. The role spans manufacturing operations, retail performance, and financial reporting, combining data analysis with lightweight applications and automation. This position partners closely with plant managers, finance, engineering, and retail teams to identify trends, investigate data issues, and improve decision-making. The Data Scientist also owns a portfolio of recurring analytics deliverables and serves as a trusted resource when business metrics need to be understood or validated.

Essential Functions and Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain operations analytics covering production, OEE, downtime, scrap, and labor as a percentage of production sales value.
  • Analyze retail performance with retail partners, including sell-in vs. sell-through, fill rate, on-time compliance, new-store stocking, and price tests.
  • Own recurring analytics deliverables, including daily briefs, weekly operating reviews, and month-end analyses, and automate these processes where appropriate.
  • Build reports and lightweight Python web applications that enable business users to access and explore data independently.
  • Investigate data quality issues by tracing unexpected results back to their source systems and partnering with engineering to resolve issues upstream rather than applying downstream workarounds.
  • Present analytical findings and business insights to plant leadership and finance teams in clear, accessible language.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to define metrics, understand business requirements, and translate analytical findings into practical business decisions.

Required Qualifications

  • 2–4 years of experience in analytics, data science, or a related field.
  • Strong SQL and Python skills, including experience with pandas and statistical or machine learning libraries such as stats models or scikit-learn.
  • Sound understanding of statistical concepts, including distributions, regression, statistical significance, and appropriate sample sizes and limitations.
  • Experience with Power BI, including DAX, or a comparable business intelligence and reporting platform.
  • Ability to clearly explain metric definitions, analytical findings, and data limitations to both operational leaders and executive stakeholders.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to investigate data issues from business outputs back to underlying source systems.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with manufacturing KPIs such as OEE, scrap, and cycle time.
  • Experience in plastics manufacturing or injection molding.
  • Familiarity with retail vendor data, including retailer portals, point-of-sale data, and EDI.
  • Experience with time-series forecasting.
  • Experience with Flask or a similar Python web framework.
  • Experience integrating LLM APIs into analytics tools and applications.

  • Location: Remote
  • This position will report to the VP of AI & Analytics

Grow your career with the industry leader in behavioral health – Proud Moments ABA.

Proud Moments ABA provides the gold standard of Applied Behavior Analysis (ABA) services for children on the autism spectrum from birth to age 21. As a BCBA, you will combine your knowledge and experience with our innovative treatment techniques to change our clients’ lives. Our clinical support team makes sure you are able to focus on providing excellent clinical services to our learners and not administrative work.

We are actively seeking Board Certified Behavior Analysts (BCBA’s) to join our team as full-time or part-time clinical experts.

As a Proud Moments BCBA, you’ll enjoy professional respect, recognition, and rewards:

  • Competitive compensation + robust/achievable quarterly bonus program

  • Multi-tiered clinical team; both at the local and regional level designed to ensure you feel supported in your day to day

    • PTO/flexible holidays
    • Medical, dental and vision coverage
    • 401K retirement savings program
    • Employee Assistance Programs

Responsibilities

As a Proud Moments BCBA, you’ll be challenged to realize your professional potential. Key responsibilities as a BCBA include:

  • Utilize your expertise to develop and supervise the implementation of targeted interventions that change the lives of children with autism
  • Share in the achievements of your clients as they develop positive behaviors and learn new skills
  • Provide caring support during family conversations to ensure parents fully understand assessment results and treatment recommendations
  • Advocate for your clients by monitoring for potential issues and communicating concerns

  • Commitment to handling confidential information responsibly

title: Learning & Adoption Lead
description:
About Gallagher

Our purpose at Gallagher is ‘Protect what matters most’ and we live it every day, whether that’s protecting the world’s highest security environments or agricultural businesses, we care deeply about our people, their families, and our wider communities.

Gallagher Security is on a mission to unlock more value for our customers through the power of our people and solutions. Our culture is entrepreneurial in spirit, complex, challenging, and ever changing. With operations in New Zealand, Australia, Asia, Africa, USA, Canada, and Europe and exports to over 140 countries, we’re proud to be unlocking globally focused career paths for New Zealand based candidates.

We’re painting the future of what’s possible. Come join us.

The Opportunity

We're looking for an experienced and passionate Learning and Adoption Lead to join our Security Change team. Reporting to the Change Manager, you'll play a pivotal role in helping our people build the knowledge, skills, and confidence needed to successfully adopt new systems, processes, and ways of working across Gallagher Security.

This role combines strategic thinking with hands-on delivery. You'll lead learning and adoption workstreams across transformation initiatives, partnering with project teams, subject matter experts, leaders, and change specialists to design and deliver engaging learning experiences that enable business success.

In this role you will:

  • Lead learning and adoption activities across business change, technology, and transformation initiatives.

  • Conduct learning needs analyses and design role-based learning pathways aligned to business outcomes.

  • Create engaging learning materials including guides, presentations, eLearning, videos, knowledge articles, in-application help, and support resources.

  • Plan and coordinate learning delivery, including training schedules, learner communications, resources and logistics, and facilitator readiness.

  • Deliver or support workshops, virtual learning, demonstrations, and guided practice sessions.

  • Prepare leaders, trainers, and change champions to reinforce learning and support adoption.

  • Measure learning effectiveness, readiness, confidence, and capability uplift.

  • Identify adoption risks and capability gaps, recommending targeted interventions and support.

  • Coordinate post go-live learning reinforcement, coaching, and knowledge transfer activities.

  • Ensure project-lead learning activities are successfully transferred to BAU ownership for long term benefits.

The Fit

You are an experienced learning and development professional who understands that successful change starts with helping people learn and grow. You have a strong background in instructional design, learning delivery, or capability development, and enjoy translating complex information into practical, engaging learning experiences.

You're collaborative, adaptable, and comfortable working in fast-paced project environments where priorities evolve and stakeholder engagement is key.

You'll bring:

  • Experience in learning design, instructional design, training, digital learning, or a similar field.

  • Proven experience supporting business change, technology, system, or process transformation initiatives.

  • Strong learning needs analysis and learning programme design capabilities.

  • Experience creating a range of learning materials, including digital and instructor-led content.

  • Confidence facilitating training sessions and working with diverse stakeholder groups.

  • Strong written, visual, and verbal communication skills.

  • Excellent organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.

  • Experience leveraging digital learning and AI-enabled tools to enhance learning outcomes.

Why Gallagher?

At Gallagher, you'll join a supportive and high-performing team that's passionate about helping our people and business succeed through change. You'll have the opportunity to work on meaningful transformation initiatives, collaborate with stakeholders across the globe, and continue growing your expertise in change management within a market-leading technology business.

We also offer:

  • Competitive salary and annual bonus opportunities.

  • Ongoing professional development and career growth opportunities within a global organisation.

If you're passionate about helping people navigate change and want to be part of a business shaping the future of security technology, we'd love to hear from you. Confidential conversations to explore this opportunity are welcome.

title: Supply Chain Engineering Intern - Summer 2027
description:
About Us

At Antares, our long-term mission is to make clean energy abundant from Earth to the Asteroid Belt. We’re fueled by the belief that advanced nuclear energy can strengthen our military, solve the climate crisis, elevate global living standards, and expand humanity's presence in outer space. To achieve our mission, we’re building mass-producible, inherently safe, deployable microreactors that can be used terrestrially, underwater, and in space.

The Antares team hails from SpaceX, the White House, the Pentagon, the Department of Energy, MIT, Rigetti Computing, General Atomics, Relativity Space, Ursa Major, and National Laboratories like Idaho, Oak Ridge, Los Alamos, and Savannah River. Antares has raised over $600M in venture capital from top-tier investors and has hundreds of million-dollars on contract with the military services, NASA, and the Department of Energy.

About the Summer Internship Program

Internships at Antares are anything but ordinary. You'll work alongside our team as we design, build, and test fission microreactors built to deliver reliable energy for critical missions on Earth, in space, and underwater.

Our interns contribute to real work from day one. Depending on your role, you may touch hardware, write and test software, support manufacturing and operations, or help build the systems that allow Antares to move quickly as we scale. You'll work alongside engineers, operators, and other experts solving challenging problems—and you'll leave your internship with hands-on experience that's difficult to find anywhere else.

We work hard, move quickly, and take pride in what we're building. If you're excited to learn by doing and want to contribute to the next generation of nuclear energy, we'd love to have you join us next summer.

We will be running two separate cohorts to accommodate students on both semester and quarter schedules:

Cohort #1

Monday, May 17 – Friday, August 13

Cohort #2

Monday, June 14 – Friday, September 10

All internship roles are based at our Torrance headquarters and require interns to work onsite five days per week. We will not be considering candidates for remote or hybrid arrangements.

Interns will receive a relocation and housing stipend as part of their offer package.

About the Team

As a Supply Chain Engineering Intern, you will work alongside Antares’ Supply Chain and Engineering teams to help source the components and materials needed to build our reactor systems. You will contribute to hands-on sourcing, supplier development, and technical procurement work, gaining exposure to both the engineering requirements behind what we build, and the supply chain required to make it possible.

This role is well suited for someone who is interested in the intersection of engineering and supply chain and wants hands-on experience working through technical sourcing and supplier challenges.

Roles and Responsibilities:

· Support sourcing activities for technical components and materials

· Work with Supply Chain and Engineering teams on technical procurement activities

· Support supplier development efforts

· Help translate engineering needs into sourcing and procurement activities

· Contribute to hands-on supply chain projects supporting Antares’ engineering work

Basic Qualifications:

· Enrolled in at least a bachelor’s degree program, and going into your Junior or Senior year of studies

· Must have prior internship experience, or significant (>1yr) project team, laboratory, or research experience

Preferred Skills & Experience:

  • GPA of 3.5 or above

  • Experience in a University club or organization, leadership role preferred

  • Strong interpersonal and technical communication skills (examples: leading a student project team, presenting research at conferences, etc.)

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail

  • Ability to work cross-departmentally with different groups and teams

  • Ability to work effectively in a dynamic environment with changing needs and requirements

  • Ability to work independently and in a team, take initiative, and communicate effectively

Location

  • We are located in Torrance, CA in a 322,000 square foot, brand new facility featuring large open spaces for team collaboration, R&D, and production, as well as easy access to the 405, 105, and 110 freeways. Our facility is in the heart of Los Angeles' vibrant emerging tech ecosystem alongside many other high growth startups and enterprises.

Culture

At Antares, we like to specifically tie each role to our founding document’s set of values–here are the top five cultural values we think you should believe at your core to be successful:

  • Think in Systems - Energy and Defense are complex ecosystems with numerous stakeholders with competing priorities, conflicting policies, perverse incentives, and emergent and path-dependent properties. First principles thinking alone is insufficient. Think probabilistically and then take action. “If you want to be certain, then you are apt to be obsolete.” Over-optimizing the components often degrades the system

  • Obsess over the End User - The customer and end user are often not the same. We will never build globally competitive commercial products if we lose sight of our end users and their entire interaction with the product life cycle

  • Be Unconstrained by Convention - Our only limits are the laws of physics. Many, even experts, will say what we are working on is impossible. They said the same about SpaceX reusing rockets. Generationally impactful companies, by definition, must accomplish the seemingly impossible. If it were easy, it would have already been done. Never shy away from a solution because it has never been tried before, and never choose to do something because that's “how it's always been done”

  • Go Where the Work Is - Never miss a chance to meet a customer, user, or stakeholder face to face, even if that means hopping on a plane. If you can’t make it, find a teammate who can channel your intentions and go in your place. Deep work can be done from anywhere, but we believe teams are built in person, and aim to maximize our time together

  • Operate in the Grey - Embrace nuance in pursuit of truth. Question every fundamental assumption

Equal Opportunity

Antares is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are based solely on merit, competence, and qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability, or any other legally protected status.

ITAR Requirements

To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. title: Senior Computer Vision Engineer
company: Hyundai Motor Group Innovation Center Singapore
description:
Your Mission

As a Computer Vision Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in designing, implementing, and optimizing computer vision algorithms that are integral to our robotic systems. You will work closely with a multidisciplinary team of engineers and researchers to develop software and in-house core algorithm. This role demands a blend of creativity and technical expertise to tackle challenging problems and contribute to our mission of revolutionizing robotics applications in manufacturing and assembly.

What To Expect
  • Design and implement advanced computer vision algorithms for 3D reconstruction, image processing, object detection, recognition, tracking, and scene understanding to enhance the capabilities of our robotic systems.
  • Develop robust software solutions that integrate computer vision algorithms into our robotic platforms, ensuring high performance and reliability.
  • Collaborate with other engineers and researchers to prototype new concepts and bring innovative technologies from conception to deployment in real-world applications.
  • Continuously research and stay updated on the latest advancements in computer vision and machine learning technologies to inform development strategies.
  • Optimize existing computer vision algorithms for efficiency, including improving accuracy, reducing computational resources, and achieving real-time performance.
  • Conduct rigorous testing and validation of computer vision components to ensure system performance and reliability under diverse and challenging conditions.
  • Document software designs, implementation details, and testing protocols to facilitate knowledge sharing and ensure reproducibility.
What You'll Bring
  • A Master's or Ph.D. degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Robotics, or a related field, with more than 5 years of industrial experience focusing on computer vision and robotics.
  • Solid foundation in computer vision, image processing (e.g. edge detection, denoising), multiple view geometry, depth estimation, machine learning techniques with proven experience developing and deploying algorithms in real-world applications. Please note that knowledge in deep learning is required but not sufficient.
  • Expertise in camera calibration, like camera intrinsic calibration, camera-to-camera calibration and robot-to-camera calibration with proven experience on developing and deploying calibration algorithms.
  • Expertise in programming languages such as C++, Python and CUDA, and familiarity with computer vision libraries (e.g., OpenCV, PCL) and machine learning frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch).
  • Expertise in calibration and 3D reconstruction (nerf and gaussian).
  • Experience with point cloud processing is highly desirable.
  • Ability to work effectively in a collaborative team environment and communicate complex technical concepts clearly and concisely.
  • Creative problem-solving skills and a passion for innovation in robotics and computer vision technologies.

title: Ansøgning til "Operationssygeplejerske til kombinationsstilling"
description:
Er du en erfaren operationssygeplejerske, som både trives på operationsgangen og har blik for planlægning, flow og den gode kunderejse?

Vi søger en sygeplejerske til en kombinationsstilling, hvor du får en central rolle i operationsbookingen og samtidig bevarer din kliniske tilknytning til operationsgangen. Ved ferie og andet fravær skal du også have lyst til at indgå i sengeafdelingen som en del af teamet. Stillingen er på 32 timer fordelt på fire dage

Dine opgaver

Du kommer blandt andet til at:

  • planlægge og koordinere operationsprogrammer
  • sikre et godt flow og en realistisk udnyttelse af kapaciteten
  • samarbejde tæt med kirurger, anæstesi, operationsgang, sengeafdeling og sekretariat
  • arbejde klinisk som operationssygeplejerske
  • indgå i sengeafdelingen ved ferie og andet fravær
  • bidrage til enklere og mere effektive arbejdsgange

Vi søger dig, der

  • er autoriseret sygeplejerske
  • har mindst to års erfaring som operationssygeplejerske
  • har flair for planlægning og operationsbooking
  • arbejder struktureret og bevarer overblikket, når planen ændrer sig
  • tager ansvar for hele kunderejsen
  • er fleksibel, hjælpsom og løsningsorienteret

Du behøver ikke kunne alle dele af operationsbookingen fra første dag. Det vigtigste er, at du forstår driften, lærer hurtigt og har lyst til at udvikle dig i rollen.

Det tilbyder vi

Du bliver en del af et hospital med høj faglighed, korte beslutningsveje og ambitioner om hele tiden at gøre tingene bedre. Vi tager ansvar, hjælper hinanden og siger til i tide. Du får mulighed for at påvirke din egen funktion og udviklingen af vores arbejdsgange.

Stillingen er på 32 timer fordelt på fire dage. Arbejdstiden kan tilrettelægges fleksibelt med udgangspunkt i driften.

Vi tilbyder en attraktiv lønpakke med:

  • Grundløn efter overenskomst
  • 10 % særlig opsparing
  • 29 % aftentillæg efter kl. 15.30
  • sundhedsforsikring
  • kaffe, frugt og frokostordning
  • mindst to årlige sociale arrangementer, herunder sommerarrangement og julefrokost

Vigtigst af alt bliver du en del af en virksomhed i udvikling, hvor vi hver dag arbejder for at skabe en endnu bedre arbejdsplads.

Ansættelse og yderligere oplysninger

Har du yderligere spørgsmål kan du kontakte hospitalschef Helle Hillingsø på hhil@capio.dk eller på 29750717

Ansættelse sker efter gældende overenskomst.

Send din ansøgning og dit CV hurtigst muligt. Vi holder samtaler løbende.

Ved ansættelse skal der fremvises straffeattest og der indhentes børneattest.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

_Capio er et alsidigt privathospital og med speciale i hhv. diagnosticering og behandling af ryg- og nakkelidelser samt almen kirurgi – herunder mave-tarm, urologi, ortopædkirurgi, håndkirurgi og plastikkirurgi samt en lang række øvrige specialer. Vi har fem hospitaler beliggende i henholdsvis Hellerup, Odense, Aalborg, Viborg og Aarhus. Vi har gennem årene været i konstant vækst og er i dag et af de største privathospitaler og største sundhedsleverandør i Danmark samt en del af Ramsay-koncernen. Vi vægter kvalitet og patientsikkerhed meget højt, og har konstant fokus på høj patienttilfredshed.

title: Senior Staff Product Engineer

Role Summary/Purpose:

As the Senior Staff Product Engineer, you will be responsible for leading the design, development, and deployment of Digital Onboard Solutions Engineering (DOSE) Electronic Braking technology. Additionally, the successful candidate will work closely with Product Management, Program Management and railroad customers to develop world class solutions that bring advanced automation and data analytics to the rail industry with high quality and reliability. The Senior Staff Product Engineer will be the technical architect developing long term strategy for the Electronic Braking product line by leveraging industry experience, input from customers and collaboration with Product Management. The Senior Staff Product Engineer will be the focal point for all technical inquiries for the engineering department with respect to Electronic Braking product line. They will interact with both internal and external engineering organizations to steward the braking product line through all product lifecycle phases.

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Lead future concepts and design enhancements for the Transport Intelligence products using sound engineering principles and adhering to business standards, practices, procedures, and product / program requirements.
  • Support development of the R&D strategy for the product
  • Serve as a primary customer contact for the Transport Intelligence product line. Translate customer needs / requirements, resolve specification issues, handle technical correspondence, provide periodic updates, ensure customer satisfaction, and negotiate / coordinate with cross-functional teams as appropriate.
  • Provide guidance to the internal engineering teams on design tradeoff considerations during the development lifecycle
  • Be a Technical Leader for the projects across global cross-functional teams (Product / Program Management, SW COE, Electrical Integration, Train Control, Office Systems, Safety, Validation and Applications Engineering) assuring “cradle to grave” success.
  • Participate in the development of proposals for projects.
  • Work with Wabtec’s scientific community and railroad subject matter experts to develop freight automation solutions, evaluate them in field trials and productize the solutions to function in a railroad revenue environment.
  • Lead and participate in technical and program reviews.
  • Maintain broad awareness of technical trends to ensure technical quality excellence, timely completion of work, and reviews and responsiveness to customer/program needs.
  • Work collaboratively with the Global Supply Chain Organization across the various locations to support procurement of parts from an engineering requirements perspective.
  • Provide technical input to customer facing documentation such as but not limited to product descriptions, operational manuals, installation instructions, troubleshooting guides, and product marketing material.
  • Interface with the Global Locomotive Operations group to ensure factory-built locomotives are manufactured successfully and delivered to customers in a timely manner.
  • Provide design input into external teams for locomotive integration of Digital Solutions products.
  • Manage program execution of engineering team to deliver on time, within budget, and meet contractual obligations
  • Highlight dependencies to Project Management Organization (PMO) and escalate engineering impeding items

Qualifications/Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree or Associate’s degree in Engineering, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline from an accredited institution, or equivalent technical training and demonstrated relevant experience.

  • Proven ability to work in a cross-functional, global environment.

The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. More information on offered benefits, which include health, welfare, and retirement, are available at mywabtecbenefits.com. Whether it’s freight, transit, ports, logistics, mining, industrial, or marine, our expertise, technologies, and people together – are accelerating the future of transportation. title: SSAère søges til de midlertidige pladser Solgården

Vores borgere på midlertidigt ophold kommer enten direkte fra sygehuset eller hjemmefra og har behov for pleje, behandling og træning, så de kan komme så tæt på deres habituelle niveau som muligt, - eller det afklares, om der er behov for øget hjælp, anden bolig og så videre.

Vores borgere tilbydes også adspredelse og aktiviteter sammen med vores aktivitetsmedarbejdere og frivillige.

Solgården har 30 midlertidige døgnopholdspladser og 4 plejehjemspladser.
