title: Staff Engineer - Distributed Systems
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Staff Engineer - Distributed Systems based in India.

This role focuses on the architecture and resilience of large-scale distributed systems operating under significant production load. You will look across services, queues, databases, infrastructure, and deployment patterns to identify systemic risks before they become incidents. The role begins with a high-throughput automation platform and expands across communication and emerging product systems. You will influence critical-path architecture while remaining hands-on, spending meaningful time prototyping solutions, resolving complex failures, and shipping remediation. You will help establish capacity models, consistency guarantees, isolation boundaries, and failure-handling strategies that can withstand continued growth. This is a high-ownership environment where technical rigor, proactive problem solving, and clear cross-team communication are central to the role.

Accountabilities:

  • Own the architecture health of large-scale distributed systems, including failure modes, capacity constraints, consistency guarantees, resilience, and interactions across numerous services and deployments.
  • Review and influence critical-path technical designs, providing rigorous architectural guidance and making well-reasoned recommendations when teams face complex technical trade-offs.
  • Proactively identify systemic risks such as single points of failure, unbounded queues, missing idempotency, thundering-herd effects, capacity constraints, and potential data-loss scenarios, then drive remediation before incidents occur.
  • Build and ship solutions for complex architectural problems, including prototypes, reliability improvements, production remediation, and fixes for difficult cross-team issues.
  • Design resilience into systems through degradation strategies, backpressure mechanisms, isolation boundaries, capacity models, and failure-handling patterns capable of supporting sustained growth.
  • Investigate and resolve the most challenging distributed-system failures by understanding interactions across application services, messaging, databases, infrastructure, and deployment environments.
  • Work hands-on with Node.js/TypeScript and/or Go to prototype architectural solutions and implement critical fixes when required.
  • Establish and improve engineering practices through design reviews, post-mortems, architectural patterns, documentation, and technical guidance that can be adopted across multiple teams.
  • Help define how AI-assisted engineering can be used safely and effectively when developing and operating highly critical distributed systems.
  • Work with technologies including GKE, GCP Pub/Sub, Cloud Tasks, Redis, MongoDB, Firestore, ClickHouse, and Elasticsearch across large-scale production environments.
  • Help engineering teams prepare systems for substantial traffic growth by identifying capacity limits, improving observability, and validating critical failure modes.
  • Influence engineers across teams through technical rigor, collaboration, mentorship, and clear communication rather than relying solely on organizational authority.

    • Requirements:

    • 10+ years of engineering experience with deep, hands-on ownership of large-scale distributed systems; experience operating hundreds of services, thousands of instances, or systems processing billions of events is strongly preferred.
    • Demonstrated experience carrying direct accountability for production systems through significant incidents, migrations, reliability challenges, and operational failures.
    • Deep expertise in queueing and asynchronous architectures, including delivery semantics, ordering, backpressure, idempotency, and the practical limitations of exactly-once processing.
    • Strong knowledge of multiple storage technologies across SQL and NoSQL environments, with the ability to reason about consistency models, indexing at scale, performance, and appropriate technology selection.
    • Expert-level experience with Redis or comparable in-memory systems, including behavior under memory pressure, network partitions, failover scenarios, and other failure conditions.
    • Strong production experience operating Kubernetes at scale, including resource limits, autoscaling, capacity planning, node failures, and workload behavior under infrastructure disruption.
    • Fluent in Node.js and/or Go, with sufficient hands-on ability to prototype technical proposals and implement production fixes on critical paths.
    • Exceptional technical communication skills, including the ability to produce design documents, architectural diagrams, and root-cause analyses that drive decisions across multiple engineering teams.
    • Strong systems-thinking ability, with an instinct for evaluating tail behavior, failure modes, network partitions, capacity constraints, and high-load scenarios.
    • Proven ability to influence engineering teams through technical depth, constructive disagreement, clear reasoning, and respect.
    • Strong ownership, curiosity, judgment, and problem-solving skills, particularly when dealing with ambiguous or cross-functional technical challenges.
    • Experience using AI-assisted development tools effectively on complex systems is an advantage, particularly when balancing development speed with code quality, reliability, and operational safety.
    • GCP-native experience with technologies such as Pub/Sub, Cloud Tasks, GKE, and Firestore is a strong advantage.
    • Previous experience in a Staff, Principal, Architect, or comparable systems-focused engineering capacity is beneficial.
    • Experience taking new systems from initial architecture through production while also hardening mature systems is a plus.

      • Benefits:

      • Full-time remote opportunity for engineers based in India.
      • Opportunity to work on distributed systems operating at substantial scale, including billions of automation actions and messages and tens of thousands of requests per second at peak.
      • Broad technical scope spanning application runtimes, messaging, asynchronous processing, databases, caching, Kubernetes, cloud infrastructure, and observability.
      • Opportunity to influence architecture across multiple engineering teams and critical production systems.
      • Significant hands-on ownership, with the ability to prototype, build, ship, and remediate solutions rather than working solely in an advisory architecture capacity.
      • Exposure to large-scale technologies including Node.js, TypeScript, Go, GKE, GCP Pub/Sub, Cloud Tasks, Redis, MongoDB, Firestore, ClickHouse, and Elasticsearch.

title: Senior Rust Systems Engineer – Edge Proxy & Fleet
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Rust Systems Engineer – Edge Proxy & Fleet based in India.

This is a senior systems engineering role focused on building and operating core edge infrastructure deployed across thousands of on-premise appliances in school networks. You’ll work primarily in Rust on fleet-wide over-the-air updates, control-plane connectivity with AWS, and network stack optimization. The role combines systems programming, embedded Linux, networking, containerization, and cloud infrastructure. You’ll be responsible for improving reliability, performance, and scalability across a large distributed appliance fleet. The environment offers the opportunity to work on production infrastructure where resilience and efficient resource usage are critical. You’ll collaborate with engineering teams across India, the US, and the UK while owning technically challenging systems-level initiatives.

Accountabilities:

  • Own and develop core components of a fleet-wide edge proxy deployed across thousands of on-premise appliances.
  • Build and maintain fleet-wide OTA update capabilities, ensuring reliable software delivery and deployment across distributed devices.
  • Develop and optimize control-plane connectivity between deployed appliances and AWS-based infrastructure.
  • Design and improve systems and network programming components, including TCP stream handling, socket programming, and transparent proxying.
  • Tune network stack performance and system behavior to maintain reliability and efficiency at significant fleet scale.
  • Work with embedded Linux environments, including device drivers, kernel modules, cross-compilation, and hardware bring-up as required.
  • Build and maintain Docker/containerized workloads designed for constrained appliance environments.
  • Conduct performance testing, load testing, memory and CPU profiling, and flame graph analysis to identify and resolve bottlenecks.
  • Apply AWS and Infrastructure as Code concepts to support reliable cloud-connected fleet infrastructure.
  • Contribute to fleet reliability, observability, operational improvements, and scalable engineering practices.

    • Requirements:

    • 6+ years of total software engineering experience, including 3+ years of hands-on production Rust development.
    • Strong production Rust experience specifically in systems or embedded environments rather than application, web, or backend development.
    • Proven experience with systems and network programming, including TCP stream handling, socket programming, and transparent proxying.
    • Solid embedded Linux fundamentals, with experience in areas such as device drivers, kernel modules, cross-compilation, or hardware bring-up.
    • Hands-on Docker and containerization experience for constrained systems or appliance deployments.
    • Experience with performance testing and profiling, including load testing, CPU and memory profiling, and flame graph analysis.
    • Working knowledge of AWS and Infrastructure as Code concepts, with exposure to tools such as Terraform or CloudFormation.
    • Fleet management or IoT device fleet experience is strongly preferred.
    • Additional experience with C/C++ or Go alongside Rust is advantageous.
    • Exposure to Linux kernel networking technologies such as eBPF or netfilter, or high-performance proxy/load-balancing technologies such as HAProxy or Envoy, is a plus.
    • Familiarity with RADIUS and observability practices involving tools or concepts such as CloudWatch, Splunk, and SLOs is beneficial.
    • Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving abilities, with the ability to investigate complex systems-level issues.
    • Ability to work independently on technically demanding infrastructure while collaborating effectively across distributed engineering teams.
    • Experience working on production systems where reliability, performance, scalability, and resource efficiency are critical.

      • Benefits:

      • Remote work opportunity within India.
      • Direct-hire opportunity in a senior systems engineering capacity.
      • Opportunity to work on infrastructure deployed across thousands of distributed on-premise appliances.
      • Hands-on exposure to advanced Rust systems programming, embedded Linux, networking, and edge infrastructure.
      • Opportunity to work across AWS, Infrastructure as Code, Docker, performance engineering, and fleet management.
      • Collaboration with distributed engineering teams across India, the US, and the UK.
      • High-impact ownership of production infrastructure where reliability and scalability are essential.

description:
We encourage applications from people from all backgrounds and aim to have a workforce that represents the wider society that we serve. We pride ourselves on being an employer of choice. We champion diversity, inclusion and wellbeing and aim to create a workplace where everyone feels valued and a sense of belonging. To find out more about how we do this visit: .

Working Arrangements & Further Information

The MoJ offers Hybrid Working arrangements where business need allows. This is an informal, non-contractual form of flexible working that blends working from your base location, different MoJ sites and / or from home (please be aware that this role can only be worked in the UK and not overseas). Some roles will not be suitable for Hybrid Working. Similarly, Hybrid Working will not suit everyone’s circumstances. Arrangements will be discussed and agreed with the successful candidate(s) and subject to regular review.

For nationally advertised roles, the successful candidate(s) will be appointed to a MoJ office location, which may include their nearest Justice Collaboration Centre or Justice Satellite Office. This will be discussed and agreed on the completion of pre-employment checks.

Some of MoJ’s terms and conditions of service are changing as part of Civil Service reform. The changes will apply to staff joining MoJ who are new to the Civil Service. Staff joining MoJ from other civil service employers will transfer onto the new MoJ terms if they are already on 'modernised' terms in their current post or onto 'unmodernised' MoJ terms if they are on 'unmodernised' terms at their current post. Details will be available if an offer is made.

Standard full time working hours are 37 hours per week excluding breaks which are unpaid. HMPPS welcomes part-time, flexible and job-sharing working patterns, where they meet the demands of the role and business needs. All applications for part-time, flexible and job-sharing working patterns will be considered in accordance with the HMPPS’ Flexible Working policy.

If you are a current NPS employee, this vacancy may be available on a Loan basis for up to 2 years. Applications are invited from suitable qualified staff.

The Loan/Secondment is subject to the approval of the selected candidate's Business Unit, which should be obtained before confirmation of appointment.

Benefits

Annual Leave

-The holiday year runs from 1 March. If you work a non standard work pattern your leave entitlement may be expressed in either hours or days as appropriate. Leave entitlement is calculated on a pro-rata basis and you will be advised of your actual entitlement on appointment. If you were appointed internally and your leave was previously calculated in days, this will continue to be the case.

Bank, Public and Privilege Holidays

-You are entitled to 9 days (66 hours 36 minutes) in recognition of bank, public and privilege holidays. These hours are added to your annual leave allowance. There is a requirement to work some public and bank holidays subject to your shift pattern and the operational needs of the establishment

Pension

-The Civil Service offers a choice of two pension schemes, giving you the flexibility to choose the pension that suits you best.

Work Life Balance

HM Prison & Probation Service (HMPPS) is keen to encourage alternative working arrangements. Work life balance provides greater opportunities for staff to work more flexibly wherever managers and establishments can accommodate requests to do so. HMPPS offers flexible working subject to completion of a satisfactory probationary period and NVQ

Season Ticket Advance

-After two months’ service, you’ll be eligible to apply for a season ticket advance to purchase a quarterly or longer-period season ticket for travel between home and your place of work

Childcare Vouchers

For any moves across the Civil Service may have implications on your ability to carry on claiming childcare vouchers

Training

HMPPS is committed to staff development and offers a range of training and development opportunities, including areas such as Equality and Diversity, Dealing with Challenging Behaviour, Suicide Prevention and Anti Bullying Programmes

-There are opportunities to access promotion programmes and HMPPS provides a variety of training appropriate to individual posts

Eligibility

-All candidates are subject to security and identity checks prior to taking up post

-All external candidates are subject to 6 months probation. Internal candidates are subject to probation if they have not already served a probationary period within HMPPS

-All staff are required to declare whether they are a member of a group or organisation which the HMPPS considers to be racist

Working for the Civil Service

The Civil Service Code sets out the standards of behaviour expected of civil servants.

We recruit by merit on the basis of fair and open competition, as outlined in the Civil Service Commission's recruitment principles. Should you feel that the recruitment process has breached the recruitment principles you are able to raise a formal complaint in the following order

  • To Transformative Business Services (0345 241 5358 (Monday to Friday 8am - 6pm) or e mail moj-recruitment-vetting-enquiries@resourcing.soprasteria.co.uk);
  • To Ministry of Justice Resourcing team (resourcing-management-office@justice.gov.uk);

Diversity & Inclusion

The Civil Service is committed to attract, retain and invest in talent wherever it is found. To learn more please see the Civil Service People Plan and the Civil Service Diversity and Inclusion Strategy.

A Great Place to Work for Veterans

The "Making the Civil Service a Great Place to work for veterans" initiative includes a guaranteed interview scheme to those who meet the minimum criteria to provide eligible former members of the Armed Forces with opportunities to secure rewarding jobs. Allowing veterans to continue to serve their country, and to bring highly skilled individuals with a broad range of experience into the Civil Service in an environment, which recognises and values your previous service in the Armed Forces.

Civil Service departments are expected to explore redeployment opportunities before making an individual redundant. The MoJ is committed, as part of the Redeployment Interview Scheme, to providing opportunities to those who are 'at risk of redundancy'.

MoJ is able to offer an interview to eligible candidates who meet the minimum selection criteria, except in a limited number of campaigns. Candidates will not be eligible for the Redeployment Interview Scheme if they are applying on promotion.

title: Finance Business Partner
description:
Why Gallagher?

At Gallagher, finance isn't just about reporting what happened - it's about helping shape what happens next.

As a Finance Business Partner within our Animal Management business, you'll work closely with regional leaders across NZ, Australia and LATAM, turning financial data into commercial insight that drives better decisions, stronger margins and sustainable growth.

Alongside a competitive salary and annual performance bonus, you'll enjoy:

  • Competitive salary and bonuses

  • Hybrid flexibility (minimum 3 days in the office a week, with additional onsite days required depending on work demands)

  • KiwiSaver on-top and Life and Disability insurance

  • Free onsite parking, a subsidised café and great local eateries

  • Boost App membership and exclusive Gallagher staff discounts

  • Ongoing professional development and career growth opportunities

  • Team events, guest speakers, wellbeing initiatives and an inclusive, social culture

About Gallagher

At Gallagher, we're building technology that protects what matters most. From securing some of the world's most valuable assets to helping farmers care for millions of animals, our solutions are trusted in more than 160 countries.

Our Animal Management business is growing fast - combining world-class technology, connected products and deep agricultural expertise to help farmers work smarter and improve animal welfare.

It's an exciting stage of the journey, with plenty of opportunity to shape how we operate, how we make decisions and how we grow profitably. That's where you come in.

The Opportunity

This is a hands-on commercial finance role with genuine influence.

As our Finance Business Partner – Animal Management, you'll become a trusted finance partner to regional leadership across NZ, Australia and LATAM, owning the P&L story and bringing clarity to the commercial drivers behind performance.

You'll dive into margin, pricing, discounting, forecasting and profitability - challenging assumptions, identifying opportunities and making complex financial information useful for the people making business decisions.

You'll also have the chance to build, not just maintain. With plenty of scope to improve existing processes, you'll help establish stronger commercial governance around margin, deal approvals, rebates and forecasting, while using AI and modern tools to make finance smarter and more efficient.

Working across Finance, Sales, Pricing, eShepherd, Power BI and regional leadership, you'll have a broad view of the business and a real opportunity to make your mark.

You'll be responsible for

  • Partnering with regional leaders across NZ, Australia and LATAM to drive commercially informed decisions

  • Owning the P&L story, including revenue, margin, FX, mix, cost to serve and discounting

  • Delivering budgets, forecasts and scenario modelling - and challenging assumptions where needed

  • Identifying margin leakage and strengthening pricing, discounting and commercial controls

  • Building practical processes and governance where they don't yet exist

  • Providing analysis for customers, products, promotions and investment decisions

  • Supporting eShepherd and wider Animal Management initiatives through commercial modelling and performance insight

  • Using AI, Power BI and modern finance tools to improve analysis, reporting and decision-making

The Fit

You're a commercially minded finance professional who enjoys getting beyond the numbers. You can move comfortably from detailed financial analysis to a conversation with a senior leader, turning complex information into clear insights and practical action.

You'll also bring:

  • A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business or a related discipline

  • CA, CPA or CIMA qualification

  • Proven experience in commercial finance or finance business partnering

  • Strong P&L and margin analysis experience within a product-based business

  • Experience building or improving commercial processes and controls

  • Advanced Excel and financial modelling skills

  • Strong communication, influencing and stakeholder management skills

  • A hands-on, pragmatic approach and the ability to thrive in a changing environment

  • An interest in using AI and technology to improve how finance works

Experience with SAP, Power BI, multi-country/multi-currency environments, LATAM, agritech, FMCG, manufacturing or technology-enabled products would be advantageous.

If you're looking for a commercial finance role where you can influence decisions, build capability and see your work translate into real business outcomes, we'd love to hear from you.

Applications will be reviewed as they are received, and the role may be filled before the closing date.

title: Senior Principal Software Engineer, Vertica
description:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they're doing!

Job Description Summary:

The Senior Principal Software Engineer serves as a technical leader for the Vertica database platform, defining and driving the architecture, design, and implementation of strategic innovations across the core server. This role is responsible for advancing Vertica's foundational database technologies, including query optimization, distributed execution, storage, scalability, and performance, while influencing the long-term technical direction of the product.

As a recognized subject matter expert, the Senior Principal Software Engineer combines deep expertise in database internals with a proven track record of delivering innovative technologies that improve performance, reliability, and competitive differentiation in large-scale analytical data platforms. The role partners closely with Engineering, Product Management, Support, Sales Engineering, and customers to identify opportunities, define technical strategy, and deliver high-impact capabilities that strengthen Vertica's position in the market.

This role is particularly well suited for engineers who have previously driven major innovations in commercial analytical database systems and can leverage deep domain expertise to shape the next generation of Vertica’s core platform.

Key Responsibilities

  • Acts as the subject matter expert across multiple Vertica core server domains, including query optimization, distributed query execution, storage, concurrency, and database infrastructure.
  • Responsible for the technical direction and architecture of one or more critical components of the Vertica database engine.
  • Synthesizes customer requirements, market trends, product strategy, and engineering input into technical direction and product requirements.
  • Advises on architectural decisions and their impact on product capabilities, scalability, performance, reliability, and business outcomes.
  • Defines and drives the long-term architectural vision for core database technologies.
  • Researches and evaluates state-of-the-art database algorithms, distributed systems techniques, and emerging technologies, driving their practical application within the Vertica platform.
  • Identifies opportunities for innovation and delivers foundational enhancements that improve performance, scalability, reliability, and operational efficiency.
  • Architects complex database features and infrastructure that support large-scale analytical workloads across distributed environments.
  • Leads the design and implementation of highly concurrent, high-performance C++ software within mission-critical database systems.
  • Guides the evolution of Vertica’s query optimizer, execution engine, distributed architecture, and related core server technologies.
  • Documents and communicates complex technical concepts, architectures, and design decisions across the organization.
  • Works effectively with all groups involved in the software development process to ensure solutions consider downstream impacts across the product lifecycle.
  • Provides thought leadership and innovation within database systems and distributed data processing domains.
  • Regularly proposes and implements innovative ideas that improve Vertica’s competitive position and customer value.
  • Identifies, socializes, and drives improvements that have significant impact across products, teams, and customer workloads.
  • Applies deep knowledge of algorithms, data structures, database internals, and distributed systems to develop optimal solutions balancing performance, reliability, scalability, and security.
  • Provides forward-thinking designs that leverage existing platform capabilities in novel and impactful ways.
  • Actively participates in strategic planning, roadmap development, feature scoping, estimation, and prioritization of major initiatives.
  • Works with software architects and product owners to ensure roadmaps and backlogs align with long-term architectural objectives.
  • Guides testing strategies, including functional, performance, scalability, resiliency, and stress testing.
  • Collaborates directly with customers, support teams, and field organizations to understand real-world challenges and translate them into impactful technical solutions.
  • Mentors engineers and technical leaders across the organization, fostering engineering excellence and innovation.
  • Communicates effectively across the organization, including with senior leadership.
  • Demonstrates the ability to manage multiple competing priorities while maintaining focus on strategic objectives.

Experience and Qualifications

  • Minimum 12 years of software engineering experience, including significant experience developing complex systems software.
  • Proven track record of successful software innovation, problem solving, and product delivery at increasing scale and complexity.
  • Deep expertise in one or more database engine domains, including query optimization, query execution, storage engines, transaction processing, concurrency control, distributed systems, or database infrastructure.
  • Expert knowledge of C++ and performance-oriented systems programming.
  • Strong understanding of algorithms, data structures, operating systems, and multi-threaded programming.
  • Demonstrated experience designing and implementing large-scale distributed systems.
  • Strong knowledge of SQL and relational database technologies.
  • Ability to evaluate emerging research and translate innovative concepts into production-quality software.
  • Able to take ownership of the design and development of large architectural components and define interactions across subsystems.
  • Able to review designs and anticipate performance, scalability, reliability, and maintainability considerations.
  • Proven success leading cross-functional technical initiatives and influencing engineering strategy across multiple teams.
  • Recognized by peers as a superior technical contributor and technical leader.
  • Exemplary at dealing with uncertainty and ambiguity.
  • Proven success mentoring and developing software engineers at all levels.
  • Excellent technical communication and collaboration skills.
  • Ph.D. or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Database Systems, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline is strongly preferred.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical discipline required.

Preferred Experience

  • Expertise in commercial database internals and database kernel development.
  • Experience designing or implementing cost-based query optimizers.
  • Experience developing distributed query processing or execution frameworks.
  • Experience building highly scalable analytical database systems or massively parallel processing (MPP) database platforms.
  • Experience shaping the architectural direction of a mature enterprise software platform.
  • Record of innovation reflected through patents, publications, significant product contributions, or industry-recognized technical achievements.
  • Prior experience contributing to the Vertica database engine or other large-scale analytical database platforms.
  • Deep familiarity with Vertica core server architecture, query optimization, distributed execution, storage, catalog, transaction management, or related subsystems is highly valued.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence the technical direction of a complex database platform through architectural leadership and long-term innovation.

title: X-Day Offensive Research (XOR) Vulnerability Researcher
description:
As an X-Day Offensive Research (XOR) Vulnerability Researcher - Assessments & Exercises at JPMorganChase in the Cybersecurity & Technology Controls line of business, you will contribute significantly to enhancing the firm's cybersecurity or resiliency posture by using industry-standard assessment methodologies and techniques to proactively identify risks and vulnerabilities in people, processes, and technology. In this role, you will design and deploy risk-driven assessments (or manage a highly-skilled team that does) and inform analysis to clearly outline root causes.

We are seeking a dedicated, self-motivated vulnerability researcher to tackle the complex demands of our mission. Working closely with fellow researchers and defense teams, you will investigate challenging targets, uncover novel attack surfaces, and develop innovative solutions that enhance our security posture. The ideal candidate combines deep technical curiosity with a strong background in reverse engineering, static analysis, and dynamic analysis, and thrives in a highly collaborative, research-driven environment.

Job responsibilities
  • Design and execute testing and simulations - such as penetration tests, technical controls assessments, cyber exercises, or resiliency simulations - and contribute to the development and refinement of assessment methodologies, tools, and frameworks to ensure alignment with the firm's strategy and compliance with regulatory requirements.
  • Evaluate controls for effectiveness and impact on operational risk, as well as opportunities to automate control evaluation.
  • Conduct in-depth vulnerability research and exploit development across a broad range of categories, including operating systems, mobile devices, web applications, browsers, edge devices, and enterprise software.
  • Reverse engineer binaries using tools such as IDA Pro, Ghidra, or Binary Ninja to identify novel attack surfaces and develop proof-of-concept exploits.
  • Use common vulnerability research toolsets such as fuzzers, disassemblers, debuggers, and code browsers for static and dynamic analysis.
  • Perform N-day vulnerability analysis, patch diffing, and proof-of-concept exploit validation.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to develop comprehensive reports - including detailed findings, risk assessments, and remediation recommendations - supporting vulnerability triage, patch prioritization, and the sharing of indicators of compromise (IOCs) in service of the firm's mission requirements.
  • Leverage threat intelligence and security research to stay ahead of emerging threats, vulnerabilities, industry best practices, and regulations, applying this knowledge to enhance the firm's assessment strategy and risk management, and engaging with peers and industry groups that share threat intelligence analytics.
  • Document research findings, proof-of-concepts, and technical workflows to enable knowledge sharing and repeatability.


Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills
  • 5+ years of experience in cybersecurity or resiliency, with demonstrated exceptional organizational skills to plan, design, and coordinate the development of offensive security testing, assessments, or simulation exercises.
  • Track record of discovered vulnerabilities (CVEs) in high-profile targets in at least one of the following categories: operating systems, mobile devices, web applications, browsers, edge devices, or enterprise software.
  • Proven hands-on experience in vulnerability research, proof-of-concept exploit development, coordinated vulnerability disclosure, and mitigating security vulnerabilities in open-source projects.
  • Expertise in advanced analysis frameworks leveraging symbolic execution techniques and dynamic binary instrumentation to identify, triage, and exploit complex software vulnerabilities.
  • Hands-on proficiency exploiting complex vulnerability classes - including use-after-free, double free, type confusion - and applying advanced exploitation techniques such as heap spraying and controlled memory corruption to achieve reliable code execution.
  • Strong understanding of the internals of at least two operating systems throughout user mode and kernel mode (Microsoft Windows, GNU/Linux, Android, macOS, or iOS).
  • Experience auditing large C/C++, Java, and .NET codebases combining automated static analyzers with manual review to trace data and control flow, uncover memory-safety, injection, and deserialization vulnerabilities and produce proof-of-concept code.
  • Extensive reverse engineering expertise on x86/x64 and ARM/ARM64 binaries, employing IDA Pro, Ghidra, Binary Ninja, WinDbg, GDB, and RR for deep static/dynamic analysis and root cause vulnerability discovery.
  • Knowledge of US financial services sector cybersecurity or resiliency organization practices, operational risk management processes, principles, regulations, threats, risks, and incident response methodologies.
  • Ability to identify systemic security or resiliency issues as they relate to threats, vulnerabilities, or risks, with a focus on recommendations for enhancements or remediation, and proficiency in multiple security assessment methodologies (e.g., Open Worldwide Application Security Project (OWASP) Top Ten, National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) Cybersecurity Framework), offensive testing tools, or resiliency testing equivalents.
  • Excellent communication, collaboration, and report writing skills, with the ability to influence and engage stakeholders across various functions and levels.


Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills
  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, or PhD in a related technical field, or an equivalent combination of education and/or experience in a related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in vulnerability research and exploit development.
  • Experience using fuzzing tools such as LibFuzzer, LibAFL, AFL++, OSS-Fuzz, and Syzkaller.
  • Experience using program analysis tools such as LLVM, Angr, KLEE, Intel Pin, DynamoRIO, and Frida.
  • Experience emulating embedded platforms for live debugging.
  • Experience with kernel and low-level operating system development.
  • Deep Linux internals knowledge (SELinux, AppArmor, Seccomp, eBPF, containers, VMs).
  • Deep Windows internals knowledge (KASLR, DSE, SSDT, IDT, SMEP, SMAP, PXN, KPP, KDP, VBS, HVCI, KMCI, UMCI).

Part-Time, Binghamton/Waverly/Elmira, NY

4. You’ll work across the full UX process, translating ambiguous business goals into clear user journeys, information architecture, and interaction models. The role combines hands-on design with close collaboration across UX, design, product, engineering, and client teams. You’ll help create alignment, guide decisions, and ensure experiences are both thoughtful and ready to ship.   • Support end-to-end UX direction across client engagements, creating intuitive, scalable, and production-ready digital experiences.
  • Collaborate closely with UX, design, product, and engineering teams to define scope, clarify priorities, and make informed tradeoffs that protect the user experience.
  • Translate complex or ambiguous business objectives into clear user journeys, information architecture, interaction models, and actionable UX deliverables.
  • Develop UX patterns and design foundations that improve consistency, usability, and delivery efficiency across projects.
  • Facilitate workshops and alignment sessions with clients and internal stakeholders, turning different perspectives and competing inputs into clear decisions.
  • Design effectively within content management systems, taking into account content models, templates, reusable components, and CMS constraints.
  • Deliver UX solutions that improve measurable product outcomes, including usability, engagement, conversion, navigation, and onboarding.
  • Bring structure and clarity to open questions early in the process, helping teams move forward with confidence.
  • Contribute to a high standard of UX craft across client projects through thoughtful interaction design, iteration, and attention to detail.
  • Strengthen collaboration between clients, product, design, and engineering teams throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Continuously develop your UX practice through feedback, iteration, knowledge sharing, and collaboration with experienced multidisciplinary teams.

    • Requirements

    • A few years of professional experience designing digital products and UX solutions across complex web and/or mobile experiences.
    • Hands-on experience working with content management systems; strong WordPress experience is highly preferred.
    • Demonstrated ability to translate business and user needs into clear flows, information architecture, interaction models, and polished UX solutions.

    • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to bring structure, clarity, and momentum without unnecessarily complicating the process.

title: Pest Control Technician
description:
Pest Technician

BAM’S Landscaping & Lawn Care is looking for a motivated Pest Technician to join our growing team!

This is a varied, hands-on pest-control position covering mosquito, tick, and general nuisance-pest services around residential properties. No two days are necessarily the same—you may spend part of the day performing mosquito and tick treatments, then transition to inspecting and treating homes for other common nuisance pests.

If you enjoy working outdoors, solving pest problems, interacting with customers, and seeing the results of your work, this could be a great opportunity to grow with BAMS.

What You’ll Do

  • Perform mosquito and tick control treatments around residential properties
  • Perform general pest-control applications for common nuisance pests in and around homes
  • Inspect properties to identify pest activity, conducive conditions, and potential entry points
  • Diagnose pest problems and determine appropriate treatment methods
  • Apply pesticides safely and according to label requirements
  • Perform exterior perimeter and targeted pest treatments
  • Treat common nuisance pests such as ants, spiders, wasps, stinging insects, and other pests within the scope of your certification
  • Educate customers about pest activity, prevention, and recommended corrective measures
  • Perform follow-up service and monitor previously treated areas
  • Properly calibrate and maintain sprayers and other application equipment
  • Maintain accurate pesticide application and service records
  • Use a smartphone and company technology to document services and communicate with the office
  • Participate in continuing education and product/service training
  • Maintain clean, organized, and properly functioning equipment
  • Perform other related pest-control and outdoor service duties as needed

What We’re Looking For

We’re looking for a problem-solver and DOER who wants to build a career in the pest-control industry and take pride in solving customers’ pest problems.

The ideal candidate:

  • Has experience in pest control, landscaping, lawn care, horticulture, or a related outdoor service industry
  • Has practical knowledge of common household and nuisance pests or is willing to learn
  • Takes pride in quality workmanship and attention to detail
  • Has excellent communication and customer-service skills
  • Is dependable, self-motivated, and able to work independently
  • Works well as part of a team
  • Is comfortable using a smartphone and basic technology
  • Has a valid driver’s license
  • Can perform physically demanding outdoor work in varying weather conditions
  • Is comfortable working around homes, landscaping, crawlspaces, garages, and other residential environments
  • Must be able to pass a drug test

Licensing & Certifications

Maryland pesticide certification is preferred but not required. We can train the right candidate.

Preference will be given to applicants who already hold:

  • Maryland Department of Agriculture Category 7A – General Pest Control
  • Maryland Department of Agriculture Category 8 – Public Health
  • Other relevant Maryland pesticide certifications (7c a plus)

Qualified employees may be able to work under BAMS’ Business Applicator License while completing the training and certification process necessary to obtain their own credentials.

BAMS will provide training and continuing education to help the right employee expand their knowledge and certifications.

A Variety of Pest-Control Work

This position is designed to provide variety throughout the season.

Depending on the time of year and customer needs, your work may include:

Spring & Summer

  • Mosquito control
  • Tick control
  • Ants
  • Spiders
  • Wasps and other nuisance/stinging pests
  • Exterior perimeter treatments
  • Residential pest inspections

Fall & Winter

  • Interior general pest services
  • Seasonal nuisance-pest problems
  • Preventative exterior treatments when appropriate
  • Pest inspections and follow-up services
  • Preparation for the following mosquito and tick season

You’ll have the opportunity to develop skills across multiple areas of pest management rather than performing the exact same treatment every day.

Compensation & Benefits

Competitive pay based on experience, skills, and certifications.

Additional earning opportunities may include:

  • Performance-based commissions
  • Service and production incentives
  • Advancement opportunities based on performance, experience, and work ethic
  • Company-matched retirement plan
  • Ongoing training and professional development
  • Opportunity to earn additional Maryland pesticide certifications

About BAM’S Landscaping

BAM’S Landscaping was established in 2010 after beginning operations in 2004. We are a locally owned landscaping and lawn-care company serving the Montgomery County area.

We take pride in providing high-quality services while building long-term relationships with our customers. Our goal is simple: provide excellent work, create an outstanding customer experience, and build a team that takes pride in what we do.

We are expanding our services to provide customers with more of the outdoor and property-care services they need throughout the year. This position provides an opportunity to grow with that expansion and develop a long-term career in the pest-control industry.

If you are dependable, motivated, enjoy working outdoors, and want to learn how to solve a wide variety of pest problems, apply today!

BAM’S Landscaping & Lawn Care — protecting Montgomery County homes and properties, one pest problem at a time.

description:

About Us

Black Top Consulting provides digital and multimedia services across a diverse portfolio of businesses and brands, including Troya Living, Tool Market and other businesses within the Blacktop group.

Our team supports multiple brands through multimedia production, interactive website development, UI/UX design, digital content creation and e-commerce solutions.

We are seeking a creative and technically skilled Multimedia Specialist to join our Melbourne team.

In this role, you will combine multimedia design, interactive web technologies and emerging AI-powered creative tools to develop engaging digital experiences across our business portfolio.

You will work closely with our design, marketing, product and development teams to deliver multimedia projects from initial concept through to development and implementation.

Key Responsibilities

1. Multimedia Design and Production

  • Design, develop and produce multimedia content, including digital graphics, videos, animations, motion graphics and interactive web elements.

  • Create and edit video content for product presentations, websites and digital campaigns.

  • Develop multimedia content that combines graphics, animation, video and interactive functionality to deliver engaging digital experiences.

  • Utilise Adobe Creative Cloud and other multimedia production tools to create and refine digital assets.

  • Optimise multimedia content for different devices, screen sizes and digital platforms.

  • Maintain consistent visual and technical standards across multimedia projects.

2. Interactive Website Development

  • Design and develop interactive website components, responsive layouts and multimedia features.

  • Implement multimedia elements and interactive functionality using HTML, CSS, JavaScript and relevant web technologies.

  • Integrate graphics, videos, animations and interactive components into websites and content management systems.

  • Develop and enhance interactive product presentations, navigation systems and other digital interfaces.

  • Collaborate with developers to implement design concepts and resolve technical issues.

  • Test multimedia components for usability, responsiveness, accessibility and cross-browser compatibility.

3. UI/UX Design and Prototyping

  • Analyse user requirements and develop user-centred interface designs for websites and digital platforms.

  • Create wireframes, user flows, interactive prototypes and high-fidelity interface designs using Figma or similar tools.

  • Design responsive interfaces for desktop, tablet and mobile devices.

  • Develop engaging user experiences through interactive elements, animation and visual design.

  • Conduct usability testing and refine digital interfaces based on user feedback and project requirements.

  • Collaborate with developers to translate interface designs into functional digital experiences.

4. Multi-brand Digital Development

  • Develop multimedia content and interactive digital solutions for multiple brands within the business portfolio.

  • Adapt multimedia designs, interactive components and website layouts to meet the requirements of different brands and target audiences.

  • Create and maintain consistent digital experiences across brand websites and online platforms.

  • Collaborate with internal teams to deliver multimedia projects across different product categories and digital channels.

  • Support the development and implementation of multimedia content for websites, product pages, landing pages and digital campaigns.

5. E-commerce and Digital Content Integration

  • Develop and integrate multimedia content into Shopify and other e-commerce platforms.

  • Design and implement interactive product displays, promotional content and multimedia components for online stores.

  • Create digital assets that enhance product presentation and the online shopping experience.

  • Optimise graphics, video and interactive elements for website performance and usability.

  • Collaborate with marketing and product teams to implement digital content and website enhancements.

6. AI-Assisted Multimedia Production

  • Utilise AI-assisted creative tools to support the production of digital graphics, video, animation and multimedia content.

  • Explore emerging AI technologies to improve multimedia production workflows and creative efficiency.

  • Integrate AI-generated assets into digital projects while maintaining visual consistency, brand identity and quality standards.

  • Evaluate AI-powered design and multimedia tools for use in digital content production across multiple brands.

  • Combine traditional multimedia production techniques with AI-assisted workflows to develop engaging digital experiences.

7. Multimedia Project Delivery and Optimisation

  • Manage multimedia projects from initial concept and planning through to design, development, testing and implementation.

  • Prepare design specifications, interactive prototypes and multimedia assets for development and production.

  • Coordinate with designers, developers and other stakeholders to ensure projects meet agreed requirements.

  • Conduct quality assurance and troubleshoot multimedia content and interactive website features.

  • Review website usability and digital performance to identify opportunities for improving multimedia experiences.

  • Maintain documentation of multimedia assets, design specifications and implementation processes.

Skills and Experience

Essential Requirements

  • A relevant qualification in Multimedia, Information Technology, Digital Media, Interactive Design or a related field, or equivalent relevant professional experience.

  • Demonstrated professional experience in multimedia design, interactive website development or digital media production.

  • Proficiency in relevant Adobe Creative Cloud applications, particularly Photoshop and Illustrator.

  • Strong experience in UI/UX design, responsive web design, wireframing and interactive prototyping using Figma or similar software.

  • Working knowledge of HTML, CSS and JavaScript, including experience implementing interactive website elements.

  • Experience working with content management systems and integrating multimedia assets into digital platforms.

  • Understanding of multimedia production workflows, responsive design principles and website usability.

  • Ability to develop multimedia projects from concept through to implementation.

  • Strong creative thinking, technical problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work across multiple projects and brands.

Desirable Skills

  • Experience with Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve or similar video editing and motion graphics software.

  • Experience producing and editing digital videos, animations and motion graphics.

  • Experience with Shopify or other e-commerce platforms.

  • Knowledge of SEO principles and website performance optimisation.

  • Familiarity with Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager or similar web analytics tools.

  • Experience with generative AI and AI-assisted multimedia production tools, such as Adobe Firefly, Runway, Kling, Midjourney or similar platforms.

  • Understanding of prompt development, AI-generated asset refinement and multimedia post-production.

  • Experience working across multiple brands or managing concurrent multimedia projects.

About You

You are a creative and technically minded professional who enjoys combining design, technology and multimedia production to develop engaging digital experiences.

You have a strong understanding of interactive website development, digital media production and user-centred design.

You are comfortable translating creative concepts into functional digital solutions and working collaboratively with designers, developers and marketing professionals.

You are adaptable, organised and detail-oriented, with an interest in emerging technologies and a commitment to delivering high-quality digital experiences.

What We Offer

  • The opportunity to work on diverse multimedia and digital development projects across multiple brands.

  • A collaborative working environment involving design, marketing, product and development teams.

  • Exposure to a variety of digital platforms, technologies and creative projects.

  • Opportunities to contribute to the ongoing development of our digital platforms and customer experiences.

How to Apply

title: Technical Product Manager
description:
Technical Product Manager

Optiveum is looking for a hands-on Technical Product Manager for a long-term, engaging project. The cooperation is based on a B2B contract directly with Optiveum.

The Client You will be working for a US-based technology company that builds a live consumer platform connecting communities through video, audio, text, and photos. Alongside this, they are developing an emerging AI business that helps brands understand public conversations through transcription, media analysis, topic and entity detection, and sentiment analysis.

The Role This is a high-ownership product role with technical depth and direct user contact. You will learn directly from creators, audiences, customers, and internal teams to identify the problems worth solving. You will own the entire path from research and product decisions to clear designs, user stories, and post-launch learning. We are looking for someone who is comfortable in a dynamic startup environment, able to lead customer conversations independently, and can turn feedback into clear, actionable recommendations.

What you will do

  • Plan and conduct product discovery: interview creators, users, prospective customers, and internal stakeholders to test assumptions with evidence.

  • Synthesize conversations, usage signals, and market research into clear problem statements, user journeys, opportunities, and priorities.

  • Partner with design and engineering to explore solutions, sketch flows, define MVPs, and make trade-offs across user value, technical effort, risk, and speed.

  • Translate decisions into concise design briefs, user stories, acceptance criteria, and technical workflows that help engineers build with clarity.

  • Work closely with engineering on dependencies, APIs, data flows, AI/media capabilities, privacy, and reliability.

  • Test releases with users, measure adoption and friction, and use what you learn to improve onboarding, engagement, monetization, and retention.

Expectations

  • Ideally 4-7 years of relevant experience, including at least 2-3 years owning product discovery and delivery for a software product (ideally in an early-stage or fast-moving team). A technical background followed by a move into product works well too.

  • Technical fluency: you can discuss architecture and implementation choices with engineers, understand APIs and data flows, and write precise requirements without prescribing every solution.

  • Strong interviewing and synthesis skills – you are comfortable approaching users, asking useful questions, and changing your view when evidence changes.

  • Good product judgment and a bias for simple solutions. You know what to build now, what to test first, and what to defer.

  • Ability to collaborate across time zones and communicate clearly in English, both in writing and in live conversations.

  • Nice to have: Experience with consumer social or community products, creator tools, media workflows, subscriptions/monetization, or AI-assisted products.

What is offered

  • Salary: Up to 30 USD net/h.

  • Contract: B2B directly with Optiveum.

  • Start: ASAP, long-term project.

  • Type of work: 100% Remote (Candidates must be based in Poland).

  • Working hours: Full-time, with dependable overlap required for working sessions and alignment with the US East Coast team, as well as availability for user interviews.

Recruitment Process Our recruitment process is straightforward and consists of two stages:

  1. A take-home assignment to showcase your product judgment and technical fluency.

  2. A final interview with the CEO.

You will own the roadmap, determine priorities, challenge requests that don’t align with the product strategy, and use customer and commercial insights to decide where we invest next.

This a great role for a Product Manager who likes asking “why?”, making informed trade-offs and seeing the impact of their products. The role can be based in Sydney, Melbourne or Brisbane!

Your key responsibilities:
  • Own the product roadmap, backlog and lifecycle for our Managed Modern Workplace portfolio.
  • Shape and evolve our Microsoft 365 managed services, endpoint management and end-user support offerings.
  • Use customer, commercial and product data to identify opportunities, prioritise improvements and drive product decisions.
  • Define scalable, repeatable services, balancing customer needs with commercial viability and operational efficiency.

description:

JOB STATEMENT: The Senior Database Engineer is a hands-on technical role responsible for the architecture, development, administration, security, performance, and reliability of the company’s Microsoft SQL Server and Oracle database environments. The role also designs and develops enterprise data warehouse and integration solutions supporting ERP, reporting, analytics, and other business-critical applications.


KEY RESPONSABILITIES:

Database Engineering & Development

  • Own the administration, configuration, maintenance, and optimization of Microsoft SQL Server and Oracle environments.
  • Design, develop, and optimize complex T-SQL and PL/SQL, including stored procedures, functions, views, packages, triggers, and database jobs.
  • Review database code and architecture for performance, scalability, reliability, and maintainability.
  • Establish standards for database design, development, deployment, and change management.

Performance & Reliability

  • Perform advanced database and query tuning using execution plans, wait statistics, indexing, statistics, query profiling, and workload analysis.
  • Diagnose CPU, memory, I/O, locking, blocking, deadlocks, TempDB, transaction log, storage, and concurrency issues.
  • Monitor database health, performance, availability, and capacity and proactively identify potential issues.
  • Design database configurations for performance, scalability, high availability, and growth.

Data Warehouse & Integration

  • Architect, design, and develop enterprise data warehouses, data marts, staging environments, and dimensional models.
  • Develop and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines integrating ERP, operational, financial, and other enterprise data sources.
  • Design fact tables, dimensions, star schemas, historical data structures, and aggregation strategies.
  • Develop data validation, reconciliation, error handling, and data-quality controls.
  • Optimize data models and database structures supporting BI, reporting, analytics, and data visualization platforms.

Security, Backup & Recovery

  • Own database backup, recovery, disaster recovery, retention, and restore-testing procedures.
  • Manage database users, roles, permissions, service accounts, encryption, auditing, and least privilege access.
  • Support database vulnerability remediation, patching, upgrades, and security reviews.
  • Maintain database recovery procedures and participate in business continuity and disaster recovery testing.
  • ERP & Enterprise Systems
  • Support database and integration requirements for enterprise ERP and business applications.
  • Understand complex ERP schemas and develop efficient extraction and integration strategies.
  • Support ERP implementations, upgrades, migrations, data conversions, integrations, and troubleshooting.
  • Partner with application, infrastructure, security, and business teams to resolve complex data and system issues

Other duties as assigned


QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 7+ years of experience in database engineering, development, administration, or data warehousing.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft SQL Server and Oracle.
  • Advanced SQL, T-SQL, and PL/SQL development and performance-tuning skills.
  • Strong experience with stored procedures, functions, views, packages, execution plans, indexing, and query optimization.
  • Experience designing and building enterprise data warehouses, dimensional models, and ETL/ELT solutions.
  • Strong knowledge of database architecture, security, backup/recovery, disaster recovery, monitoring, and capacity planning.
  • Experience working with large transactional databases and high-volume data environments
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and root-cause-analysis skills.


PREFERRED EXPERINCE:

  • ERP platforms such as IFS, SAP, NetSuite, Microsoft Dynamics, JD Edwards, Epicor, or similar enterprise systems.
  • Data integration technologies including SSIS, Azure Data Factory, Informatica, Talend, or similar tools.
  • BI, reporting, analytics, and data visualization platforms such as Tableau, Power BI, Qlik, Cognos, or similar technologies.
  • Cloud data platforms including Snowflake, Azure, AWS, or similar technologies.
  • Scripting and automation using PowerShell, Python, or similar technologies.
  • Manufacturing, distribution, supply chain, or consumer products environments.
  • Integration of AI services, APIs, and AI-enabled capabilities into enterprise applications.


PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Sit for extended period of time
  • Perform tasks using standard computer equipment
  • Lift up to 50 lbs.


WORK ENVIRONMENT:

  • Limited noise level
  • Indoor climate


PERSONAL PROTECTIVE EQUIPMENT REQUIRED:

  • Side shield safety glasses, safety vest, head/ear protection and proper footwear when in production facility.

title: Worship Technical Specialist
description:
Overview

Lifeway is seeking a Worship Technical Specialist to serve as a key resource for Lifeway Worship, blending technical expertise with a heart for ministry to support churches and worship teams across the country. In this role, you will manage digital and physical worship assets, provide advanced technical support for LifewayWorship.com, and collaborate with programmers, legal, and ministry leadership on strategic worship initiatives. This is a unique opportunity for someone who understands both the technical and ministry dimensions of worship resource development and wants their work to have lasting impact in the local church.

Why Lifeway?

Lifeway is a place where you can bring your faith and work experience to join in the most important mission in the world: making disciples of Jesus Christ. Whether you’re a creator or storyteller, data guru or problem-solver, or anywhere in between, if you’re passionate about serving the church, we have a place for you. Lifeway has a strong Work from Anywhere (WFA) culture that is deeply focused on our mission and values. While headquartered in Nashville, TN, many of our positions are remote-eligible and have autonomy and flexibility with work hours. We provide equipment and resources to ensure team members have access to a productive and ergonomic workspace. We believe building relationships and community is essential to how we work together, so Lifeway hosts all-team meetings several times per year and provides travel for key team gatherings for remote-based team members. Full-time employees are eligible for enrollment in our comprehensive benefits plans including healthcare, vacation and sick time, holiday pay, care days, 401(k) plan, maternity and parental leave, adoption assistance, mission trip time, and more. If this sounds like a place where you would be excited to serve the kingdom of God, we would love for you to join our team.

Learn more about our culture at team.lifeway.com/culture-code

This is a remote position in the U.S. with occasional travel to Nashville for in-person team gatherings.

Responsibilities

  • Lives out Lifeway’s mission and values, showing deep commitment to Kingdom work
  • Limited travel: 2-4 times per year, typically overnight
  • Provide advanced technical support for LifewayWorship.com via phone, chat, and email, resolving escalated issues for customers, church partners, and internal support teams
  • Serve as the primary liaison for the Lifeway Worship Customer Service Teams channel, assisting Church Sales & Support Specialists with complex or escalated cases
  • Investigate and resolve technical and product-related customer inquiries, maintaining a support spreadsheet to ensure timely follow-ups and accurate records
  • Manage all digital and physical worship assets, including archive organization, duplication of physical masters, artwork development for vendor relationships, and custom audio edits for church sound systems
  • Partner with the Legal team to ensure rights and royalties for worship assets are properly administered
  • Coordinate shipping, tracking, and fulfillment of vendor orders and sample products in partnership with the Order Research team
  • Oversee One Source administration for Canon accounts and manage Metro 2 mailing list memberships to maintain database accuracy
  • Collaborate with programmers on regression testing, bug fixes, and feature support for LifewayWorship.com
  • Support and lead new Lifeway Worship initiatives in partnership with the Project Team Leader, including content development and ministry partnerships
  • Continuously evaluate and recommend improvements to technical support systems, digital resource management, and customer service processes

Qualifications

Education

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Digital Media, Music, or a related field, required

Master's degree, not required

Advanced graduate degree (PhD, etc.), not required

Skills, Knowledge, & Experiences, required

  • Ability to travel to the Middle Tennessee area 2-4 times annually for team gatherings
  • 3+ years of experience in technical support, digital media, or a related field
  • Experience in local church music ministry
  • Experience in web design and development
  • Technical troubleshooting and web platform support
  • Digital asset management and organization
  • Vendor coordination and order fulfillment
  • Clear written and verbal communication across phone, chat, and email

Actively involved in an evangelical Christian church

Skills, Knowledge, & Experiences, preferred

  • Familiarity with rights and royalty administration for digital media
  • Experience with regression testing or software QA processes
  • Experience with audio editing for worship or church sound systems
  • Background in content development for digital ministry platforms

title: Claims Analyst
description:
The Claims Analyst will: utilize experience within commercial property and casualty claims to monitor and assess claims activity of Third-Party Administrators (TPAs); use direct systems to access and monitor claim files, denials, reservations of rights, and settlements conducted by TPAs; verify that the TPAs are performing within their authority, pursuant to agree upon processes and practices, within the agreed upon territories and market segments; consult with the Credit Risk, Legal, Compliance, Finance, Underwriting, and IT departments to identify specific trends or problems within a program; keep records of all monitoring activity and report to the management team, including both quantitative and qualitative measures and assessments.

The Claims Analyst will also develop a long-term relationship with the TPA staff and the third-party reinsurance panel participating in the risk of the program through the appropriate reinsurance broker, and will internally and externally communicate any observations, problems, trends, strengths, and opportunities discovered. The goal of the position is growing the business and maintaining and improve the program results for the benefit of Clear Blue and the other stakeholders, including the agencies and participating reinsurance companies.

MAIN DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Providing front-line oversight of Third-Party Administrators’ personnel through direct communication and monitoring claims online using the Third-Party Administrators’ claim systems.
  • Identifying, analyzing, and discussing monthly loss run trends, reportable claims and/or problematic claims.
  • Providing excellent claim service to external clients and internal partners.
  • Participating in claim file reviews with agents, brokers and Third-Party Administrators’ claim personnel.
  • Interfacing with Clear Blue and external underwriting on claim status, exposures, and other factors impacting their risks.
  • Preparing and presenting internal management reports for large losses and large loss potential; usually over $250,000.
  • Conducting remote and onsite claim file audits of Third-Party Administrators.
  • Performing other duties as required by management including reinsurance and subrogation.
  • Focus on monthly auditing of Third-Party Administrators

EDUCATION AND QUALIFICATIONS

• Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree in insurance, finance, or risk management; or equivalent related experience.

• AIC certification preferred, or other relevant course work.

REQUIREMENTS

  • One (1) to Three (3) years of experience in claim handling, quality assurance, relevant litigation, TPA management, or equivalent related experience.
  • Demonstrated success in evaluating claims, making coverage determinations based on policy provisions, and managing litigation.
  • Strong communication (verbal and written) and interpersonal skills.
  • Some travel might be required and will vary depending on business needs and caseload.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Office.
  • Ability to manage time effectively, set priorities and meet deadlines.

The responsibilities of this position require continuous interaction internally (executive team, managers, supervisors, and fellow associates) and externally (with TPAs, managing general agents, reinsurers, and brokers/intermediaries).

GENERAL SKILLS

  • Teamwork and ability to work and interact with departments throughout the organization
  • Time management
  • Excellent attention to detail
  • Ability to safeguard confidential information.

PHYSICAL AND MENTAL DEMANDS

The position requires sitting, standing, and walking associated with a normal office environment, talking and hearing. This position requires minimal weightlifting or force exertion.

ENVIRONMENTAL AND WORKING CONDITIONS

The Claims Analyst is exposed to a general normal office environment and some travel. The Claims Analyst may work occasionally in the evenings or weekends. The noise in the work environment is moderate.

This description is intended to provide only basic guidelines for meeting job requirements. Responsibilities, knowledge, skills, abilities and working conditions may change as needs evolve.

title: Tech Architect Practitioner
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Tech Architect Practitioner based in Switzerland.

This is a senior technical consulting role focused on helping investors, portfolio companies, and technology leaders make effective architecture decisions that support measurable business outcomes. You will lead complex architecture engagements across applications, cloud, infrastructure, integration, data, security, and software delivery. The role combines deep technical expertise with strategic thinking, requiring you to translate business priorities into pragmatic and scalable technology solutions. You will assess current technology environments, define target architectures, identify risks and constraints, and establish practical transition roadmaps. You will work closely with senior technology and business stakeholders, communicating complex technical topics with clarity and confidence. The environment is collaborative, fast-moving, and focused on solving complex technology challenges through practical, evidence-based recommendations.

Accountabilities

  • Lead technical architecture workstreams across complex client engagements, assessing applications, infrastructure, cloud environments, integration patterns, data platforms, and technical constraints.
  • Define pragmatic target-state architectures that align business priorities with application, infrastructure, data, security, scalability, resilience, and delivery requirements.
  • Advise clients on technology platform and architecture decisions, including cloud platforms, application modernisation, infrastructure, integration, software delivery tooling, data platforms, and analytics environments.
  • Translate business and technology requirements into clear architecture principles, technical designs, transition approaches, and delivery priorities.
  • Develop and present architecture recommendations that are credible to senior technology leaders while remaining accessible and actionable for non-technical stakeholders.
  • Identify technical risks, dependencies, technical debt, architectural constraints, and delivery challenges, recommending practical mitigation strategies.
  • Collaborate with client teams and multidisciplinary specialists to ensure architecture decisions support product, engineering, cloud, security, data, and broader transformation objectives.
  • Challenge assumptions and pressure-test proposed designs, balancing strategic ambition with cost, complexity, resilience, and time to value.
  • Develop prioritised technology roadmaps that help clients move from current-state limitations toward scalable, resilient, and fit-for-purpose technology capabilities.

    • Requirements

    • Significant experience in technical, solutions, or enterprise architecture, software engineering, or related technical leadership roles, with a proven track record of designing and delivering complex technology solutions.
    • Strong practical knowledge of modern technology architectures and platforms, including cloud services, application architecture, infrastructure, integration patterns, software delivery practices, security, and reliability.
    • Demonstrated experience assessing existing technology estates and defining target-state architectures, transition strategies, and delivery roadmaps.
    • Strong understanding of cloud technologies, security, resilience, observability, performance, scalability, and operational considerations.
    • Meaningful expertise in data architecture and modern data platforms, including data warehouses, data lakes, lakehouses, integration patterns, data modelling, data governance, data quality, and analytics.
    • Ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, practical recommendations for senior business, data, and technology stakeholders.
    • Credibility when working with senior technology leaders, including CTOs, CIOs, CDOs, Heads of Engineering, Heads of Data, and enterprise architects.
    • Experience across the full technology lifecycle, from architecture and platform design through software delivery, deployment, operations, modernisation, and continuous improvement.
    • Practical and hands-on mindset, with the ability to move between architecture design, technical problem-solving, and client-facing advisory work.
    • Consulting, advisory, or multi-client delivery experience is desirable, together with the ability to operate effectively in ambiguous and fast-moving environments.

      • Benefits

      • Opportunity to lead high-impact technology architecture engagements across a diverse range of clients and business contexts.
      • Exposure to strategic technology challenges spanning cloud, applications, infrastructure, data, security, integration, and modernisation.
      • Direct interaction with senior technology and business leaders, including executive-level stakeholders.
      • Opportunity to influence architecture decisions that support measurable business outcomes and long-term technology value.
      • Collaborative environment bringing together experienced technology, transformation, commercial, and operational specialists.
      • Scope to deepen expertise across modern architecture practices while contributing to complex, multidisciplinary engagements.
      • Opportunity to work on varied, challenging projects in a fast-moving and entrepreneurial consulting environment.
      • Ability to contribute to practical technology roadmaps and solutions that balance scalability, resilience, cost, complexity, and speed to value.

description:
Where applicants provide multiple location preferences, reserve lists will be managed in accordance with location preference/s, as indicated in your application. Please only indicate preferences where you are prepared to work. If you are subsequently offered a role from the reserve list for a location preference indicated in your application and decline it, you will be removed from the reserve list for the vacancy, across all locational preferences.

All offers of employment will be made strictly in merit order, based on your performance throughout the recruitment process. Candidates at the top of the merit list will be offered vacancies as they arise in their chosen locations.

The addresses listed in the job advertisement are not an exhaustive list of potential base locations, they give an indication of some of the potential locations you could be based at.

Once you have accepted an offer for a role, you will be withdrawn from any other live applications for the same role and will no longer be considered for those vacancies.

We will therefore endeavour to offer you a vacancy within a 60-minute commute of your home location.

New entrants to the Civil Service will be expected to join at the entry point salary for the advertised band.
