title: Route Planner
description:
We are seeking an organized and detail-oriented Route Planner to coordinate efficient delivery and collection routes for warehouse operations. The successful candidate will plan daily transportation schedules, assign routes and vehicles, monitor deliveries, and ensure that shipments reach customers on time and cost-effectively.

Key Responsibilities

  • Plan and optimize daily delivery and collection routes based on customer locations, delivery windows, vehicle capacity, and driver availability.
  • Coordinate with warehouse, transportation, customer service, and inventory teams.

title: Senior Platform Engineer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Platform Engineer based in France.

As a Senior Platform Engineer, you will help build and evolve the foundational infrastructure and services that enable product and engineering teams to work efficiently at scale. You’ll combine strong software engineering skills with hands-on expertise across GCP, AWS, Kubernetes, and Terraform. The role offers significant ownership over platform architecture, infrastructure automation, reliability, security, and developer experience. You’ll work closely with development teams to understand their needs and turn them into scalable self-service solutions. You’ll also contribute to CI/CD systems, internal tools, APIs, and operational improvements. This is an individual contributor role within a collaborative, globally distributed, and fully remote engineering environment.

Accountabilities

  • Design, build, and continuously improve scalable, reliable, and secure cloud infrastructure across GCP and AWS.
  • Architect and maintain Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, applying software engineering practices such as reusable modules, testing, and predictable deployments.
  • Deploy, operate, and optimize Kubernetes environments, including GKE and EKS, with responsibility for networking, upgrades, service meshes, availability, performance, and resource utilization.
  • Develop and maintain internal CI/CD systems and automation using technologies such as Argo CD, Atlantis, or similar tools.
  • Diagnose and resolve complex platform issues involving performance, scalability, reliability, and security, while contributing to incident response and post-mortem processes.
  • Drive automation initiatives that reduce manual work, minimize operational risk, and improve system reliability and efficiency.
  • Partner closely with development teams to understand infrastructure and developer-experience needs and translate them into effective platform capabilities and roadmaps.
  • Develop internal platform products, services, tools, and APIs that improve self-service and developer productivity.
  • Implement strong cloud security practices covering access control, vulnerability management, encryption, compliance, audits, and relevant standards such as SOC 2 and GDPR.
  • Contribute to technical direction through code reviews, knowledge sharing, mentorship, and close collaboration with engineering peers.

    • Requirements

    • 6+ years of experience in platform engineering, DevOps engineering, or a closely related field, with experience building and operating complex cloud infrastructure.
    • Strong hands-on experience with GCP and/or AWS, Kubernetes including GKE/EKS, and Terraform.
    • Proven ability to build scalable, reliable, secure, and highly automated cloud environments.
    • Strong software engineering fundamentals and coding proficiency in Go, TypeScript, or another relevant programming language, including knowledge of data structures, algorithms, testing, and defensive programming.
    • Experience designing and maintaining CI/CD systems using tools such as Argo CD, Atlantis, or comparable technologies.
    • Solid understanding of networking concepts and protocols within cloud environments.
    • Extensive experience with monitoring and logging solutions such as Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, or similar tools, with the ability to investigate and resolve performance issues.
    • Knowledge of cloud security best practices and experience applying them to production environments.
    • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
    • Self-organized, proactive, goal-oriented, and comfortable taking ownership in an individual contributor role.
    • Ability to collaborate effectively within a remote, distributed, and international engineering team.
    • Previous experience working specifically on platform engineering initiatives and internal developer platforms.

      • Benefits

      • Fully remote, full-time position for candidates based in the Netherlands.
      • Flexible working options and the freedom to structure your schedule around your work and personal life.
      • Unlimited paid time off.
      • Health insurance.
      • Parental leave.

description:
Where applicants provide multiple location preferences, reserve lists will be managed in accordance with location preference/s, as indicated in your application. We will appoint in merit list order for each location outlined in the vacancy and hold a separate locational reserve list for each of these locations. After appointments have been made using this locational appointment process, any remaining candidates who met the benchmark for the role will remain on a locational reserve list in accordance with their preferences for 12 months.

Please only indicate preferences where you are prepared to work. If you are subsequently offered a role from the reserve list for a location preference indicated in your application and decline it, you will be removed from the reserve list for the vacancy, across all locational preferences.

All offers of employment will be made strictly in merit order, based on your performance throughout the recruitment process. Candidates at the top of the merit list will be offered vacancies as they arise in their chosen locations.

The addresses listed in the job advertisement are not an exhaustive list of potential base locations, they give an indication of some of the potential locations you could be based at.

Once you have accepted an offer for a role, you will be withdrawn from any other live applications for the same role and will no longer be considered for those vacancies.

We will therefore endeavour to offer you a vacancy within a 60-minute commute of your home location.

New entrants to the Civil Service will be expected to join at the entry point salary for the advertised band.

Existing Civil Servants will have their salary calculated in accordance with the Departments pay on transfer / pay on promotion rules.

The post is currently advertised without VISOR Vetting to enable appointment to take place as soon as possible, however, VISOR vetting will be required to be completed post offer.

Working Arrangements & Further Information

The MoJ offers Hybrid Working arrangements where business need allows. This is an informal, non-contractual form of flexible working that blends working from your base location, different MoJ sites and / or from home (please be aware that this role can only be worked in the UK and not overseas). Some roles will not be suitable for Hybrid Working. Similarly, Hybrid Working will not suit everyone’s circumstances. Arrangements will be discussed and agreed with the successful candidate(s) and subject to regular review.

For nationally advertised roles, the successful candidate(s) will be appointed to a MoJ office location, which may include their nearest Justice Collaboration Centre or Justice Satellite Office. This will be discussed and agreed on the completion of pre-employment checks.

Some of MoJ’s terms and conditions of service are changing as part of Civil Service reform. The changes will apply to staff joining MoJ who are new to the Civil Service. Staff joining MoJ from other civil service employers will transfer onto the new MoJ terms if they are already on 'modernised' terms in their current post or onto 'unmodernised' MoJ terms if they are on 'unmodernised' terms at their current post. Details will be available if an offer is made.

Standard full time working hours are 37 hours per week excluding breaks which are unpaid. HMPPS welcomes part-time, flexible and job-sharing working patterns, where they meet the demands of the role and business needs. All applications for part-time, flexible and job-sharing working patterns will be considered in accordance with the HMPPS’ Flexible Working policy.

Benefits

The MoJ offers a range of benefits:

Annual Leave

Annual leave is 25 days on appointment and will increase to 30 days after five years’ service, plus public holidays. Leave for part-time and job share posts will be calculated on a pro-rata basis

Pension

The National Probation Service is covered by the Local Government Pension Scheme (LGPS) run through the Greater Manchester Pension Fund (GMPF). Please visit www.gmpf.org.uk for further information.

Please note: Any current Civil Servant who is a member of the PCSPS, by accepting an offer of employment to the National Probation Services will be opted out of the PCSPS and auto enrolled into the Local Government Pension Scheme.

Training

The Ministry of Justice is committed to staff development and offers an extensive range of training and development opportunities.

Networks

The opportunity to join employee-run networks that have been established to provide advice and support and to enable the views of employees from minority groups to be expressed direct to senior management. There are currently networks for employees of minority ethnic origin, employees with disabilities, employees with caring responsibilities, women employees, and lesbian, gay, bisexual and transgender.

Eligibility

All candidates are subject to security and identity checks prior to taking up post

Support

  • A range of ‘Family Friendly’ policies such as opportunities to work reduced hours or job share.
  • Access to flexible benefits such as voluntary benefits, retail vouchers and discounts on a range of goods and services.
  • For moves to or from another employer or moves across the Civil Service this can have implications on your eligibility to carry on claiming childcare vouchers. You may however be eligible for alternative government childcare support schemes, including Tax Free Childcare. More information can be found on or Childcare Choices. You can determine your eligibility at .
  • Paid paternity, adoption and maternity leave.
  • Free annual sight tests for employees who use computer screens.

Working for the Civil Service

The Civil Service Code sets out the standards of behaviour expected of civil servants.

We recruit by merit on the basis of fair and open competition, as outlined in the Civil Service Commission's recruitment principles. Should you feel that the recruitment process has breached the recruitment principles you are able to raise a formal complaint in the following order

  • To Transformative Business Services (0345 241 5358 (Monday to Friday 8am - 6pm) or e mail moj-recruitment-vetting-enquiries@resourcing.soprasteria.co.uk);
  • To Ministry of Justice Resourcing team (resourcing-management-office@justice.gov.uk);
  • To the Civil Service Commission (details available here)

As a Disability Confident employer, MoJ are committed to providing everyone with the opportunity to demonstrate their skills, talent and abilities, by making adjustments throughout all elements of the recruitment process and in the workplace. MoJ are able to offer an interview to disabled candidates who meet the minimum selection criteria, except in a limited number of campaigns.

You will be able to request reasonable adjustments to the recruitment process within the application form. If you need additional help completing the application form, please contact the TBS Recruitment Enquiries Team.

For more information on applying for a role as a candidate with a disability or long-term condition, please watch our animated videos.

Diversity & Inclusion

The Civil Service is committed to attract, retain and invest in talent wherever it is found. To learn more please see the Civil Service People Plan and the Civil Service Diversity and Inclusion Strategy.

A Great Place to Work for Veterans

The "Making the Civil Service a Great Place to work for veterans" initiative includes a guaranteed interview scheme to those who meet the minimum criteria to provide eligible former members of the Armed Forces with opportunities to secure rewarding jobs. Allowing veterans to continue to serve their country, and to bring highly skilled individuals with a broad range of experience into the Civil Service in an environment, which recognises and values your previous service in the Armed Forces.
For further details about the initiative and eligibility requirements visit:

Redeployment Interview Scheme

Civil Service departments are expected to explore redeployment opportunities before making an individual redundant. The MoJ is committed, as part of the Redeployment Interview Scheme, to providing opportunities to those who are 'at risk of redundancy'.

MoJ is able to offer an interview to eligible candidates who meet the minimum selection criteria, except in a limited number of campaigns. Candidates will not be eligible for the Redeployment Interview Scheme if they are applying on promotion.

Civil Service Nationality Rules

This job is broadly open to the following groups:

  • UK nationals
  • nationals of the Republic of Ireland
  • nationals of Commonwealth countries who have the right to work in the UK
  • nationals of the EU, Switzerland, Norway, Iceland or Liechtenstein and family members of those nationalities with settled or pre-settled status under the European Union Settlement Scheme (EUSS) (opens in a new window) https://www.gov.uk/settled-status-eu-citizens-families

Further information on nationality requirements (opens in a new window) https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/nationality-rules

Reserve list

A reserve list may be held for up to 12 months from which further appointments may be made for the same or similar roles.

title: Account Director, Japan
description:
Company Introduction:

Mintel’s clients choose us because they know we’re drawing on Mintel data, knowledge, expertise, and insights that are rooted in the rigorous, multi-disciplinary research on which our reputation has been built.

To support the business priorities of our top global and regional accounts, our Strategic Client Partnership Model provides high-growth, high-value clients with a dedicated team of experts, ensuring we can deliver tailored support aligned to their unique business needs.

We are seeking a strategic Account Director for Strategic Partnership Accounts to own and grow a portfolio of these high-growth global and regional accounts, with a focus on deepening client relationships, identifying commercial opportunities, and building long-term value.

What You Will Be Doing:

You will own and grow a portfolio of Mintel’s largest and highest-value global and regional accounts. As the Account Director for Strategic Partnership Accounts, you will be responsible for renewing key client relationships, identifying growth opportunities, and positioning Mintel as a valued and preferred research partner. Day-to-day responsibilities include:

  • Owning the commercial relationship for key accounts in your market, working closely with global account managers to support best practices and drive growth across Mintel regions.
  • Building strong relationships across multiple levels of the client organization to identify opportunities for consultancy sales, contract upgrades, and long-term account growth.
  • Leading regular strategic reviews with internal stakeholders to track progress against account plans and adjust priorities where needed.
  • Developing and delivering creative business solutions that demonstrate ROI, strengthen client relationships, and support successful renewals.
  • Meeting commercial KPIs set by the APAC management team, including contract upgrades, consultancy sales, and renewal targets.
  • Maintaining accurate CRM records of client details, meetings, objectives, opportunities, and account activity.
  • Planning and executing a strategic reach-out plan aligned with the annual account plan.
  • Collaborating closely with internal business teams to ensure clients receive a consistent, high-quality experience across touchpoints.

We Are Looking for People Who Are:

  • Commercially-minded: You can identify growth opportunities within existing client relationships and are comfortable leading conversations around renewals, upgrades, and consultancy solutions.
  • Relationship-driven: You enjoy building trusted partnerships with senior stakeholders and navigating complex client organizations.
  • Strategic and proactive: You are able to translate account goals into clear plans and take ownership of driving them forward.
  • Collaborative: You work effectively with global account managers, internal stakeholders, and cross-functional teams to deliver the best client experience.
  • Client-focused: You are motivated by understanding client needs and showing how Mintel’s data, insights, and expertise can support their business goals.
  • Self-directed: You are comfortable managing priorities independently and taking accountability for the success of your account portfolio.
  • A strong communicator: You can adapt your communication style for different clients, seniority levels, and internal business partners.

Must-Have Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience in sales or account management
  • Native-level Japanese and business-level English proficiency
  • Strong skills in Excel and PowerPoint

Nice-to-Have Qualifications

  • Experience in the FMCG (Fast-Moving Consumer Goods) industry
  • Experience in the Research industry

  • Design, develop and operate modern solutions on AWS.
  • Build and support backend, integration and web applications.
  • Develop cloud infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code and automation.
  • Design and maintain CI/CD pipelines and deployment processes.
  • Build and integrate services using technologies such as API Gateway, AppSync, Lambda, ECS and SQS.
  • Develop modern front-end applications using React and contemporary web technologies.
  • Implement monitoring, observability, alerting and operational support practices.
  • Diagnose complex technical issues and contribute to the ongoing evolution of University technology platforms.
  • Provide technical leadership, mentor engineers and promote effective software engineering and DevOps practices.
  • Work closely with stakeholders and delivery teams to understand problems, develop practical solutions and achieve delivery outcomes.

About you

You’re a senior software engineer who enjoys solving complex problems and working across development, cloud and operations. You will also have experience leading and managing a small technical team, including mentoring and developing engineers

You’ll bring strong experience in AWS, software engineering and DevOps, along with the ability to take ownership of solutions from design through to deployment and ongoing support.

Experience with Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD, cloud-native development, integration services and modern web development will be valuable.

We’re not expecting you to be an expert in every technology listed — if you bring strong experience across most of these areas and the ability to learn and adapt, we’d like to hear from you.

You’ll also have:

  • Strong software engineering skills across backend, integration and web applications.
  • Experience designing, building and operating solutions in AWS or a comparable cloud environment.
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code, such as CDK, CloudFormation, SAM or Terraform.
  • Experience implementing CI/CD pipelines, deployment automation and DevOps practices.
  • Experience with cloud services such as API Gateway, AppSync, Lambda, ECS and SQS, or comparable technologies.
  • Experience with monitoring, observability, alerting and operational support.
  • Front-end development experience using React and modern web technologies.
  • The ability to provide technical leadership, mentor engineers and contribute to delivery outcomes.
  • Strong problem-solving, communication and stakeholder engagement skills.

It would be great if you also have

  • Experience with serverless and event-driven architectures.
  • Experience in platform engineering and developer enablement.
  • AWS certifications or equivalent cloud qualifications

description:

Job Overview

Join Cargill as an Operations Technician and help keep our production processes running safely, efficiently, and reliably. In this hands‑on role, you’ll operate and support chemical, mechanical, and thermal processes, troubleshoot equipment issues, and contribute to continuous improvement across multiple areas of the facility. What You Will Do

• Operate equipment and chemical, mechanical, or thermal processes across assigned production areas, including rotation or backfill support.
• Monitor and adjust production processes using computer systems to meet quality and specification requirements.
• Perform preventative and autonomous maintenance and troubleshoot equipment issues using hand, power, and basic electrical tools.
• Record production data, manage inventory, and load or unload materials using mobile equipment.
• Work with peers and management to support continuous improvement and follow standard operating procedures.
• Follow all safety and regulatory policies while maintaining a clean, safe work environment and coordinating with connected process areas.
• Willing to work overtime, weekends, holidays, or variable shifts with advance notice.

• Able to work rotating shifts

What Will Put You Ahead

• Experience working in a production, chemical, or manufacturing environment.
• Experience operating industrial or mobile equipment (e.g., forklifts, loaders).
• Familiarity with maintenance practices or troubleshooting mechanical/electrical systems.
• Experience using computerized production, quality, or inventory systems.

description:
INFINISOURCE CONSULTING SOLUTIONS (ICS)

InfiniSource Consulting Solutions (ICS), a 150+ employee government contractor specializing in Management Consulting, Information Technology, and Professional Services to the federal government. We tailor our services to meet the specific needs of our civilian, defense, and private-industry sponsor. Our corporate support processes are ISO 9001 certified, giving our customers the confidence that we are continually measuring and improving upon the support we provide and are committed to the highest level of customer satisfaction.


JOB TITLE: Education Technician/Instructor


CLIENT: U.S. Air Force Eaker Center


SUMMARY:

The Associate of Applied Science Degree in Air Force Leadership and Management’s Studies also known as the Air Force Civilian Associate Degree Program’s (CADP) focus is to provide foundational leadership, management, behavioral and air power development for Air Force civilians. Ira C. Eaker Center for Leadership Development administers the CADP program through the Civilian Leadership Development School (CLDS) based upon its mission of providing civilian undergraduate and professional continuing education and workforce development integrated with the Total Force.


ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

To perform this job successfully, the Education Technician/Instructor will act primarily as an Academic Advisor and must be able to perform each of the essential duties and responsibilities listed in a satisfactory manner:

  • Create and execute education support project plans, following a project delivery approach for work.
  • Provide academic advising to students within the CADP.
  • Assist students to complete and/or update advising sheets (also understood as degree plans) based on established, approved list of courses and CLEP/DSST exams and/or understanding of accreditation requirements and subject matter requirements to complete CADP requirements based upon AU Registrar standards.
  • Work with students to identify a list of CADP approved CLEP/DSST exams that will complete each general education and elective requirement. Explore topics with students to help guide student decision on which choice may be best for them.
  • Provide information to students and help students update advising sheet (also known as CADP degree plan).
  • Document each individual student advising in advising/counseling notes using established CADP/AU systems.
  • Track all student advising sheets.
  • Update AU/CADP student record, Air Force Virtual Education Center (AFVEC) and all other associated CADP/AU systems, as appropriate, each time advising sheet is updated.
  • Identify any students missing an advising sheet by the end of SOAR and assist students in completing an advising sheet based upon their individual academic strengths or challenges and previous transfer credits.
  • Use internal CADP spreadsheet and systems as well as AU and AU Registrar systems to track raw data, final products, and completion or other metrics as appropriate.
  • Develop draft transfer credit packages, per CADP and AU Registrar format, for students based upon student advising sheet, transcripts, student transfer request form, list of approved transfer courses and exams.
  • Provide completed draft to the government for review/approval.
  • Coordinate flow of student transfer credit packages for acceptance of credit by AU Registrar.
  • Support student success in credit by exam testing to complete Foundational Studies requirements.
  • Discuss with students the general education and elective requirements for CADP.
  • Interact with students via phone, email or collaboration platform, varying as best supports each student’s comprehension of materials.
  • Be knowledgeable about AF CivTA process and CLEP/DSST process, including registration and study resources available for free or through Air Force-paid sources and advise students on these processes and resources.
  • Be knowledgeable about systems used by CADP students to request AF civTA, such as Air Force Automated Education Management System (AFAEMS) and AFVEC. Maintain an AFAEMS account, once coordinated by the government, by which students advising sheets will be updated.
  • Be knowledgeable about CLEP and Prometrics (DSST) sites in terms of where information on various credits by exams will be found.
  • Understand the exam registration process for each company and be able to walk students through the process using already developed guides.
  • Update existing credit by exam registration how-to guides and/or create new ones as website information and/or exam companies and/or their information changes.
  • Develop/update basic guides or study sheets on AF CivTA and CLEP/DSST for students by collating existing information currently found in various government and non-government resources, providing a one-stop center of info for students.
  • Track and support ongoing student success in the Foundational Studies segment.
  • Make routine contact (via phone and email) with students, ensuring students are on track to complete degree requirements by projected graduation date (determined based upon student entry into program).
  • Update AFVEC and other AU/CADP records/systems showing completion of each degree requirement for each student (either CLEP/DSST, transfer course, or AU-delivered course).
  • Track student progress toward foundational studies completion.
  • Track whether each student is making satisfactory progress per CADP schedule, to complete requirements so students can graduate on time.
  • Contact and advise students who are not on track for completion of their degree according to the CADP schedule.
  • Provide inputs regarding current status of student completion of CADP degree requirements to appropriate CADP/AU spreadsheets, reports and/or systems as necessary.
  • Provide weekly data to metrics update for CADP team by Cohort #.
  • Provide other data monthly or by term, as needed to maintain oversight of status of each Cohort active within CADP.
  • Develop adhoc metrics report as necessary.
  • Elevate unclear policy or challenging/unusual issues to government.
  • Support graduation/degree completion identification.
  • Advise students to help ensure they make satisfactory progress by CADP standards for graduation date associated with their cohort #.
  • Provide government, a minimum of once per term, a list and overall count of all students not on track for graduation and counsel said students.
  • Review transcripts and course credits for all students identified as ready/on track for graduation beginning 3 months prior to graduation.
  • Provide metrics/status report as required to provide overview of situation.
  • Be knowledgeable on general CADP policies and procedures to field basic student questions during the course of interaction with students.
  • Be aware of various educational resources available to CADP students and refer students to resources as necessary/applicable.
  • Follow all applicable federal, AETC, AU, Eaker, CLDS and CADP regulations and policy regarding protection of student rights and privacy of information.
  • Understand the requirement of protection of sensitive and/or private student information and maintain student confidentiality of information and records.
  • Instruct students in CADP courses designed to prepare students for understanding and completing CADP Foundational Studies segment (General Education and Elective requirements) as well as providing a broad overview of CADP processes (to include academic advising, civTA, and general academic and study skills).
  • Teach seminars using conference lines for audio, and government provided live webinar service using a web cam and employing the chat function.
  • Review student work in discussion boards and provide them feedback.
  • Review student progress in exercises, quizzes, and other interactive activities for participation.
  • Attend Academic Instructor Course and other identified CADP specific instructor training to meet AETC and/or local requirements for instructors.

This is a senior, client-facing role focused on helping private equity investors and technology businesses create value through technology. You will lead complex engagements spanning technology strategy, due diligence, transformation, cybersecurity, AI, and operational execution. The role combines deep technical expertise with commercial thinking, requiring you to translate complex findings into clear, decision-useful recommendations. You will work directly with senior investors, boards, and management teams, building trusted relationships and guiding critical decisions. Alongside leading multidisciplinary teams, you will develop a recognised functional specialism and contribute to broader technology value-creation initiatives. The environment is collaborative, entrepreneurial, and driven by curiosity, credibility, creativity, commitment, and a strong focus on client service.

Accountabilities

  • Independently lead complex client engagements from initial scoping through high-quality delivery, balancing project management, team leadership, client service, and commercial considerations.
  • Build trusted relationships with senior investors, boards, and management teams by applying sound judgment, communicating clearly, and making complex technology topics accessible.
  • Lead technical due diligence and technology-focused engagements, identifying material risks, opportunities, and priorities for post-deal value creation.
  • Assess areas including technology strategy, product and engineering capabilities, architecture, cloud platforms, delivery performance, data and AI, cybersecurity, scalability, technical debt, and operating models.
  • Translate technical findings into commercial implications related to growth, customer outcomes, margins, investment risk, timing, capital requirements, and value creation.
  • Produce concise reports, executive presentations, and workshops that connect analysis to the decisions clients need to make.
  • Develop a recognised functional specialism while maintaining sufficient breadth to lead integrated discussions and direct multidisciplinary teams.
  • Contribute to commercial diligence, investment thesis development, and value-creation engagements where technology plays a central role.
  • Strengthen client relationships, support repeat business and proposition development, and mentor colleagues as the practice grows.

    • Requirements

    • 10+ years of relevant experience in technology consulting, technology due diligence, technology strategy, digital transformation, or technology leadership.
    • Demonstrated experience leading client-facing workstreams or engagements, managing senior stakeholders, and delivering high-quality, decision-ready outputs.
    • Strong technology fundamentals with demonstrable expertise in at least one area such as product and engineering, software architecture and cloud, data and AI, cybersecurity, software delivery, or technology operating models.
    • Significant experience within a business domain such as insurance, capital markets, healthcare, logistics, or supply chain.
    • Ability to move confidently between technical detail and business-level discussions, identifying the issues that materially affect clients and investment cases.
    • Experience with private equity, transaction advisory, corporate development, or high-growth technology businesses is strongly preferred.
    • Excellent structured thinking, written communication, presentation, and storytelling skills, with the ability to turn complex analysis into clear and compelling narratives.
    • Collaborative, action-oriented approach, with the confidence to challenge constructively and the curiosity to expand beyond an initial area of expertise.
    • Entrepreneurial mindset, commercial awareness, and enthusiasm for building client relationships, leading teams, and contributing to broader technology value-creation initiatives.

      • Benefits

      • Opportunity to lead high-impact engagements with private equity investors and technology businesses.
      • Exposure to complex, strategic technology challenges spanning due diligence, transformation, growth, cybersecurity, AI, and operational execution.
      • Senior-level interaction with investors, boards, and executive management teams.
      • Opportunity to develop and establish a recognised functional technology specialism.
      • Collaborative environment combining practitioner expertise, proven frameworks, technology-enabled solutions, and objective data.

      • Entrepreneurial environment that values service, curiosity, credibility, commitment, and creativity.

title: Vi søger socialpædagoger til nyt akut Retspsykiatrisk Sengeafsnit R2 på Aarhus Universitetshospital i Skejby
description:
Den 1. april 2027 åbner vi Retspsykiatrisk Sengeafsnit R2 – et helt nyt akut retspsykiatrisk Sengeafsnit.

Derfor søger vi socialpædagoger, som ikke alene har lyst til et nyt job, men som også har lyst til at være med til at skabe en ny arbejdsplads.

Som en af de første medarbejdere på R2 får du mulighed for at præge afsnittets kultur, arbejdsgange og pædagogiske praksis. Sammen skal vi opbygge et højt specialiseret behandlingsmiljø, hvor pædagogik, relationer, struktur, udvikling og sikkerhed går hånd i hånd.

Som socialpædagog bidrager du med et selvstændigt fagligt perspektiv. Du skal ikke være sundhedsfaglig – du skal være stærk i din pædagogiske faglighed og kunne omsætte den til arbejdet med mennesker med komplekse psykiske, sociale og funktionelle problemstillinger.

Du behøver ikke have erfaring fra retspsykiatrien. Det vigtigste er, at du er fagligt nysgerrig, kan skabe professionelle relationer og har lyst til at arbejde i et miljø, hvor pædagogisk faglighed er en vigtig del af den samlede behandling.

Et nyt akut retspsykiatrisk afsnit

R2 bliver det ene af Retspsykiatrisk Afdelings to akutte udrednings- og behandlingsafsnit og placeres i bygning L i Skejby på samme etage som det eksisterende akutte Sengeafsnit R1.

Afsnittet skal blandt andet varetage:

  • Udredning og behandling af varetægtssurrogatanbragte patienter
  • Patienter i varetægt, som ikke er omfattet af brev- og besøgskontrol
  • Behandling og stabilisering af særligt udfordrende og komplekse patienter efter aftale med almenpsykiatrien

På R2 bliver du en del af et højt specialiseret tværfagligt miljø.

Som socialpædagog får du en central rolle i arbejdet med patienternes hverdagsliv, struktur, relationer, aktiviteter, mestring og udvikling.

Du skal være med til at skabe R2

Når man åbner et nyt sengeafsnit, er ikke alt givet på forhånd.

Det ser vi som en mulighed.

Som medarbejder på R2 får du reel mulighed for at bidrage til udviklingen af afsnittets kultur, arbejdsgange og pædagogiske tilgang.

Vi ønsker at skabe en arbejdsplads præget af høj faglighed, tydelighed, nysgerrighed, refleksion og et stærkt tværfagligt fællesskab.

Her skal forskellige fagligheder ikke ligne hinanden.

Tværtimod.

Vi ønsker, at sygeplejersker, social- og sundhedsassistenter, socialpædagoger og øvrige faggrupper bidrager med hver deres professionelle perspektiv.

Som socialpædagog skal du derfor kunne stå tydeligt i din egen faglighed og samtidig være nysgerrig på, hvordan den bringes i spil sammen med andre faggrupper.

Din pædagogiske rolle på R2

Som socialpædagog vil du blandt andet:

  • Være kontaktperson for 2-3 patienter og indgå i et fast tværfagligt team omkring den enkelte patient
  • Planlægge, gennemføre og evaluere pædagogiske og miljøterapeutiske indsatser med udgangspunkt i patientens ressourcer, behov og mål
  • Arbejde målrettet med struktur, forudsigelighed og sammenhæng i patienternes hverdag
  • Opbygge og vedligeholde professionelle relationer, der understøtter udvikling, mestring og recovery
  • Anvende aktiviteter, samvær og hverdagens situationer som aktive pædagogiske redskaber
  • Arbejde med motivation, deltagelse og patientens mulighed for gradvist at tage mere ansvar for eget hverdagsliv
  • Bidrage med systematiske observationer af patientens trivsel, adfærd, sociale funktion og funktionsniveau
  • Dokumentere dine observationer og pædagogiske indsatser og bidrage til behandlingsplaner i tæt samarbejde med det tværfaglige team
  • Reflektere over, justere og evaluere den pædagogiske og miljøterapeutiske indsats
  • Bidrage aktivt til udviklingen af R2's pædagogiske praksis, kultur og tværfaglige samarbejde
  • Indgå i afdelingens sikkerhedsberedskab og tage del i alarmløb til de øvrige retspsykiatriske afsnit
  • Bidrage aktivt til et positivt uddannelsesmiljø og fungere som daglig vejleder for blandt andet pædagogstuderende

Din pædagogiske faglighed er særlig vigtig i de mange situationer, der ligger mellem de formelle behandlingsaktiviteter.

Det kan være i måltidet, gåturen, aktiviteten, samtalen, konflikten eller den stille stund i fællesmiljøet.

Her er din evne til at observere, skabe struktur, danne relationer, motivere og arbejde udviklingsorienteret en væsentlig del af behandlingsmiljøet.

Pædagogik i en retspsykiatrisk kontekst

Retspsykiatrien stiller særlige krav til det pædagogiske arbejde. Relationen er vigtig, men relationen skal altid være professionel.

Du skal kunne være nærværende og samtidig tydelig. Du skal kunne arbejde med motivation uden at overtage ansvaret. Og du skal kunne skabe struktur og forudsigelighed uden at miste blik for det enkelte menneske.

Vi arbejder med patienter, hvor psykisk sygdom, sociale problemstillinger, kognitive vanskeligheder og komplekse livsforløb kan påvirke deres mulighed for at mestre hverdagen.

Her kan din pædagogiske faglighed gøre en konkret forskel.

Det kan eksempelvis være gennem:

  • relations pædagogik
  • miljøterapeutisk arbejde
  • struktur og visualisering
  • motivationsarbejde
  • recovery-orienteret praksis
  • rehabilitering
  • social træning
  • aktivitet og deltagelse
  • deeskalering
  • professionel grænsesætning
  • refleksion over adfærd, funktion og samspil

Vi lægger ikke vægt på, at du allerede behersker alle områder. Vi lægger vægt på, at du kan bringe din pædagogiske grundfaglighed aktivt i spil og har lyst til at udvikle den i en retspsykiatrisk kontekst.

Du behøver ikke kende retspsykiatrien på forhånd

Retspsykiatrien er et specialiseret område. Derfor prioriterer vi din introduktion højt.

Du får et grundigt introduktionsforløb samt kompetenceudvikling inden for blandt andet retspsykiatri, deeskalering og Fundamentals of Care.

Fundamentals of Care er afdelingens fælles referenceramme for pleje og behandling. Som socialpædagog forventes du ikke at være sundhedsfagligt uddannet, men du vil blive introduceret til rammen og til, hvordan din pædagogiske faglighed indgår i den samlede tværfaglige indsats.

Hvis du starter inden 1. marts 2027, starter du på et af Retspsykiatrisk Afdelings eksisterende sengeafsnit. Her får du mulighed for at lære specialet, patientgruppen, behandlingen, sikkerheden og hverdagen i specialet at kende.

Fra 1. marts 2027 bliver introduktionen målrettet arbejdet på et akut retspsykiatrisk sengeafsnit, inden vi sammen åbner dørene til R2 den 1. april 2027.

Hvem er du?

Vi søger dig, der:

  • Er uddannet socialpædagog
  • Har en tydelig pædagogisk faglig identitet og kan argumentere fagligt for dine observationer og indsatser
  • Har interesse for relations arbejde, miljøterapi, recovery og rehabilitering
  • Kan arbejde målrettet med struktur, motivation og udvikling i patientens hverdag
  • Er ansvarsbevidst, fagligt nysgerrig og selvreflekterende
  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og samtidig trives i et tæt tværfagligt samarbejde
  • Kan skabe professionelle relationer og samtidig sætte tydelige og respektfulde grænser
  • Kommunikerer tydeligt og konstruktivt
  • Har interesse for sikkerhedsorienteret arbejde
  • Kan bevare ro, overblik og faglig refleksion i komplekse situationer
  • Ønsker løbende faglig udvikling
  • Har lyst til aktivt at bidrage til udviklingen af et helt nyt akut Sengeafsnit

Husk at vedhæfte dokumentation for din pædagoguddannelse, når du søger.

Har du særlige pædagogiske kompetencer?

Når vi etablerer et helt nyt afsnit, skal vi samtidig opbygge en række faglige nøglefunktioner og kompetenceområder.

Har du særlig erfaring med eksempelvis:

  • Miljøterapi
  • Recovery og rehabilitering
  • Neuropædagogik
  • Kognitive eller strukturerende pædagogiske metoder
  • Deeskalering
  • Aktivitet og beskæftigelse
  • Misbrugsproblematikker
  • Social færdighedstræning
  • Vejledning af studerende
  • Kvalitet og faglig udvikling

vil vi meget gerne høre om det i din ansøgning, men det er ikke et krav for at søge stillingen.

Vi er interesserede i forskellige pædagogiske profiler og i, hvad netop du kan bidrage med til det kommende R2.

Har du lyst til på sigt at varetage en særlig faglig funktion, hører vi også gerne om det.

Hvad tilbyder vi?

Hos os får du:

  • En unik mulighed for at være med til at etablere et helt nyt akut retspsykiatrisk Sengeafsnit
  • Reel mulighed for at præge afsnittets pædagogiske praksis, kultur og arbejdsgange fra begyndelsen
  • Et fagligt miljø, hvor din pædagogiske uddannelse og dit perspektiv har en selvstændig værdi
  • Grundigt introduktionsforløb og mentorordning
  • Kompetenceudvikling inden for retspsykiatri, deeskalering og miljøterapi
  • Et højt specialiseret og tværfagligt arbejdsmiljø
  • Supervision og refleksionsfora
  • Gode muligheder for faglig udvikling
  • 3-4 årlige kompetencedage
  • Mulighed for indflydelse på egen vagtplan under hensyntagen til driften

Vi arbejder målrettet med sikkerhed og ser et højt sikkerhedsniveau som en forudsætning for, at det pædagogiske og behandlingsmæssige arbejde kan udfolde sig i et trygt miljø for både patienter og medarbejdere.

Praktisk om stillingen

Stillingen er som udgangspunkt på 37 timer ugentligt eller efter aftale.

Stillingen indebærer blandede vagter, hvor 2-holdsskifte tilstræbes, og du har mulighed for at få indflydelse på egen vagtplan under hensyntagen til driften.

Ansættelse senest 1. marts, men der er mulighed for at starte hurtigst muligt.

Ved tiltrædelse før 1. marts 2027 vil du indgå i et af Retspsykiatrisk Afdelings eksisterende afsnit frem til 1. marts 2027, hvor den målrettede introduktion til arbejdet i det akutte retspsykiatriske sengeafsnit påbegyndes. Afsnittet R2 åbner 1. april 2027.

Der indkaldes løbende til samtaler.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du meget velkommen til at kontakte:

Oversygeplejerske på nuværende R2, Yasmine Hassan
yasmhass@rm.dk / +45 7847 2550

Om Retspsykiatrisk Afdeling

Med afsæt i Region Midtjyllands værdier er vores ambition at skabe en åben og respektfuld dialog med patienter, pårørende, samarbejdspartnere og medarbejdere.

Vi stræber efter høj faglig kvalitet og en kultur, der fremmer udvikling, læring og tværfagligt samarbejde.

På Retspsykiatrisk Afdeling arbejder vi ud fra Fundamentals of Care som en fælles referenceramme for pleje og behandling.

I det tværfaglige samarbejde bidrager de enkelte professioner med forskellige faglige perspektiver. For socialpædagogen er det særligt den pædagogiske forståelse af relationer, hverdagsliv, funktion, struktur, aktivitet, mestring og udvikling, der bringes ind i den samlede behandling.

Vi tror på, at stærke professionelle relationer, tydelige fagligheder og et tæt tværfagligt samarbejde skaber de bedste forudsætninger for gode patientforløb – også i en retspsykiatrisk kontekst, hvor sikkerhed er en integreret del af behandlingen.

Har du lyst til at være med fra begyndelsen?

Så glæder vi os til at modtage din ansøgning og høre, hvilken pædagogisk faglighed du kan bringe med ind i det kommende R2.

I Psykiatrien i Region Midtjylland prioriterer vi både, at vores medarbejdere føler sig trygge i deres opstart og løbende udvikler deres kompetencer. Derfor har vi skræddersyet vores eget uddannelsesunivers – Psykiatriakademiet.
Her kan du finde introduktions- og onboardingforløb for din faggruppe og blive inspireret til det næste skridt i din karriere.

Læs mere om vores mange muligheder på Psykiatriakademiets hjemmeside: Klik her for at se hjemmesiden

Stillingen er som udgangspunkt en fuldtidsstilling.

Da Region Midtjylland løbende gennemfører besparelser og omorganiseringer, vil medarbejdere i omplacering, der søger stillingen, have fortrinsret.

title: Business Process Re-engineering Specialist
description:
Information Technology Strategies, Inc. is a government IT solutions provider servicing commercial and government initiative in various parts of the United States. We are currently seeking a Business Process Re-Engineering Specialist to work for our company.

Summary:

Client Agency is Defense Logistics Agency. Candidate will provide facilitation, training, methodology development and evaluation, process reengineering across all phases, identifying best practices, change management, business management techniques, organizational development, activity and data modeling, or information system development methods and practices, and supervision of business process reengineering. Will apply process improvement and reengineering methodologies and principles to conduct process modernization projects. Will be responsible for data modeling, developing modern business methods, identifying best practices, and creating and assessing performance measurements. Will create process change by integrating new processes with existing ones and communicating these changes to impacted Business Systems teams. Will work cross-functionally with development and functional teams to engineer process maps for different business units within the organization. Will work directly with Project Management to track risks, monitor issues and manage all project-critical milestones and tasks. Will leverage various technologies to engineer end-to-end process maps that capture workstreams and workflows across multiple lines of business. Will analyze business workflows and end-to-end processes to ideate and develop new and modified business processes for enterprise-wide applications. Will recommend and facilitate quality improvement efforts. Will work with various business units to validate business requirements, technical specifications and front-end systems features and functionalities. Will facilitate and conduct stakeholder interviews to develop project-critical documentation and artifacts.

Requirements:

  • A CURRENT U.S. Government IT-I / IT-II / SECRET Clearance. Sponsorship will not be provided.
  • Must have ServiceNow Certified HR Service Delivery (HR) Implementation Specialist Certification
  • Must have 4+ years’ experience in business process reengineering with demonstrated, increasing responsibilities within this field.
  • Must have 7+ years’ relevant experience.
  • Must have a B.S. or B.A. Degree
  • Must have strong verbal and written communication skills including the ability to create frequent business presentations.
  • Must have previous experience working directly with both process and product owners to define system requirements, data elements, business rules and User Acceptance criteria for front-end system functionalities.
  • Must have previous experience analyzing end-to-end process flows to identify risks, waste and opportunities for improvement.
  • Must have previous experience determining scope, planning and writing user stories for front-end system functionalities.
  • Must have excellent persuasion skills.
  • Must be able to effectively communicate verbally and in writing with business and technical personnel at all levels.
  • Must be willing and able to work standard East Coast Hours (EST)

Work With Us

IT-Strat is a technology consulting company that holds various contract vehicles including best in class vehicles. IT-Strat has supported multiple clients including the Department of Homeland Security (DHS), Customs and Border Protection (CBP) and Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE via both prime and meaningful subcontracts). Additionally, IT-Strat has prime contracts with Defense Information Systems Agency (DISA), Defense Logistics Agency (DLA) and many others. We maintain relationships with multiple large businesses.

IT-Strat was established in 2002. We are a certified Woman Owned Small Business. IT-Strat also successfully graduated as an SBA 8(A) company. It was an 8(a) company from 2008 through 2017 and currently still has 8(a) contract vehicles.

  • 401K Retirement Program with company contribution
  • Paid Vacation, Holidays, Sick Leave, Floating Holidays, Bereavement Leave
  • Semi-monthly pay cycle

Information Technology Strategies (“IT-Strat”) is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer, and it is our policy to consider applicants for employment without regard to sex, race, color, creed, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, marital status, age, disability, veteran status, alienage, ancestry, and any other factors prohibited by law. Employment selections are based on company and client requirements and the qualifications and skills of the candidate. IT-Strat is committed to actively capitalizing on the diversity of skills, talents, and perspectives of our employees.

title: Executive Administrator & Project Manager
description:
Our mission: 'To provide comfort and care through life's journey’

Join our team today!

General Summary:

The Executive Administrator & Project Manager serves as a highly trusted extension of the Executive Director’s office with two primary responsibilities: Executive Administration and Executive Project Management. The position provides high-level administrative support to the Executive Director while also accepting projects, priorities, and implementation assignments from the Executive Director and coordinating with leaders and employees across HIA Health to achieve the intended results.

This position is expected to move work forward. When an organizational priority or project is assigned by the Executive Director, the Executive Administrator & Project Manager identifies the appropriate individuals who need to be involved, establishes the work plan and timeline, facilitates communication and decision-making, monitors progress, addresses barriers, and follows the work through implementation and completion. The position provides the Executive Director with a consistent mechanism for ensuring that executive decisions and assigned projects are translated into action and completed.

Essential Functions:

Executive Administration

  • Provide high-level administrative and organizational support to the Executive Director.
  • Manage and organize the Executive Director’s calendar, meetings, deadlines, commitments, correspondence, and priorities.
  • Assist with management and organization of executive email, identifying items requiring response, delegation, follow-up, or Executive Director attention.
  • Maintain an organized system for Executive Director priorities, commitments, decisions, and outstanding items.
  • Anticipate upcoming needs, deadlines, Board requirements, meetings, and organizational commitments.
  • Draft, edit, proofread, format, and finalize executive correspondence, reports, presentations, documents, and other materials.
  • Prepare meeting agendas and materials and attend designated meetings with the Executive Director.
  • Document decisions, assignments, responsible individuals, and expected completion dates.
  • Maintain confidentiality and exercise sound judgment regarding sensitive organizational, personnel, Board, financial, and operational information.

Board & Governance Support

  • Coordinate administrative support for the Board of Directors and Board committees in partnership with the Executive Director.
  • Prepare and organize Board agendas, Executive Director reports, presentations, supporting documents, and Board packets.
  • Coordinate collection of required materials from organizational leaders.
  • Track Board decisions, requests, commitments, and follow-up items.
  • Assist the Executive Director with preparation for Board meetings, committee meetings, executive sessions, retreats, and other governance activities.
  • Maintain current and organized Board and executive documents.

Executive Project Management

  • Accept projects, implementation priorities, and special assignments directly from the Executive Director and assume responsibility for coordinating the work through completion.
  • Translate Executive Director direction into clear objectives, work plans, timelines, responsibilities, deliverables, and measures of completion.
  • Identify and engage the appropriate leaders, providers, employees, and departments necessary to accomplish the assigned objective.
  • Work directly with responsible individuals to obtain the actions, information, decisions, and results necessary to complete assigned projects.
  • Establish project timelines and expectations and maintain consistent follow-up with responsible individuals until deliverables are completed.
  • Coordinate implementation of Executive Director decisions that require action across one or multiple departments.
  • Facilitate meetings and working sessions necessary to move assigned projects forward.
  • Identify barriers, competing priorities, unresolved decisions, or missed deadlines and work with responsible leaders to resolve them.
  • Escalate significant barriers, unresolved issues, or lack of progress to the Executive Director when appropriate.
  • Verify that implementation has occurred rather than considering a project complete solely because a recommendation, plan, or meeting has occurred.
  • Provide the Executive Director with concise progress updates, outstanding decisions, barriers, and completed results.
  • Maintain a centralized tracking system for Executive Director projects and assignments.

Executive Communication & Work Product

  • Take concepts, notes, drafts, reports, and other work developed by the Executive Director and prepare them for professional presentation and distribution.
  • Draft and prepare communications on behalf of the Executive Director.
  • Review executive documents for accuracy, clarity, consistency, tone, and presentation.
  • Prepare reports, presentations, Board materials, meeting materials, and organizational communications.
  • Maintain organized electronic files, project records, and current versions of Executive Director and Board documents.

Benefits:

We offer a robust benefits package for qualifying full-time and part-time employees. Depending on eligibility, a variety of benefits include health insurance, dental insurance, vision insurance, life insurance, a 401(k) retirement plan, short-term and long-term disability, and a generous time off package.

We have a Drug Free Workplace Policy. An accepted offer will require a drug screen and pre-employment background screening as a condition of employment.

Pay Range: Starting at $36.00/hour (based on experience)

Expectations of all Employees
Support the mission, vision and values through unequaled quality patient care, professional competence, collaboration, communication, innovation, accountability, ownership and provide support to the entire agency regardless of their primary office location.

HIA Health has HEART
Honor - Accepting the honor of service to hospice patients, families, and communities.
Excellence - Striving for excellence in my work, as we stand on hallowed ground.
Attitude - Choosing a positive attitude at work.
Respect - Training people with the same respect I wish to be given.
Teamwork - Valuing everyone’s contribution in delivery of care, operation of the organization and stewardship of our resources.

title: Heritage Data and Assurance Officer
company: NSW Department of Climate Change, Energy, the Environment and Water
description:
Do you want your work to make a difference for NSW?

Working to protect the state’s environment and heritage.

  • Turn complex heritage data into meaningful insights that strengthen the protection and management of NSW’s heritage
  • Temporary full-time opportunity till 31 Oct 2028
  • Office location: Parramatta, hybrid working supported
  • Salary relative to experience, and ranges from $112,375 to $124,158 + super

Heritage NSW works with communities to protect, celebrate and manage our incredible heritage across NSW. If you are keen to be a part of a high performing, multi-disciplinary team that helps conserve and protect the Aboriginal, built and archaeological heritage of NSW, then this is the job for you!

We are seeking a skilled and detail-oriented Heritage Data and Assurance Officer to join Heritage NSW within Department of Climate Change, Energy, the Environment and Water. In this temporary role, you will play a key part in supporting the delivery of heritage programs by improving the quality, consistency and integrity of heritage data across NSW Government agencies.

The role is responsible for analysing heritage and conservation register data, identifying data quality issues, supporting compliance with Section 170 heritage reporting requirements, and providing insights that inform heritage listing and conservation priorities. Working closely with government agencies and internal stakeholders, you will help strengthen reporting frameworks, improve data governance practices, and contribute to heritage reform initiatives.

To be successful, you will bring strong data analysis and problem-solving skills, the ability to manage competing priorities, and experience working with complex or incomplete datasets. Knowledge of heritage registers, asset management, Section 170 programs, or similar regulatory and reporting frameworks will be highly regarded.

This role would suit someone who enjoys turning data into meaningful insights, collaborating with a broad range of stakeholders, and contributing to the protection and management of NSW's heritage assets.

About You

You are a highly organised and analytical professional with experience working with complex datasets and a passion for maintaining data quality, accuracy and integrity. You enjoy investigating issues, identifying trends and translating data into meaningful insights that support informed decision-making.

You have strong problem-solving skills and can confidently manage multiple priorities while delivering high-quality outcomes within tight timeframes. You are comfortable working with incomplete or inconsistent information, applying sound judgement and attention to detail to ensure reporting is accurate and reliable.

A collaborative communicator, you build positive working relationships with a range of stakeholders and can clearly explain complex information to diverse audiences. You take a proactive approach to engaging with others to improve data quality, resolve issues and drive continuous improvement.

Ideally, you will bring experience in data analysis, data assurance, reporting, information management or a related field, along with an understanding of heritage registers, heritage asset management, Section 170 requirements or similar compliance and reporting frameworks. Relevant tertiary qualifications in data analysis, data assurance, data management, or equivalent experience are essential. Most importantly, you are motivated by contributing to meaningful outcomes and are excited by the opportunity to support the protection, management and recognition of NSW's heritage assets for future generations.

Essential Requirements

  • Tertiary qualifications in Data Analysis, Data Assurance, Data Management and/or equivalent demonstrated experience.

For more information read the full Role Description: Heritage Data and Assurance Officer

Who we are

The Department of Climate Change, Energy, the Environment and Water (DCCEEW) works to protect the state’s environment and heritage. It leads the way on climate change, driving the sustainable transition to a net zero economy, powered by affordable, reliable, and clean energy.

DCCEEW conserves and protects the state’s natural environment. It manages the NSW national park estate, including its rich and diverse biodiversity and Aboriginal cultural heritage for future generations.

DCCEEW also ensures sustainable management of water resources across the state, to support the environment, communities and industry.

We acknowledge the ongoing custodial responsibilities of the Aboriginal peoples of NSW to care for Country and water and are committed to establishing meaningful partnerships with Aboriginal peoples in the management of the environment.

To Apply

If excited by the information above, we look forward to receiving your application, including a copy of your resume and cover letter expressing your interest and suitability for the role.

Please note to be eligible to apply for this position you must be an Australian or New Zealand citizen or permanent resident, or hold a valid Australian working Visa for the duration of the appointment.

Applications close Sunday 11th October 2026 at 11:55PM.

Should you require further information about the role please contact Michael Ellis via Michael.Ellis@environment.nsw.gov.au or on 02 8275 1968

A recruitment pool may be created for ongoing and temporary opportunities of the same role or role type that may become available over the next 18 months.

Our goal is to build a workforce that not only represents but also understands and serves the diverse communities of New South Wales. We are committed to making our state a vibrant and inclusive place to live, work, and thrive for everyone. Our workforce represents people of all ages and genders, Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people, people with disabilities, the LGBTQI+ community, and people from diverse ethnic and cultural backgrounds.

Looking for more information or assistance in applying?

  • Our commitment to a diverse and inclusive workplace.
  • How we encourage and support people with disability
  • Information and adjustments for individual needs for the recruitment process and the workplace.

If you require an adjustment for your application process, please contact our Talent Acquisition Team by emailing dcceew.ta@dpie.nsw.gov.au or contacting Lila Snow on 02 9995 5095 (please mention reference number 552874).

If you are an Aboriginal or Torres Strait Islander use our Aboriginal applicants guide to assist with applying for roles or our Aboriginal Career pathways team at AEX@dcceew.nsw.gov.au for a yarn.

title: Forretningsspecialist til udvikling af landets vigtigste digitale systemer
description:
Vil du være med til at sikre udvikling af digitale løsninger, der udbetaler ydelser til borgere hver måned? Og trives du i en rolle, hvor du bygger bro og skaber løsninger i samspil med en lang række interessenter? Så er det dig, vi søger.

Som forretningsspecialist hos os hjælper du med at optimere nogle af landets vigtigste digitale systemer, der hver måned udbetaler ydelser som bl.a. boligstøtte og pension. Det er samtidig nogle af de mest komplekse systemer, der med garanti leverer faglige udfordringer, som du ikke finder andre steder.

Vi er på udkig efter dig, der kan drive videreudviklingen af vores system og agere bindeled, når du fx indhenter oplysninger fra kunderådgivere og borgeren på den ene side, og udvikleren, der programmerer løsningen, på den anden.

Dine opgaver:
Konkret bliver det dig, der:

  • udarbejder kravspecifikationer til leverandører, hvor du tager afsæt i udviklingen i lovgivningen og analyser af nuværende og fremtidige forretnings- og kundebehov
  • driver mindre projektopgaver og indgår i større projekter – det kunne fx være i forbindelse med Boligstøtteloftet eller Aldersopsparing, samt andre kundeforbedrende tiltag
  • kan indgå i driftsarbejdet, hvor du analyserer og prioriterer fejl, fx systemfejl, datafejl og fejl i slutprodukter
  • agerer vidensbank, når du som specialisten leverer input til en bred pallette af interessenter, herunder kundeservice, leverandører og jurister

Hør en håndfuld af dine kommende kolleger fortælle om jobbet som forretningsspecialist i ATP:

Hvem er du?
Vi forestiller os, at du har en relevant videregående uddannelse og erfaring fra en rolle, hvor du har arbejdet med forretningsudvikling, drift eller digitale løsninger. Men der kan være flere veje ind i jobbet.

Det vigtigste er, at du:

  • kan sætte dig ind i komplekse systemer og opbygge en dyb forståelse for, hvordan forretning, processer, data og teknologi hænger sammen
  • kan omsætte forretningsbehov, lovgivning og faglige krav til konkrete løsningsbeskrivelser og krav til udviklere og leverandører - og at du kan udfordre leverandører, når det er nødvendigt
  • trives med at dykke ned i detaljer, når du skal analysere fejl, kortlægge processer eller forstå, hvordan data bevæger sig gennem systemerne
  • kan skabe overblik over komplekse problemstillinger og navigere mellem forskellige hensyn, interessenter og løsninger
  • formidler tekniske og faglige sammenhænge på en måde, der giver mening for både jurister, systemejere, kunderådgivere og andre samarbejdspartnere
  • tager ansvar for at drive opgaver fremad og opsøger selv den viden, du har brug for, når du møder nye problemstillinger, som du finder en løsning på - også selvom det kræver en smule vedholdenhed

Hvem er vi?
Vi er en del af Digital Solutions. Vi spiller en afgørende rolle i digitaliseringen af det danske samfund, fordi vi står bag de systemer, der får to ud af tre velfærdskroner ud til borgerne i Danmark. Vi råder over landets mest interessante datagrundlag og et unikt fagligt fællesskab med mere end 500 IT-, data- og digitaliseringsspecialister, der blandt andet jonglerer med kode, algoritmer og AI.

I teamet er vi 13 forretningsspecialister, der hver især er en del af udviklingen af forskellige områder på tværs af ATP. Vi arbejder tæt sammen om at skabe stabile og brugervenlige løsninger. Vi sparrer med hinanden om komplekse problemstillinger og deler viden på tværs af fagligheder.

Vi udvikler systemerne, sikrer den daglige drift og står bag forbedringer, som øger effektiviteten og automatiseringsgraden og i sidste ende gør hverdagen bedre for kunderådgivere og borgere.

Hos os får du dine egne ansvarsområder, men du står aldrig alene. Vi hjælper hinanden med at finde løsninger, kvalitetssikre leverancer og udvikle vores arbejdsgange.

Sådan ansøger du
Send os dit CV og en kort motivation for at søge stillingen senest søndag den 18. oktober

I ATP arbejder vi for en fair rekrutteringsproces, og derfor beder vi dig om ikke at vedhæfte billede i dit CV eller angive din alder, når du søger.

Vi ansætter på baggrund af kompetencer og potentiale og opfordrer alle til at søge stillingen – uanset køn og kønsidentitet, etnicitet, national, social og kulturel baggrund, religion eller tro, seksuel orientering, funktionsnedsættelse og alder.

title: Tekniker till Gotland
description:
1 plats(er).

Vill du göra samhällsnytta och bidra till Sveriges oberoende i världen? FRA söker nu en initiativtagande tekniker till ett varierande jobb med ansvar för den lokala IT- och radiomiljön på Gotland. På FRA är varje arbetsuppgift en del av något större. Är du den vi söker kan vi erbjuda ett varierande arbete i en kunskapsintensiv miljö där du får vara med och göra skillnad varje dag.

Ditt uppdrag

I rollen som tekniker tillhör du avdelningen för teknik. Avdelningen har till uppgift att förse FRA med de tekniska system som behövs för verksamheten. Avdelningen utvecklar, förvaltar och driftsätter nya tekniska system samt sköter drift och underhåll av befintliga system. Tjänsten som tekniker är bred och din vardag kommer vara väldigt varierande. Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter består framförallt av:

· Drift & underhåll – Ansvara för drift, underhåll och installation av hårdvara i olika miljöer samt mjukvara (servrar, switchar, brandväggar, klientdatorer).

· IT, radio & mätteknik – Utföra arbetsuppgifter inom IT, radio‑ och telekommunikation samt mätteknik – med stor variation och omfattning.

· Kundsupport – Tillhandahålla kundnära support och service, ge daglig användarsupport och hålla kunskapsbasen uppdaterad.

Resor ingår i tjänsten.

Du kan

Vi söker dig som har:

· Teknisk gymnasial utbildning eller kunskaper förvärvade genom relevant arbetslivserfarenhet inom IT/el/tele

· Flera års erfarenhet inom IT/el/tele

· Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska

· B-körkort

Vi ser det som meriterande om du har:

· Teknisk eftergymnasial utbildning

· Kunskaper inom radio-, och antennteknik

· Kunskaper inom Linux och Windows

· Kunskap inom felsökning av IT-system förvärvad genom erfarenhet eller egna initiativ

Vi ser positivt på att du har ett stort tekniskt intresse då tjänsten förutsätter en allmän teknisk bredd.

Du är

Vi söker dig med följande egenskaper:

· Initiativtagande – Du tar initiativ för att lösa tekniska uppgifter du ställs inför, sätter igång aktiviteter och uppnår resultat.

· Flexibel – Du har lätt för att anpassa ditt synssätt och förhållningssätt när omständigheter förändras. Vid förändring ser du möjligheter.

· Serviceinriktad – Du är uppmärksam på behov och har en vilja att hjälpa andra. Du är tillmötesgående och anstränger dig för att tillgodose andras behov.

· Samarbetsförmåga – Du arbetar bra med andra människor samt relaterar till dem på ett lyhört och smidigt sätt. Du lyssnar, kommunicerar och löser konflikter på ett konstruktivt sätt.

Om FRA

FRA har omvärlden som sin arena där varje arbetsuppgift är en del av något större. På ett eller annat sätt får du som medarbetare vara med och bidra till att skydda Sveriges integritet och oberoende i världen. Du är med och gör skillnad på riktigt, varje dag.

Vår uppgift som underrättelsetjänst är att skydda Sverige mot de allvarligaste hot som kan riktas mot ett samhälle – militära angrepp, terrorism och cyberattacker. Vi skyddar det viktigaste vi har – vår trygghet, vår demokrati och vårt sätt att leva. Vi är experter på cyberområdet och signalspaning samt en larmklocka för militära hot.

FRA leder sedan 2024 Nationellt cybersäkerhetscenter, NCSC vars uppdrag är att utveckla och stärka Sveriges förmåga att förebygga, upptäcka och hantera cyberhot.

Som nyanställd på FRA får du en omfattande introduktionsutbildning och kontinuerlig kompetensutveckling, vilket ger dig möjlighet att utveckla dina färdigheter och bli ännu bättre på det du brinner för. Vår organisation är mångfacetterad och består av olika kompetenser och personligheter, där varje individ har unika egenskaper och förutsättningar. Vi strävar efter att skapa en miljö där alla känner sig välkomna och trygga. Utöver en stimulerande arbetsmiljö erbjuder vi också ett attraktivt förmånspaket, som du kan läsa mer om på www.fra.se (http://www.fra.se/). För mer information om Nationellt cybersäkerhetscenter besök www.ncsc.se (http://www.ncsc.se/) För din trygghet. För vår demokrati. Varje dag. Året om.

Mer information

Arbetsplatsen är belägen i Visbyområdet. Svenskt medborgarskap är ett krav då anställning vid FRA innebär placering i säkerhetsklass. Innan en anställning kommer du att säkerhetsprövas i enlighet med säkerhetsskyddslagens bestämmelser. Med anställning följer en skyldighet att krigsplaceras. Vi tillämpar sex månaders provanställning. För mer information är du välkommen att kontakta rekryterande chef Ove Flisberg på telefon 010-557 44 73. Fackliga företrädare nås på 010-557 46 00.

Vi tar emot ansökningar via www.fra.se senast 2026-10-25. Referensnummer 2026FRA277-2.

Då vi inför denna rekrytering redan tagit ställning till de rekryteringskanaler vi önskar använda undanber vi oss att bli kontaktade för ytterligare erbjudanden om annonserings- och rekryteringshjälp.
