title: Staff Developer Experience Engineer
description:
Get to Know Us

Horizon3 is a fast-growing, remote cybersecurity company dedicated to the mission of enabling organizations to proactively find and fix and verify exploitable attack vectors before criminals exploit them. Our flagship product, the NodeZeroTM platform, delivers production-safe autonomous pentests and other key assessment operations that scale across the largest internal, external, cloud, and hybrid cloud environments. NodeZero has been adopted by organizations of all sizes, from small educational institutions to government agencies and Global 100 enterprises. It is used by ITOps/SecOps teams, consulting pentesters, and MSSPs and MSPs.

We are a fusion of former U.S. Special Operations cyber operators, startup engineers, and formerly frustrated cybersecurity practitioners. We're committed to helping solve our common security problems: ineffective security tools, false positives resulting in alert fatigue, blind spots, "checkbox” security culture, cybersecurity skills shortage, and the long lead time and expense of hiring outside consultants. Collectively, we are a team of learn it alls, committed to a culture of respect, collaboration, ownership, and results.

About the Role

We are looking for a Staff Developer Experience Engineer to help shape how Horizon3 engineers build, test, release, and operate software.

The Developer Experience team owns the foundations connecting local development to production delivery: developer tooling, CI/CD, build systems, container base images, artifact promotion, release gates, and approved agentic-development workflows. You will define technical direction, lead complex initiatives across engineering, and build reusable paths that improve delivery speed, quality, security, and confidence.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role for an engineer who enjoys solving ambiguous problems, influencing across teams, and making the software lifecycle easier to use and operate.

What You’ll Do

Developer Platform Strategy, Delivery & Operations

  • Define the architecture and roadmap for local development, repository tooling, CI/CD, build systems, and release workflows.

  • Lead high-impact initiatives across engineering that reduce manual coordination and standardize the path from code change to production.

  • Build reusable GitLab CI/CD templates, runner capabilities, developer workflows, test gates, artifact promotion, release manifests, and rollback paths.

  • Establish sustainable practices for shared container images, build performance, reproducibility, scanning, signing, provenance, and supply-chain security.

  • Improve developer workflow and delivery observability through useful measures of setup time, pipeline health, release performance, and adoption.

  • Partner with Platform, Security, QA, and feature teams to make delivery foundations reliable, secure, and easy to consume.

Technical Leadership & Enablement

  • Establish standards and paved paths for developer workflows, build and release engineering, and approved AI-assisted development.

  • Design safe agentic-development workflows that integrate with code review, testing, scanning, permissions, auditability, and Security requirements.

  • Turn repeated developer friction into reusable tooling, templates, documentation, migration guidance, and runbooks.

  • Mentor engineers, develop technical owners, and raise the engineering bar across Developer Experience and Horizon3.

  • Communicate complex technical decisions clearly and build alignment across Platform, Application Engineering, Data Engineering, Security, QA, Product, and Program Management.

  • Participate in design reviews, operational reviews, incident response, and continuous improvement.

What You’ll Bring

Required Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience in Developer Experience, Developer Productivity, Build/Release Engineering, Platform Engineering, SRE, DevOps, or software engineering with substantial tooling and delivery ownership.

  • Deep experience designing and operating CI/CD systems, preferably GitLab CI/CD and self-hosted runners.

  • Experience with container builds, Docker or OCI images, artifact repositories, and reproducible builds.

  • Strong understanding of Kubernetes-based development or delivery workflows.

  • Experience implementing automated tests, security checks, release gates, progressive delivery, and rollback.

  • Proficiency in Go and Python for automation, developer tooling, or platform services.

  • Strong understanding of software supply-chain security, dependencies, image vulnerabilities, provenance, secrets, and least privilege.

  • Demonstrated success leading complex initiatives across multiple teams and driving adoption of shared capabilities.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

  • Experience mentoring engineers and influencing technical direction without relying on formal authority.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Internal developer platform, paved-road, service-template, or developer-portal experience.

  • Shared language/runtime base images, image signing, SBOMs, or provenance-control experience.

  • GitLab Runner fleets, CI optimization, build caching, or multi-repository release-system experience.

  • Local Kubernetes, dev containers, Docker Compose, Orbstack, Skaffold, ArgoCD, or GitOps experience.

  • AI-assisted or agentic engineering workflow experience.

  • OpenTelemetry, Datadog, pipeline telemetry, or developer-productivity metrics experience.

  • Security-sensitive, regulated, or cybersecurity experience.

Our Developer Experience Stack

  • GitLab, GitLab CI/CD, and private runner fleets

  • Shared CI/CD templates and pipeline management

  • Docker/OCI images, artifact repositories, and shared base images

  • Kubernetes, EKS, Helm, Skaffold, and ArgoCD

  • AWS and cloud-native development environments

  • Go, Python, TypeScript, shell scripting, and repository tooling

  • OpenTelemetry, Datadog, and pipeline/deployment observability

  • Approved AI coding tools, including Claude Code for approved engineering use cases

Exact tool matches are less important than strong software-engineering fundamentals, platform judgment, empathy for developers, and a track record of improving delivery systems at scale.

What Success Looks Like

  • Engineering teams adopt clear, reliable paved paths from local development through production.

  • Shared CI/CD, build, and release capabilities reduce friction and manual coordination.

  • The same validated artifact or commit moves predictably through environments.

  • Base images, build components, and delivery workflows are secure, current, traceable, and easy to consume.

  • Approved AI-assisted workflows improve productivity without bypassing review, testing, or security.

  • Developer Experience has clear standards, strong adoption, measurable outcomes, and multiple technical owners.

  • You are trusted across Engineering to lead difficult developer-workflow and delivery decisions.

Why Join Us

You’ll shape the engineering system behind a rapidly evolving cybersecurity product used by organizations around the world. Your work will improve how every engineering team builds and operates NodeZero while establishing a new, high-leverage technical function at Horizon3.

Travel

Occasional travel may be required for company onsite meetings and team collaboration.

Perks of Horizon3

  • Inclusive Team: We value diversity and promote an inclusive culture where everyone can thrive.

  • Growth Opportunities: Be part of a dynamic and growing team with numerous career development opportunities.

  • Innovative Culture: Work in a collaborative environment that encourages creativity and out-of-the-box thinking.

  • Hybrid & Remote Work: We embrace a mix of remote and hybrid work models depending on role and location, including our Chicago office, where some roles require regular in-office presence.

  • Competitive Compensation: We offer competitive salary, equity and benefits. Our benefits include health, vision & dental insurance for you and your family, a flexible vacation policy, and generous parental leave.

Compensation and Values

At Horizon3, we believe that our people are our greatest asset, and our compensation philosophy reflects this core value. We are committed to fostering an environment where all employees feel valued, respected, and rewarded for their contributions. Our compensation structure is designed to be fair, competitive, and transparent, ensuring that every team member is recognized and compensated equitably across roles, levels, and locations.

In accordance with various State’s transparency regulations, we provide the following salary range information for this position:

  • Base salary range: $199,750 - $270,000 annually. The exact salary will be determined based on the selected candidate’s location, qualifications, experience, and relevant skills.

  • Additional compensation: All full-time roles are eligible for an equity package in the form of stock options.

You Belong Here

Horizon3 is not just an equal opportunity employer - we are a community that values diversity, equity, and inclusion as fundamental principles of our culture and success. We are dedicated to fostering a workplace where everyone feels welcome and respected, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, or any other legally protected status by law.

Our commitment to diversity and inclusion means we strive to attract, develop, and retain a workforce that reflects the varied communities we serve. We believe that diverse perspectives drive innovation and strengthen our ability to create cutting-edge cybersecurity solutions. At Horizon3, every team member is valued and supported in an environment that encourages personal and professional growth.

We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and experiences, and we encourage all qualified individuals to apply. Come be a part of Horizon3, where your unique contributions are recognized, and your potential is limitless.

Other Duties

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

Application Note

In any materials you submit, you may redact or remove age-identifying information such as age, date of birth, or dates of school attendance or graduation. You will not be penalized for redacting or removing this information.

title: Enhedschef til sundheds- og omsorgspladserne i Charlottenlund, Afdeling for Borgernær Sundhed
description:
Vil du have det overordnede ledelsesansvar for en stor, tværfaglig enhed med 51 sundheds- og omsorgspladser og stå i spidsen for overgangen til regional drift?

Vi søger en erfaren enhedschef, som kan lede gennem ledere, sikre stabil drift og faglig kvalitet og skabe retning gennem en omfattende organisatorisk forandring. Du får ansvar for Sundheds- og omsorgspladser Charlottenlund og bliver samtidig en del af den strategiske ledelse af Afdeling for Borgernær Sundhed på Herlev og Gentofte Hospital.

En ny afdeling med en central opgave i sundhedsreformen

Herlev og Gentofte Hospital har etableret Afdeling for Borgernær Sundhed som led i sundhedsreformen. Fra 1. januar 2027 overtager regionen blandt andet ansvaret for sundheds- og omsorgspladserne og akutsygeplejen.

Afdelingen får ansvar for syv lokationer med i alt 285 sundheds- og omsorgspladser på tværs af de ni kommuner i Sundhedsråd Københavns Omegn Nord. Som enhedschef refererer du til chefsygeplejersken og bliver en del af afdelingens strategiske ledergruppe sammen med fem øvrige enhedschefer. I får et fælles ansvar for at udvikle den nye afdeling og skabe retning for kvalitet, drift, faglighed, arbejdsmiljø og sammenhængende borgerforløb.

Dit ledelsesområde

Sundheds- og omsorgspladser Charlottenlund består fra 1. januar 2027 af 51 pladser på én matrikel. Enheden er i dag organiseret i to afsnit med henholdsvis 25 og 26 pladser.

Du bliver leder for fire afsnitsledere, som varetager den daglige personale- og driftsledelse tæt på medarbejdere og borgere. Gennem afsnitslederne får du det overordnede ledelsesansvar for den samlede enhed.

Medarbejdergruppen er tværfagligt sammensat med blandt andre sygeplejersker, social- og sundhedsassistenter, social- og sundhedshjælpere, ergoterapeuter og fysioterapeuter. Faglighederne arbejder sammen om tidsafgrænsede borgerforløb, der blandt andet kan omfatte observation, pleje, behandling, genoptræning, rehabilitering og basal palliation. Indsatserne tager udgangspunkt i borgerens samlede situation og skal understøtte muligheden for at vende tilbage til et så selvstændigt hverdagsliv som muligt.

En central udviklingsopgave bliver gradvist at implementere Sundhedsstyrelsens nationale kvalitetsstandarder for sundheds- og omsorgspladser. Det skal ske i tæt samarbejde med ledere og medarbejdere og med respekt for den eksisterende faglighed, praksis og enhedens aktuelle udgangspunkt.

Opgaveløsningen kræver et tæt samarbejde med blandt andre hospitalets afdelinger, kommunale myndighedsfunktioner, hjemmepleje, kommunale genoptræningsenheder, almen praksis og øvrige tilbud omkring borgeren. Afdelingens tildelingsenhed bliver en central samarbejdspartner i arbejdet med at sikre gode borgerforløb, rettidig tildeling, kapacitetsudnyttelse og fremdrift både ind på pladserne og videre efter opholdet.

Din ledelsesopgave

Du får det overordnede ansvar for drift og kapacitet, økonomi, medarbejdere og arbejdsmiljø, faglig kvalitet og patientsikkerhed samt udvikling af sammenhængende borgerforløb.

Sundheds- og omsorgspladser Charlottenlund er en stor og etableret kommunal enhed med mange erfarne medarbejdere og en faglig praksis, der er udviklet over tid. Din opgave bliver sammen med de fire afsnitsledere og medarbejderne at føre enheden sikkert ind i den regionale organisering. Det indebærer både at fastholde en stabil drift og at udvikle ledelse, arbejdsgange, kvalitet og samarbejde inden for de nye rammer.

Du skal være en synlig og nærværende leder, som skaber tydelig retning og gode rammer for involvering, samarbejde og et trygt arbejdsmiljø. Samtidig skal du kunne drive forandringer med fremdrift og omsætte afdelingens fælles beslutninger til lokal praksis.

I tæt samarbejde med de fire afsnitsledere skal du blandt andet:

  • skabe fælles retning, tydelige roller og en sammenhængende ledelsespraksis på tværs af de to afsnit

  • udvikle et stærkt og forpligtende ledelsesfællesskab

  • bygge videre på den eksisterende faglighed og erfaring

  • sikre involvering og tryghed under virksomhedsoverdragelsen

  • fastholde drift, kvalitet, patientsikkerhed og et godt arbejdsmiljø gennem forandringen.

Afdeling for Borgernær Sundhed er en ny organisation, og ikke alle løsninger vil være fastlagt fra begyndelsen. Du skal derfor kunne sætte retning og samtidig udvikle løsninger i takt med, at organisationen og opgaven tager form.

Vi søger en erfaren leder med stærke forandringskompetencer

Det er et krav, at du har en relevant sundhedsfaglig uddannelse og en formel lederuddannelse. Du skal have betydelig ledelseserfaring fra en sammenlignelig sundhedsfaglig kontekst samt dokumenteret erfaring med at lede omfattende og komplekse forandringsprocesser.

Vi forventer, at du har erfaring med at lede gennem andre ledere i en driftsorganisation med tværfaglige medarbejdergrupper og komplekse borger- eller patientforløb. Du skal kunne skabe forandring og følgeskab uden at miste grebet om den daglige drift og faglige kvalitet.

Vi lægger vægt på, at du:

  • kan sætte en tydelig retning, udvikle en ledergruppe og skabe følgeskab gennem dine ledere

  • har solid forståelse for drift, økonomi, kapacitet og ressourceanvendelse

  • arbejder systematisk med kvalitet, patientsikkerhed og arbejdsmiljø og har blik for den samlede tværfaglige og rehabiliterende opgave

  • kommunikerer klart og kan skabe involvering og følgeskab gennem omfattende forandringer

  • kan bevæge dig mellem strategiske drøftelser og den driftsmæssige virkelighed, navigere i mange samarbejdsflader og bidrage aktivt til det fælles ansvar i afdelingens strategiske ledergruppe.

Som leder er du relationelt stærk og nysgerrig på den praksis, du træder ind i. Du træffer beslutninger og står på mål for dem, men har samtidig blik for, at holdbare løsninger udvikles i dialog med de mennesker, der kender opgaven og den lokale kontekst.

Vi tilbyder

Du får en central lederstilling med mulighed for at præge både Sundheds- og omsorgspladser Charlottenlund og udviklingen af fremtidens sundheds- og omsorgspladser.

Du bliver en del af et strategisk ledelsesfællesskab og får et tæt samarbejde med chefsygeplejersken, de øvrige enhedschefer og afdelingens tværgående funktioner. Sammen med de fire afsnitsledere får du mulighed for at udvikle en tydelig og sammenhængende lokal ledelse omkring en vigtig opgave for borgerne.

På Herlev og Gentofte Hospital arbejder vi ud fra ambitionen Godt behandlet. Det gælder både patienter, borgere og medarbejdere. Vi ønsker en ledelseskultur, hvor høje faglige ambitioner går hånd i hånd med ordentlighed, gensidig respekt og samarbejde.

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår

Ansættelse sker efter aftale i henhold til aftale for chefer på Sundhedskartellets område.

Stillingen ønskes besat den 1. december 2026.

Vil du vide mere?

Hvis du vil høre mere om stillingen og Afdeling for Borgernær Sundhed, er du velkommen til at kontakte chefsygeplejerske Louise Falkedal på telefon 28 69 10 70 til en uforpligtende samtale.

Ansøgningsfrist og ansættelsesproces

Ansøgningsfristen er den 6. oktober 2026.

Vi afholder første samtale den 19. oktober og anden samtale den 26. oktober 2026. Mellem de to samtaler gennemføres en personlighedstest med tilbagemelding fra en profilkonsulent.

title: Cyber Response Analyst
description:
Who will you be working with?

Join Enterprise Information Security (EIS) to drive cybersecurity excellence leveraging intelligence, strategic partnerships and analysis. Collaborate daily with Security Operations, GRC and key Information Technology stakeholders to advance our information security capabilities.

How will you make a difference?

Join Enterprise Information Security and play a key role in advancing Wabtec Corporation’s cybersecurity program. As Lead Response Analyst, reporting to the Team Lead, Response, you will be responsible for handling the entire lifecycle of security incidents from detection to resolution and root cause analysis. You will also develop, implement, and maintain standard documents, policies, and playbooks.

In this role you will be responsible for handling and escalating security incidents and owning critical security projects. You should be comfortable with learning new technologies and highly motivated to develop and deploy cutting edge technologies. You must be security focused and driven to perform in a fast-paced environment.

What do we want to know about you?

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, related field, or experience in cybersecurity.
  • Strong leadership and decision-making skills, with the ability to remain calm and effective during high-pressure security incidents.
  • Solid understanding of incident response lifecycles, including preparation, detection and analysis, containment, eradication, and recovery, and post-incident activity.
  • Excellent communication skills, with experience briefing technical teams, leadership, and stakeholders through written incident writeups and verbal presentations.
  • Must be willing to work weekends/off-shift hours, as needed during cybersecurity incidents.
  • Advanced English.

We would love it if you had:

  • Hands-on experience with enterprise security tools such as SIEM, EDR, SOAR, threat intelligence platforms, and cloud security controls.
  • Strong understanding of modern threat landscapes, attack techniques and defensive control strategies.
  • Effective project management skills.
  • Ability to work independently with strong time management skills, consistently driving value and delivering results without direct supervision.
  • Commitment to continuous learning in an evolving cybersecurity landscape.

What will your typical day look like?

  • Monitor active security incidents and lead response efforts, including triage, escalation, and coordination through resolution.
  • Review alerts, incident escalations, and post-incident analyses to identify trends, gaps, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Maintain and enhance incident response playbooks, runbooks, and documentation to reflect evolving threats and technologies.
  • Detect, investigate, and respond to security events from firewalls, IDS, IPS, SIEM, WAF, Mail Gateway, DLP and other sources.
  • Lead, coordinate, work closely with 24/7/365 monitoring, incident detection, and response using both internal resources and an industry leading MSS provider.

title: Multidisciplinary Studio Internship - Art, Engineering & Communication (Berlin)
description:
Studio Apelbaum is an artist-led studio founded by Jonathan Apelbaum, an artist and engineer. Our paintings explore intimacy, memory and gender through people and their stories. We are building a new 150 m² studio at Osloer Straße 16–17, in the historic Umspannwerk Christiania.

We build cognitive paintings: oil paintings that change with light, movement and sound through LED systems and software we develop ourselves. Painting, electronics, music and performance become parts of the same work.

Our team crosses disciplines: Jonathan Apelbaum (painting and artistic direction), Thore Bartholomäus (co-owner and main engineer), James Calvert (mechanics and mechatronics), Fabian Wetekamp (software), Titouan Duflo (engineering, sound and AV), Clément Royon and malice. (music and soundscape), Lucie Fröhlich (fabrication and animation), Patricia Berchtold (architecture), and Nas (building). Choreographer Matilde Flor Usinger was part of I Want You to Love Me More. Aaron, who performs as Forgotten Sound, helps us shape the move from an exhibition into a party.

The new space is workshop, exhibition room and invitation-only meeting place. We make its adaptable furniture ourselves in steel and oak, and our intimate event series is at the heart of the studio. We build the works, shape the room, invite and welcome guests. With Clément Royon's music and sound, we explore how an exhibition can slowly change its rhythm; with Aaron / Forgotten Sound, that movement can carry on into a party. This approach grows from Jonathan's experience in queer and club culture. I Want You to Love Me More shows how painting, sound, performance and people can become one evening. Beyond the studio we create large installations with TRACEY (formerly Lunchbox Candy), Playground Festival and other art festivals.

Main Focus

We are looking for engineers, programmers, makers, artists, writers and communicators. You will work with the paintings and take on one main project shaped around your skills. The internship is a first step toward a longer collaboration.

First, we will build and open the new studio, including its steel and oak furniture and intimate event series. Our major exhibition in May is the main shared project: we will transform an entire building and make the experience together, from installation and invitations to welcoming guests. Depending on your role, you may build, code, write, coordinate or host.

Tasks

  • Build and assemble cognitive paintings and LED systems (wood, metal, electronics)
  • Help design and build the studio's custom steel and oak furniture and adaptable dining space, then produce exhibitions and large external installations
  • Contribute to research, prototypes, software, spatial design or storytelling according to your skills
  • Organise materials, tools, storage, artwork transport and installation in the studio and at external sites
  • Manage shipping lists, cost estimates, and customs documentation
  • Write or create invitations, exhibition texts, documentation and communication materials where relevant to your project
  • Assist in managing multiple ongoing projects
  • Occasionally travel as a courier for exhibitions

Requirements

  • A practice or strong interest in engineering, programming, making, visual art, writing, communication or related fields
  • Ability to work independently and take initiative
  • Interest in contemporary art, installation, or performance
  • Curiosity about working across art, technology, production, storytelling and communication; you do not need to arrive with all these skills
  • Reliability, flexibility and care for both artworks and people

Benefits

You will learn within a diverse team that works like a chosen family, surrounded by a larger community. You will gain practical experience in electronics, steel and oak, and help shape our studio, intimate events and major May exhibition. Your own studio project gives you room to grow with us.

  • Duration: 6 months
  • Format: Part-time
  • Compensation: Unpaid

The role is part-time so you can continue an independent project alongside your studio work and work on the side. During the internship you will also lead one main project within Studio Apelbaum, agreed together and supported by the team.

The studio is a place to teach, learn and grow together. We are looking for people who want to stay with us. The internship is a first step, and the main project you take on here can become the direction of your future work in the studio.

Please send:

  • A motivation letter explaining your interest in the studio, your independent work and the direction you would like to develop here (most important)
  • Your CV and/or portfolio (if available)

title: RPA Customer Engagement Specialist
description:
The Robotic Process Automation (RPA) Team requires one full-time Customer Engagement Specialist to support the expansion and adoption of automation capabilities across the Defense Health Agency (DHA), Military Treatment Facilities (MTFs), and other supported organizations.

The position will serve as a primary outreach resource for the RPA Team, proactively identifying opportunities where automation can reduce administrative burden, improve operational efficiency, increase accuracy and compliance, and return valuable time to the DHA workforce.

The successful candidate will combine customer engagement, process discovery, marketing, and communication skills with an understanding of automation and digital transformation. The position will work closely with government program leadership, RPA developers, business analysts, and prospective customers to develop and maintain a sustainable pipeline of automation opportunities.

Key Responsibilities

Customer Engagement and Pipeline Growth:

  • Proactively identify and pursue new RPA opportunities across DHA, MTFs, program offices, and other supported organizations.
  • Develop and execute outreach strategies designed to increase awareness and adoption of RPA capabilities.
  • Establish relationships with organizational leaders, business process owners, and other key stakeholders to identify automation needs.
  • Conduct targeted outreach to organizations with manual, repetitive, high-volume, and rules-based business processes.
  • Maintain a pipeline of prospective automation opportunities from initial engagement through formal RPA intake.
  • Track customer engagements, potential opportunities, follow-up actions, and conversion of prospective opportunities into RPA projects.
  • Identify opportunities to expand successful automation use cases to other DHA organizations performing similar business processes.

Customer Engagement and Process Discovery:

  • Meet with prospective customers to understand existing business processes, pain points, workload challenges, and desired outcomes.
  • Conduct initial process-discovery discussions to determine whether a business process may be an appropriate candidate for RPA.
  • Assist customers in understanding RPA capabilities, limitations, requirements, and expected benefits.
  • Coordinate with the RPA technical team to evaluate prospective opportunities for feasibility and potential business value.
  • Guide interested customers toward the appropriate RPA intake and service-request processes.
  • Maintain regular communication with prospective and existing customers throughout the engagement process.

Marketing and RPA Awareness:

  • Develop and execute an RPA marketing and awareness strategy across DHA.
  • Promote RPA capabilities through briefings, demonstrations, webinars, roadshows, leadership engagements, MTF outreach, conferences, and other communication channels.
  • Develop customer-facing marketing materials, presentations, success stories, capability briefs, one-pagers, and other RPA promotional content.
  • Coordinate live demonstrations of existing automations to illustrate the practical application and value of RPA.
  • Develop compelling RPA use cases highlighting measurable outcomes such as labor-hour savings, reduced errors, improved compliance, increased data quality, and faster processing.
  • Support and maintain content for the DHA RPA website and other approved communication platforms.
  • Identify opportunities to increase visibility of RPA successes throughout DHA.

Stakeholder Relationship Management:

  • Serve as a liaison between prospective customers and the RPA Team during the early stages of automation discovery.
  • Develop productive relationships with MTF leadership, administrative organizations, program offices, functional communities, and other DHA stakeholders.
  • Coordinate customer meetings, RPA capability briefings, demonstrations, and follow-up engagements.
  • Maintain awareness of organizational priorities and emerging business challenges that may present opportunities for automation.
  • Encourage cross-organizational sharing and reuse of successful automation concepts where appropriate.

Metrics and Reporting:

  • Develop and maintain customer-engagement metrics.
  • Track outreach activities, customer engagements, automation leads, intake submissions, qualified opportunities, and projects entering the RPA development pipeline.
  • Monitor the progression of prospective opportunities from initial contact through intake and development.
  • Assist in documenting projected and realized benefits, including labor-hour savings, cost avoidance, processing-time reductions, and quality improvements.
  • Provide recurring pipeline status reports to RPA program leadership.
  • Use customer feedback and engagement data to recommend improvements to outreach and service-delivery strategies.

Required Qualifications:

  • Must Hold Secret Clearance and maintain ability to hold Secret Clearance
  • Experience in customer engagement, account management, marketing, program support, or a related field.
  • Demonstrated ability to establish and maintain professional relationships with customers and senior stakeholders.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate technical concepts to nontechnical audiences.
  • Experience developing and delivering presentations, capability briefings, demonstrations, and customer-facing materials.
  • Ability to identify customer business challenges and translate those challenges into potential technology or process-improvement opportunities.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple prospective opportunities and customer engagements simultaneously.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with technical and nontechnical team members.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office and collaboration tools.

Desired Qualifications:

  • Previous experience supporting DHA, DoD, MTFs, federal healthcare, or other federal organizations.
  • Experience with Robotic Process Automation, intelligent automation, workflow automation, digital transformation, or business process improvement.
  • Familiarity with UiPath or comparable automation platforms.
  • Experience with customer relationship management, opportunity tracking, or pipeline-management processes.
  • Experience supporting technology demonstrations, conferences, roadshows, or organizational outreach campaigns.
  • Familiarity with SharePoint, Power Platform, or similar collaboration and workflow technologies.
  • Experience conducting business process discovery or assessing processes for automation potential.

Desired Knowledge and Competencies:

The candidate should understand how to identify processes that are strong candidates for automation, particularly those that are:

  • Manual and repetitive
  • Rules-based and standardized
  • High-volume or time-consuming
  • Prone to human error or rework
  • Dependent on data entry or transfer between systems
  • Associated with significant administrative burden
  • Capable of producing measurable operational benefits through automation

Key Performance Indicators:

Success for this position may be measured through:

  • Number of DHA and MTF organizations engaged
  • Number of RPA capability briefings and demonstrations conducted
  • Number of new automation opportunities identified
  • Number of qualified opportunities progressing to formal intake
  • Growth and health of the RPA project pipeline
  • Percentage of leads converted into viable automation projects
  • Expansion or reuse of successful automations across multiple organizations
  • Estimated labor hours and operational efficiencies associated with opportunities generated
  • Customer engagement and satisfaction
  • Increased awareness and utilization of RPA services

Position Objective The ultimate objective of this position is to grow the RPA program by connecting DHA organizations with automation solutions that address real business challenges.

The Customer Engagement Specialist will help organizations recognize where automation can provide value, connect those opportunities with the RPA Team, and build a sustainable pipeline of automation projects that reduce administrative burden and return valuable time to the DHA workforce.

The measure of success is not simply how many customers hear about RPA—it is how many meaningful automation opportunities move from conversation to implementation.

About Us

Diné Development Corporation (DDC) is a Navajo Nation–owned family of companies that provides government agencies and commercial organizations with high-quality IT, professional, environmental, and research and development services. DDC is dedicated to empowering the Navajo Nation and the communities we serve.

Eligible full-time employees receive a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, life and disability coverage, retirement savings with company match, and paid time off. Additional benefits include voluntary supplemental benefits, access to an employee assistance program, and educational assistance with tuition reimbursement.

title: Parish Catechetical Leader; Parish Catechetical Director; Faith Formation Director
description:
SUMMARY

The Parish Catechetical Leader, under the direction of the Pastor, is responsible for the overall leadership, development, and administration of the parish’s comprehensive catechetical ministry. This includes planning, implementing, and evaluating formation programs for all age groups, sacramental preparation, and catechumenal processes, in alignment with diocesan standards. The role oversees catechetical programming, supports and forms catechists and volunteers, and ensures effective communication and coordination across parish and diocesan stakeholders.


The Diocese of Orlando four core values lay the foundation for the work performed by its employees.

  1. Authenticity: Conviction that God has called us to reflect exteriorly our inner life of faith in our daily living.
  2. Respect: Affirming each person’s God-given dignity and uniqueness.
  3. Courage: Inspired by this gift of the Holy Spirit, we proclaim and live the Word of God fearlessly and devotedly.
  4. Commitment: Individually and collectively, we are steadfast to the team and its purpose.


ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

The duties and functions outlined herein are representative of the types of tasks performed within this classification. They are not listed in any order of importance. The omission of specific duties or functions does not exclude them from the classification if the work is similar, related, or a logical assignment for this role. Other duties may be required and assigned.

  • Develops goals, objectives, and implements strategies for a comprehensive catechetical program that serves adults through Pre-K, including preparation for Sacraments of Initiation, Reconciliation, and Marriage.
  • Develops and implements a coherent and unified curriculum and catechetical plan for the parish, in conjunction with the pastor, parish staff, formation team, ad-hoc advisory committees, and others.
  • Directs and oversees various catechetical programs that support a comprehensive, systematic, lifelong, and ongoing discipleship in the Catholic faith for all parishioners in accordance with Church teaching and practice as outlined by Sacred Scripture, the Catechism of the Catholic Church (CCC), the General Directory for Catechesis (GDC), the National Directory for Catechesis (NDC), church law diocesan guidelines, and parish needs.
  • Responsible for the recruitment and training of catechists/volunteers and assures that they fulfill diocesan Safe Environment and certification requirements.
  • Oversees and directs the work of the formation team; works with them on the development of a yearly schedule for all programs.
  • Responsible for administrative functions such as maintenance of all Sacramental records, program registrations, evaluations, and other pertinent data or information.
  • Evaluates the parish formation programming and makes recommendations to the pastor.
  • Researches, evaluates, and recommends primary and supplemental catechetical resources and materials.
  • Utilizes the parish bulletin, weekly update, website, social media and other media to communicate and market catechetical programming, best practices, and milestones.
  • Provides support to the formation team in the areas of training, resources, and programs.
  • Keeps current in developments/changes with diocesan policy.
  • Acts as a resource person in the area of catechetics for the formation team, parish staff, pastor, and parish community.
  • Prepares annual budget for review by the pastor and parish finance council and oversees expenditures to maintain budget within parameters.
  • Develops an accurate and reliable statistical metric of the parish’s catechetical efforts and submits reports to the pastor, pastoral council, diocese, or other as required.
  • Attends and participates in staff meetings.
  • Attends and facilitates formation staff and/or committee meetings.
  • Attends meetings/events convened by the diocese as related to catechetical ministry or job-responsibilities.
  • Participates in local and regional professional organizations related to catechetics; gives priority to professional development and to keeping credentials current as a parish catechetical leader serving in the Diocese of Orlando.
  • Performs any other job-related duties as required.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES

The Parish Catechetical Leader has supervisory responsibility for the total parish faith formation team, which includes three catechetical professionals: evangelization, adult formation, and annulment advocate; youth minister; and faith formation/evangelization administrative assistant.

title: Forløbskoordinator og vagtplanlægger søges til Center for Neurorehabilitering
description:
Vil du være med til at skabe sammenhængende patientforløb, sikre optimale arbejdsgange og understøtte driften i en specialiseret neurorehabiliteringsafdeling?

Center for Neurorehabilitering (CfN) på Epilepsihospitalet Filadelfia søger en forløbskoordinator og vagtplanlægger til en nyoprettet stilling, hvor koordinering, overblik og samarbejde er i centrum.

Stillingen er en nøglefunktion i afdelingen og kombinerer ansvar for forløbskoordination (ca. 30 %) og vagtplanlægning (ca. 70 %).

Du bliver en væsentlig del af CfN’s ansigt udadtil, igennem det tætte samarbejde med hospitaler, kommuner, pårørende og øvrige samarbejdspartnere, samtidig med at du bliver en central del af afdelingens maskinrum igennem hensigtsmæssig planlægning og dermed bidrager til en velfungerende drift og god trivsel blandt medarbejderne.

Om Center for Neurorehabilitering – Filadelfia

CfN yder intensiv, specialiseret neurorehabilitering til voksne med moderate til svære følger efter erhvervet hjerneskade, herunder stroke, hovedtraumer og tilgrænsende neurologiske lidelser.

CfN er det eneste ikke-offentlige hospital med regionsfunktion inden for neurorehabilitering og tilbyder sammenhængende rehabiliteringsforløb – inklusive fase 3, den nuværende kommunale specialiserede rehabilitering.

Centret råder over 22 sengepladser fordelt på to etager, og patienterne er typisk indlagt i 2–5 måneder. Det giver mulighed for længerevarende, individualiserede rehabiliteringsforløb med høj faglig kvalitet, kontinuitet og tæt opfølgning.

Tværfaglighed er et grundlæggende princip i arbejdet på CfN. De kliniske teams består af sygeplejersker, social- og sundhedsassistenter, ergo- og fysioterapeuter, neuropsykologer, læger, audiologopæder, socialrådgivere og administrativt personale. Samlet har CfN mere end 50 medarbejdere, som arbejder tæt sammen om at skabe de bedst mulige rehabiliteringsforløb for patienterne.

Om stillingen

Du bliver en del af CfN’s administrative og driftsmæssige fundament og kommer til at arbejde tæt sammen med afdelingsledelse, oversygeplejerske, overterapeut og afdelingens tværfaglige teams.

En væsentlig del af stillingen bliver at understøtte implementeringen af kommende krav og retningslinjer i forbindelse med overgangen af den specialiserede rehabilitering fra kommunalt til regionalt regi.

Du får blandt andet ansvar for:

  • Koordinering af patientforløb og tværfaglige møder
  • Planlægning, indkaldelse og opfølgning på patientrelaterede møder
  • Understøttelse af sammenhængende patientforløb
  • Understøttelse af arbejdsgange og driftsudvikling
  • Vagtplanlægning og feriekoordinering
  • Sikring af hensigtsmæssig faglig bemanding på tværs af afdelingens afsnit, herunder vikardækning

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har erfaring med koordinering, planlægning eller administrative funktioner i sundhedsvæsenet
  • Har erfaring med vagtplanlægning, gerne erfaring med KMD OPUS.
  • Kendskab til relevante overenskomster
  • Har stærke organisatoriske kompetencer
  • Trives med mange kontaktflader og samarbejdsrelationer
  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og bevare overblikket i en kompleks hverdag
  • Har gode kommunikations- og samarbejdsevner
  • Er struktureret, løsningsorienteret og serviceminded

Din faglige baggrund er mindre afgørende. Du kan eksempelvis være sundhedsfagligt uddannet, lægesekretær, sundhedsadministrativ koordinator eller have anden relevant erfaring.

Vi tilbyder:

  • En nyoprettet stilling med mulighed for at præge funktionens udvikling
  • En central rolle i en specialiseret neurorehabiliteringsafdeling
  • Et stærkt tværfagligt miljø med høj faglighed
  • Gode muligheder for faglig og personlig udvikling
  • Engagerede kolleger og en afdeling i udvikling
  • Massageordning
  • Gratis træning i Filadelfias motionscenter
  • Mulighed for fordelagtig leje af feriehuse gennem Regions Sjællands Feriefond

Yderligere oplysninger eller aftale om et evt. besøg i afdelingen fås ved henvendelse til Cheflæge Nicole Frandsen tlf. 20727845 eller overterapeut Stine Jochumsen Schüder tlf. 58271268.

Startlønnen kan variere afhængigt af anciennitet, relevant erfaring og uddannelse.

title: Lead UX Designer
description:

About the Role
TechnoMile is seeking a Lead UX/UI Designer to lead the design and development of advanced user experiences for our SaaS platform tailored to the Government Contracting (GovCon) industry. This role combines strategic UX leadership with hands-on design, with a strong focus on agentic AI experiences where users collaborate with autonomous systems.

You will define how users interact with AI agents, ensuring clarity, control, and confidence while navigating complex workflows and data-rich environments.

What You’ll Do

Agentic Experience (AX) Design

  • Define and lead how users interact with autonomous AI agents
  • Design human-in-the-loop systems that provide visibility into AI reasoning and decision-making
  • Create interfaces for monitoring long-running agent tasks, including status tracking, alerts, and intervention points
  • Establish clear hand-offs between users and AI systems to maintain trust and control

AI Workflow & Platform Design

  • Design seamless AI-driven workflows across React-based applications, Salesforce, and Microsoft Power Platform (including Teams)
  • Create unified experiences across multiple enterprise ecosystems

Complex Data & Content Systems

  • Architect dashboards and workflows for content-heavy, data-rich environments
  • Design systems that enable AI agents to aggregate, connect, and contextualize disparate data (e.g., linking subcontract records to prime contracts)
  • Translate complex analytics into clear, actionable insights

Advanced AI Interaction Design

  • Move beyond chat interfaces to design canvas/workbench-style experiences
  • Enable real-time collaboration between users and AI agents for document editing, data analysis, and multi-step workflows

Design Systems & Consistency

  • Extend and maintain our design system (based on UntitledUI)
  • Define standardized UI components for:
    • AI status indicators
    • Confidence levels and explainability
    • Approval, undo, and intervention actions

Prototyping & Validation

  • Develop high-fidelity prototypes in tools such as Figma or Bolt to simulate AI-driven interactions
  • Conduct usability testing focused on user trust, clarity, and control over AI systems
  • Iterate based on user feedback and behavioral insights

Strategic & Collaborative Design

  • Define and drive UX vision aligned with business and product strategy
  • Collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, and Data Science teams to deliver technically feasible solutions
  • Translate complex requirements into intuitive user experiences
  • Present design concepts and strategies to stakeholders, leadership, and clients

Research & Optimization

  • Conduct user research, persona development, and journey mapping
  • Use qualitative and quantitative insights to inform design decisions
  • Continuously refine UX processes, tools, and workflows to improve efficiency and outcomes

Qualifications:

  • 8+ years of professional experience in UX/UI design for SaaS, enterprise, or workflow-heavy products
  • Proven experience designing AI/agentic user experiences beyond simple chat interfaces
  • Asynchronous task monitoring
  • AI transparency and explainability
  • Multi-step automation workflows
  • Strong experience designing for complex data visualization and content-heavy systems
  • Experience working across React, Salesforce, and Microsoft ecosystems (Teams/Power Automate)
  • Proficiency in prototyping tools such as Figma, Bolt, or similar
  • Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving, and attention to detail
  • Experience conducting user research and usability testing
  • Bachelor’s degree in Design, HCI, or related field (or equivalent experience)

Preferred Skills

  • Front-end fluency and understanding of how React components integrate with AI APIs, including streaming UI states
  • Experience in B2B enterprise environments, particularly GovCon or regulated industries
  • Familiarity with prompt engineering concepts and LLM/agent capabilities and constraints
  • Experience working with AI/ML or data science teams to translate insights into user-facing features

Who We Are:

TechnoMile provides AI-enabled cloud solutions that empower GovCon, aerospace and defense, and other government-focused companies to modernize operations. Our SaaS products help clients:

  • Optimize business development and sales processes.
  • Streamline and de-risk contract management.
  • Unlock the value of public and private data for a competitive advantage.

Today, more than 200 companies rely on TechnoMile, including over half of the top 10 federal defense contractors and the top 10 IT government contractors.

Our Culture

  • Hungry, Humble, and Smart.We foster continuous learning and career growth, offering tuition reimbursement and ongoing development opportunities.
  • Innovative.We embrace challenges and develop solutions others cannot.
  • Flexible.Remote, hybrid, and in-office options support your best work.
  • Global.With teams across the U.S. and India, we collaborate worldwide with one mission.

title: Enhedschef til sundheds- og omsorgspladserne i Farum og Ølstykke, Afdeling for Borgernær Sundhed
description:
Vil du have det overordnede ledelsesansvar for to enheder med sundheds- og omsorgspladser og samtidig være med til at udvikle en ny afdeling, der skal bringe sundhedsvæsenet tættere på borgerne?

Vi søger en enhedschef, som kan lede gennem ledere, sikre stabil drift og faglig kvalitet og skabe retning og tryghed i en organisation under udvikling. Du får ansvar for sundheds- og omsorgspladserne i Farum og Ølstykke og bliver samtidig en del af den strategiske ledelse af Afdeling for Borgernær Sundhed på Herlev og Gentofte Hospital.

En ny afdeling med en central opgave i sundhedsreformen

Herlev og Gentofte Hospital har etableret Afdeling for Borgernær Sundhed som led i sundhedsreformen. Fra 1. januar 2027 overtager regionen ansvaret for en række opgaver, der i dag varetages af kommunerne, herunder sundheds- og omsorgspladserne og akutsygeplejen.

Afdelingen får ansvar for syv lokationer med i alt 285 sundheds- og omsorgspladser på tværs af de ni kommuner i Sundhedsråd Københavns Omegn Nord. Ambitionen er at skabe borgernære tilbud med høj og ensartet kvalitet og sammenhængende forløb på tværs af hospital, kommune og øvrige samarbejdspartnere.

Som enhedschef refererer du til chefsygeplejersken og bliver en del af afdelingens strategiske ledergruppe sammen med fem øvrige enhedschefer. I ledergruppen får du et fælles ansvar for at udvikle den nye afdeling og skabe retning for kvalitet, drift, faglighed, arbejdsmiljø og sammenhængende borgerforløb på tværs af afdelingens opgaver og geografier.

Dit ledelsesområde

Ledelsesområdet består fra 1. januar 2027 af 56 sundheds- og omsorgspladser fordelt på to lokationer:

  • 20 pladser i Ølstykke

  • 36 pladser i Farum

De to lokationer har hver deres lokale organisering, faglige miljø og samarbejdsrelationer. Som enhedschef bliver du leder for tre afsnitsledere – én i Ølstykke og to i Farum. Afsnitslederne varetager den daglige personale- og driftsledelse tæt på medarbejdere og borgere, mens du gennem dem har det overordnede ledelsesansvar for begge lokationer.

På lokationerne møder du tværfagligt sammensatte medarbejdergrupper med blandt andre sygeplejersker, social- og sundhedsassistenter, social- og sundhedshjælpere, ergoterapeuter og fysioterapeuter. Faglighederne arbejder sammen om tidsafgrænsede borgerforløb, som blandt andet kan omfatte observation, pleje, behandling, genoptræning, rehabilitering og basal palliation. Indsatserne tager udgangspunkt i borgerens samlede situation og skal understøtte muligheden for at vende tilbage til et så selvstændigt hverdagsliv som muligt.

En central udviklingsopgave bliver gradvist at implementere Sundhedsstyrelsens nationale kvalitetsstandarder for sundheds- og omsorgspladser. Det skal ske i tæt samarbejde med ledere og medarbejdere og med respekt for den eksisterende faglighed, praksis og lokationernes forskellige udgangspunkter.

Opgaveløsningen forudsætter et tæt og koordineret samarbejde med blandt andre hospitalets afdelinger, kommunale myndighedsfunktioner, hjemmepleje, kommunale genoptræningsenheder, almen praksis og øvrige tilbud omkring borgeren.

En central samarbejdspartner bliver afdelingens tildelingsenhed. Samarbejdet skal understøtte gode og effektive borgerforløb, relevant og rettidig tildeling, god kapacitetsudnyttelse og fremdrift – både ind på sundheds- og omsorgspladserne og videre til den rette indsats efter opholdet.

Din ledelsesopgave

Du får det overordnede ansvar for drift og kapacitet, økonomi, medarbejdere og arbejdsmiljø, faglig kvalitet og patientsikkerhed samt udvikling af sammenhængende borgerforløb på de to lokationer.

En væsentlig opgave bliver at stå i spidsen for overgangen fra kommunal til regional drift. Det skal ske med respekt for den viden, erfaring og faglighed, der allerede findes lokalt, og med blik for, at medarbejdere og ledere skal opleve tydelighed, involvering og tryghed gennem forandringen.

I tæt samarbejde med de tre afsnitsledere skal du blandt andet:

  • skabe fælles retning, standarder og ledelsespraksis

  • bevare relevant lokal viden og forankring

  • udvikle et stærkt ledelsesfællesskab med de tre afsnitsledere

  • sikre tryghed og involvering under virksomhedsoverdragelsen

  • fastholde stabil drift, kvalitet og patientsikkerhed gennem forandringen

  • omsætte afdelingens fælles beslutninger til lokal praksis.

Du skal sammen med afsnitslederne identificere, hvor fælles tilgange skaber værdi, og hvor løsninger skal tilpasses den enkelte lokation. Samtidig skal du sikre, at ledelsen opleves nærværende og tilgængelig begge steder.

Afdeling for Borgernær Sundhed er en ny organisation, og ikke alle rammer og løsninger vil være endeligt fastlagt fra begyndelsen. Du skal derfor kunne skabe retning og fremdrift, inddrage ledere og medarbejdere og samtidig kunne udvikle løsninger i takt med, at organisationen og opgaven tager form.

Vi søger en erfaren og samlende leder

Du har en sundhedsfaglig baggrund og solid ledelseserfaring fra sundheds-, pleje- eller rehabiliteringsområdet. Du har gerne erfaring med ledelse gennem andre ledere og med at stå i spidsen for både stabil drift og organisatoriske forandringer.

Vi lægger vægt på, at du:

  • kan sætte en tydelig retning og skabe følgeskab gennem dine ledere

  • har solid forståelse for drift, økonomi, kapacitet og ressourceanvendelse

  • arbejder systematisk med faglig kvalitet, patientsikkerhed og arbejdsmiljø

  • har blik for den tværfaglige opgave og for rehabilitering som en integreret del af borgerforløbet

  • kommunikerer tydeligt og kan skabe et tillidsfuldt og udviklende ledelsesrum

  • kan navigere i en kompleks organisation med mange interessenter og samarbejdsflader

  • kan bevæge dig mellem strategiske drøftelser og den driftsmæssige virkelighed og bidrage aktivt til det fælles ansvar i afdelingens strategiske ledergruppe.

Som leder er du relationelt stærk og nysgerrig på den praksis, du træder ind i. Du kan træffe beslutninger og stå på mål for dem, men har samtidig blik for, at holdbare løsninger udvikles i dialog med de mennesker, der kender opgaven og den lokale kontekst.

Vi tilbyder

Du får en central og meningsfuld lederstilling med mulighed for at præge både dit eget ledelsesområde og udviklingen af fremtidens sundheds- og omsorgspladser.

Du bliver en del af et strategisk ledelsesfællesskab og får et tæt samarbejde med chefsygeplejersken, de øvrige enhedschefer og afdelingens tværgående faglige og administrative funktioner. Sammen med dine tre afsnitsledere får du mulighed for at skabe et stærkt ledelsesfællesskab omkring to lokationer med engagerede medarbejdere, værdifuld lokal erfaring og en vigtig opgave for borgerne.

På Herlev og Gentofte Hospital arbejder vi ud fra pejlemærket Godt behandlet. Det gælder både patienter, borgere og medarbejdere. Vi ønsker en ledelseskultur, hvor høje faglige ambitioner går hånd i hånd med ordentlighed, gensidig respekt og samarbejde.

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår

Ansættelse sker efter aftale for cheferpå Sundhedskartellets område.

Stillingen ønskes besat den 1. december 2026.

Vil du vide mere?

Hvis du vil høre mere om stillingen og Afdeling for Borgernær Sundhed, er du velkommen til at kontakte chefsygeplejerske Louise Falkedal på telefon 28 69 10 70 til en uforpligtende samtale.

Ansøgningsfrist og ansættelsesproces

Ansøgningsfristen er den 6. oktober 2026.

Vi forventer at afholde første samtale den 19. oktober og anden samtale den 22. oktober 2026. Mellem de to samtaler gennemføres en personlighedstest med tilbagemelding fra en profilkonsulent.

title: Senior Project Manager
description:
Senior Project Manager
Fixed-Term | Sydney | Hybrid flexible working

Who We Are
At Torrens University Australia, making a difference is in our DNA. As a Certified B Corporation, we belong to a global community of future-focused companies using business as a force for good. We believe in the transformative power of education to change lives, families, communities – and the world. That’s why we’re on a mission to increase access to higher education, so learners from all walks of life can chase their dreams.

Just like our students, our employees are a diverse group who want to make an impact. When you join us, we give you the freedom to be bold, creative and courageous – with flexible working arrangements that allow you to bring your best. We’ve built a culture that celebrates community, collaboration and innovation, where people love what they do.

What’s the Job?
We are seeking an experienced Senior Project Manager to lead the integrated delivery of the University’s Banner SaaS implementation and associated business transformation programme.

This is a high-profile, enterprise-wide role that will bring together University teams, implementation partners, system integrators and third-party vendors. You will establish the structure, governance and delivery discipline required to move a complex programme forward and support successful implementation across the University.

You will lead programme planning, governance, reporting, risk and dependency management, vendor coordination, testing, cutover and operational readiness. You will work closely with accountable functional, technical, data, integration, testing, training and change leads to ensure all parts of the programme are aligned and progressing.

You will not be expected to be the technical subject-matter expert across every domain. However, you will need sufficient understanding of enterprise systems, integrations, data and technology delivery to identify risks, challenge assumptions and coordinate effective decisions.

This is a 12 months fixed-term opportunity based at our Surry Hills campus in Sydney, with hybrid flexibility.

Key Responsibilities (but not limited to):

  • Lead a foundational platform / programme plan, including milestones, dependencies, resources, decisions and critical path activities.

  • Align programme delivery with university priorities, expected benefits, portfolio planning, and organisational outcomes.

  • Establish and operate effective governance, executive reporting, assurance, and escalation processes.

  • Coordinate functional, technical, data, integration, security, testing, training and change workstreams.

  • Manage scope, requirements, risks, issues, dependencies, change control, and formal approvals.

  • Act as the University’s primary day-to-day contact for implementation partners, system integrators and third-party vendors.

  • Monitor vendor deliverables, performance, resourcing, service levels, commercial obligations, and escalations.

  • Coordinate migration, technical readiness, and dependencies across the University’s wider digital ecosystem.

  • Lead integrated testing, cutover and operational-readiness planning, ensuring workstream owners are prepared for implementation.

  • Support regulatory compliance, benefits realisation, continuous improvement and the uplift of project delivery capability across the University.

Who You Are
You are a calm, structured and outcomes-focused programme professional who is comfortable working in complex, matrixed environments. You bring clarity to competing priorities, communicate complex issues plainly and build confidence through transparency and follow-through.

You will bring:

  • Demonstrated experience leading complex enterprise technology, SaaS, student information system or business transformation programmes.

  • Direct Ellucian Banner experience is highly desirable. Experience with another higher education platform or large-scale enterprise system will also be considered.

  • Strong experience in programme planning, governance, risk, issue, dependency and change management.

  • Demonstrated experience coordinating system integration, data migration, testing, cutover and operational readiness across multiple workstreams.

  • Proven experience managing implementation partners, system integrators and third-party vendors, including delivery commitments, performance, resourcing and escalations.

  • Strong stakeholder-management and communication skills, with the ability to influence executives, academic leaders, technical specialists, operational teams and external partners.

  • Experience working in a matrix environment with distributed or international teams.

  • The ability to make sound decisions with incomplete information, challenge constructively and maintain momentum through ambiguity.

  • Relevant project or programme management qualifications. PMP, PRINCE2, MSP or an equivalent certification would be highly regarded.

Why Join Us?
This is an opportunity to lead a significant enterprise transformation with genuine organisational reach. You will work across technology, operations, academic and leadership teams while helping shape the platforms and digital ecosystem that support the University’s future.

At Torrens University Australia, you will benefit from:

  • A purpose-led, B Corp-certified organisation.

  • Flexible hybrid working arrangements.

  • The opportunity to lead a complex, high-profile transformation with global stakeholders.

  • Access to professional development and internal career opportunities.

  • The opportunity to study free in a course related to your position, subject to eligibility requirements.

  • A collaborative and inclusive working environment.

Our Commitment to Inclusion
We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating an inclusive, accessible and equitable workplace. We encourage applications from Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples and people from all backgrounds.

If you require adjustments or additional support during the recruitment process, please contact yourcareer@torrens.edu.au for confidential assistance.

To learn more about what makes Torrens University Australia a great place to work, visit https://www.torrens.edu.au/blog.

We’d love to hear from you.

Dine opgaver

  • sikrer trivsel, engagement og klare rammer for et team bestående af 10 forretningskonsulenter, forretningsspecialister, applikationsspecialister og løsningsanalytikere
  • skaber sammenhæng og fælles retning på tværs af lokationer, da teamet er fordelt mellem Hillerød og Holstebro
  • omsætter forretningens behov til analyser, refinement og leverancer i tæt samarbejde med Product Lead og resten af teamet
  • sikrer stabil og effektiv eksekvering af teamets leverancer i et agilt setup med ansvar for både drift og udvikling
  • sikrer professionel håndtering af incidents, changes og øvrige driftsopgaver, så løsningerne understøtter forretningen stabilt og sikkert.
  • udarbejder roadmap for udvikling og forbedringer af understøttelsen af de forskellige ordninger og forretningsområder
  • navigerer i et komplekst interessentlandskab og skaber fremdrift, også når behov og prioriteringer skal balanceres
  • bidrager aktivt til lederfællesskabet i WorkZone-området og til samarbejdet på tværs af Internal Development.

Hvem er du?
Der er flere veje til jobbet, men vi forestiller os, at du har erfaring med personaleledelse i en større organisation og motiveres af at skabe resultater gennem andre.

Derudover ser vi gerne, at du:

  • har erfaring med at lede specialister og skabe retning i tværfaglige fagmiljøer
  • udvikler din ledelsespraksis gennem sparring og samarbejde med andre ledere
  • kan skabe fremdrift i opgaver og leverancer, også når interessenter har forskellige behov og perspektiver
  • har kendskab til sagsbehandlingsprocesser ogGDPR.
  • er fortrolig med agile arbejdsformer og gerne har erfaring fra et SAFe-inspireret setup
  • har erfaring med styring af driftsopgaver i et ITIL-miljø, herunder incident- og change management
  • har kendskab til WorkZone eller et tilsvarende ESDH-system. Det er en fordel, men ikke et krav.

Hvem er vi?
Du bliver en del af Internal Development i Digital Solutions, hvor vi udvikler, forvalter og forbedrer digitale løsninger, der understøtter ATP's kerneopgaver.

Vi arbejder i faste agile teams og kombinerer forretningsforståelse, teknologi og drift for at skabe stabile løsninger og løbende forbedringer.

Som leder bliver du en del af en arbejdsplads, der prioriterer netværk, sparring og ledergruppen som et værdiskabende fællesskab. Vi tror på, at en effektiv ledergruppe skaber merværdi, som ingen leder kan levere alene – for ATP, for ledergruppen og for den enkelte leder og vedkommendes medarbejdere.

Vi ser frem til at få dig med på holdet.

Dit næste skridt? Send dit CV
Send os dit CV senest onsdag den 30/9. Når du sender dit CV via vores system, får du mulighed for kort at beskrive din motivation for at søge stillingen.

I ATP arbejder vi for en fair rekrutteringsproces, og derfor beder vi dig om ikke at vedhæfte billede i dit CV eller angive din alder, når du søger.

Vi ansætter på baggrund af kompetencer og potentiale og opfordrer alle til at søge stillingen – uanset køn og kønsidentitet, etnicitet, national, social og kulturel baggrund, religion eller tro, seksuel orientering, funktionsnedsættelse og alder.

Du kan læse mere om rekrutteringsforløbet her:

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Flemming Bøge på FLBO@atp.dk eller 31 21 63 74.

_Af sikkerhedsmæssige årsager og for at beskytte værdier og datainfrastruktur indhenter ATP straffeattest på alle inden ansættelse, ligesom vi i forbindelse med indgåelse af kontrakten beder om at se en kopi af dit pas. Straffeattesten må ikke give anledning til bemærkninger og slettes umiddelbart efter, at den er vurderet.

Til annoncører og rekrutteringsbureauer: ATP frabeder sig uopfordrede henvendelser om annoncering, kandidater, produkter og ydelser i forbindelse med stillingsopslag og rekrutteringer. Vi beder om, at dette respekteres, og at vores ledere og medarbejdere ikke kontaktes i den henseende._

title: Claims Advisor, AB
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Claims Advisor, AB based in Canada.

As a Claims Advisor, you will manage complex first-party Accident Benefits claims and help customers navigate challenging situations with professionalism and empathy.
You’ll assess coverage, investigate claims, establish appropriate reserves, and negotiate settlements within your authority.
The role combines technical insurance knowledge, critical thinking, customer service, and careful file management.
You’ll communicate with claimants, vendors, medical professionals, lawyers, and internal teams throughout the claims process.
Working remotely, you’ll operate in a fast-paced environment while maintaining high standards for documentation, compliance, and service.
You’ll also collaborate closely with Accident Benefits Adjusters and Claims Assistants to resolve customer concerns and achieve effective outcomes.
This opportunity is well suited to an experienced insurance professional who values accountability, sound judgment, and meaningful customer interactions.

Accountabilities:

  • Interpret insurance policy wording, determine applicable coverage, and establish appropriate reserves for assigned Accident Benefits claims.
  • Investigate, negotiate, and settle moderate to highly complex claims through telephone, written correspondence, and in-person interactions where required.
  • Manage claims in accordance with established policies, procedures, best practices, and applicable legislative and regulatory requirements.
  • Maintain thorough and accurate claim files, ensuring documentation supports decisions and settlement activity.
  • Resolve claims within personal settlement authority and follow appropriate guidelines when matters exceed assigned authority.
  • Establish clear customer service expectations, take ownership of customer concerns, and proactively identify solutions to resolve problems.
  • Communicate professionally and effectively with claimants, vendors, medical professionals, legal representatives, and other stakeholders.
  • Work collaboratively with Accident Benefits Adjusters and Claims Assistants to support efficient and consistent claims handling.

    • Requirements:

    • Experience in Accident Benefits, Bodily Injury, Property Claims, Underwriting, Sales, or another relevant insurance environment.
    • Completion of a CIP designation, or a demonstrated interest and willingness to pursue the designation.
    • Strong critical-thinking and analytical skills, with the ability to assess claim strengths and weaknesses and make well-reasoned decisions.
    • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a strong commitment to delivering high-quality customer service.
    • Strong time-management and organizational abilities, with the capacity to prioritize effectively in a fast-paced, high-volume environment.
    • Ability to work independently while also contributing effectively within a collaborative team.
    • Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, sound judgment, and accountability.
    • Ability to interpret policy coverage, manage claim documentation, negotiate settlements, and work within regulatory requirements.

title: Full Stack Software Engineer, Launch Software
description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

FULL STACK SOFTWARE ENGINEER, LAUNCH SOFTWARE

The application software team is the central nervous system of SpaceX – we create mission critical applications that are used throughout SpaceX to accelerate launch vehicle production and flight as well as systems that allow Starlink to grow into a worldwide fast, reliable Internet service. We are looking for engineers who treat fellow teammates with fairness, respect, and support.

Our team is currently creating and evolving systems to enable rapid build and reuse of Starship as well as designing the next generation manufacturing software that will be used in high throughput factories for Starlink. Other applications range from platforms that support concurrent streams of data from many always-on assets to manage the world’s largest satellite constellation to public facing systems where customers can join our Starlink network globally. We work closely with engineers throughout the company to create and update our systems with respect to crewed launches, Starship flights, changes to the Starlink network and much more.

Aerospace experience is not required to be successful here - rather we look for smart, motivated, respectful, collaborative engineers who love solving problems and want to make an impact on a super inspiring mission. You will have full ownership of challenging problems, working with a team of enthusiastic engineers with diverse perspectives to design and produce solutions that enable SpaceX to move towards our goals at a rapid pace. The success of the missions at SpaceX depends on the software that you and your team produce.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Develop highly reliable software solutions that are used across SpaceX
  • Create new applications that improve how SpaceX operates
  • Build prototypes to prove out key design concepts and quantify technical constraints
  • Own all aspects of software engineering and product development
  • Deep dive into your users’ problems to find and create efficient solutions
  • Bring your voice to the table in team collaborations on architecture, design, and code reviews

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, math, or scientific discipline; OR 2+ years of professional experience building software in lieu of a degree
  • Experience in full stack development

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Programming experience in Python, C#.NET, Go, Scala, Java, or similar object-oriented language
  • 1+ years of rigorous experience building single page web applications
  • Experience with version control, continuous integration, and continuous delivery concepts
  • Expertise in designing software systems
  • Deep understanding of testing, continuous integration, build, deployment & monitoring
  • Expertise in profiling and improving application performance
  • Experience with build systems (Make, Bazel/Pants/Buck, Gradle) and package management tools (pip, npm)
  • Experience with UNIX-like operating systems and tools like Terraform, Ansible, Puppet for managing them
  • Experience working with in-stream data processing using Apache Kafka, RabbitMQ, ActiveMQ, or similar technologies
  • Production experience with Docker and Kubernetes
  • Front-end experience in Angular, React, or similar JavaScript framework
  • Database experience with PostgreSQL, SQL Server, or similar database technologies

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Must be willing to work extended hours and weekends as needed
  • Ability to pass Air Force background check for Cape Canaveral

ITAR REQUIREMENTS:

  • To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.
