title: Director, GTM Strategy, Planning & Analytics
description:
Articulate is seeking a Director of GTM Strategy, Planning & Analytics to lead and evolve how we translate company strategy into actionable go-to-market plans, measure business performance, govern the data foundations that support decision-making, and align compensation programs to GTM priorities across Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, and Channel.

This role leads an integrated function spanning GTM strategy and planning, forecasting and performance management, analytics and insights, GTM data strategy and governance, and compensation strategy and analytics.

The Director will own the end-to-end GTM planning system, translating company growth objectives into targets, capacity and resource plans, forecasts, performance frameworks, and operating rhythms. The role will ensure GTM leaders have clear, decision-ready insights into business performance, risks, opportunities, and tradeoffs.

The Director will also provide leadership for GTM data strategy and governance, ensuring that the business logic, metric definitions, data standards, and cross-system requirements underlying GTM decision-making are scalable, consistent, and trusted. In partnership with centralized Data, Engineering, IT, and other teams, this role will establish GTM priorities and requirements while those technical organizations retain responsibility for technical architecture and development.

As the leader of this function, the Director will define priorities and operating models, develop managers and senior individual contributors, and partner closely with GTM, Finance, Data, IT, and executive stakeholders to operationalize company strategy and improve GTM performance.

What you'll do:

    GTM Strategy, Planning & Operating System

    • Lead the end-to-end GTM planning system, including annual and quarterly planning, forecasting, target setting, capacity planning, resource allocation, and performance management.
    • Translate company growth objectives and strategic priorities into aligned GTM targets, resource plans, and execution strategies across functions, segments, regions, and products.
    • Establish and continuously improve GTM operating rhythms, including planning cycles, forecast reviews, executive business reviews, and performance-management processes.
    • Develop scalable planning frameworks, governance models, and operating standards that enable GTM teams to adapt to changing business priorities.
    • Evaluate strategic tradeoffs across GTM investments and develop recommendations regarding capacity, coverage, demand generation, retention, enablement, and other GTM investments.
    • Partner with Finance and GTM leadership on scenario planning, investment decisions, and resource allocation.

    Business Performance, Analytics & Insights

    • Define performance measurement frameworks that provide consistent visibility into GTM health across the customer lifecycle.
    • Lead the development of analytics and insights that enable GTM leaders to understand performance, identify risks and opportunities, and make informed business decisions.
    • Ensure forecasting, pipeline, funnel, retention, productivity, and other critical GTM performance measures are clearly defined and consistently understood.
    • Translate complex business performance into clear, decision-ready insights and recommendations.
    • Identify emerging performance trends and develop recommendations to improve near- and medium-term GTM effectiveness.
    • Establish priorities for GTM analytics based on business impact and ensure analytical resources are focused on the highest-value questions.

    GTM Data Strategy & Governance

    • Lead the GTM data strategy and governance function, establishing priorities for the integrity, scalability, and evolution of the GTM data foundation.
    • Ensure consistent GTM business logic, metric definitions, dimensions, and data standards across systems, reporting, and business processes.
    • Establish governance for GTM data definitions, lineage, quality, and usage in partnership with Data, Engineering, IT, Finance, and GTM stakeholders.
    • Ensure GTM business requirements are clearly defined and aligned before technical development begins.
    • Oversee prioritization of GTM data initiatives and make recommendations regarding sequencing, dependencies, business impact, and tradeoffs.
    • Ensure data structures and governed data assets support critical GTM use cases including forecasting, pipeline management, compensation, retention, planning, and performance measurement.
    • Partner with centralized Data and technical organizations to ensure GTM requirements inform technical roadmaps while maintaining clear accountability between business ownership and technical execution.
    • Improve adoption and understanding of governed data assets, metrics, and BI capabilities across GTM.

    Compensation Strategy & Analytics

    • Lead GTM compensation strategy and planning in partnership with GTM and Finance leadership.
    • Ensure compensation programs align with company objectives, GTM priorities, targets, quotas, and desired business outcomes.
    • Lead compensation modeling and analytics to evaluate program effectiveness, cost, performance, and behavioral impact.
    • Establish governance and decision frameworks for compensation design and changes.
    • Partner with GTM leadership on quota and incentive strategy and provide recommendations regarding tradeoffs and program design.
    • Ensure compensation planning is integrated with broader capacity, target, resource, and financial planning.
    Strategic Decision Support & Cross-Functional Leadership
    • Serve as a strategic partner to GTM, Finance, Data, IT, and other functional leaders.
    • Structure complex and ambiguous GTM problems, bringing together business context, data, financial implications, and operational considerations.
    • Develop recommendations regarding GTM priorities, investments, organizational tradeoffs, and performance improvement.
    • Lead cross-functional strategic initiatives from problem definition through recommendation and implementation.
    • Collaborate with senior leaders to turn company strategy into actionable GTM plans and ensure alignment across functions.
    • Communicate plans, performance, risks, recommendations, and tradeoffs clearly to senior and executive stakeholders.

    Leadership & Organizational Development

    • Lead and develop a multidisciplinary organization spanning strategy, planning, analytics, data strategy, and compensation.
    • Translate functional priorities into clear objectives, execution plans, and measurable outcomes.
    • Coach managers and individual contributors toward outcomes, impact, and increasingly strategic thinking.
    • Establish clear accountability and decision rights across the function.
    • Build cross-functional relationships that enable the team to operate effectively across organizational boundaries.
    • Continuously evolve the team's capabilities, processes, and operating model as business needs change.
    • Create clarity around priorities and ensure the organization remains focused on its highest-impact work.

What you should have:

  • 12+ years of experience in GTM strategy, business operations, revenue operations, planning, analytics, data strategy, or related functions, preferably within B2B SaaS.
  • 5+ years of people leadership experience, including experience leading managers and/or senior individual contributors.
  • Proven experience leading GTM planning, forecasting, target setting, capacity planning, and performance management.
  • Strong understanding of GTM analytics, SaaS metrics, customer lifecycle performance, and executive decision support.
  • Experience with GTM data strategy, metric governance, data definitions, and the relationship between business requirements and modern data ecosystems.
  • Experience with compensation strategy, quota planning, incentive design, compensation analytics, or closely related planning disciplines.
  • Demonstrated ability to structure ambiguous business problems and translate complex information into actionable recommendations.
  • Strong systems thinking and understanding of dependencies across CRM, data warehouse, BI, planning, and GTM execution environments.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Finance, Data, IT, and other functions.
  • Strong leadership, communication, prioritization, and judgment.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

title: Software & Firmware Engineering Experts
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for Software & Firmware Engineering Experts based in India.

This is a hands-on engineering opportunity for experienced professionals working at the intersection of software, firmware, digital hardware, and real-world physical systems.
You will apply deep technical expertise to complex engineering and AI research initiatives involving embedded systems and hardware-connected software.
The role spans areas such as embedded firmware, FPGA/RTL, flight software, hardware test automation, and system-level integration.
You will evaluate architectures, implementation decisions, testing approaches, and failure modes under real-world hardware constraints.
Your practical experience in development, hardware bring-up, debugging, verification, validation, and deployment will directly inform technically rigorous engineering work.
The opportunity is particularly suited to engineers who enjoy solving complex problems and applying production-grade engineering judgment.
You will work remotely and contribute your expertise to projects designed to advance the capabilities of AI systems in sophisticated engineering domains.

Accountabilities:

  • Apply hands-on software, firmware, and digital hardware expertise to technically complex engineering tasks involving real physical systems.
  • Review and evaluate embedded firmware, FPGA/RTL designs, flight software, test automation frameworks, hardware interfaces, and system-level engineering workflows.
  • Analyze architecture and implementation trade-offs involving real-time performance, timing, memory, compute resources, interfaces, reliability, fault handling, concurrency, and hardware/software integration.
  • Assess the technical correctness, robustness, scalability, and practical feasibility of engineering solutions for embedded and hardware-connected systems.
  • Identify implementation errors, incorrect assumptions, race conditions, timing issues, interface failures, resource constraints, and other system-level failure modes.
  • Develop or review technically rigorous engineering problems, reference implementations, test cases, evaluation criteria, and supporting technical documentation.
  • Apply practical experience across software development, system integration, hardware bring-up, debugging, verification, validation, test automation, and deployment.

  • Evaluate engineering approaches and solutions with consideration for reliability, performance, maintainability, and hardware/software interactions.

    • Requirements:

    • 5+ years of professional experience in software, firmware, FPGA, embedded systems, or a closely related engineering discipline, including at least 3 years of recent, hands-on experience working with real hardware.
    • Demonstrated experience taking responsibility for production hardware-connected software or firmware across meaningful stages of the lifecycle, from requirements and architecture through implementation, integration, bring-up, verification, debugging, and deployment.
    • Deep technical expertise in at least one core area: embedded firmware and real-time systems; FPGA/RTL design and verification; flight software and safety- or mission-critical systems; or hardware test automation and hardware-in-the-loop infrastructure.
    • Strong practical command of relevant technologies such as C/C++, Python, RTOS, bare-metal development, device drivers, bootloaders, embedded Linux, SPI, I²C, UART, CAN, Ethernet, Verilog, SystemVerilog, VHDL, FPGA toolchains, telemetry, and automated test systems, as applicable to your specialization.
    • Extensive experience debugging software-hardware interactions and physical systems using tools such as JTAG/SWD debuggers, logic analyzers, oscilloscopes, hardware simulators or emulators, HIL/SIL environments, automated test equipment, and CI infrastructure.

    • Experience in industries such as aerospace and defense, space, automotive and EV, semiconductors, consumer electronics, robotics, eVTOL, industrial technology, energy, or medical devices is highly relevant.

    • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with excellent attention to technical detail.
    • Ability to work independently and communicate complex technical concepts clearly in a remote environment.
    • Strong practical engineering judgment and a willingness to engage deeply with technically challenging problems.

description:

About the role

You will join a small, senior team, building and running a commercial real estate platform. You will pick up work at the feature level and take it through database schema, API, front end, tests and production. Most weeks that means some C# and some TypeScript. Some weeks it means Terraform or a Lambda. You will own features end to end: schema, API, UI and deployment.

  • Design and build features across the .NET API and the React front end.

  • Take a turn on production triage. Alarms come to the team, not to a separate ops group.

  • A FinTech or financial software background: banking, payments, accounting, payroll or similar. Somewhere the numbers had to be right. MUST HAVE!

  • Substantial commercial experience in C# and .NET, with real opinions about how an API should be structured.

  • Equally substantial React and TypeScript experience. This is a genuine full-stack role and both halves are weighted the same.

  • Enjoy and up for the fast-paced startup-to-scale-up environment

  • Comfort with relational data modelling and schema change under zero-downtime constraints.

  • A real testing habit. Our test suite is not decoration and we would like to keep it that way.

  • Shipped LLM features in production, with an understanding of how they fail.

  • Daily use of AI coding agents on a real codebase.

  • The judgement to work without a lot of process, and the discipline not to need it.

About us

LeaseSuite builds commercial real estate software. Our platform is what property and finance teams run their portfolios and their deals on, from the leases themselves through to the financials attached to them. Our customers are multi-site occupiers across Australia/New Zealand and will push into global regions, and the numbers we show them are relied on for reporting, audit and decision-making. We are a small team with a large surface area.

    • Manage and troubleshoot Windows Server infrastructure (2016/2019/2022) at an advanced level, including Active Directory design, Group Policy architecture, DNS/DHCP, DFS, and Certificate Services
    • Oversee VMware ESXi and virtualization environments including capacity planning, performance optimization, host management, and migration strategies

    • Manage Cisco Meraki environments at scale, including complex wireless deployments, SD-WAN, switch stacking, and security appliance policies
    • Design, configure, and troubleshoot SSL VPN and IPsec VPN solutions across multiple client environments
    • Perform advanced Cisco networking tasks including routing configuration (OSPF, BGP basics), ACLs, inter-VLAN routing, and spanning tree optimization

  • Desktop and Endpoint Expertise

    • Architect Group Policy structures and manage complex AD environments across multiple client tenants
  • Client Relationship and Service Coordination
    • Liaise directly with client stakeholders on escalated issues, service reviews, and change management activities
    • Support client onboarding and handover processes, ensuring smooth transitions and comprehensive documentation
    • Collaborate with the account management teams on client escalations, service improvement plans, and quarterly business reviews
    • Contribute to pre-sales technical assessments and scoping for new client engagements
  • Automation, Process Improvement, and Jira Workflow Management
    • Design and implement automation solutions using PowerShell, Azure Automation, and other scripting tools to eliminate manual overhead and improve operational efficiency
    • Own and optimize Jira Service Management workflows, SLA configurations, dashboards, and reporting for the Cloud Operations team
    • Manage Jira project boards for change management, infrastructure projects, and operational improvement initiatives
    • Lead process improvement initiatives across the service desk, including SLA optimization, ticket workflow refinement, and monitoring enhancements
    • Evaluate and recommend new tools, technologies, and processes to enhance the team’s capabilities and service delivery

QUALIFICATIONS
  • Experience
    • Minimum 5+ years of experience in a third line (L3) or senior helpdesk/service desk/cloud operations role within an MSP or MSSP environment
    • At least 2 years of experience in a technical leadership, senior escalation, or mentorship capacity
    • Extensive experience supporting enterprise Windows environments, Microsoft Azure, Office 365, and hybrid infrastructure
    • Proven track record leading major incident resolution and driving root cause analysis in client facing environments with stringent SLAs

  • Technical Skills

    • Advanced Windows Server administration (2016/2019/2022): AD architecture, GPO design, DNS/DHCP, DFS, Certificate Services, and PowerShell automation
    • Expert-level Windows desktop troubleshooting and endpoint management (Intune, Autopilot, SCCM/MECM)
    • Advanced networking: TCP/IP, VLANs, routing (OSPF, BGP basics), subnetting, wireless enterprise design, and WAN optimization
    • Strong Fortinet FortiGate experience: advanced firewall policies, SD-WAN, VPN (SSL and IPsec), IPS/IDS, and HA configurations
    • Advanced Cisco Meraki management and intermediate Cisco IOS networking (switching, routing, ACLs)

title: Business Analyst
description:
Are you ready to be the catalyst for change in a fast paced, forward-thinking organisation? As a member of our team, you won't just work for the city; you’ll co-create it. Here, your ideas and efforts directly shape the places where you and your community live, work, and play.

City of Newcastle (CN) has a Fixed-Term opportunity until 23 November 2028 for a dynamic Business Analyst who thrives on solving complex problems, translating business needs into actionable insights and driving innovation across teams.

What you’ll be doing

Through your work, you’ll have a behind the scenes pass to Newcastle's evolution as you shape our future as a liveable, inclusive city. You will be at the heart of transformation, bridging the gap between IT and business, shaping future-state processes and influencing strategic outcomes. This role will suit a Business Analyst who enjoys unpacking complex problems, facilitating meaningful conversations, analysing business processes and translating business needs into clear, actionable requirements.

You will:

  • Plan and facilitate workshops with stakeholders from across the organisation.

  • Analyse business problems, needs, processes and opportunities for improvement.

  • Map current-state and future-state business processes using BPMN.

  • Elicit, analyse and document business, functional and non-functional requirements.

  • Identify pain points, gaps, business rules, risks and dependencies.

  • Apply structured analysis techniques, including root cause and fit/gap analysis where appropriate.

  • Develop and maintain requirements traceability and other fit-for-purpose BA artefacts.

  • Work collaboratively with project managers, architects, technical specialists and business subject matter experts.

  • Support solution design, testing and implementation to help ensure delivered solutions meet identified business needs.

And we’ll be there for you in important times in your life. We embrace flexible work arrangements to find a balance that allows us to enjoy the city we shape.

Our focus on inclusion and respecting culture, will help you feel a deeper connection with others. You'll connect with internal communities that will help you to feel a sense of belonging and reflect the diversity of the growing region.

Life at City of Newcastle (CN)

You’ll get to experience your work up close alongside the brilliant minds of your colleagues who care for one another and the region.

You’ll chip away at ambitious plans with a talented, passionate crew alongside you, shaping the very fabric of our community. Showing up for neighbours not shareholders.

Every single day offers the chance to think big and act local. Planning and prioritising to achieve the most important outcomes with the community.

You’ll add value in the moments that matter. From librarians to lifeguards, in a range of iconic places, we achieve a better Newcastle together.

Whether we’re planning to host major events, providing essential services or supporting creative artists, it’s what we do when the cameras aren't rolling that matters most.

You’ll do meaningful work and do it sustainably as you take ideas from plan to play, in your own backyard.

With hundreds of different roles, each person adds their uniqueness to our culture and plays their part as we head towards our 2040 vision.

With natural assets and a focus on the environment, co-create a sustainable region with us.

Why join CN?

At CN, we value our employees, and their wellbeing takes priority. We encourage employees to make time for what's important and provide the benefits to enable a work life balance that allow us to enjoy the city we shape. To read more, visit here!

People with diverse lived experiences (including but not limited to, Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Australians, people with diverse gender identities and sexualities, people from different cultural, racial, ethnic, religious and linguistic backgrounds, people with disability, carers, and veterans) are encouraged to apply.

title: Jurister til juridisk sagsbehandling på SU-området
description:
Har du lyst til at arbejde med klagesagsbehandling, forvaltningsret og juridiske afklaringer på SU-området? Kan du omsætte komplekse regler til konkrete afgørelser og løsninger? Og vil du være en del af et fagligt miljø, der løfter en vigtig samfundsopgave for studerende i hele Danmark? Så er du en af de jurister, vi søger.

Som en af vores nye jurister kommer du til at arbejde med juridisk sagsbehandling, fortolkning af regler og afklaring af komplekse juridiske problemstillinger på et område med en høj grad af digitalisering. Du bliver en del af et fagligt miljø, hvor juridisk kvalitet, samarbejde og sparring er afgørende for opgaveløsningen.

Samtidig får du mulighed for at arbejde med en vigtig samfundsopgave i nye rammer. Pr. 1. oktober bliver SU-området en del af ATP, og du bliver en del af et område, hvor størstedelen af dine kolleger kommer med stor erfaring og dyb viden om uddannelsesstøtteområdet.

Opgaverne er velkendte, men rammerne er nye. Derfor får du mulighed for at være med til at forme samarbejder, processer og arbejdsgange, samtidig med at vi sikrer en stabil og sikker administration af en ordning, der har stor betydning for studerende i hele Danmark.

Dine opgaver:
Som jurist i Tværgående får du en central rolle i den juridiske sagsbehandling på uddannelsesstøtteområdet. Du kommer blandt andet til at:

  • behandle klagesager og andre juridisk komplekse sager
  • afklare spørgsmål om regler, praksis og fortolkning
  • bidrage til ensartet administration gennem juridiske vurderinger og faglige afklaringer
  • yde juridisk støtte og sparring til kolleger og sagsbehandlere
  • deltage i vores juridiske netværk og øvrige tværgående opgaver
  • bidrage til udvikling af processer og arbejdsgange på området.

Hvem er du?
Der er flere veje til jobbet.

Måske arbejder du allerede med juridisk sagsbehandling og forvaltningsretlige problemstillinger. Måske er du tidligere i din karriere og har lyst til at udvikle din juridiske faglighed i praksis. Det vigtigste er, at du trives med at sætte dig ind i komplekse regler og finde løsninger, der fungerer juridisk og i hverdagen.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • er uddannet cand.jur. eller cand.merc.jur.
  • har erfaring med eller interesse for juridisk sagsbehandling
  • har et godt kendskab til forvaltningsretlige problemstillinger
  • kan forstå, anvende og formidle komplekse regler og juridiske vurderinger
  • formulerer dig præcist i skrift og tale
  • arbejder struktureret og bevarer overblikket over dine opgaver
  • tager ansvar for dine opgaver, er opsøgende og bidrager aktivt til samarbejdet med dine kolleger.

Det er en fordel, men ikke et krav, hvis du har erfaring med EU-ret eller interesse for uddannelsesområdet.

Hvem er vi?
I Tværgående arbejder vi med bl.a. med afklaring af juridiske spørgsmål, sagsbehandling, processer og udvikling på uddannelsesstøtteområdet. Vi løser opgaverne i tæt samarbejde med kolleger på tværs af området og bruger hinanden aktivt til faglig sparring.

Pr. 1. oktober bliver SU-området en del af ATP. Du bliver derfor en del af et veletableret fagmiljø med stor viden om uddannelsesstøtteområdet, samtidig med at du bliver en del af ATP's fællesskab og samfundsopgave. Her får du mulighed for at arbejde tæt sammen med kolleger, der kender området i dybden, og som hver dag bidrager til at gøre en forskel for det samfund, vi er en del af.

Et sundt arbejdsliv kræver en fleksibel arbejdsplads med plads til den enkelte medarbejder – og det har vi.

Vi ser fleksibilitet som en gensidig interesse, hvor vi sammen har fokus på trivsel, opgaveløsning og borgernes behov. Hjemmearbejde og anden fleksibilitet kan aftales med din leder.

Vi går op i godt kollegaskab, og vi insisterer på en venlig arbejdskultur – med nær ledelse, personlig udvikling, sammenhold og sundhed.

For ATP skal være et godt sted at gå på arbejde.

Dit næste skridt? Send os dit CV
Send os dit CV senest onsdag d. 30. september.

Når du sender dit CV via vores system, får du mulighed for kort at beskrive din motivation for at søge stillingen.

I ATP arbejder vi for en fair rekrutteringsproces, og derfor beder vi dig om ikke at vedhæfte billede i dit CV eller angive din alder, når du søger.

Vi ansætter på baggrund af kompetencer og potentiale og opfordrer alle til at søge stillingen – uanset køn og kønsidentitet, etnicitet, national, social og kulturel baggrund, religion eller tro, seksuel orientering, funktionsnedsættelse og alder.

Du kan læse mere om rekrutteringsforløbet her:

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte kontorchef Thomas Fogtmann på 7231 7975 eller P&C-partner John Brandt på 2115 8855.

Af sikkerhedsmæssige årsager og for at beskytte værdier og datainfrastruktur beder vi om straffeattest, kopi af dit pas og eventuelt eksamensbevis. Straffeattesten må ikke give anledning til bemærkninger, og dokumenterne slettes umiddelbart efter vurdering.

Til annoncører og rekrutteringsbureauer: ATP frabeder sig uopfordrede henvendelser om annoncering, kandidater, produkter og ydelser i forbindelse med stillingsopslag og rekrutteringer. Vi beder om, at dette respekteres, og at vores ledere og medarbejdere ikke kontaktes i den henseende.

title: System Software Engineer
company: Hyundai Motor Group Innovation Center Singapore
description:
Your Mission

This position is responsible for developing simulation platforms, virtual models, and testing methods to support the deployment and validation of mobile robot fleets across manufacturing and logistics environments. It requires a strong software engineering foundation and practical experience in real-time system modelling, simulation design, or platform development. Experience in game development, simulation, autonomous vehicles, industrial automation, software systems, or applied research is relevant, while familiarity with advanced robotics simulation platforms such as NVIDIA Isaac Sim or Omniverse would be advantageous but is not mandatory.

What To Expect
  • Design and develop simulation software modules that model the behaviour of manufacturing and logistics systems and mobile robot fleets
  • Build modular, reusable simulation components that can be configured and deployed across different operational environments
  • Develop data pipelines, APIs, and connectors for integration with industrial systems, databases, middleware, and automation platforms
  • Apply simulation concepts such as event-driven systems, state machines, and continuous-time modelling to represent real-world operational behaviour
  • Support the development of digital twin models for robot fleets, logistics systems, and system interactions, including sim-to-real fidelity assessment
  • Work with simulation engines and frameworks such as Unity, Unreal Engine, Gazebo, Plant Simulation, AnyLogic, SimPy, NVIDIA Isaac Sim, or similar platforms to build and validate digital twins
  • Define test cases, acceptance criteria, KPIs, and methods for sim-to-real validation
  • Support technical documentation, software requirements, and engineering sprint reviews
  • Collaborate with robotics, automation, factory operations, data, and software teams
  • Prepare clear technical materials for internal stakeholders and management reporting
What You'll Bring
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Physics, Mathematics, Mechatronics, Automation Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
  • At least 3 years of professional software engineering experience in simulation, real-time or autonomous systems, game engines, backend platforms, industrial automation, logistics software, or applied computational modelling
  • Strong programming skills in Python and/or C++
  • Experience developing maintainable software, APIs, data pipelines, or simulation applications
  • Understanding of simulation concepts, including event-driven systems, state machines, time synchronisation, distributed systems, kinematics, motion dynamics, and rigid-body mechanics
  • Experience with simulation engines or frameworks such as Unity, Unreal Engine, Gazebo, AnyLogic, FlexSim, SimPy, Plant Simulation, NVIDIA Isaac Sim, or Omniverse
  • Experience with digital twin development, physical model validation, or sim-to-real workflows
  • Experience with SQL, data schemas, logs, time-series data, and data-quality validation
  • Experience with REST APIs, MQTT, gRPC, Protobuf, or other messaging and communication protocols
  • Experience with ROS/ROS2, URDF/SDF, robot model imports, or sensor simulation
  • Familiarity with AMR/AGV systems, fleet simulation, traffic control, or robot fleet management
  • Experience integrating with industrial and factory automation platforms such as MES, WMS, PLC, SCADA, and OPC UA, including communication standards such as VDA 5050
  • Experience with Docker, Git, CI/CD, automated testing, and engineering documentation
  • Exposure to automotive manufacturing, smart factories, logistics or warehouse automation, or industrial robotics
  • Ability to work effectively across software, operations, manufacturing, and cross-functional engineering teams

title: Medical Lead - INTERNAL
description:
Summary/Objective:

The PLH Medical Lead position is responsible for being a clinical leader in the organization in terms of clinical mentorship, capacity to train new providers, and being the champion for PLH policy and procedures. A person in this position would exemplify a commitment to the PLH mission and values, an understanding of the importance of championing new and established policies and procedures working closely with the Medical Lead team and Medical Directors to support new policies. The position requires a willingness to be collaborative, positive, and solutions-based as a team member for PLH providers. The lead position includes being part of the PLH clinical pool which requires the provider to be accessible to fellow providers to discuss and process clinical issues that can arise through the day. The lead position can include leading PLH’s success in our MOD program to collaborate with partnerships to ensure the program is running smoothly and patients are being seen within the MOD hours at an appropriate rate. Also making sure the glossary is up to date.

Responsibilities:

  • Meets all the above PLH medical provider expectations
  • Clinical expert resource to other PLH medical providers in the area of provider policies
  • Acts as a lead virtual trainer and clinical support resource for new PLH medical providers, including clinical onboarding, orientation, workflow education, documentation expectations, and ongoing development support.
  • Provider/chart reviews when needed- will co-sign responsibilities as needed
  • Mentors, promotes, and fully supports adherence to PLH Clinical and Administrative Policies
  • Assists with outreach and standardization of the PLH MOD platform. Provides ongoing support to administration staff and providers
  • Promotes adherence to FRC Clinical and Administrative Policies
  • Reviews clinical quality trends and assists in identifying opportunities for improvement on workflows.
  • Performs other duties as assigned by PLH Clinical Leadership.

Qualifications:

Must be a virtual provider with experience caring for MOD patients.

  • Must have a minimum of two (2) years of provider experience.
  • Must consistently meet Medical Lead productivity and performance expectations.
  • Demonstrated excellence in clinical documentation, compliance standards, and quality patient care.
  • Demonstrated ability to mentor, coach, and support fellow providers.
  • Strong communication, collaboration, and leadership skills.
  • Demonstrated commitment to the PLH mission, values, patient-centered care, and continuous improvement.
  • Ability to identify challenges, recommend solutions, and support implementation of organizational initiatives.

Job Breakdown:

The Medical Lead is a full-time (40-hour per week), exempt salary position
that includes maintaining clinical provider responsibilities while dedicating designated administrative time to leadership responsibilities.

Administrative responsibilities may include provider mentorship, onboarding support, chart reviews, MOD program support, workflow standardization, and policy implementation.

Clinical hours will be scheduled based on organizational needs. Administrative time will be a minimum of two (2) hours per month or additional time as approved by the Medical Directors and Executive Team based on clinical business needs.

The Medical Lead provides clinical leadership and mentorship but does not assume the responsibilities of the Senior Medical Lead or Medical Director roles.

Salary: Internal Promotion, standard 1-3% increase of base salary

title: Solution Architect
description:
Sitting at the intersection of sales and delivery, this role partners with Sales and Delivery teams to shape compelling, feasible solutions, produce High-Level Solution Overviews and POCs, evaluate solution blueprints, and guarantee seamless handovers to Execute delivery teams.



KEY RELATIONSHIPS



  • Head of Engineering: Direct reporting line for technical pre-sales strategy, solution architecture, and practice alignment.
  • Sales Directors and Marketing: Collaborate on pitches, RFPs, commercial estimates, and thought leadership campaigns.
  • Envision & Explore Teams: Partner during discovery phases to refine current state and detail future state architectures.
  • Execute Delivery Teams: Lead structured handovers, capturing pre-sales intent, assumptions, and solution blueprints.
  • Senior Client Technical Leaders: Act as go-to technical advisor, understanding business goals and technical roadmaps.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES


Technical Sales Support and Account Advisory


  • Collaborate with Sales Directors to develop and deliver compelling pitches, proposals, RFPs, and RFIs, providing technical validation to ensure proposed solutions are accurate and feasible.
  • Actively participate in client calls and discovery sessions to capture business and technical requirements for internal teams.
  • Provide estimates, feasibility checks, and margin awareness to support commercial decisions early in the sales cycle.
  • Collaborate with Marketing and the wider RUSH team to create compelling collateral, campaigns, and thought leadership tailored to our services.
  • Develop deep, trusted relationships with senior technical leaders and decision-makers within key accounts, acting as their go-to advisor to influence strategy and position our solutions as integral to their success.


Solution Definition, Estimation and AI Positioning


  • Translate client requirements into clear high-level solution options and risks for internal teams and clients.
  • Develop solution concepts, present/deliver them clearly to clients, and create proof-of-concepts (POCs) to demonstrate feasibility.
  • Provide estimates and confirm feasibility of proposed approaches, ensuring operational alignment and healthy margins.
  • Evaluate emerging AI architectures, agentic systems, and vendor tools to incorporate cutting-edge AI capability into client pre-sales proposals and solution designs.
  • Articulate AI risks, feasibility, cost models, and data governance frameworks to client stakeholders during pre-sales and Envision phases.


Technical Enablement & Execution Handover


  • Act as the bridge between Sales, Envision, and Explore phases to the Execute Delivery team, ensuring all pre-sales knowledge, assumptions, and solution intent are captured in a structured way that sets projects up for success.
  • Partner with Delivery people to align client expectations with operational capabilities and delivery realities.
  • Produce and maintain High-Level Solution Overviews (HLSOs) summarizing business context, key requirements, assumptions, risks, and proposed solution approach for each opportunity.
  • Serve as the primary technical authority in pre-sales engagements, establishing trust by articulating technical solutions and knowledge, and adding strategic value.
  • Guarantee project success from the outset by delivering a well-documented and robust handover, empowering delivery teams to proceed with a clear, unambiguous understanding of the solution and client objectives.

title: Pædagog søges til et lille børnehus med stort hjerte
description:
Pædagog søges til et lille børnehus med stort hjerte
Forestil dig en arbejdsdag, hvor du mødes af børn, der glæder sig til at se dig, kollegaer der løfter i flok, og et børnehus, hvor stærke relationer går hånd i hånd med faglig refleksion, udvikling og en tydelig pædagogisk retning. Sådan er hverdagen i Børnehuset Kastaniegården.

Børnehuset Kastaniegården er en del af Børneinstitution Nord, som omfatter otte børnehuse i områderne Næsby, Søhus, Stige og Lumby.
Vi er et lille børnehus med 34 fantastiske børn, en stor legeplads, masser af grønne områder lige udenfor døren og en hverdag, hvor vi bruger naturen og lokalområdet aktivt. Her er der plads til både vilde lege, nysgerrige spørgsmål, fordybelse og stærke fællesskaber.

Hvem er vi?
I Kastaniegården tror vi på, at de bedste dage skabes sammen.
Vi tror på, at stærke børnefællesskaber skabes af engagerede og reflekterede voksne. Derfor arbejder vi aktivt med at skabe deltagelsesmuligheder for alle børn, styrke deres trivsel, udvikling og læring samt udvikle vores pædagogiske praksis gennem refleksion, sparring og fælles ansvar.
Vi er en arbejdsplads, hvor du får lov til at være med til at præge hverdagen. Nye idéer er velkomne, og vi sætter pris på medarbejdere, der tør byde ind med tanker, forslag og initiativer.

Hvem er du?
Måske er du nyuddannet.
Måske har du mange års erfaring.
For os er det vigtigste ikke, hvor længe du har været pædagog.

Det vigtigste er, at du:

  • Har lyst til at være sammen med børn
  • Er nysgerrig på deres perspektiver
  • Bidrager til fællesskabet
  • Har lyst til at udvikle dig og lære nyt
Vi søger en kollega, der møder børn, forældre og kollegaer med varme, engagement og lysten til at bidrage til fællesskabet.

Hos os får du

  • Et lille og overskueligt børnehus med 34 børn.
  • Dygtige og hjælpsomme kollegaer.
  • En nærværende ledelse, som gerne vil høre dine idéer.
  • Et stærkt fællesskab blandt både børn og voksne.
  • Mulighed for at sætte dit eget præg på hverdagen.
  • En grundig introduktion, så du kommer godt fra start.
  • En arbejdsplads med fokus på faglig udvikling, samarbejde og trivsel.
Lyder det som noget for dig?
Så send os din ansøgning.
Fortæl os gerne lidt om dig selv, hvad der giver dig arbejdsglæde, og hvorfor du kunne se dig selv i Kastaniegården.

Er du nysgerrig på stedet, så er du meget velkommen til at kontakte daglig pædagogisk leder for en rundvisning. Vi viser gerne huset frem, for vi oplever, at Kastaniegården er et sted, der skal opleves. Her får du mulighed for at mærke stemningen, møde os og få et indblik i hverdagen.
Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig

I Odense kommune arbejder vi med fuldtids- og livsfasepolitik. Målet med fuldtidspolitikken er at give medarbejderne mulighed for et bedre forsørgelsesgrundlag, både i løbet af arbejdslivet, men også efter pensionering.

På dagtilbudsområdet har vi fokus på, at fuldtidsansættelse er udgangspunktet. Samtidigt har vi fokus på, at livsfaser kan betyde behov for nedsat tid i kortere eller længere perioder. Der vil derfor være løbende dialog i løbet af ansættelsen med fokus på arbejdstiden og det overordnede mål om ansættelse på fuld tid.



Løn og ansættelsesforhold

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår i henhold til gældende overenskomst mellem KL og den forhandlingsberettigede organisation.



Vil du vide mere?
Du er meget velkommen til at kontakte Cecilie Hauge Malling, daglig pædagogisk leder på mobil:
20 16 98 51 eller på mail: ceham@odense.dk


Det praktiske

Ansøgningsfristen er søndag d. 18. oktober.
Vi holder løbende samtaler og rekrutteringsprocessen forventes afslutte i uge 44.

Our services span collectible trading cards, autographs, comic books, coins, video games, event tickets, and memorabilia. Our subsidiaries include PSA, PCGS, Beckett, SGC, and Card Ladder. Since our founding in 1986, we have graded and authenticated millions of items, and today we employ more than 3,000 people across our headquarters in Santa Ana, California and offices in New Jersey, Texas, Florida, Japan, Shanghai, Hong Kong, Canada, Mexico, Germany, and France.


We're transforming the collecting experience with technology that brings authentication, grading, and trading into the modern era. Our products are equalizing the playing field by providing tools that make complex research analytics — including pricing, scarcity reports, and historic sales data — accessible to every collector, old or new. Our Product & Engineering mission is to democratize technology while promoting innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning throughout the organization.


About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to build the PSA Liquidity Platform — the product suite that connects supply and demand across our marketplace, including PSA Partner Offers and our eBay Consignment platform.

PSA Partner Offers is a first-party marketplace that sources offers from our network of buyers and surfaces them as instant, targeted offers to grading and vault customers. Our eBay consignment business allows customers to seamlessly sell on the world's largest marketplace while we handle every step of fulfillment as eBay's official vault partner.

You'll own the technical design and delivery of the end-to-end buyer and seller experiences, partnering with a dedicated cross-functional team (business, product, engineering, design, data) to seamlessly connect supply and demand. This is a high-visibility, high-impact role on our Marketplace engineering team, building systems that maximize GMV, conversion, and offer-to-sale velocity at scale.

We believe there is significant value in onsite partnership and team collaboration, and candidates within 1-hour commuting distance of the office may be expected to work onsite most of the time. Additional details will be discussed during the recruiting process.


What You'll Do

  • Build powerful buyer tooling. Lead development of our next-generation buyer platform: targeting, campaign management, budget controls, and analytics that let every type of buyer — from individual collectors to large-scale dealers — discover and acquire the right cards at scale.
  • Build and optimize the offer pricing engine. Partner with Engineering and AI/ML to build a sophisticated, real-time targeting and ranking engine that maximizes marketplace GMV, conversion, and offer-to-sale velocity across channels.
  • Elevate the seller experience. Make it effortless for sellers to understand their options, price their items accurately, and complete a sale via the PSA Partner Offer or eBay Consignment channel with minimal friction.
  • Architect for scale. Design and operate microservices and distributed, event-driven systems that power instant, accurate offers across millions of collectibles — with the low latency and reliability our customers expect. You'll make pragmatic, high-conviction architecture calls and own the quality of what you ship across the full stack.
  • Take an AI-first approach to building. Use AI tooling across the development lifecycle to move faster and raise quality, and bring a strong point of view on how AI changes the way we design, build, and operate software.
  • Own outcomes end-to-end. Take projects from 0 to 1 — from an ambiguous problem to a shipped, instrumented, production product — and wear whatever hat the moment requires, whether that's frontend, backend, infrastructure, or data.
  • Drive cross-functional execution. Translate strategy into clear technical plans, specs, and user stories. Coordinate delivery across dedicated and partner engineering teams, and keep stakeholders aligned and projects moving.
  • Connect the ecosystem. Ensure seamless liquidity handoffs across the broader PSA enterprise, from Grading to Collection Management to Vaulting, reducing friction and resolving cross-system dependencies that span payments, logistics, and risk.
  • Communicate with clarity at every level. From executive reviews to engineering standups, synthesize complexity, articulate tradeoffs, and bring people with you — clearly, in writing and in person.

Who You Are

  • 6+ years engineering experience. You have a track record of designing, shipping, and scaling products 0-to-1 that have measurable business impact. Ideally 2+ years operating as a Senior IC or equivalent technical leadership level at a high-growth company or a scaled consumer platform.
  • Full-stack range. You have strong proficiency in Java (Spring Boot) and equally comfortable in modern frontend frameworks like React and Svelte, moving fluidly across the stack. Mobile experience using Flutter/Dart is a plus.
  • Distributed-systems depth. You've designed and operated microservices and Kafka-based event-driven architectures, run workloads on Kubernetes, and know your way around the AWS ecosystem.
  • Observability-first mindset. You instrument what you ship using tools such as Datadog, New Relic, or OpenTelemetry. You're comfortable building dashboards, setting up monitoring/alerting, and using distributed tracing to debug production issues.
  • AI-first engineer. You build with AI tooling across the SDLC - from planning and code generation to review and debugging. You lean on your experience to make high-conviction calls quickly.
  • Systems thinker and customer focused. You naturally decompose complex, multi-service systems into clean boundaries and intuitive interfaces, without losing sight of the customer experience.
  • Influential communicator. A strong written and verbal communicator who aligns engineers, product partners, and stakeholders without direct authority, makes crisp calls, and brings people with you.
  • Bias for ownership. You have an extreme ownership mindset and will wear any hat required to get the job done. You thrive in a fast-moving, self-directed environment — you set the bar, hold it, and take full accountability for outcomes.
  • Passion for collecting is a plus.

title: Sr. Embedded Software Engineer, Robotics Platform
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Sr. Embedded Software Engineer, Robotics Platform based in United States .

This role offers the opportunity to build and evolve the embedded software platform powering a growing fleet of autonomous delivery robots. You’ll work hands-on with modern C++ and embedded Linux to develop reliable middleware and application frameworks. The position combines deep systems engineering with real-world robotics challenges involving performance, safety, reliability, and constrained computing resources. You’ll own significant platform components from architecture and implementation through validation, deployment, and fleet operations. Working closely with autonomy, systems, hardware, and software teams, you’ll help translate system-level requirements into robust software solutions. The role also provides opportunities to influence technical architecture, mentor engineers, and improve the scalability and developer experience of the robotics platform.

Accountabilities:

  • Design, develop, test, and maintain robotics middleware and application frameworks using modern C++ on embedded Linux, with a focus on reliability, maintainability, and production readiness.
  • Own significant platform components throughout their full lifecycle, from technical design and implementation to validation, deployment, monitoring, and operation across a fleet of robots.
  • Partner with software teams using the robotics platform to identify reliability, performance, and developer-experience challenges, then build reusable solutions that improve the overall platform.
  • Collaborate with autonomy and systems engineering teams on risk assessments, failure analysis, fault-handling strategies, system architecture, and the translation of safety and reliability requirements into software behavior and verification approaches.
  • Develop instrumentation, benchmarks, logging, tracing, telemetry, and fleet-level metrics to monitor software performance, reliability, resource utilization, and overall system health.
  • Diagnose and resolve complex system-level problems involving concurrency, scheduling, synchronization, interprocess communication, networking, and constrained compute environments.
  • Evaluate technical tradeoffs and contribute to architectural decisions that improve platform scalability, reliability, performance, and long-term maintainability.
  • Lead technical design and code reviews while contributing to engineering standards, development practices, technical documentation, and knowledge-sharing initiatives.
  • Provide technical guidance and mentorship to other engineers through design discussions, problem solving, code reviews, and collaborative technical work.

    • Requirements:

    • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Robotics, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
    • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, including substantial experience developing production-grade software using modern C++17 or newer.
    • Strong experience developing and debugging systems software in embedded Linux environments, with a solid understanding of multithreading, concurrency, synchronization, interprocess communication, and systems-level programming.
    • Experience designing software for latency-sensitive, safety-related, real-time, or high-reliability systems, along with practical experience profiling and optimizing embedded software for performance and resource utilization.
    • Demonstrated ability to independently own complex software components across technical design, implementation, testing, deployment, and ongoing operation.
    • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving abilities, including the capacity to diagnose complex issues that span software, hardware, networking, and system-level boundaries.
    • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across software, systems, hardware, autonomy, and other engineering disciplines.
    • Experience with robotics middleware, autonomous vehicles, or other complex robotic systems is highly valued, as is experience deploying production software on NVIDIA Jetson or similar embedded computing platforms.
    • Additional experience with Linux internals, scheduling, resource management, device interfaces, fault-tolerant architecture, functional safety, distributed systems, networking, RPC frameworks, serialization technologies, telemetry, observability, or robotic sensors and hardware integration is advantageous.

      • Benefits:

      • Competitive Compensation: Salary range of $167,800–$204,000, with actual compensation determined by geographic location, experience, level, domain knowledge, and interview performance.
      • Remote Flexibility: Remote position available across Canada, including British Columbia, Calgary, Toronto, and Vancouver.
      • Full-Time Opportunity: A full-time engineering role with significant ownership over production robotics software and platform components.
      • Technical Impact: Work on complex real-world robotics systems spanning embedded software, autonomy, hardware, safety, reliability, and fleet operations.
      • Cross-Functional Environment: Collaborate closely with experienced engineers across software, systems, hardware, and autonomy disciplines.
      • Professional Growth: Opportunities to lead technical design, influence architecture, mentor engineers, and contribute to engineering standards and development practices.
      • Hands-On Robotics Exposure: The role may occasionally involve access to robotics hardware or onsite participation in integration, testing, troubleshooting, and validation activities.

title: Product Manager (Brake Control)
description:
Product Line Overview

Wabtec Transit Brakes & Couplers is a world leader in the supply of braking systems and couplers for all types of trains, on all continents. With more than a century of expertise, our braking systems range from brake manipulators to friction materials, air treatment and generation, brake control and bogie brake equipment. We deliver the widest range of couplers, covering most world standards.

How will you make a difference?

As Brake Control Product Manager, you will own the strategy, competitiveness, and lifecycle performance of Wabtec's Brake Control portfolio. Your mission is to connect customer needs, market trends, business objectives, and technology evolution to develop products that win in today's market while preparing the next generation of brake control systems for tomorrow.

You will define and drive the product roadmap, product architecture evolution, modularization strategy, and platform development for the portfolio. Working closely with Sales, Technical Sales, Engineering, Sourcing, Quality, Operations, and R&D teams, you will translate market opportunities into tangible product and business outcomes.

What will your typical day look like?

  • Define and drive the product strategy, roadmap, and technology vision for the Brake Control portfolio, aligning customer needs, market trends, and business objectives.
  • Own the complete product lifecycle and portfolio performance, from introduction to retirement, ensuring competitiveness, profitability, and relevance in the market.
  • Lead modularization and platforming initiatives to improve scalability, reduce complexity, accelerate development, and increase product re-use.
  • Drive product excellence and cost competitiveness, leading quality, reliability, lifecycle optimization, value engineering, and cost reduction initiatives.
  • Translate market and customer insights into future product requirements, technology roadmaps, and innovation programs.
  • Support profitable business growth by maximizing product positioning, re-use, and competitiveness in customer bids and projects.
  • Lead through influence, aligning Engineering, R&D, Quality, Sourcing, Operations, Service, and Commercial teams around portfolio objectives.
  • Monitor market, competitive, and portfolio performance, driving corrective actions and continuous improvement where required.

What do we want to know about you?

Hard Skills

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a related technical discipline; Master's degree is an advantage.
  • Strong technical foundation in complex engineered systems, product architectures, and lifecycle management; knowledge of brake systems or railway vehicle subsystems is strongly preferred.
  • Ability to translate customer needs, market insights, and business objectives into product strategies, roadmaps, and requirements.
  • Experience with business cases, cost optimization, value engineering, product improvement, or industrial competitiveness initiatives.

Soft Skills

  • Strong ownership mindset with a demonstrated ability to convert ideas into tangible business results.
  • Strategic thinker capable of balancing long-term vision with pragmatic execution.
  • Ability to lead and influence multidisciplinary and multicultural teams without direct authority.
  • Sound judgment, entrepreneurial spirit, and willingness to challenge the status quo while driving continuous improvement.

Others:

  • Fluent English is required (other EU languages are considered a plus)
  • Willingness and ability to travel internationally as required.

Successful candidates may come from Product Management, Engineering, Technical Sales, Quality, Operations, or other relevant functions. More important than prior job title is the ability to combine technical understanding, business acumen, ownership, and cross-functional leadership to deliver results.

What do we offer?

  • Permanent full-time contract, CCNL Metalmeccanico
  • Training and professional development opportunities
  • Benefits, including: flexible hours, canteen, welfare platform, accident insurance, tax assistance, and electric car charging
  • The current salary for this role ranges from €54,500 to €72,200 + 15% bonus. The actual salary offered to the candidate may be influenced by various factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, education, business needs, market demands, and work location. The base salary range is subject to change and may be reviewed in the future.

Location: this role can be located close to any Wabtec Transit site.

Please, attach your CV in English.

Legal authorization to work in EU is required. We will not sponsor individuals for employment visas, now or in the future, for this job opening.

Please note that we do not accept agency candidate submissions without a formalized agreement with Wabtec Talent Acquisition. If you are an agency/third party Recruiter and have not been engaged by Wabtec for this search, we do not owe you a fee if you submit a candidate to the applicant tracking system that is ultimately hired.

What could you accomplish in a place that puts People First?

At Wabtec, it’s not just about a job - it’s about the impact you make. When our people come together, we’re Expanding the Possible by continuously improving what we do and how we do it - for our clients and each other.

If you’re ready to revolutionize how the world moves for future generations, Wabtec is the place for you.

Wabtec is a leading global provider of equipment, systems, digital solutions, and value-added services for the freight and transit rail sectors. Drawing on more than 150 years of experience, we are leading the way in safety, efficiency, reliability, innovation, and productivity. Whether it’s freight, transit, ports, logistics, mining, industrial, or marine, our expertise, technologies, and people together – are accelerating the future of transportation. With roots that date back to George Westinghouse, Thomas Edison, and Louis Faiveley, Wabtec has always built technologies and implemented solutions for a variety of sectors that are critical to meeting the needs of customers and governments alike.

Our global team of about 30,000 employees worldwide delivers performance that moves the world forward. We’re lifelong learners, obsessed with better. Learn more at www.WabtecCorp.com.

We believe the best ideas come from a mix of experiences and backgrounds. At Wabtec, we strive every day to create a place where everyone belongs. We’re building a culture where leadership, inclusion and your unique perspective fuel progress.

title: Sygeplejerske søges til Retspsykiatrisk Sengeafsnit R2, Aarhus Universitetshospital
description:
37 timer ugentligt, – tiltrædelse snarest muligt

Vil du være en del af en arbejdsplads, hvor høj faglighed, tværfagligt samarbejde og rehabilitering går hånd i hånd med sikkerhed, udvikling og et stærkt kollegialt fællesskab?

På Retspsykiatrisk Sengeafsnit R2 i AUH søger vi en autoriseret sygeplejerske, der har lyst til at arbejde med nogle af psykiatriens mest komplekse patientforløb. Hos os bliver du en del af et engageret team, hvor vi hver dag arbejder målrettet for at skabe trygge rammer, understøtte patienternes recovery og forebygge ny kriminalitet gennem en helhedsorienteret behandling.

Om Retspsykiatrisk Sengeafsnit 2

Retspsykiatrisk Sengeafsnit 2 er et rehabiliterende Sengeafsnit under Retspsykiatrisk Afdeling på Aarhus Universitetshospital. Vores patienter er indlagt over længere tid og har behov for en specialiseret, tværfaglig og individuelt tilrettelagt behandling.

Vi arbejder ud fra en recovery-orienteret tilgang, hvor relationen til patienten, høj sygeplejefaglig kvalitet og tværfagligt samarbejde er fundamentet for vores indsats. Samtidig arbejder vi aktivt med innovation i vores praksis, fordi vi ønsker løbende at udvikle og forbedre behandlingen, skabe bedre patientforløb og sikre, at vores metoder er tidssvarende og effektive. Innovation hos os handler både om at afprøve nye tilgange i det daglige arbejde og om at tænke kreativt i forhold til komplekse problemstillinger

Hos os får du en alsidig og meningsfuld hverdag, hvor få dage er ens, og hvor du får mulighed for at gøre en reel forskel for en patientgruppe med komplekse behandlings- og rehabiliteringsbehov.

Dine arbejdsopgaver

Som sygeplejerske bliver du kontaktperson for en gruppe patienter og får en central rolle i den daglige pleje og behandling. Dine opgaver vil blandt andet omfatte:

  • Planlægning, udførelse og evaluering af sygepleje, herunder fokus på Fundamentals of Care.
  • Observation, vurdering og dokumentation af patienternes psykiske og somatiske tilstand.
  • Medicinhåndtering.
  • Udarbejdelse og opfølgning på sygeplejeplaner.
  • Samarbejde med læger, psykologer, socialrådgivere, terapeuter og pædagoger samt social og sundhedsassistenter.
  • Deltagelse i behandlingskonferencer og pårørendesamtaler.
  • Relationsarbejde og miljøterapeutiske interventioner.
  • Bidrag til udvikling af den sygeplejefaglige kvalitet.

Vi søger en kollega, som

  • Er autoriseret sygeplejerske.
  • Har interesse for psykiatri – erfaring fra psykiatri eller retspsykiatri er en fordel, men ikke et krav.
  • Arbejder selvstændigt og tager ansvar.
  • Har gode samarbejds- og kommunikationsevner.
  • Er nysgerrig, reflekterende og ønsker løbende faglig udvikling.
  • Bidrager positivt til fællesskabet og ser værdien i tværfagligt samarbejde.

Vi tilbyder

  • Et grundigt introduktionsforløb tilpasset dine kompetencer.
  • Mentorordning og sidemandsoplæring.
  • En arbejdsplads med høj faglighed og stærkt tværfagligt samarbejde.
  • Løbende supervision, undervisning og kompetenceudvikling.
  • Mulighed for at præge udviklingen af den sygeplejefaglige praksis.
  • Engagerede kolleger, der hjælper hinanden og prioriterer et godt arbejdsmiljø.

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår

  • Stillingen er på 37 timer ugentligt.
  • Tiltrædelse snarest muligt eller efter aftale.
  • Der arbejdes i blandede vagter med weekendarbejde efter gældende vagtplan.
  • Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår sker i henhold til gældende overenskomst.

Har du lyst til at høre mere?

Du er meget velkommen til at kontakte Oversygeplejerske Jonas Lisius Martinussen (51 37 12 83) eller Yasmine Hassan (91 16 88 48) for en uforpligtende samtale.

Ansøgning

Send din ansøgning, CV, autorisation og relevante bilag via Region Midtjyllands rekrutteringssystem.

Ansættelsessamtaler afholdes løbende, og stillingen besættes, når den rette kandidat er fundet.

Om Retspsykiatrisk Afdeling

Retspsykiatrisk Afdeling ved Aarhus Universitetshospital varetager behandling af patienter med psykisk sygdom, som samtidig er omfattet af en retslig foranstaltning. Vi arbejder med høj faglighed, sikkerhed, rehabilitering og tværfagligt samarbejde med det fælles mål at understøtte patienternes recovery og forebygge ny kriminalitet.

Du kan læse mere om Retspsykiatrisk Sengeafsnit 2 her:

Stillingen er som udgangspunkt en fuldtidsstilling.

Da Region Midtjylland løbende gennemfører besparelser og omorganiseringer, vil medarbejdere i omplacering, der søger stillingen, have fortrinsret.

Region Midtjylland er jf. EU’s løngennemsigtighedsdirektiv, der trådte i kraft 7. juni 2026 forpligtet til at oplyse dig om startløn eller et interval for startløn for en stilling inden du tilbydes ansættelse.

You will provide architectural direction to engineering teams while helping align technology decisions with business strategy and product roadmaps. title: Senior AI Research Scientist
description:
SENIOR AI RESEARCH SCIENTIST

About iCAD:

iCAD, a global leader on a mission to create a world where cancer can’t hide by providing clinically proven AI-powered solutions that enable medical providers to accurately and reliably detect cancer earlier and improve patient outcomes. iCAD’s industry-leading ProFound Breast Health Suite provides AI-powered mammography analysis for breast cancer detection, density assessment and risk evaluation. The ProFound Breast Health Suite is cleared by the U.S. Food & Drug Administration (FDA) and has received CE mark and Health Canada licensing. Used by thousands of providers serving millions of patients, ProFound is available in over 50 countries.

POSITION DESCRIPTION:

iCAD is seeking a talented and motivated Senior AI Researcher to join our dynamic and innovative team. As a critical contributor to our research and development efforts, you will play a pivotal role in designing, developing, and improving AI-based medical devices that will drive the next generation of solutions in medical imaging and healthcare, particularly in breast cancer detection and diagnosis. This position offers the opportunity to work in a fast-paced environment with cutting-edge technology while directly contributing to saving lives through improved healthcare solutions.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • AI Model Development: Design, develop, and optimize AI/ML models, specifically deep learning algorithms, to advance our breast cancer detection and imaging tools.
  • Algorithm Research: Conduct research to identify new methodologies, techniques, and technologies in artificial intelligence and machine learning that can be applied to medical image analysis.
  • Collaboration with Product Management: Work closely with Product Management to identify key innovation areas where AI can drive meaningful product functionality and market differentiation improvements. Contribute to strategic roadmaps by providing insights on AI trends and potential research breakthroughs that align with customer needs and business goals.
  • Data Analysis: Work with large medical datasets, performing data preprocessing, annotation, and enhancement tasks to improve the accuracy and efficiency of AI models.
  • Collaborate Across Teams: Partner with software engineers, radiologists, clinical teams, and other stakeholders to integrate AI solutions into production environments and evaluate their real-world performance.
  • Validation and Testing: Lead the testing and validation of AI models to ensure they meet regulatory standards, including FDA clearance, and are robust for clinical use.
  • Research Publications and Product Marketing Support: Provide write-ups, white papers, and technical documentation that clearly describe the functionality, benefits, and impact of AI models and innovations. Collaborate with Product Management and Marketing teams to highlight the key benefits of research deliverables for external audiences, including customers, investors, and healthcare professionals.
  • Mentorship: Provide mentorship and guidance to junior researchers and collaborate with cross-functional teams to accelerate research and development efforts.
  • Regulatory Compliance: Ensure all AI development activities comply with healthcare industry regulations and are accompanied by supporting documentation for submissions to regulatory bodies.

REQUIREMENTS:

  • Ph.D. in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of R&D experience in medical imaging, computer vision, or machine learning, with a proven track record of developing AI solutions.
  • Expertise in deep learning frameworks such as TensorFlow, Keras, or PyTorch.
  • Advanced knowledge of Python and C++ for implementing AI solutions.
  • Demonstrated experience with large-scale data processing and managing complex datasets.
  • Experience with medical imaging datasets (e.g., DICOM, mammography, CT, MRI) is highly preferred.
  • Solid understanding of AI model validation techniques, regulatory requirements (e.g., FDA 510(k)), and experience working in a healthcare environment.
  • Strong publication history in top-tier conferences and journals, showcasing original research.
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to present complex research results to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Excellent analytical, organizational, and communication skills with the ability to present complex ideas clearly.
  • A proactive team player, capable of working independently while contributing to cross-functional teams.
  • Ability to generate patentable ideas and contribute to intellectual property development.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with explainable AI (XAI) and model interpretability in medical applications.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (Google Cloud, AWS) and deploying AI solutions in cloud environments.
  • Knowledge of biostatistics, healthcare regulations, and clinical workflows.
  • Experience working in cross-functional teams and fast-paced R&D environments.

Full Remote.

title: Senior Data Scientist
description:
The Senior Data Scientist owns the analytical methods and models that support critical business decisions across demand, inventory, production capacity, scheduling, and core business metrics. The role combines advanced analytics, forecasting, optimization, experimentation, and data governance to help the business make informed decisions across multiple plants and functions. The Senior Data Scientist leads and mentors a Data Scientist, establishes standards for analytical methods and communication, and serves as a trusted resource for resolving discrepancies between reports and determining the appropriate source of truth. This position also partners with engineering, finance, corporate development, and business leadership to develop production-ready analytical tools and models.

Essential Functions and Responsibilities

  • Own the production planning model, including demand forecasting, safety stock and inventory targets, and forward production plans across plants.
  • Build capacity and scheduling optimization models, including press and mold assignment, site balancing, and utilization targets while accounting for real-world constraints such as tool availability.
  • Own metric governance and establish consistent definitions for key business metrics, including labor as a percentage of production sales value, OEE, and net sales.
  • Reconcile metric definitions and calculations across the lake house, Power BI, and business applications to establish a consistent source of truth.
  • Design, execute, and analyze experiments with retail partners, including price and assortment tests.
  • Partner with engineering to build LLM-assisted analytics tools, such as natural-language question-and-answer capabilities over the data warehouse, with appropriate evaluation methods, accuracy standards, and guardrails.
  • Support finance and corporate development with analytical modeling for acquisitions, capital projects, facility decisions, and other strategic initiatives.
  • Lead and mentor the Data Scientist, providing guidance on analytical approaches, technical development, and communication.
  • Establish and maintain review standards for analytical code, methodologies, documentation, and business communication.
  • Present analytical findings, models, and recommendations to executive leadership and clearly explain and defend the underlying methodology and assumptions.
  • Collaborate across data, engineering, operations, finance, and commercial teams to translate complex business problems into practical analytical solutions.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in data science, operations research, advanced analytics, or a related field, ideally within manufacturing, supply chain, consumer packaged goods (CPG), or a similar environment.
  • Demonstrated experience applying forecasting and inventory methods in production environments, including intermittent and hierarchical demand forecasting and service-level-based safety stock.
  • Experience with optimization techniques such as linear programming (LP) or mixed-integer programming (MIP), using tools such as OR-Tools, PuLP, Pyomo, or similar platforms, or demonstrated experience developing practical scheduling heuristics.
  • Expert-level SQL and Python skills, with experience developing production-quality code maintained in Git.
  • Demonstrated ability to investigate and reconcile conflicting metrics or reports and establish a consistent definition or source of truth across teams.
  • Strong analytical judgment and the ability to evaluate assumptions, methodologies, and limitations.
  • Excellent communication skills, including the ability to present complex analytical concepts to executive leadership and confidently explain and defend analytical methods under questioning.
  • Demonstrated leadership or mentoring experience, with the ability to establish standards and develop less-experienced data science professionals.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with injection molding, plastics manufacturing, or multi-plant Sales and Operations Planning (S&OP).
  • Experience with Microsoft Fabric and Power BI semantic models.
  • Experience using LLM APIs, including Anthropic or Open AI, in production analytics tools or applications.
  • Experience formally managing or mentoring analysts or data scientists.

  • Location: Remote
