title: Expert Team Lead, Engineering
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Expert Team Lead, Engineering based in United States.

As an Expert Team Lead, Engineering, you will lead a team responsible for producing high-quality training data and evaluations that support advanced AI models. You will combine engineering expertise with hands-on team leadership, quality assurance, and operational excellence. The role requires you to personally review technical work while establishing consistent standards for accuracy, quality, and guideline adherence. You will coach and develop AI Tutors, manage performance, and build effective training and certification programs. Working closely with Human Data and Engineering teams, you will translate model requirements into clear labeling strategies and workflows. You will use operational metrics to identify bottlenecks, improve efficiency, and continuously raise data quality. This is an opportunity to apply engineering knowledge to the development of sophisticated AI systems while helping scale high-performing human data operations.

Accountabilities

  • Own end-to-end quality and delivery for assigned Human Data projects, personally reviewing engineering-domain work and ensuring accuracy, consistency, guideline adherence, and high-quality data production at scale.

  • Lead, coach, and performance-manage a team of AI Tutors, including full-time employees and contractors, through regular reviews, action plans, shadow sessions, and continuous improvement initiatives.

  • Oversee and actively participate in labeling and review activities to maintain high standards and demonstrate effective working practices.

  • Ensure consistent adherence to project guidelines, taxonomies, and quality assurance processes.

  • Identify operational bottlenecks and implement process improvements to increase efficiency, quality, and throughput.

  • Monitor performance through KPI dashboards, using metrics such as quality, throughput, and send-back rates to guide improvements.

  • Create, maintain, and deliver training materials, practice exercises, and certification benchmark tasks.

  • Manage certification processes and make appropriate workforce adjustments based on performance and project requirements.

  • Collaborate with Human Data Managers, other Team Leads, and Engineering teams to translate model requirements into clear labeling strategies and operational guidelines.

  • Coach and develop team members while maintaining accountability and a high-performance culture, including supporting disciplinary processes when required.

  • Document project outcomes, recommend process iterations, and communicate project status, risks, and results.

  • Represent the needs and perspectives of AI Tutors while fostering collaboration across the wider Human Data organization.

    • Requirements

    • Bachelor's degree or higher in Mechanical, Electrical, Chemical, Civil, Environmental, or another closely related engineering discipline.

    • At least 2 years of professional engineering experience in areas such as design, analysis, testing, research and development, or systems integration; alternatively, a Master's degree or higher in engineering or a related field.

    • Basic understanding of artificial intelligence and machine learning concepts, including the role of high-quality training data in model performance.

    • Advanced engineering degree such as an MS or PhD, or professional credentials such as PE or FE/EIT, is preferred.

    • Demonstrated experience with data-quality metrics, annotation processes, and guideline-driven workflows.

    • Breadth across multiple engineering disciplines, with the ability to credibly review technical work beyond your primary specialty.

    • Experience with performance management, coaching, training program development, or certification frameworks.

    • At least 1 year of hands-on experience in data labeling, annotation, AI training or evaluation, content quality, or a similar operational field is preferred.

    • Experience developing scalable, high-performance technology applications is advantageous.

    • Previous experience leading small teams in data labeling, annotation, or related operational environments is preferred.

    • Proven ability to manage multiple concurrent projects, prioritize effectively, and deliver in a fast-paced environment.

    • Strong track record of reviewing technical or domain-specific work, maintaining data quality, and improving operational processes.

    • Strong analytical capabilities and experience using data and KPIs to drive continuous improvement; SQL knowledge is a plus.

    • Experience managing distributed teams or mixed employment structures, including full-time employees and contractors.

    • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to build rapport quickly and align stakeholders.

    • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, proactive problem-solving abilities, and a continuous-improvement mindset.

    • Ability to combine strategic thinking with hands-on execution.

    • Strong domain expertise in at least one relevant area such as Finance, STEM, Coding/Software Engineering, or another technical field.

    • Passion for developing high-performing teams and scaling reliable, high-quality Human Data operations.

title: Kunderådgiver til teamet med ansvar for 1 mio. dokumenter om året
description:
Vil du være med dér, hvor kunderejsen begynder? Kan du sikre, at tusindvis af dokumenter hver dag bliver behandlet korrekt og til tiden? Og har du lyst til at bidrage til udviklingen af fremtidens kundeservice i ATP? Så er det dig, vi søger.

I Journalen er vi en central del af ATP's kundeservice. Det er hos os, alle indkomne dokumenter lander først, og derfor er vores arbejde afgørende for, at kunderne får den rette behandling af deres sag.

Hvert år håndterer vi omkring en million fysiske og digitale dokumenter på tværs af ATP's ordninger. Nu søger vi en ny kollega, der både kan bidrage til den daglige drift og være med til at udvikle måden, vi arbejder på.

Du bliver en del af en sektion, hvor struktur, kvalitet og samarbejde går hånd i hånd med nysgerrighed på nye løsninger. Sammen arbejder vi løbende med at gøre sagsbehandlingen mere effektiv og skabe endnu bedre kundeoplevelser.

Dine opgaver bliver at:

  • journalisere indkomne dokumenter og sikre, at de bliver registreret korrekt og sendt videre til rette behandling
  • følge op på driftsdata og bidrage til, at vi lever op til vores mål for kvalitet og sagsbehandlingstid
  • samarbejde med kolleger på tværs af kundeservice om håndtering af dokumenter og driftsopgaver
  • indgå i samarbejde med IT om løsninger, der understøtter en effektiv og stabil drift
  • bidrage til udvikling og optimering af arbejdsgange, så vi kan behandle sager smartere og skabe bedre løsninger for kunderne.

Hvem er du?

Der er flere veje til jobbet, men vi forestiller os, at du:

  • har erfaring som kunderådgiver eller fra en anden rolle, hvor kundeservice og sagsbehandling har været en central del af arbejdet.
  • trives med opgaver, hvor kvalitet, præcision og overholdelse af frister er vigtigt.
  • tager ansvar for dine opgaver og selv finder løsninger, når du møder udfordringer.
  • kan arbejde selvstændigt, men samtidig bidrager aktivt til sparring og samarbejde med kolleger.
  • motiveres af at forbedre arbejdsgange og finde nye måder at skabe værdi for kunderne på.

Hvem er vi?
I Journalen er vi grundstenen i kundeservice. Det er hos os, kunderejsen starter, når dokumenter og henvendelser kommer ind i ATP.

Vi er en stor sektion med forskellige ansvarsområder. Ud over journalisering står vi blandt andet for reception, omstilling, printshop og arkiv. Fælles for vores arbejde er ønsket om at levere god service til både kunder og kolleger.

Samarbejdet fylder meget i hverdagen, og du får stor indflydelse på, hvordan vi udvikler vores opgaver og arbejdsgange. Mange af vores processer er faste, men arbejdsdagen er varieret, fordi vi løser opgaver på tværs af kundeservice og løbende arbejder med nye løsninger og forbedringer.

Sådan ansøger du
Send os dit CV senest søndag den 4. oktober. Når du sender dit CV via vores system, får du mulighed for kort at beskrive din motivation for at søge stillingen.

I ATP arbejder vi for en fair rekrutteringsproces, og derfor beder vi dig om ikke at vedhæfte billede i dit CV eller angive din alder, når du søger.

Vi ansætter på baggrund af kompetencer og potentiale og opfordrer alle til at søge stillingen – uanset køn og kønsidentitet, etnicitet, national, social og kulturel baggrund, religion eller tro, seksuel orientering, funktionsnedsættelse og alder.

Du kan læse mere om rekrutteringsforløbet her:

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte sektionschef Birgitte Pedersen på tlf. 2374 3100 eller mail bpe@atp.dk.

Af sikkerhedsmæssige årsager og for at beskytte værdier og datainfrastruktur beder vi om straffeattest, kopi af dit pas og eventuelt eksamensbevis. Straffeattesten må ikke give anledning til bemærkninger, og dokumenterne slettes umiddelbart efter vurdering.

Til annoncører og rekrutteringsbureauer: ATP frabeder sig uopfordrede henvendelser om annoncering, kandidater, produkter og ydelser i forbindelse med stillingsopslag og rekrutteringer. Vi beder om, at dette respekteres, og at vores ledere og medarbejdere ikke kontaktes i den henseende.

Som trainee er du en pædagogfagligt kvalificeret ekstra person for en fast gruppe børn/stue og del af et team, der arbejder i børnenes trivsel, udvikling og læring, samt medansvarlig for det gode forældresamarbejde.

Du bliver et ligeværdigt medlem af teamet for en gruppe børn/stue med begrænset timetal. Herunder gives eksempler på traineeopgaver:

  • Opgaverne består i at være tilknyttet en stue/gruppe.
  • Faste dage, hvor du tilhører en fast gruppe, faste børn, faste personaler. Skabe tryghed, stabilitet og forudsigelighed for trainee, børn, forældre og personale.

Opgaver:

  • Vi tager opgaverne med børnegruppen alvorligt. Vi ved, at det er vigtigt, at du får nye oplevelser og udvider dine erfaringer fra tidligere praktikker. Målet er at hjælpe dig til at være den bedste pædagog efter din uddannelse.
  • Vi fokuserer på at arbejde sammen med forældrene. Det handler om at bygge gode relationer og føle sig tryg med det pædagogiske ansvar i samarbejdet med forældrene. Vi vil gerne hjælpe dig med at stå stærkt i dette.
  • Vi ønsker, at overgangen fra tidligere praktikoplevelser til den virkelige verden som pædagog under traineeperioden skal være glidende. Det handler om at tage det, du har lært, og anvende det i den rigtige arbejdssituation.
  • Sammen med en pædagogkollega, at prøver du også at arbejde konkret med dialogprofil i Hjernen og Hjertet.
  • Vi tror på at lære ved at se. Det er derfor også en opgave at være med til at lave observationer af hverdagen i institutionen og at institutionen forpligter sig til at arbejde med de observationer.

LØN OG ANSÆTTELSESVILKÅR

BUPL og Gentofte Kommune har indgået en særskilt aftale om traineeordningen, der betyder at du ansættes på BUPL-overenskomst.

Ansættelsen varer det sidste halve studieår, under bachelorskrivningen. Som udgangspunkt arbejder du som trainee i en daginstitution, hvad der svarer til 2 dage pr uge i 15 uger. Ansættelsen må ikke give anledning til en forlængelse af din studietid. Ansættelse sker for 26 uger.

Der vil være en vejleder fra daginstitutionen tilknyttet traineen. Vejlederen fokuserer på forhold for den enkelte trainee, mens teamet har fokus på det daglige faglige arbejdsfællesskab.

Lønnen er lig en nyuddannet pædagog: Du kan finde relevante oplysninger om løninterval for den konkrete stilling via https://www.krl.dk/#/kommuneloenstat . I oversigten vælges Gentofte Kommune, hvilken stillingskategori (overenskomst) du ansøger til og yderligere, hvilken stilling du søger.


VIL DU VIDE MERE

Oplysninger om stillingen kan fås ved henvendelse til Specialkonsulent Lone Kirstine Pallesen på tlf.nr.: 21331897. Du er også velkommen til at læse mere på dagtilbuddenes hjemmesider: Liste over dagtilbud - Gentofte Kommune

Du er også meget velkommen til at kontakt lederen af børnehusene direkte til en snak.

Du kan læse om dagtilbud i Gentofte Kommune på .

ANSØGNINGSFRIST

Vi glæder os til at modtage din ansøgning, Ansøgning med relevante bilag sendes via linket med frist torsdag d. 5.november 2026 kl. 23.59. Vi modtager kun digitale ansøgninger. Tilkendegiv gerne hvilket/hvilke dagtilbud du er interesserede i. Vi afholder løbende samtaler i dagtilbuddene.

Hvis du bliver ansat, forventer vi, at du starter i december 2026 eller snarest derefter. I forbindelse med opstarten af traineestillingen vil der blive afholdt et velkomstmøde for alle igangværende trainees.

I Gentofte Kommune er der en generel politik om, at der på børne- og ungeområdet skal indhentes straffeattest og børneattest.

Børn og Skole, Kultur, Unge og Fritid har ansvaret for 36 daginstitutioner, med børn på mere end 50 matrikler. Børn og Skole, Kultur, Unge og Fritid beskæftiger ca. 3000 ansatte på Rådhuset og i de decentrale enheder.

Gentofte Kommune vil være Danmarks mest attraktive kommunale arbejdsplads. Kunne du tænke dig et meningsfuldt job, på en arbejdsplads med et højt serviceniveau, hvor fagligheden er i top og hvor der samtidig er plads til et arbejdsliv og familieliv i balance? Så er Gentofte Kommune svaret. I Gentofte Kommune tror vi på, at dygtige og tilfredse medarbejdere og ledere er den bedste garanti for, at borgerne får den bedst mulige service.

description:
Overview

JOB TITLE: Technical Analyst

AGENCY SUPPORTED: U.S. Department of Justice (DOJ) – MEGA 6 Automated Litigation Support

POSITION TYPE: Full-Time, Contingent Upon Award

LOCATION: Remote

CLEARANCE: Public Trust – Candidates do not need to be cleared at the time of application but must be able to obtain and maintain a Public Trust clearance prior to starting.

BENEFITS: Health, Dental and Vision, 401(k), Tuition Reimbursement, Flexible Spending Account (FSA), 11 Paid Federal Holidays, 3 weeks’ Paid Time Off

ITC Federal, LLC (ITC) connects technology advancements in automation and AI, customer experience, and financial services to solve government mission challenges, enabling smoother operational efficiency and bolstering national security. We leverage the latest technology innovations and proven approaches to better serve the mission and support the DHS, DOJ, and DoW workforce, customers, and programs, regardless of scale or complexity. ITC is located in Fairfax, VA and offers an outstanding compensation and benefits plan and a challenging and rewarding professional work environment.

We are seeking an experienced Technical Analyst to support ITC Federal’s work for the U.S. Department of Justice (DOJ) under the anticipated MEGA 6 automated litigation support (ALS) program. This is a fully remote position supporting DOJ’s complex litigation mission.

Important: This opening is being established in connection with the MEGA 6 contract vehicle award itself. ITC Federal must still be awarded individual task orders under the vehicle before employees can be onboarded. Accordingly, this position is full-time and contingent upon both contract award and the award of the applicable task order.

POSITION OVERVIEW:

The Technical Analyst is a very senior professional with outstanding or unique skills and analytic abilities, particularly with respect to specific application software, operating systems, or technologies.

PROGRAM CONTEXT:

This position supports the U.S. Department of Justice (DOJ) under the anticipated MEGA 6 procurement. MEGA 6 is expected to continue DOJ’s multiple-award contract vehicle for automated litigation support (ALS) services, following the structure of the MEGA 5 contract. These contracts are designed to provide DOJ offices, boards, divisions, and other federal agencies with information technology, professional services, and litigation support tools to manage complex legal proceedings efficiently.

Responsibilities

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • The Technical Analyst consults with Contractor and Government management to solve complex litigation support requirements.
  • If required by the litigation and approved by the COR, the analyst will make recommendations for technical solutions including applications development, applications maintenance, documentation, quality assurance and user support; provides technical advice, supervision, and guidance to the contractor support team; evaluates programs in terms of efficiency, effectiveness, quality and interoperability with client systems; evaluates software and hardware requirements along with short and long range planning, including systems integration solutions and telecommunications requirements; translates advanced concepts into practical and effective solutions using structured techniques to define requirements; and develops feasible alternatives and estimates costs of implementation.
  • Makes presentations of findings, recommendations, and specifications in formal reports and oral presentations to a variety of audiences, including non-technical personnel.
  • May be required to perform supervisory or managerial duties.

Qualifications

REQUIRED:

  • Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. Government Public Trust clearance prior to start (candidates are not required to be cleared at the time of application).
  • Authorized to work in the United States.
  • Ability to work effectively in a fully remote environment.
  • This is a very senior, high-level technical position.
  • At least five years of specific, hands-on experience actually doing work described in the preceding section is usually expected.
  • Candidates must demonstrate mastery level skills designing, implementing, and troubleshooting applications, and making use of the software or technology for which consulting services are required.
  • For example, if a project involves a large-scale Oracle application in a Unix environment, the candidate will have to have had five or more years’ experience developing large-scale Oracle applications employing and integrating a variety of Oracle products, features, and capabilities, such as Oracle Forms and Reports, Oracle Internet Developer Suite, and PL/SQL functions and procedures, together with user exits to other programs, and interactions with operating system shell scripts.
  • Other applications will require other sets of skills and competencies.
  • It is extremely important that candidates demonstrate a successful history of difficult and complex problem-solving with respect to the appropriate systems.
  • Excellent oral and written communications skills required.
  • Some supervisory or managerial experience may be required.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Litigation support experience helpful.
  • Undergraduate degree strongly preferred; preferably in the computer science or information management/technology disciplines.

title: Senior Customer Experience Coordinator
description:
About Us

At Splend, we're on a mission to fundamentally change the way people own and operate a vehicle. With a strategic focus on rideshare, we provide our customers with straightforward, no-strings-attached access to vehicle ownership. But we aren't just about vehicle ownership. We're also fast-tracking the transition to green mobility, leading the way globally in reducing the carbon footprint of the transportation sector by transitioning our fleet to electric vehicles.

You'll be excited to work in this role if...

  • You love solving problems and helping customers, taking ownership of issues and finding fair, effective solutions.

  • You thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative environment, working across teams to keep customers and vehicles moving.

  • You’re looking to grow and make an impact, with opportunities to mentor others, shape the InLife function and progress into leadership.

About the role

The Senior Customer Experience Coordinator is the face of Splend for our existing customers throughout the lifetime of their subscription, and is a key member of the most senior member of Splend's UK InLife team.
Based in our Cricklewood hub, the role supports drivers through the harder parts of their journey - including accidents, warranty issues, breakdowns and contract terminations - with the goal of resolving issues early and retaining the customer’s trust. Success in this role directly drives retention, customer satisfaction, and operational efficiency across the UK fleet.

What you'll be doing

  • Handle day-to-day customer issues including accident damage, warranty claims, breakdowns and contract terminations. Resolve issues early to prevent escalations, explain next steps, responsibilities and costs fairly, and balance empathy with process rigour.
  • Act as Splend's specialist for accident vehicles; confirm non-fault status following an accident and introduce customers to appropriate replacement vehicle in exchange for the damaged one; ensure a smooth, well-communicated experience for the customer throughout the process.
  • Manage customer conversations around billing, repairs and contract breaches calmly and clearly. Communicate consistently with customers from diverse backgrounds.
  • Work closely with other departments to coordinate vehicle inspections, repairs and service issues. Ensure smooth handovers and timely follow-up across functions.
  • Record all customer interactions and updates accurately in CRM (Zoho) and vehicle systems. Maintain account hygiene, ensure customers adhere to contracts and company policies, and complete admin tasks supporting policy compliance.
  • Act as the key point of escalation for complex or sensitive InLife cases; support and mentor other members of the InLife team, sharing knowledge and modelling best practice; contribute to the ongoing development of the InLife function ahead of potential progression into a formal leadership role.
  • Ability to work weekends if required.

What you'll bring to Splend

  • Full UK Driving Licence

  • Proven experience in a customer-facing role involving complex or emotionally challenging conversations

  • Strong communicator able to explain policies, processes and costs clearly to a diverse customer base

  • Comfortable using CRM systems (preferred but not essential Zoho/Fleetio/Zoom)

  • Highly organised, process-driven, and accurate with admin and documentation

  • Available to work weekends as per rota

  • Experience mentoring or informally supporting colleagues, with the ambition and capability to grow into a leadership role within the InLife function

  • Experience in automotive, mobility, rideshare or vehicle subscription industries

  • Experience working in a high-growth scale-up environment

Benefits & Support

💰 Bonus scheme: Opportunity to earn based on your performance

🏖️ Annual leave: 25 days + bank holidays

🎂 Day off for your Birthday!

📖 Dedicated Learning & Development platform

❤️‍🩹 Private Health Insurance and Monthly Wellness Allowance

💭 Employee Assistance Program

Our Process

  1. Intro with our Talent team to understand your background, aspirations, and answer your questions.

  1. Interview with the hiring manager to discuss your experience and how it aligns with this role.

  1. Where it applies, we’ll ask you to complete a practical case study.

  1. Final interview to discuss Splend’s long-term vision and to check any remaining questions.

Diversity & Inclusion

At Splend, we value diversity and inclusion and consider it key to our success. We’re dedicated to fostering a workplace where everyone is respected and supported. We celebrate differences in race, gender, age, sexual orientation, religion, and ability, seeking diverse perspectives to drive us forward.

If this role sounds like you, but you're not quite sure if you meet every requirement, apply anyway. We're interested in the whole person - your attitude, your potential, and what you'd bring to the team - not just a checklist of credentials. We'd rather hear from you than have you talk yourself out of it.

When you apply, let us know if there are any reasonable adjustments we can make to accommodate you during the interview process.

title: Pædagogmedhjælper/PAU søges til Brahesminde, afdeling Svanninge Børnehus
description:
Brahesminde Skoler og Børnehuse er en Landsbyordning, som omfatter vuggestue, børnehave, SFO og skole, på to matrikler - i henholdsvis Svanninge og Horne.
Afdeling Svanninge er beliggende i skønne omgivelser med Svanninge Bakker i baghaven og tæt ved skov og strand.
Vi er en arbejdsplads, hvor høj faglighed, høj social kapital og fællesskaber er i højsædet. Brahesminde har egen bus, så vi også af og til kan komme ud af huset.
Børnehuset består af børnehave med pt. 24 indskrevne børn samt en vuggestue med 8 børn. Vi vægter især børns trivsel og læring samt et godt forældresamarbejde højt.

På Brahesminde værdsætter vi en hverdag med nærvær, omsorg og leg højt, da alle børn skal føle sig set, forstået og værdsat, hvorfor relationsarbejdet er vigtigt, både mellem børn og voksne og indbyrdes mellem børnene.

Vi søger en pædagogmedhjælper/PAU der:
• kan arbejde selvstændigt, reflektere og have et godt overblik
• vil være med til at udvikle og sætte dit præg på både børnekulturen og den professionelle kultur i tråd med fordringerne i ”Den styrkede pædagogiske læreplan”
• har interesse for og viden omkring livet i børnehaven for børnehavebørn og vuggebørn
• er med på at udforske verden omkring os, ud fra børnenes perspektiver og inddrage børnenes interesser i den pædagogiske praksis
• Vi forventer af dig, at du er udadvendt, engageret, ansvarlig og stabil
• Du er tydelig og har god humoristisk sans.
Vi tilbyder en arbejdsplads:
• med engagerede, sparingsparate og dygtige medarbejdere
• der er udviklingsorienteret og hvor dialogen er i højsædet
• med en engageret forældregruppe
• med stort fokus på trivsel for store og små
• hvor du kan udvikle dig pædagogisk, fagligt og personligt

Har du mod på disse udfordringer, så er det måske dig, vi søger!

Stillingen er i første omgang på 30 timer, men timerne kan måske øges i det nye år.

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår efter gældende overenskomst.
Vi indhenter børne- og straffeattester.

Tiltrædelse 1. november eller snarest.

Ansøgningsfrist den 30.september 2026 kl.12. Der vil være ansættelsessamtaler i uge 41.

Kontakt afdelingsleder Dorte Barber på tlf. 7253 4550 eller leder af Landsbyordningen Vibeke Kryssing Tingberg Munck på 7253 3942 for yderligere information eller for at aftale et besøg.

title: Transformation and Change Management Practitioner
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Transformation and Change Management Practitioner based in Netherlands.

This is a senior consulting role focused on helping private equity investors, portfolio companies, and technology businesses turn strategic ambitions into measurable business outcomes. You will lead complex transformation and change-management programmes spanning operating models, technology, processes, people, and governance. The role combines strategic thinking with hands-on programme leadership, requiring you to engage senior stakeholders and maintain momentum through delivery. You will help organisations build compelling cases for change, align teams around priorities, and embed new ways of working. Your work will directly support growth, operational performance, resilience, customer outcomes, and value creation. You will operate in a collaborative, entrepreneurial environment alongside investment, commercial, operational, financial, and technology specialists.

Accountabilities

  • Lead complex, multi-workstream transformation programmes from initial diagnosis and mobilisation through delivery and the achievement of measurable outcomes.
  • Develop clear transformation roadmaps covering the case for change, target operating model, initiative sequencing, accountabilities, investment requirements, risks, and expected benefits.
  • Establish effective programme governance, delivery rhythms, decision-making structures, and accountability mechanisms to keep transformation initiatives on track.
  • Engage senior stakeholders and build organisational commitment through credible communication, structured facilitation, and practical approaches to change adoption.
  • Design and implement change-management strategies covering stakeholder alignment, communications, organisation design, capability building, adoption, and benefits realisation.
  • Translate technology and operational challenges into commercial implications relating to growth, customer outcomes, margins, resilience, investment risk, and value creation.
  • Support post-deal value creation by helping portfolio-company leadership teams execute transformation priorities at pace while maintaining business continuity.
  • Connect transformation priorities with product, engineering, data, platforms, delivery capabilities, and technology operating models.
  • Build trusted client relationships, contribute to new propositions and business development, and mentor colleagues in transformation, programme leadership, and change management.

    • Requirements

    • 10+ years of experience in transformation, change management, operating-model improvement, technology-enabled transformation, or complex programme delivery.
    • Proven experience leading large-scale, cross-functional transformation programmes involving senior sponsors and diverse stakeholder groups.
    • Strong track record in developing and executing transformation roadmaps, programme governance, organisational and process change, capability-building initiatives, and benefits realisation.
    • Excellent ability to develop and communicate compelling, evidence-based narratives that help leaders understand the need for change, required actions, and measures of success.
    • Strong commercial judgment, with the ability to connect transformation initiatives to business outcomes such as growth, cost efficiency, customer experience, risk, and operational performance.
    • Sufficient technology fluency to work effectively with product, engineering, data, and technology leaders and integrate technology change into broader transformation programmes.
    • Experience in private equity, transaction advisory, corporate development, or high-growth technology businesses is strongly preferred.
    • Significant experience in a business domain such as insurance, capital markets, healthcare, logistics, or supply chain.
    • Excellent structured thinking, facilitation, written communication, presentation, and stakeholder-management skills.
    • Collaborative, action-oriented leadership style with the ability to challenge constructively, build alignment, and maintain momentum across complex programmes.

      • Benefits

      • Opportunity to lead high-impact transformation programmes for private equity investors, portfolio companies, and technology businesses.
      • Exposure to strategic initiatives spanning transformation, technology, operating models, organisational change, and value creation.
      • Direct interaction with senior executives, boards, investment teams, and other key decision-makers.
      • Opportunity to contribute to post-deal value-creation initiatives and complex business transformation programmes.
      • Collaborative environment bringing together commercial, operational, financial, and technology expertise.
      • Scope to develop deeper expertise in transformation, programme leadership, and change management.
      • Opportunities to build trusted client relationships, contribute to proposition development, and mentor colleagues.
      • An entrepreneurial culture centred on service, curiosity, credibility, commitment, and creativity.

title: Senior Platform Engineer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Platform Engineer based in United Kingdom.

As a Senior Platform Engineer, you will help build and evolve the foundational infrastructure and services that enable product and engineering teams to work efficiently at scale. You’ll combine strong software engineering skills with hands-on expertise across GCP, AWS, Kubernetes, and Terraform. The role offers significant ownership over platform architecture, infrastructure automation, reliability, security, and developer experience. You’ll work closely with development teams to understand their needs and turn them into scalable self-service solutions. You’ll also contribute to CI/CD systems, internal tools, APIs, and operational improvements. This is an individual contributor role within a collaborative, globally distributed, and fully remote engineering environment.

Accountabilities

  • Design, build, and continuously improve scalable, reliable, and secure cloud infrastructure across GCP and AWS.
  • Architect and maintain Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, applying software engineering practices such as reusable modules, testing, and predictable deployments.
  • Deploy, operate, and optimize Kubernetes environments, including GKE and EKS, with responsibility for networking, upgrades, service meshes, availability, performance, and resource utilization.
  • Develop and maintain internal CI/CD systems and automation using technologies such as Argo CD, Atlantis, or similar tools.
  • Diagnose and resolve complex platform issues involving performance, scalability, reliability, and security, while contributing to incident response and post-mortem processes.
  • Drive automation initiatives that reduce manual work, minimize operational risk, and improve system reliability and efficiency.
  • Partner closely with development teams to understand infrastructure and developer-experience needs and translate them into effective platform capabilities and roadmaps.
  • Develop internal platform products, services, tools, and APIs that improve self-service and developer productivity.
  • Implement strong cloud security practices covering access control, vulnerability management, encryption, compliance, audits, and relevant standards such as SOC 2 and GDPR.
  • Contribute to technical direction through code reviews, knowledge sharing, mentorship, and close collaboration with engineering peers.

    • Requirements

    • 6+ years of experience in platform engineering, DevOps engineering, or a closely related field, with experience building and operating complex cloud infrastructure.
    • Strong hands-on experience with GCP and/or AWS, Kubernetes including GKE/EKS, and Terraform.
    • Proven ability to build scalable, reliable, secure, and highly automated cloud environments.
    • Strong software engineering fundamentals and coding proficiency in Go, TypeScript, or another relevant programming language, including knowledge of data structures, algorithms, testing, and defensive programming.
    • Experience designing and maintaining CI/CD systems using tools such as Argo CD, Atlantis, or comparable technologies.
    • Solid understanding of networking concepts and protocols within cloud environments.
    • Extensive experience with monitoring and logging solutions such as Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, or similar tools, with the ability to investigate and resolve performance issues.
    • Knowledge of cloud security best practices and experience applying them to production environments.
    • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
    • Self-organized, proactive, goal-oriented, and comfortable taking ownership in an individual contributor role.
    • Ability to collaborate effectively within a remote, distributed, and international engineering team.
    • Previous experience working specifically on platform engineering initiatives and internal developer platforms.

      • Benefits

title: Lead Product Manager (AGC)
description:
The Government Technology Agency (GovTech) is the lead agency driving Singapore’s Smart Nation initiatives and public sector digital transformation. As the Centre of Excellence for Infocomm Technology and Smart Systems (ICT & SS), GovTech develops the Singapore Government’s capabilities in Data Science & Artificial Intelligence, Application Development, Smart City Technology, Digital Infrastructure, and Cybersecurity.

At GovTech, we offer you a purposeful career to make lives better. We empower our people to master their craft through continuous and robust learning and development opportunities all year round. Our GovTechies embody our Agile, Bold and Collaborative values to deliver impactful solutions.

GovTech aims to transform the delivery of Government digital services by taking an "outside-in" view, putting citizens and businesses at the heart of everything we do.

Play a part in Singapore’s vision to build a Smart Nation and embark on your meaningful journey to build tech for public good. Join us to advance our mission and shape your future with us today!

Learn more about GovTech at tech.gov.sg.

[What you will be working on]

We are looking for a Forward-Deployed Product Lead to be embedded within the Attorney-General's Chambers to drive the modernisation of case management system

AGC is modernising its case management system, used by every officer and supporting every type of work it handles advisory, litigation, legislative drafting, prosecution and international matters. You will shape the product's direction and lead its delivery.

The platform will help officers:

  • Track their work from intake to completion, with clear status, ownership and links across divisions.

  • Review and clear work products quickly, in the tools they already use every day.

  • See workload and deadlines so supervisors can assign and prioritise with confidence.

  • Find what they need, including precedents and past work, through modern, AI-assisted search.

  • Work with external systems, such as the courts, law enforcement agencies and whole-of-government platforms.

Where you'll work

This is a hybrid, forward-deployed role based at the Attorney-General's Chambers PARKROYAL COLLECTION Pickering.

In this role, you will

  • Own the product strategy and roadmap. Turn AGC's priorities and officers' needs into a sequenced roadmap, and adjust it as evidence comes in.

  • Use metrics to drive product decisions. Define meaningful measures such as turnaround time, officer adoption and reduced manual data entry, and use them to prioritise the roadmap, assess progress and adjust course.

  • Lead the transition off the legacy platform. Plan for old and new systems running side by side, and work with delivery partners so officers can trust the data throughout.

  • Make build, buy and reuse decisions with Engineering and Design, keeping the platform modular and replaceable.

  • Partner with legal and operational leadership across divisions. Understand why processes work the way they do, and propose changes where the process, not the system, is the constraint.

  • Guide and develop the product team. Work closely with and mentor the product managers and product operations staff on the team and help AGC build its own product capability over time.

You'll thrive in this role if...

  • You have taken a legacy system through replacement before. You know the hard parts are running two systems at once, migrating data and winning over reluctant users.

  • You think in platforms, not modules. You would rather solve a common problem once for every division than build it five times.

  • You are comfortable being hands-on. You write the acceptance criteria and sit with users yourself, not only through a team.

  • You earn trust with expert users. You can hold a credible conversation with senior legal officers about how their workflows.

  • You think in outcomes. You start with what problem you are solving and how you will know it is solved.

Experience in legal, justice or other regulated domains is helpful but not essential. We value product judgement and the ability to learn a complex domain over industry background.

What you'll bring

  • 8–12 years of product management experience, including owning a complex platform or enterprise system end to end.

  • Experience/Exposure in replacing or modularising a legacy system incrementally, including data migration.

  • Experience with case management, workflow or document management systems, and with integrating across systems.

  • Experience working with and holding delivery partners and vendors to account.

  • Strong facilitation and stakeholder skills with senior, specialist users.

Bonus points: experience in legal, justice or regulatory tech; exposure to AI-assisted search or information retrieval; familiarity with SharePoint or Microsoft 365 integration.

What success looks like

In your first year, you will have succeeded when:

  • The first release is live and used by officers, and there is evidence it reduced the time and effort involved in their work.

  • The platform is measured by outcomes. Leadership reviews progress through agreed measures, not only milestone dates.

  • The transition is on track. Officers can rely on data across the old and new systems, and there is a credible path to retiring the legacy platform.

  • Shared capabilities are being reused. New releases build on what was built for earlier ones, rather than each division getting its own version.

Why this role is different

This is not a greenfield build. You will be modernising a system that every officer in AGC relies on daily, while their work carries on uninterrupted.

Some problems will need strong new product capabilities. Others will need a process simplified or a policy revisited, and some will need a deliberate decision not to rebuild something at all. The platform and ways of working you establish will shape how AGC's officers work for years to come.

What we offer you:

GovTech is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive workplace that values diverse voices and perspectives, as we believe that diversity is the foundation to innovation.

Our employee benefits are based on a total rewards approach, offering a holistic and market-competitive suite of perks. These include leave benefits to meet your work-life needs and employee wellness programs.

We champion flexible work arrangements (subject to your job role) and trust that you will manage your own time to deliver your best, wherever you are, and whatever works best for you.

Learn more about life inside GovTech at go.gov.sg/GovTechCareers.
Stay connected with us on social media at go.gov.sg/ConnectWithGovTech

title: Senior Frontend Software Engineer, Discovery
description:
ABOUT THE TEAM

Anduril Cyber is focused on positioning Anduril as a lead provider of capabilities to enable offensive cyber missions. Cyber is a new business line at Anduril, and relies upon our fleet of autonomous vehicles, the Lattice operating system, mesh networks, and other hardware products to engage in cyber operations at the edge. We design and build novel solutions to deploy cyber capabilities in unconventional or difficult to reach environments.

The new Lattice for Cyber team will build the core capabilities, experiences, and primitives that allow our Cyber products to operate reliably at scale. This is a founding team working from an unusually blank sheet of paper.

ABOUT THE JOB

As a Software Engineer in Lattice for Cyber, you will build the core capabilities, experiences, and primitives that our offensive Cyber programs rely on. You will solve a wide variety of problems involving networking, autonomy, systems integration, robotics, and more, while making pragmatic engineering tradeoffs along the way.

Above all, Anduril engineers on this team are driven by a "Whatever It Takes" mindset — executing in an expedient, scalable, and pragmatic way while keeping the mission top-of-mind and making sound engineering decisions to deliver successful outcomes on-time and with high quality. Not only will you build the software, you’ll have the opportunity to work with the customer’s to deploy it.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Work with design teams and cyber subject matter experts to build a brand new UX product that enables US and allied nations to perform offensive cyber missions at scale.
  • Design and build an extensible React-based component system as a foundation for other cyber teams to build upon for their customer’s use cases and integrations.
  • Build the UX that powers our offensive cyber products such as command and control, autonomous cyber behavior trees, SIGINT analysis tools, and data exfiltration pipelines.
  • Work directly with program teams and customers as they build real missions on your products.
  • Contribute to technical leadership, design clarity, and long-term maintainability across a growing software stack.
  • Incorporate AI/LLM-enabled workflow features where they improve analyst or operator effectiveness without compromising system reliability.
  • Contribute back to the Lattice software platform core, allowing your products to provide value across the entire company.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • 5+ years of experience designing, building, and operating production software.
  • Strong front-end engineering experience in modern TypeScript/React application development, Angular, Vue.js or similar tools.
  • Ability to debug across the full stack, including logs, networking, interfaces, configuration, and hardware/software boundaries.
  • Practical experience with Linux and containerized deployment.
  • Comfort collaborating with cross-functional engineering teams and translating ambiguous requirements into clean user experiences.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills for technical reviews and architecture discussions.
  • Based in, or willing to relocate to, the Washington, DC or the Orange County, CA metro areas.
  • Willingness to travel up to 20% of the time support program teams and customer events.
  • US security clearance eligible

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Exposure to AI/LLM integration patterns, inference workflows, tool orchestration, or model-assisted application features.
  • Track record of technical leadership, productization work, or direct customer interface in complex engineering environments.
  • Prior work delivering into air-gapped or otherwise constrained deployment environments.
  • Hands-on offensive or defensive cyber background.
  • An active U.S. Security clearance.

US Salary Range

$191,000 - $253,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

  • No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

  • Please always verify communications:
    • Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.
    • Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

title: Robotics Manipulator Engineer (Software Architecture)

description:
Your Mission

This position is responsible for building a robotic manipulation software platform that transforms proven bin-picking technologies into a scalable, maintainable, and deployable product for rollout across manufacturing facilities worldwide. The successful candidate will lead the internalization, standardization, and productization of the company’s robotic manipulation software platform.

What To Expect
  • Define and maintain the overall architecture of the robotic manipulation software platform.
  • Transform existing project-specific software into a reusable and configurable software product.
  • Establish software architecture standards, coding guidelines, and development frameworks.
  • Drive the modularization and standardization of software components for global deployment.
  • Design scalable software infrastructure that supports multiple factories, part families, and robotic cells.
  • Architect end-to-end robotic manipulation pipelines, including vision processing, object segmentation, 6D pose estimation, grasp planning, motion planning, and robot execution.
  • Design scalable MLOps infrastructure and architect AI model deployment workflows, including data management, model training, validation, deployment, and monitoring.
  • Develop deployment strategies for global factory rollouts.
  • Create software architecture documentation, standards, and best practices.
  • Support technology transfer to regional engineering teams.
  • Lead architecture reviews and technical design discussions, and evaluate emerging robotics and AI technologies.
  • Prepare technical reports, document program code, and develop setup manuals.
What You'll Bring
  • Master’s or PhD degree in Robotics, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related discipline, with more than 3 years of industry experience.
  • Extensive experience in software architecture or robotics software development.
  • Proven ability to develop scalable software platforms rather than project-specific solutions.
  • Experience with industrial automation systems and a strong understanding of industrial communication protocols such as OPC UA and PROFINET.
  • Proficiency in implementing control and communication solutions using C#, SQL, REST APIs, and MQTT.
  • Ability to program industrial robotic manipulators using C/C++ and Python.
  • Strong knowledge of robotic bin-picking systems and related AI solutions, including pose estimation, synthetic data generation, reinforcement learning, and imitation learning.
  • Experience with ROS 1 or ROS 2, Linux-based operating systems, ARM-based systems, and related libraries and software tools.
  • Patents, publications, specialist certifications, or awards in robotics and automation would be an added advantage.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills and a methodical approach to fault diagnosis.

title: Studiejob: Struktureret Bæredygtighedskonsulent
description:
Løbende rekruttering

Vi rekrutterer løbende til vores stillinger. Dette betyder at vi ikke opererer med en fast ansøgningsfrist. Stillingerne kan dog blive besat til enhver tid, så hvis du er interesseret i én specifik stilling, så anbefales det at ansøge med det samme.

Studiejob: Struktureret Bæredygtighedskonsulent

Har du interesse for bæredygtighed og data - og elsker du at skabe struktur? Så er dette måske jobbet for dig!

Studerende præsenterer sine synspunkter til workshop om energiledelse

Hvem er Cand?

Cand skaber udviklingsmuligheder i samspillet mellem studerende og virksomheder. Vi gør det nemt for virksomheder at opnå positive resultater med studerende i studierelevante jobs - og det er her, du kommer ind i billedet. Du bliver nemlig ansat som konsulent hos Cand. Vi ansætter studerende fra mange forskellige uddannelser, og det er både for bachelor- og kandidatstuderende. Det vigtigste for os er, at du brænder for at vise, hvordan du - med din personlighed, dine talenter og din faglige profil - skaber værdi i et studierelevant job hos vores samarbejdspartnere.

Studiejobbet

Vores samarbejdspartner søger en struktureret og nysgerrig studerende, der har lyst til at arbejde med bæredygtighed, emballage og de nye EU-krav på området.

Virksomheden importerer en bred vifte af produkter fra bl.a. Kina og Vietnam og har derfor mange forskellige produktkategorier og leverandører at holde styr på. De søger en studerende, der kan være med til at skabe struktur og få endnu bedre styr på data, dokumentation og krav inden for emballage og bæredygtighed.

Dine arbejdsopgaver kan bl.a. være:

  • Indsamling og strukturering af data om emballage og bæredygtighed

  • Arbejde med de nye EU-emballageregler (PPWR)

  • Skabe struktur på tværs af forskellige produktkategorier

  • Indhente information og dokumentation fra leverandører

  • Dialog og opfølgning med leverandører i bl.a. Kina og Vietnam

  • Understøtte test og vurdering af emballage på forskellige produktgrupper

  • Samarbejde med interne kolleger og eksterne importører

  • Bidrage til at udvikle og systematisere processer omkring bæredygtighed og emballage

Rollen vil løbende udvikle sig, efterhånden som du får mere indsigt i virksomheden og området.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Er struktureret og detaljeorienteret

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og tage ansvar for dine opgaver

  • Har lyst til at skabe struktur i data og processer

  • Er nysgerrig og har lyst til at sætte dig ind i nye regler og problemstillinger

  • Tør stille spørgsmål og sige din mening

  • Har mod på dialog med leverandører

  • Har interesse for bæredygtighed, ESG, compliance eller lignende

Det er ikke et krav, at du allerede har erfaring med PPWR eller bæredygtighed. Det vigtigste er, at du har lyst til at lære området at kende og kan arbejde struktureret med mange forskellige informationer.

Virksomheden

Du bliver en del af en veletableret dansk handelsvirksomhed med omkring 350 medarbejdere i alt, hvoraf ca. 35 arbejder på kontoret i Tilst. Virksomheden importerer og sælger en bred vifte af produkter, og sortimentet spænder bl.a. over planter, elartikler, trævarer, stålvarer, legetøj, værktøj og mange andre produktkategorier.

Virksomheden har et stort internationalt leverandørnetværk og samarbejder bl.a. med leverandører og importører i Asien. Det betyder, at der er mange forskellige produkter, materialer, emballagetyper og krav at holde styr på.

Du bliver en del af indkøbsafdelingen og kommer til at arbejde tæt sammen med virksomhedens indkøbschef. Her får du en central rolle i arbejdet med at skabe struktur omkring data, emballage og bæredygtighed på tværs af de mange produktkategorier.

Virksomheden har en uformel kultur, hvor der er plads til at stille spørgsmål, tage ansvar og komme med egne input. Arbejdspladsen ligger i Tilst.

Sådan kommer du i betragtning til denne studiestilling

Hvis du gerne vil i betragtning til det her studiejob, skal du deltage i Cands rekrutteringsevent. Vi kalder det ‘Get to Know You’. Hos Cand kigger vi hverken på dine karakterer eller dine tidligere erfaringer. Vi møder dig der, hvor du er i dit studieliv. Vi ansætter engagerede studerende, der er klar til at udvikle deres talenter i et fagligt og socialt talentforløb, der åbner karrieremuligheder. title: Satellite Ground Station Technician
location: Alice Springs, Alice Springs & Central Australia NT
description:
Geoscience Australia values the lands, water and sky as we work to deepen a shared understanding of Country and Earth. We respect First Nations peoples and their enduring connection, contribution and obligations to Country. Reflecting on our shared history, we are committed to listen and learn.

About us

Geoscience Australia is Australia's pre-eminent public sector geoscience organisation. We are the nation's trusted advisor on the geology and geography of Australia. We apply science and technology to describe and understand the Earth for the benefit of Australia. We apply our diverse professional expertise, our deep and trusted knowledge, our national-scale Earth observation infrastructure and our strong partnerships to the opportunities and challenges that face our nation.

Our team

The Ground Station Operations team within Satellite Land Imaging Collection Branch is responsible for the operation and lifecycle management of the in-service Alice Springs Ground Station and associated infrastructure to ensure that Geoscience Australia meets satellite data (including Earth observation and satellite health) collection performance metrics that are required by our international partnerships. The team is also responsible for supporting the delivery of an upgraded satellite ground station to meet the requirements of the Landsat Next program.

What we can offer you

When you work at Geoscience Australia you will have access to a range of benefits and the opportunity to experience a workplace culture that truly values and promotes diversity, inclusion, equity and belonging. To learn more about our competitive salary, secure onsite parking, generous flexible working arrangements and the role you can play in growing our culture click here. You may be eligible for a remote locality allowance; further information can be found in the Geoscience Australia Enterprise Agreement.

Our culture

Our strength lies in our people, including our diversity in backgrounds, skills and experiences, and the way we work together to respond to the emerging needs of our work. We value diversity in gender, backgrounds, culture, and experiences of our employees and are committed to providing an inclusive workplace culture that ensures everyone has equal opportunity to contribute, participate and progress. Applications from people who reflect this diversity are encouraged.

Our workplace is committed to the health, safety and wellbeing of our employees and offers a variety of flexible working arrangements to enhance flexibility, including remote working arrangements.

The role

The Ground Station Operations team within Satellite Land Imaging Collection Branch is responsible for the operation and lifecycle management of the in-service Alice Springs Ground Station and associated infrastructure to ensure that Geoscience Australia meets satellite data (including Earth observation and satellite health) collection performance metrics that are required by our international partnerships. The team is also responsible for supporting the delivery of an upgraded satellite ground station to meet the requirements of the Landsat Next program. Learn more about the Landsat program and our work here.

The Satellite Ground Station Technician ensures the reliable operation and maintenance of Geoscience Australia’s Alice Springs Ground Station. The role supports daily performance monitoring, troubleshooting, and system upkeep to deliver satellite data essential for Australia’s Earth observation programs.

Position Duties

In this role you will:

  • Monitor ground station performance against agreed indicators and promptly report faults, disruptions, and other technical or operational issues.
  • Support troubleshooting, evaluation, and restoration activities, including repair or replacement of faulty equipment.
  • Assist in coordinating maintenance activities to avoid conflicts with satellite passes, working closely with supervisors, contractors, and service providers.
  • Undertake scheduled and unscheduled maintenance in accordance with established procedures, documenting outcomes and required follow-up actions.
  • Maintain accurate asset and maintenance records, including spares registers, and assist with audits.
  • Support the integration of new equipment and systems under direction.
  • Conduct all activities in accordance with relevant safety requirements and procedures.
  • Develop or update technical documentation such as work instructions, schematics, site records, and change requests.
  • Undertake minor procurement and administrative tasks (e.g., ordering consumables and parts).
  • Supervise one staff member for day-to-day task allocation and work quality monitoring.

Desirable skills, experience, knowledge and/or qualifications

  • Demonstrated experience in satellite ground station system maintenance and operations.
  • Broad understanding of ground station components, such as antennas, power systems, and HVAC.
  • Demonstrated experience with Linux operating systems, network switching/routing, and remote monitoring systems.
  • Demonstrated technical and analytical skills to diagnose and resolve faults.
  • Demonstrated experience in preparing maintenance records, serviceability reports, and contributing to maintenance scheduling and forecasting activities.
  • Demonstrated experience in the areas of project management, administration, procurement, or contracting.
  • Certificate III (AQF Level 3 or above) in electronics, electrical or IT from an Australian institution or comparable qualifications assessed by an accreditation body (e.g., Engineers Australia or Trades Recognition Australia).
  • Current working at heights certificate and elevated work platform licence, or ability to attain these.
  • Ability to work with limited direction while following established procedures and safety requirements.
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills to engage with diverse stakeholders.

title: Transformation and Change Management Practitioner
description:

This is a senior consulting role focused on helping private equity investors, portfolio companies, and technology businesses turn strategic ambitions into measurable business outcomes. You will lead complex transformation and change-management programmes spanning operating models, technology, processes, people, and governance. The role combines strategic thinking with hands-on programme leadership, requiring you to engage senior stakeholders and maintain momentum through delivery. You will help organisations build compelling cases for change, align teams around priorities, and embed new ways of working. Your work will directly support growth, operational performance, resilience, customer outcomes, and value creation. You will operate in a collaborative, entrepreneurial environment alongside investment, commercial, operational, financial, and technology specialists.

Accountabilities

  • Lead complex, multi-workstream transformation programmes from initial diagnosis and mobilisation through delivery and the achievement of measurable outcomes.
  • Develop clear transformation roadmaps covering the case for change, target operating model, initiative sequencing, accountabilities, investment requirements, risks, and expected benefits.

title: Ph.d.-studerende til 3-årigt klinisk forskningsprojekt om infektioner i barndommen ved COPSAC, Gentofte Hospital
description:
COPSAC (Copenhagen Prospective Studies on Asthma in Childhood/Dansk BørneAstma Center) søger en ph.d.-studerende til et klinisk projekt omhandlende infektioner i barndommen. Det overordnede formål med projektet er at forstå, hvorfor nogle børn bliver mere syge af infektioner end deres jævnaldrende. Man ved at infektioner tidligt i livet disponerer til senere sygdomsrisiko og er samtidig en hyppig årsag til indlæggelse, derfor vil vi gerne blive klogere på området, så vi kan blive bedre til at forebygge.

Som ph.d.-studerende vil du skulle dykke ned i, hvordan tidlige livsstils- og miljøfaktorer allerede i løbet af graviditeten og i den tidlige barndom er afgørende for infektionstilbøjeligheden op igennem barndommen. Herudover vil du blive introduceret til arbejdet med forskellige forklarende datalag som f.eks. metabolomics og proteomics for at forstå de underliggende mekanismer der er i spil. Studierne vil tage udgangspunkt i data fra den bredt anerkendte danske mor-barn kohorte COPSAC2010 med mulighed for replikation i internationale kohorter, samt mulighed for udlandsophold hos samarbejdspartnere, hvis interesse for dette.

Vi er en klinisk forskningsenhed på Gentofte Hospital med 60 dybt engagerede og ambitiøse medarbejdere, herunder en stor gruppe ph.d.-studerende og postdocs, mange læger, med et stort klinisk team og en administrativ samt statistisk support. Vi brænder for vores arbejde og er stolte over vores resultater og det uhøjtidelige, inspirerende og dynamiske miljø vi sammen skaber hver eneste dag. Forskergruppen har international bevågenhed og området nyder stor offentlig interesse. Projektet er finansieret af en større EU-bevilling til læge og forskningslektor (Associate Professor) Nicklas Brustad, som er hovedvejleder for projektet.

Som forsker hos COPSAC vil du:

  • Blive en del af en velfungerende, uhøjtidelig og inspirerende arbejdsplads
  • Få tæt supervision i alle aspekter af dit projekt
  • Indgå i det kliniske arbejde med undersøgelser af forsøgsdeltagere
  • Tage aktiv del i vores engagerede forskningsgruppe
  • Indgå i et højt kvalificeret team af postdocs, andre ph.d.-studerende og forskningsassistenter
  • Få omfattende støtte af et ”maskinrum” med datamanagers, statistikere, IT-support, økonomi og andet

Vi forventer, at du

  • Har færdiggjort KBU, hvis du er læge og dermed vil indgå i det kliniske team bestående af læger og sygeplejersker.
  • Har en relevant sundhedsfaglig kandidatgrad, hvis du ikke er uddannet læge.
  • Er fleksibel og indstillet på at yde en indsats udover det sædvanlige.
  • Er motiveret for at lære nye kompetencer herunder statistik, artikelskrivning og publicering.

Ansættelsesvilkår

Fuldtidsstilling af 3-årig varighed til besættelse 1. november 2026. Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår følger overenskomst og RegionH´s retningslinjer.

title: Senior Counsel, Privacy
description:
Aledade is seeking a Senior Counsel to join our Privacy Team, reporting to our Privacy Officer and Associate General Counsel. The ideal candidate will work independently to advise on privacy risk, own key privacy verticals end-to-end, and serve as a trusted advisor to internal stakeholders on evolving privacy and AI regulatory issues. The successful candidate must bring strong legal judgment, confidence using AI tools to work efficiently, and enthusiasm for advising the business on emerging AI laws and governance frameworks.

What You’ll Do:

  • Independently manage and own discrete privacy verticals, driving projects from issue-spotting through resolution with minimal oversight.
  • Provide clear, practical, and business-oriented legal advice to internal stakeholders on privacy laws applicable to U.S. healthcare organizations, including HIPAA, state privacy and data breach notification laws, and other applicable federal and state requirements.
  • Advise business, product, and engineering teams on the use of artificial intelligence, including applicable AI-specific laws and regulations, AI governance frameworks, and responsible AI practices.
  • Provide support to our internal commercial contracting team, acting as a subject matter expert for escalated review of privacy-related provisions in vendor agreements, data use agreements, and business associate agreements.
  • Support the development and maintenance of privacy policies, procedures, and training materials.
  • Partner cross-functionally with Compliance, Security, IT, and business teams to identify privacy risks and implement practical, risk-based solutions.
  • Monitor developments in privacy and AI law and proactively communicate implications to relevant stakeholders.
  • Support responses to privacy incidents, regulatory inquiries, and audits as needed.
  • Use AI tools thoughtfully and effectively in day-to-day legal work to improve efficiency, quality, and turnaround time.

What We’re Looking For:

  • J.D. and active license to practice law in at least one U.S. jurisdiction, in good standing.
  • Minimum of 6 years of total legal experience, including at least 2 years at a law firm with substantive privacy or healthcare regulatory work.
  • Prior experience advising healthcare organizations or clients on privacy, regulatory, or compliance matters is required.
  • Working knowledge of HIPAA and other U.S. privacy laws applicable to healthcare entities; familiarity with emerging state and federal AI laws is a plus.
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and exercise sound judgment with limited supervision.
  • A self-starter mindset with a genuine willingness to take ownership of projects and privacy verticals, rather than waiting for direction.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex legal concepts into clear, actionable guidance for non-lawyers.
  • Comfort and enthusiasm using AI tools (e.g., generative AI, legal research and drafting assistants) as part of a daily legal workflow.
  • Interest in and willingness to advise on AI governance and AI-related legal and regulatory issues as they intersect with privacy.
  • Strong collaboration skills and the ability to build trust with stakeholders across legal, compliance, product, and business teams.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Professional certifications such as Certified Information Privacy Professional (CIPP), Certified Information Privacy Manager (CIPM), or Artificial Intelligence Governance Professional (AIGP).
  • Familiarity with privacy program frameworks (e.g., NIST Privacy Framework) and/or AI governance frameworks (e.g., NIST AI RMF).
  • Prior in-house experience, particularly within the healthcare or health tech industry.
Who We Are:
Aledade PBC, a public benefit corporation, exists to empower the most transformational part of our health care landscape - independent primary care. We were founded in 2014, and since then, we've become the largest network of independent primary care in the country - helping practices, health centers and clinics deliver better care to their patients and thrive in value-based care. Additionally, by creating value-based contracts across a wide variety of health plans, we aim to flip the script on the traditional fee-for-service model. Our work strengthens continuity of care, aligns incentives and ensures primary care physicians are paid for what they do best - keeping patients healthy. If you want to help create a health care system that is good for patients, good for practices and good for society - and if you're eager to join a collaborative, inclusive and remote-first culture - you've come to the right place.
What Does This Mean for You?
At Aledade PBC, you will be part of a creative culture that is driven by a passion for tackling complex issues with respect, open-mindedness and a desire to learn. You will collaborate with team members who bring a wide range of experiences, interests, backgrounds, beliefs and achievements to their work - and who are all united by a shared passion for public health and a commitment to the Aledade mission.

  • Het uitvoeren van een grondige inspectie van het gebouw bij aanvang van de werkzaamheden.
  • Het uitwerken van de methode van kablering binnen het gebouw, rekening houdend met de specifieke kenmerken van elk project.
  • Het opmaken en verwerken van de dossiers op kantoor.
  • Het coördineren met verschillende stakeholders om een soepel verloop van de werkzaamheden te waarborgen.

Mogelijkheid om te starten via een individuele beroepsopleiding. Dit is een maatregel waarbij je opleiding in het bedrijf volgt van minimum 1 maand tot maximum 6 maanden waarbij werkloosheidsuitkering of leefloon behouden blijft + een opleidingsvergoeding. Dit kan ook voor vrij werkzoekenden en schoolverlaters zonder uitkering. Na de opleiding volgt een contract van bepaalde of onbepaalde duur na een succesvolle afronding van de IBO. Meer info zie https://www.vdab.be/ibo.

  • Ervaring als surveyor of opmeter is een troef, maar geen vereiste.
  • Technisch inzicht en een nauwkeurige werkhouding.
  • Je spreekt vloeiend Nederlands.
  • Zelfstandig, betrouwbaar en stressbestendig.
