title: Postdoc positions ‘Hybrid War and Democracy’ at The Danish Institute for Advanced Study DIAS
description:
The Danish Institute for Advanced Study (DIAS) at the University of Southern Denmark, Odense, invites applications for one or more full-time Postdoc positions.

The ’Hybrid War and Democracy’ initiative explores changes in how international conflicts are waged. Domestic and foreign influence campaigns are bolstered by new digital technologies and artificial intelligence. This creates new challenges for democracies, threat perceptions, information integrity, and for citizens’ information agency.

The postdoc positions will be part of a broader initiative understanding these new dynamics.

Employment is expected to begin on April 1, 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter, and will be for a period of up to two years. The place of employment will be Odense.


Research profiles and tasks

We are looking for a candidate with a background in computational social sciences, data science, including (but not limited to) computer science, communication, political science, linguistics, information studies, digital humanities, sociology or psychology.

An ideal candidate would have a strong interest in the topic and bring methodological skills to conduct cutting edge work in this space. The Postdoc(s) will be embedded in an interdisciplinary project team and collaborate closely with other scholars at DIAS and the Centre for Digital Democracy.

Candidates must have a research profile grounded in the use of computational methods to answer social science questions. Research within this project will primarily involve using quantitative and computational techniques as well as surveys and/ or experiments.


Expectations and key responsibilities

The Postdoc(s) will be involved in all aspects of the research, from conception, execution, analysis, publishing, and public dissemination. A strong background in computational techniques is necessary, and experience the topic would be ideal.

Candidates are expected to be willing and able to contribute to DIAS and DDC by producing original research of high international quality, engaging in information exchange with both academic and non-academic actors (e.g., journalists, the public, and policy makers), contributing to grant acquisition efforts, and translating technical details across different disciplines.

Candidates are expected to:

  • Be capable of working independently and on a team through the research process, including with regards to data collection, data analysis, writing scientific articles, and knowledge dissemination.

  • Be able to translate methodological specifics to non-computational researchers

  • Contribute both academically and socially to the research environment at DIAS and the DDC

  • Code proficiently in R or Python.

  • Be able to communicate project results in English both in writing in academic contexts and to the broader public (Danish would be an advantage but not required)

  • Present research results at international conferences in social science or computational disciplines

  • Possibly contribute to teaching programs (in consultation with relevant departments)

  • Work and be present in Odense

Inquiries about the project and the positions can be addressed to Prof. Claes de Vreese (chv@sam.sdu.dk).


About The Danish Institute for Advanced Study (DIAS)

DIAS at SDU is a hub for interdisciplinary excellence at and beyond the frontier of knowledge, bringing together outstanding researchers from various disciplines to foster groundbreaking interdisciplinary research and bold innovation. DIAS nurtures a collaborative and curiosity-driven environment, encouraging scholars to think outside the box and challenge conventional boundaries. The institute values open-minded exploration and an ambitious yet collegial atmosphere with a strong sense of community. Researchers affiliated with DIAS are expected to contribute actively to DIAS activities, and engage in interdisciplinary collaborations across faculties and departments, both nationally and internationally.


About the DDC

The DDC is a part of the Faculty of Business and Social Sciences. It is an interdisciplinary Centre with members from computer science, law, media studies, political science, business, and organizations. The DDC believes in fostering a stimulating and inspiring environment for both faculty members and students. The DDC’s ambition is to recruit, develop, and retain talented scholars committed to both research, education, and impact. Furthermore, the DDC wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.


Living and working in Denmark

Foreign applicants will be offered Danish language training as part of the employment. International Staff Office (ISO) at SDU provides a variety of services for new employees, guests and people who consider applying for a job at the University of Southern Denmark. Among other things, the staff answers questions concerning salary, taxation, housing and accompanying family. Additional information about working in Denmark can be found at Work in Denmark.


Application and assessment process

Appointment to the position requires a PhD degree or equivalent and will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the Danish state with the associated circular on the protocol on job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for the position of postdocs as described herein.

An application must include:

  • A cover letter stating your specific interest and qualifications for the project in question (max two pages). It is strongly encouraged that you include a github link or proof of coding proficiency.

  • Detailed CV, including personal contact information and date entries

  • Copies of certificates and diplomas (BSc, MSc, and PhD degrees)

  • The names and complete contact details (including phone numbers and email addresses) of at least two references

  • A complete list of publications indicating which publications are most relevant for the position

  • The 3 most relevant publications or unpublished chapters of the PhD thesis.
    NOTE: If publications have been co-authored, co-author statements must be included and contain information like in this example. The statement is just for your inspiration

  • A teaching portfolio as documentation for teaching experience (if applicable).

All non-Danish documents must be translated into English.

Documents should not contain a CPR number (civil registration number) – in this case, the CPR number must be crossed out.

Applications that are incomplete may be rejected without any substantive evaluation.

Assessment of applications will be done under the existing Appointment Order for universities. Applications will be assessed by an academic assessment committee that determines whether applicants are qualified to be a postdoctoral fellow. The committee may request additional information, and if so, it is the responsibility of the applicant to provide the necessary material. The committee reserves the right to arrive at a decision solely based on the material submitted.

Shortlisting may be used in the assessment process. As part of the assessment, a short coding test may be held.

When the assessment committee has submitted its report, the applicants will receive the part of the evaluation that concerns them. The assessment report will subsequently be forwarded to the Head of Department who will assemble an appointment committee. The appointment committee will manage and complete a series of job interviews with especially promising applicants. On the basis of the applications, the written assessments, the job interviews, and a deliberation within the appointment committee, the head of department determines which candidate(s) will be offered the position.

We recommend reading "How to apply for a position at SDU" before applying.

Applications must be submitted electronically using the link "Apply now" on our website.

Uploaded files must be in Adobe PDF (unlocked). The application and CV must each not exceed 10 MB in file size.

Application deadline: November 23, 2026, 23:59 CET/CEST.

Applicants may also wish to consider the related DIAS Fellow position in Hybrid War and Democratic Challenges. Candidates interested in both positions must submit a separate application for each position, as appointment to a position is only possible if an application has been submitted for that specific vacancy.

Salary and employment terms

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements.

As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process.

SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary.

title: Director Finance
description:
Your Role in Our Story:

The APAC Finance Director is the senior financial leader for ACT's Asia Pacific business and a key member of the APAC leadership team. You also have a fiduciary role alongside the VP APAC in the running of the business.

Partnering closely with the VP APAC and regional business leaders, you will help shape the commercial and lead the financial direction of the region. You are financially accountable with the business for the value-cash-risk delivery and with that integrate finance, risk, legal, compliance activity for the APAC business: you make the judgment and sets the priorities towards business delivery and performance within the boundaries set by the Group. You identify and assess risk and opportunities, also on behalf of Legal, Accounting, Tax, Treasury, Risk, Compliance (provided minimal external regulatory obligations are met)

This is a broad leadership role spanning commercial finance, financial planning and performance, controllership, cash and working capital, risk and governance, and finance team leadership.

You will act as the bridge between APAC and ACT's global Finance and specialist functions to support informed and timely business decisions. You set the finance agenda, shape and challenge strategy, and integrate specialist inputs to ensure decisions are fact-based, timely, and compliant. With APAC being in a scale up phase, a key success factor will be for you to establish and bring together a positive learning environment so that the APAC Delvery accelerates together.

The role requires someone who can move comfortably between the boardroom and the detail: challenging commercial decisions, being curious & driving new ideas, understanding the economics and risks& opportunities of transactions, while ensuring that the fundamentals of Finance remain strong.

What You Will Do

Partner the business and shape APAC strategy

  • Work closely with the VP APAC and regional leadership team to translate ACT's strategy into financial priorities, resource allocation and measurable business outcomes.
  • Provide independent financial challenge and insight on commercial opportunities, investments, new products, market expansion and other strategic decisions.
  • Evaluate opportunities through a value, cash and risk lens, balancing growth ambitions with appropriate financial discipline and protection of the balance sheet.
  • Support leadership with high-quality analysis, scenario modelling and recommendations that enable faster and better-informed decisions.

Drive financial performance

  • Own the financial planning, budgeting, forecasting and performance management cycle for APAC.
  • Provide leadership with clear visibility into revenue, profitability, costs, cash generation and key business drivers.
  • Identify performance gaps, risks and opportunities early and translate them into actionable recommendations.
  • Partner with commercial teams to improve margins, capital efficiency and overall financial performance.
  • Build meaningful KPIs and management information that connect financial outcomes to operational and commercial drivers.

Own regional Finance delivery and controllership

  • Ensure a pragmatic and risk-based control environment that drives integrated delivery, capturing business opportunities, a learning environment and safeguarding speed and entrepreneurship
  • Ensure APAC's financial reporting, statutory requirements, financial close and audit activities are delivered accurately and on time in accordance with ACT Group standards and applicable local requirements.
  • Maintain strong financial discipline and ensure appropriate implementation of ACT's accounting policies, governance frameworks and internal controls.
  • Oversee regional audit requirements and coordinate with external auditors, advisers and local service providers.
  • Safeguard the pragmatic and risk bases LoD2 environment in which the APAC business delivers
  • Drive standardisation, automation and continuous improvement of Finance processes, working closely with Operations, IT and global Finance teams.

Manage cash, capital and financial risk

  • Drive disciplined working capital and cash management across the region, including receivables, liquidity and banking requirements.
  • Partner with Treasury and Tax on funding, hedging, tax, transfer pricing and capital considerations.
  • Work with Risk and other specialist functions to ensure commercial activities operate within ACT's established risk appetite, policies and delegated authorities.
  • Act as a key first-line business leader in identifying, assessing and managing financial and enterprise risks.
  • Escalate material risks or activities outside established frameworks and ensure appropriate specialist involvement when required.

Strengthen governance across APAC

  • Provide financial leadership and constructive challenge to APAC management on major business decisions, investments, risk exposures and capital allocation.
  • Serve as a Board Member or Director of relevant APAC entities where required, fulfilling applicable fiduciary and statutory responsibilities.
  • Ensure regional operations remain aligned with ACT Group financial objectives, governance standards and risk frameworks.
  • Maintain effective relationships with relevant banks, auditors, advisers, regulators and other external stakeholders.

Build and lead the APAC Finance team & Snr leader for integrated delivery across functions

  • Lead, develop and coach a high-performing regional Finance team as well as bringing together the cross functional leadership and related delivery of the development agendas across Risk, legal, compliance, tax, treasury alongside the global functional directors
  • Set clear priorities and accountability while building strong Finance business partnering capabilities.
  • Create a culture of ownership, commercial curiosity, continuous improvement and high professional standards.
  • Work across geographical and functional boundaries, collaborating closely with Finance Directors in other regions and ACT's global Finance organisation.

Your Expertise:

TWhat Success Looks Like

  • APAC leadership sees Finance as a commercial partner and objective challenger, rather than simply a reporting function. You enhances business impact by optimizing liquidity, governance, and resilience. With deep regional financial and regulatory expertise, you drives informed decision-making, navigate complex product-market dynamics, and balance risk and opportunity
  • Business decisions consistently consider value creation, cash implications and risk.
  • Forecasting and management information provide leadership with a reliable forward-looking view of the business.
  • Working capital and cash are actively managed and financial risks are identified early.
  • Financial reporting, audits and controls are reliable and delivered to a consistently high standard.
  • Regional Finance processes become simpler, more scalable and increasingly automated.
  • The integrated APAC Finance & risk team develops commercial insights, understanding and capability for accelerated future delivery
  • APAC and Group functions operate with clear accountability and minimal gaps or duplication.

What We Are Looking For

You will bring significant experience in senior Finance leadership roles, ideally within an international, commercially driven and fast-moving organisation.

We are looking for someone who combines strong Finance fundamentals with genuine commercial judgement.

  • Around 10+ years of progressive Finance experience, including significant leadership responsibility.
  • A recognised professional Finance or Accounting qualification such as CPA, ACCA, CA or equivalent is a plus
  • Significant experience across financial planning and analysis, budgeting, forecasting, controllership and performance management.
  • Strong knowledge of working capital, cash management, corporate finance, risk and internal controls.
  • Experience leading and developing Finance teams and bringing together cross functional teams towards an integrated agenda.
  • Strong commercial and strategic judgement, with the ability to challenge senior stakeholders constructively.
  • Experience operating across different markets, cultures and regulatory environments.
  • The ability to work effectively within a global matrix organisation and influence without relying solely on formal authority.
  • Strong analytical capability and comfort working with complex or imperfect datasets.
  • A track record of improving processes, controls and Finance operating models.
  • Pragmatic: be specific and detil oriented where critical, alternatively balance speed, entrepreneurship and 80/20 to drive bsuiness outcomes

The Profile We Think Will Thrive

This role will suit someone who is equally comfortable asking:

“Are the numbers right?” and “Should we be doing this business in the first place?”

You are likely to be commercially curious, analytically rigorous and comfortable challenging assumptions. You can zoom into accounting, controls or transaction economics when required, but you do not lose sight of the bigger business picture and are comfortable to speak up

You bring structure where needed without creating bureaucracy for its own sake, and you understand that in a growing business Finance needs to help the organisation move faster with better decisions, not simply apply the brakes.

If you meet these criteria and are ready to contribute your expertise to a dynamic and challenging environment, we encourage you to apply.

Derfor søger vi tre nye kollegaer til Team Socialfaglig, som kan hjælpe os med nye ansøgninger og opfølgninger ved kendte borgere.

Er du uddannet socialrådgiver eller ergoterapeut? Har du interesse for myndighedsarbejdet på det specialiserede voksenområde? Trives du med at træffe afgørelser, følge op på borgersager og samarbejde på tværs af fagligheder?
Så er det måske dig, vi har brug for.

Lidt om Team Socialfaglig
Vi er en myndighedsafdeling, der dagligt træffer afgørelser og har tæt opfølgning i de løbende sager. Vores kerneopgave er Sundhed, Mestring og Fællesskabelse. Vi understøtter borgernes evne til at mestre eget liv inden for rammerne af serviceloven og kommunens serviceniveau.

Vi stiller store faglige krav til os selv og hinanden og prioriterer smil og hjælpsomhed i hverdagen. Vi arbejder en del på tværs af kommunens forvaltninger og afdelinger med borgeren i centrum, så du skal kunne fungere blandt andre faggrupper og bidrage med din faglighed.

Dine opgaver som sagsbehandler i Team Socialfaglig bliver at
  • træffe afgørelser og følge op på borgersager efter serviceloven og sikre, at der altid er den rette indsats på rette tidspunkt
  • samarbejde tværfagligt og koordinerende inden for vores fire centerområder, Center for Hjerneskade og Beskæftigelse, Autismecenter Syd, Bo og Aktivitet og Center for Socialpsykiatri og Rusmiddel samt vores eksterne leverandører
  • sikre progression og at målene for dette fremgår tydeligt i den enkelte sagsbehandling
  • sætte mindsettet omkring recovery-orienteret rehabilitering i spil
  • have særlige ansvarsområder, eksempler på ansvarsområder kan være, Den kommunale ungeindsats, eksternområdet, de borgere som er på botilbud udenfor Aabenraa kommune, med mere
Om dig
Vi forventer, at du
  • er uddannet socialrådgiver eller ergoterapeut
  • har erfaring med arbejdet som sagsbehandler i en myndighedsafdeling. Det er en fordel, hvis du har kendskab til det specialiserede voksenområde
  • kan udarbejde funktionsevneudredninger, socialfaglige vurderinger og kan træffe afgørelser. Har arbejdet med VUM 2.0 og FFB er klart en fordel men ikke et krav
  • kan tage ansvar for opgaver ud over din sagsstamme
  • er god til at kommunikere, både i skrift og tale
  • Ser myndighedsopgaven som en del af løsningen sammen med borgeren og arbejder ud fra en rehabiliterende og helhedsorienteret tilgang, hvor borgerens ressourcer, ønsker og behov er i fokus
  • kan håndtere krydspres og sidde for bordenden
  • er en teamplayer

Vi tilbyder
  • en fleksibel arbejdsplads
  • at blive en del af et stærkt kollegialt fællesskab med dygtige kollegaer, hvor der er plads til faglig sparring, hjælpsomhed og et godt grin. Vi vægter trivsel højt og har en kultur præget af åben dialog og samarbejde
  • et veltilrettelagt introduktionsprogram for de første 14 dage og mentorordning de første tre måneder af din ansættelse
  • gode faglige og sociale fællesskaber

Løn - og ansættelsesvilkår
Der er tale om tre faste stillinger på 37 timer ugentligt med forventet tiltrædelse 1. januar 2027 eller efter aftale. Løn og ansættelse sker efter gældende overenskomst.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte teamleder for Team Socialfaglig Helle Dyhrberg Waje på telefon: 7376 7888.

title: Funding Specialist - Program Management
description:
Position Summary:

The Funding Specialist plays a critical role in the financial operations of fronted insurance programs, managing claims funding, premium flows, and settlements between the fronting carrier, MGA, reinsurers, and other third-party administrators. This role demands a strong understanding of delegated authority structures, cash flow processes, and the financial dynamics of fronted programs. The ideal candidate brings 5–7 years of experience in insurance finance with a focus on claims distributions and premium reconciliation in MGA-fronted arrangements.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Coordinate and manage funding activities between fronting carriers, MGAs, reinsurers, and TPAs to support claims payments and premium settlements.
  • Process and track bordereaux submissions to ensure timely and accurate funding of claims.
  • Prepare and validate funding requests based on claims bordereaux, underwriting performance, and contractual obligations.
  • Reconcile cash flows related to premium collections, claims disbursements, and fees (e.g., fronting fees, ceding commissions, MGA fees).
  • Maintain detailed documentation of all funding activity in accordance with internal audit, compliance, and contractual requirements.
  • Monitor escrow and trust account balances to ensure sufficiency for current and future program obligations.
  • Collaborate closely with program managers, finance, claims, legal, and compliance teams to ensure end-to-end funding accuracy.
  • Act as a liaison between internal departments and external partners (MGAs, TPAs, reinsurers, auditors).
  • Support month-end and quarterly close processes including reporting on funding activity and account reconciliations.
  • Recommend enhancements to existing processes and tools to drive greater accuracy, speed, and transparency.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting, Insurance, or a related field.
  • 5–7 years of experience in insurance program operations or finance, with strong exposure to fronting arrangements and MGA partnerships.
  • Deep understanding of insurance program mechanics, including bordereaux processing, TPA/MGA workflows, and premium/claims allocation.
  • Proficient in Excel and financial software.
  • Highly detail-oriented with a strong analytical mindset and ability to manage competing priorities.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills with the ability to interface effectively with both internal teams and external partners.
  • Working knowledge of regulatory and contractual funding requirements, including trust and collateralized accounts.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience working with fronting carriers and MGA/TPA ecosystems in commercial lines or E&S markets.
  • Familiarity with reinsurance flows within fronted programs (optional but beneficial).
  • Industry certifications such as AIAF, ARe, CPCU, or CPA are a plus.
  • Experience with bordereaux platforms or program administration tools (e.g., Insurity, Origami, VIPR, or custom-built solutions).

title: Assembler 2- Compressor Line Lead Technician
description:

The Line Lead serves as a day-to-day operational resource for employees within the assigned area, helping coordinate workflow, communicate production priorities, support training efforts, and drive safe, efficient operations while partnering closely with supervisors and management.

How will you make a difference:

The Compressor Line Lead is responsible for providing day-to-day leadership and operational support within the Compressor production line while performing assembly and production-related activities as needed. This position is accountable for supporting safety, quality, delivery, productivity, employee engagement, 5S, and continuous improvement initiatives. The Line Lead serves as a key communication link between operators and leadership while helping ensure operational continuity, workforce coordination, and production excellence. The Compressor Line Lead is expected to take ownership of the assigned production area by promoting accountability, supporting employee development, identifying opportunities for improvement, and leading by example in all aspects of performance.

Monday - Thursday 5:00am - 3:30pm. This position might require flexibility to work overtime on Fridays and Saturdays.

Location: KRC 4800 Deramus Ave Kansas City, MO 64120

What do we want to know about you?

  • High school diploma, associate’s degree or equivalent preferred.
  • Minimum 2-3 years in manufacturing, assembly, repair, or production experience preferred.
  • Ability to effectively communicate, read, and understand work instructions, procedures, and business communications in English.
  • Bilingual capabilities (English/Spanish) are highly preferred.
  • Demonstrated leadership capabilities and ability to positively influence team performance.
  • Knowledge and understanding of specialized equipment, hand tools, and production processes.

  • Ability to monitor production metrics and identify barriers impacting safety, quality, delivery, and productivity.
  • Ability to maintain confidentiality and appropriately escalate employee concerns.

Other Qualifications:

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills.Ability to lead by example and promote accountability.

  • Ability to identify and escalate safety, quality, and operational concerns.
  • Mechanical aptitude and manufacturing experience preferred.Ability to read and follow work instructions, drawings, procedures, and specifications.
  • Computer skills and/or experience with Microsoft office is highly preferred.
  • Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills within defined responsibilities.

What will your typical day look like?

  • Lead by example through professionalism, attendance, work ethic, safety compliance, and positive engagement.
  • Communicate daily production goals, priorities, and expectations to team members.

  • Support employee onboarding, training, and cross-training activities.
  • Serve as the first point of contact for routine employee questions and concerns.
  • Communicate employee concerns, staffing challenges, and operational issues to supervisors and management.
  • Foster teamwork, accountability, and collaboration across the production floor.
  • Participate in and/or lead daily GEMBA board discussions and production meetings as assigned.
  • Promote and model safe work practices while ensuring compliance with all safety policies, procedures, and PPE requirements.
  • Identify, report, and escalate safety hazards, incidents, and unsafe conditions.
  • Support safety initiatives, workplace inspections, and corrective actions to maintain a safe work environment.
  • Ensure adherence to quality standards, work instructions, and established production processes.
  • Communicate quality concerns promptly and support corrective actions.
  • Coach employees on quality expectations and encourage defect prevention and continuous improvement.
  • Coordinate daily workflow and staffing to support production schedules and operational goals.
  • Monitor line performance, communicate production barriers, and assist in resolving operational issues.
  • Support training, cross-training, and production coverage while maintaining workflow continuity and productivity.
  • Take ownership of the assigned production line, including supporting people, safety, quality, delivery, and operational results.
  • Promote and sustain 5S standards, workplace organization, and standard work practices.
  • Identify opportunities to improve safety, quality, productivity, and efficiency and support implementation of approved improvements.
  • Encourage employee participation in continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Coordinate staffing needs and support production coverage during employee absences.

  • Verify employees are following established work instructions, quality standards, and production procedures.

What about the physical demands of the job? (The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.)

  • Regularly lift, move, carry, push, and/or pull materials, components, and equipment weighing up to 50 pounds.
  • Walk throughout the production facility and remain on your feet for extended periods, including the duration of a full shift.

  • Move between workstations and production areas to provide operational support, training, coverage, and workflow coordination.
  • Maintain regular on-site attendance and presence during scheduled shifts to support employees and production operations.

Work Environment: (The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job.)

Work is performed in shop environment that is non-temperature-controlled production environment, with exposure to varying temperatures and other environmental factors. Our job titles may span more than one career level.

title: Senior Platform Engineer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Platform Engineer based in Netherlands.

As a Senior Platform Engineer, you will help build and evolve the foundational infrastructure and services that enable product and engineering teams to work efficiently at scale. You’ll combine strong software engineering skills with hands-on expertise across GCP, AWS, Kubernetes, and Terraform. The role offers significant ownership over platform architecture, infrastructure automation, reliability, security, and developer experience. You’ll work closely with development teams to understand their needs and turn them into scalable self-service solutions. You’ll also contribute to CI/CD systems, internal tools, APIs, and operational improvements. This is an individual contributor role within a collaborative, globally distributed, and fully remote engineering environment.

Accountabilities

  • Design, build, and continuously improve scalable, reliable, and secure cloud infrastructure across GCP and AWS.
  • Architect and maintain Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, applying software engineering practices such as reusable modules, testing, and predictable deployments.
  • Deploy, operate, and optimize Kubernetes environments, including GKE and EKS, with responsibility for networking, upgrades, service meshes, availability, performance, and resource utilization.
  • Develop and maintain internal CI/CD systems and automation using technologies such as Argo CD, Atlantis, or similar tools.
  • Diagnose and resolve complex platform issues involving performance, scalability, reliability, and security, while contributing to incident response and post-mortem processes.
  • Drive automation initiatives that reduce manual work, minimize operational risk, and improve system reliability and efficiency.
  • Partner closely with development teams to understand infrastructure and developer-experience needs and translate them into effective platform capabilities and roadmaps.
  • Develop internal platform products, services, tools, and APIs that improve self-service and developer productivity.
  • Implement strong cloud security practices covering access control, vulnerability management, encryption, compliance, audits, and relevant standards such as SOC 2 and GDPR.
  • Contribute to technical direction through code reviews, knowledge sharing, mentorship, and close collaboration with engineering peers.

    • Requirements

    • 6+ years of experience in platform engineering, DevOps engineering, or a closely related field, with experience building and operating complex cloud infrastructure.
    • Strong hands-on experience with GCP and/or AWS, Kubernetes including GKE/EKS, and Terraform.
    • Proven ability to build scalable, reliable, secure, and highly automated cloud environments.
    • Strong software engineering fundamentals and coding proficiency in Go, TypeScript, or another relevant programming language, including knowledge of data structures, algorithms, testing, and defensive programming.

    • Solid understanding of networking concepts and protocols within cloud environments.

    • Knowledge of cloud security best practices and experience applying them to production environments.
    • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
    • Self-organized, proactive, goal-oriented, and comfortable taking ownership in an individual contributor role.
    • Ability to collaborate effectively within a remote, distributed, and international engineering team.
    • Previous experience working specifically on platform engineering initiatives and internal developer platforms.

title: DIAS Fellow in Hybrid War and Democratic Challenges
description:
The Danish Institute for Advanced Study (DIAS) and the Digital Democracy Centre (DDC) at the University of Southern Denmark (SDU) seek an outstanding candidate to fill a tenure track Fellow (Assistant Professor level) position with a background in computational social sciences, data science, including (but not limited to) computer science, communication, political science, linguistics, information studies, digital humanities, sociology or psychology on the topic of Hybrid War and Democratic Challenges. The candidate is expected to start on April 1, 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter. The place of employment will be Odense.

The ’Hybrid War and Democracy’ initiative explores changes in how international conflicts are waged. Domestic and foreign influence campaigns are bolstered by new digital technologies and artificial intelligence. This creates new challenges for democracies, threat perceptions, information integrity, and for citizens’ information agency.

We are looking for a researcher with clear potential for research excellence who thrives in and is inspired by interdisciplinary collaboration. The ideal candidate will be expected to contribute to high-quality research in their field while embracing DIAS’s mission of curiosity-driven inquiry and interdisciplinary dialogue. The successful candidate should have a strong and promising research profile, with potential for attracting external research funding, and a demonstrated ability to work across disciplines. The candidate will be attached to both the DDC and DIAS and should be prepared to engage in multiple and diverse research environments at SDU. Teaching obligations will be reduced compared to a standard assistant professorship at SDU, allowing more time for research and leadership activities.

The ideal candidate should demonstrate:

  • A commitment to engaging in boundary-crossing interdisciplinary research and dialogue.

  • A strong commitment to interdisciplinary collaboration, contributing to research that bridges multiple fields.

  • Strong interest in driving internationally competitive research activities at the highest level of ambition.

  • Engagement in various forms of research dissemination, including interdisciplinary research and dialogue.

  • Ability to communicate project results in English both in writing in academic contexts and to the broader public.

  • Ability of working independently and on a team through research process, including data collection, data analysis, writing scientific articles, and knowledge dissemination.

  • Ability (preferably) to work with computational methods.


Qualifications

Successful applicants must:

  • Hold a PhD or similar qualifications within relevant fields of computational social sciences, data science, including (but not limited to) computer science, communication, political science, linguistics, information studies, digital humanities, sociology or psychology.

  • To qualify for the position as Assistant Professor you must have obtained (or approved to defend) a PhD or similar degree by the application deadline.

  • Exhibit curiosity-driven research excellence, thinking beyond traditional boundaries.

  • Be fluent in English.

  • Show potential for attracting external research funding. Experience in applying for external funding and a strong international network, are considered comparative advantages.

  • Have research publications that demonstrate their excellence and broad thinking.


The Danish Institute for Advanced Study (DIAS)

DIAS at SDU is a hub for interdisciplinary excellence at and beyond the frontier of knowledge, bringing together outstanding researchers from various disciplines to foster groundbreaking interdisciplinary research and bold innovation. DIAS nurtures a collaborative and curiosity-driven environment, encouraging scholars to think outside the box and challenge conventional boundaries. The institute values open-minded exploration and an ambitious yet collegial atmosphere with a strong sense of community. Researchers affiliated with DIAS are expected to contribute actively to DIAS activities, and engage in interdisciplinary collaborations across faculties and departments, both nationally and internationally.


About the DDC

The DDC is a part of the Faculty of Social Sciences. It is an interdisciplinary Centre with members from computer science, law, media studies, political science, business, and organizations. The DDC believes in fostering a stimulating and inspiring environment for both faculty members and students. The DDC’s ambition is to recruit, develop, and retain talented scholars committed to both research, education, and impact. Furthermore, the DDC wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.


Additional information

For further information about being a fellow at DIAS, please contact DIAS director Sten Rynning at +45 6550 2193 or via email (director-dias@sdu.dk).

For more questions about the position please contact Prof Claes de Vreese via email (chv@sam.sdu.dk).


Application, salary, and employment terms

The position is based at the DDC and DIAS in Odense and includes regular participation in DIAS and interdisciplinary collaboration.

Employment is governed by the collective agreement between the Danish Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations (AC).

The salary comprises a seniority-based base salary and a centrally agreed supplement.

Additional supplements may be negotiated locally.

As of 1 August 2026, the annual salary for an Assistant Professor is DKK 480,224.96 (salary level 6), consisting of a base salary of DKK 417,456 and a supplement of DKK 62,768.96.

All amounts are stated before tax, before added pension (18.07%), and any additional supplements. Pension contributions are paid by SDU, and both salary components (the annual salary and the supplement) are pensionable. For further information, please see SDU’s pages on salary, taxation, and general employment conditions.

SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary.


Danish Tenure Track Programme

An appointment as Assistant Professor (Danish tenure track) is limited to a six-year term. The academic assessment for promotion to Associate Professor must be initiated no later than the end of the fifth year of employment. However, a tenure track assistant professor may request an earlier assessment within the first four years.

If the initial assessment is negative, one reassessment may be conducted during the final six months prior to a potential transition. A maximum of two assessments may be undertaken.

A positive assessment leads to appointment to a permanent Associate Professor position. If the final assessment is negative, the employment may be terminated in accordance with the applicable collective agreement.

A six-year development plan for the tenure track programme is established at the start of employment.


Application requirements
The application must include the following:

  • Letter of motivation that clearly explains the applicant's interest, qualifications, and motivation for the position.

  • Detailed CV including documentation of experience, and contacts for possible references.

  • An elaborated research and funding plan (max 4 pages) for the next three years including a description of synergy with the department's activities and the potential to benefit from DIAS’s interdisciplinary environment.

  • Copies of certificates/Diplomas (Master and PhD degree).

  • Complete list of publications, indicating which publications are most relevant for the position.

  • Up to 3 of the most relevant research articles – if you submit a monograph, it counts as 3 articles. Please upload one PDF file for each publication. For co-authored publications, briefly describe the extent of the co-authorship or your contribution to the publications (please do this for each co-authored publication). You can do so by using this form or by describing the co-authorship in such a way that the committee can assess the extent of your contribution.

  • Applicants are requested to submit a teaching portfolio with the application as documentation for teaching experience as well as supervision qualifications. Formal application instructions and a guide for the teaching portfolio can be found here.

All application materials must be submitted in English, and only applications written in English will be considered.

We recommend that international applicants take the time to visit websites of Work in Denmark and the International Staff Office at SDU. Here you can find information and facts about moving to, working and living in Denmark.


Submission guidelines

  • Files must be submitted in PDF format.

  • If multiple files are needed for a single section, combine them into one PDF file.

  • Zip files, image files (jpg, png, etc.), and password-protected PDF files will not be accepted. All PDF files must be unlocked to allow binding.

  • Applications received after the deadline will not be considered.


Assessment

Shortlisting may be used as part of the assessment process. Read about shortlisting at SDU.

Assessment of applications will be done under the existing Appointment Order for universities. Applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. The committee may request additional information, and, if so, it is the responsibility of the applicant to provide the necessary material.

When the assessment committee has submitted its report, the applicant will receive the part of the evaluation that concerns them.

Applications that are incomplete with regards to the above requirements will not be assessed by the committee. Shortlisting and tests may be used in the assessment process and references may be obtained.


About SDU
SDU is committed to fostering a diverse staff that reflects society’s diversity. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates, regardless of personal background.
SDU was founded in 1966 and now has over 27,000 students, nearly 20% of whom are international. SDU employs more than 3,800 staff and offers 115 study programmes across disciplines such as the humanities, social sciences, natural sciences, health sciences, and engineering. While SDU’s main campus is in Odense, it also has campuses in other locations.


Equal opportunity employment
The University of Southern Denmark is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, colour, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, religion, national origin, age, disability, pregnancy, or any other protected status.

The University of Southern Denmark wishes our staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, are subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position.


How to apply
Applications must be submitted electronically using the link "Apply now" on our website.

We recommend reading "How to apply for a position at SDU" before applying.

If you experience technical problems, please contact hcm-support@sdu.dk.

Application deadline: November 23, 2026, 23:59 CET/CEST.

Applicants may also wish to consider the related Postdoc positions ‘Hybrid War and Democracy’ at The Danish Institute for Advanced Study (DIAS). Candidates interested in both positions must submit a separate application for each position, as appointment to a position is only possible if an application has been submitted for that specific vacancy.

description:

Who will you be working with?

Wabtec's Train Handling solutions include Trip Optimizer® and Locotrol®, which work together to optimize train performance and automate freight operations. Trip Optimizer creates and executes fuel-efficient operating plans that meet schedule and train-handling requirements, while Locotrol enables coordinated control of distributed locomotives throughout the train. Together, these technologies improve train handling, fuel efficiency, operational safety, and the ability to operate longer and heavier trains.

As a Systems Engineer, you will collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams, product management, program leadership, and railroad customers to develop and deliver advanced train automation solutions that drive operational efficiency and business value.

How will you make a difference?

As a Systems Engineer, you will lead portions of the design, development, integration, and deployment of Wabtec's Train Handling portfolio. You will define and manage system requirements, perform trade studies, coordinate verification and validation activities, and contribute to product strategy and feature development.

The successful candidate will bring an AI-native mindset, proactively leveraging AI technologies throughout the engineering lifecycle to accelerate innovation, improve product quality, and enhance customer outcomes. You will identify opportunities to apply advanced analytics, automation, and AI-enabled capabilities to solve complex operational challenges and improve system performance.

What do we want to know about you?

Preferred Qualifications

  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, organizational, and communication skills with the ability to influence technical decisions.
  • Experience collaborating across multiple engineering disciplines and managing competing priorities in a dynamic environment.

At Wabtec, it’s not just about a job - it’s about the impact you make. When our people come together, we’re Expanding the Possible by continuously improving what we do and how we do it - for our clients and each other.

If you’re ready to revolutionize how the world moves for future generations, Wabtec is the place for you.

Wabtec is a leading global provider of equipment, systems, digital solutions, and value-added services for the freight and transit rail sectors. Drawing on more than 150 years of experience, we are leading the way in safety, efficiency, reliability, innovation, and productivity. Whether it’s freight, transit, ports, logistics, mining, industrial, or marine, our expertise, technologies, and people together – are accelerating the future of transportation. title: Tech Architect Practitioner
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Tech Architect Practitioner based in Germany.

This is a senior technical consulting role focused on helping investors, portfolio companies, and technology leaders make effective architecture decisions that support measurable business outcomes. You will lead complex architecture engagements across applications, cloud, infrastructure, integration, data, security, and software delivery. The role combines deep technical expertise with strategic thinking, requiring you to translate business priorities into pragmatic and scalable technology solutions. You will assess current technology environments, define target architectures, identify risks and constraints, and establish practical transition roadmaps. You will work closely with senior technology and business stakeholders, communicating complex technical topics with clarity and confidence. The environment is collaborative, fast-moving, and focused on solving complex technology challenges through practical, evidence-based recommendations.

Accountabilities

  • Lead technical architecture workstreams across complex client engagements, assessing applications, infrastructure, cloud environments, integration patterns, data platforms, and technical constraints.
  • Define pragmatic target-state architectures that align business priorities with application, infrastructure, data, security, scalability, resilience, and delivery requirements.
  • Advise clients on technology platform and architecture decisions, including cloud platforms, application modernisation, infrastructure, integration, software delivery tooling, data platforms, and analytics environments.
  • Translate business and technology requirements into clear architecture principles, technical designs, transition approaches, and delivery priorities.
  • Develop and present architecture recommendations that are credible to senior technology leaders while remaining accessible and actionable for non-technical stakeholders.
  • Identify technical risks, dependencies, technical debt, architectural constraints, and delivery challenges, recommending practical mitigation strategies.
  • Collaborate with client teams and multidisciplinary specialists to ensure architecture decisions support product, engineering, cloud, security, data, and broader transformation objectives.
  • Challenge assumptions and pressure-test proposed designs, balancing strategic ambition with cost, complexity, resilience, and time to value.
  • Develop prioritised technology roadmaps that help clients move from current-state limitations toward scalable, resilient, and fit-for-purpose technology capabilities.

    • Requirements

    • Significant experience in technical, solutions, or enterprise architecture, software engineering, or related technical leadership roles, with a proven track record of designing and delivering complex technology solutions.
    • Strong practical knowledge of modern technology architectures and platforms, including cloud services, application architecture, infrastructure, integration patterns, software delivery practices, security, and reliability.
    • Demonstrated experience assessing existing technology estates and defining target-state architectures, transition strategies, and delivery roadmaps.
    • Strong understanding of cloud technologies, security, resilience, observability, performance, scalability, and operational considerations.
    • Meaningful expertise in data architecture and modern data platforms, including data warehouses, data lakes, lakehouses, integration patterns, data modelling, data governance, data quality, and analytics.
    • Ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, practical recommendations for senior business, data, and technology stakeholders.
    • Credibility when working with senior technology leaders, including CTOs, CIOs, CDOs, Heads of Engineering, Heads of Data, and enterprise architects.
    • Experience across the full technology lifecycle, from architecture and platform design through software delivery, deployment, operations, modernisation, and continuous improvement.
    • Practical and hands-on mindset, with the ability to move between architecture design, technical problem-solving, and client-facing advisory work.
    • Consulting, advisory, or multi-client delivery experience is desirable, together with the ability to operate effectively in ambiguous and fast-moving environments.

      • Benefits

      • Opportunity to lead high-impact technology architecture engagements across a diverse range of clients and business contexts.
      • Exposure to strategic technology challenges spanning cloud, applications, infrastructure, data, security, integration, and modernisation.
      • Direct interaction with senior technology and business leaders, including executive-level stakeholders.

title: Principal Cloud Security Engineer
description:
Application Deadline:

10/29/2026

Address:

320 S Canal Street

Job Family Group:

Technology

We are seeking an enthusiastic and passionate professional for a Senior Cloud, AI & Data Security Engineer role who wants to design and implement security solutions for systems and services across AWS, Azure, and AI/ML platforms. We need someone who can establish the highest standards that meet and exceed security governance solutions and practices, provide assurance to management and auditors, and ensure sustained protection by embedding controls in operational and DevOps (CI/CD) practices with a focus on automation.

We are looking for someone who has a high level of technical security expertise and who takes seriously the responsibility of monitoring, detecting, protecting, and maintaining the security of data, AI/ML systems, cloud platforms, and networks.

You are a leader with a strong technical background. You have demonstrated strength in:

  • Developing and implementing secure cloud and AI/ML architectures using a risk-based cybersecurity and data privacy strategy

  • Defining security patterns, roadmaps, and operating models that leverage collaboration

  • Facilitating industry-standard information security governance

  • Advising senior leadership on cybersecurity, AI risk, and privacy risks, threats, and investment strategies

  • Documenting appropriate policies and procedures to manage information security risks, including those unique to AI/ML systems and sensitive data assets

As a qualified candidate, you will be part of the team driving BMO's Cloud, AI, and Data Security implementation. As a member of this team, you should possess the ability to inspire yourself and all of our team. Based on your previous experiences, you will inject new knowledge and skills into an already high-performing team, thus elevating our efforts to new heights.

Your Responsibilities

Cloud Security

  • Assess, design, implement, automate, and document security solutions, controls, and processes for Amazon Web Services (AWS) and Microsoft Azure cloud platforms

  • Develop and maintain security patterns for cloud platforms and services; assess all cloud patterns to ensure adherence to best security practices and controls

  • Design and implement security baseline controls for Cloud Services for integration into the CI/CD process

  • Build and deliver policies as code, automating security controls and best practices

  • Review and approve code and changes with security implications (e.g., IAM Roles and Policies, Security Groups, etc.)

  • Be the cloud security subject matter expert for the Cloud Engineering group and its partners in any IaaS, PaaS, and SaaS implementations

AI & Machine Learning Security

  • Define and implement a security framework for AI/ML systems, covering the full model lifecycle from data ingestion and training to deployment and monitoring

  • Assess and mitigate AI-specific threats including adversarial attacks, model inversion, data poisoning, prompt injection, and model theft

  • Evaluate and secure AI/ML platforms and tools (e.g., Amazon SageMaker, Azure Machine Learning, Hugging Face, OpenAI APIs) against organizational risk standards

  • Collaborate with data science and AI engineering teams to integrate security controls into MLOps pipelines, ensuring model integrity, access controls, and auditability

  • Monitor emerging AI threat landscapes and regulatory developments (e.g., EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF) and translate these into actionable organizational controls

Data Security

  • Implement and manage data security posture management (DSPM) tools to continuously monitor sensitive data exposure across cloud environments

  • Establish controls for structured and unstructured data stores, including databases, data lakes, data warehouses (e.g., Snowflake, AWS S3, Azure Data Lake), and file sharing platforms

  • Drive the adoption of data-centric security practices within application development and analytics teams

General Security Leadership

  • Provide subject matter expertise on architecture, authentication, and systems security based on a clear understanding of the engineering stack, services, and data flow

  • Lead focused and continuous cybersecurity risk assessments of new and existing technologies - including AI/ML systems and data platforms - to identify risks and appropriate controls that balance security and operability

  • Provide effective and pragmatic cybersecurity guidance upfront in major technology projects to enable the business to innovate securely

  • Assist in the investigation and remediation of security incidents and issues, including those involving AI model compromise or data breaches

  • Work closely with Information Security, product, and software development teams to assess cybersecurity risk and recommend solutions in cloud, AI, and data environments

Your Mindset

  • You are a self-starter, driven, and can handle multiple projects and priorities

  • You are passionate about driving the DevSecOps and MLSecOps mindset and culture in a fast-paced, challenging environment where you get the opportunity to work with the latest tools and technologies

  • You understand the intersection of security, AI, and data, and actively seek to build bridges between these disciplines

Foundational

  • Emerging/preferred: Certifications or demonstrated knowledge in AI security (e.g., CDAI, CompTIA AI+, or equivalent vendor-specific AI security training) or data security (e.g., CDPSE, CIPP)

Cloud Security

AI & ML Security

  • Working knowledge of AI/ML development frameworks and platforms (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch, SageMaker, Azure ML) and associated security risks

  • Understanding of MLOps pipeline security, including securing model registries, feature stores, training environments, and inference endpoints

  • Knowledge of Generative AI security risks, including prompt injection, jailbreaking, data leakage via LLMs, and supply chain risks in AI model dependencies

Data Security

  • Experience implementing data loss prevention (DLP), data classification, and data access governance solutions in enterprise environments

  • Knowledge of DSPM tools and practices

  • Understanding of data encryption at rest and in transit, tokenization, and key management for large-scale data environments

Technical Skills

  • Knowledge of theoretical and applied cryptography, key management, and cryptographic algorithms (RSA, AES, TLS, PKI, etc.)

  • Knowledge of Identity and Access Management (IAM) concepts including SSO, SAML, federated identity, RBAC, and OAuth/OIDC

  • Strong scripting and programming skills with experience in Python, PowerShell, Bash, Node.js, and API/webhook development

  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) security scanning tools (e.g., Checkov, tfsec, Prisma Cloud)

Interpersonal & Leadership

  • Demonstrable internal and external relationship-building skills with the ability to clearly articulate complex security concepts across a diverse corporate culture

  • Ability to lead in-depth workshops across a broad range of topics including cloud compliance, AI risk, and data governance

  • Strong ability to influence decision-making at senior leadership levels

Other Skills

  • Strong interpersonal, communication, and leadership skills

  • A critical thinker with strong research, analytical, and problem-solving skills

  • Self-motivated with a positive attitude and an ability to work independently and within a team

  • Ability to communicate complex technical concepts to a broad range of internal and external stakeholders, including business, legal, compliance, and technology leaders

  • Strong time management skills with the ability to manage multiple workstreams and mentor less experienced team members

Why Join Us?

This is a rare opportunity to shape the cloud, AI, and data security strategy of one of Canada's largest financial institutions at a time when these domains are converging and rapidly evolving. Student Success

Student Engagement, Testing Services

These are exciting times in the Testing Services Department. We are growing and we are thrilled that you are interested in being a part of our team. We are surrounded by individuals empowered to use their expertise and talents to achieve our mission to pursue excellence.

The Testing Services Department is seeking (1) Testing Services Coordinator to join the already awesome team on the Newton Campus taking the department to the next level of excellence!

· Generous benefits, including health, dental, vision, tuition assistance, retirement, etc.

· A knowledge-sharing organization that works collaboratively.

HERE IS WHAT YOU WILL DO

The Coordinator of Testing Services is responsible for the day-to-day operations of the testing center. This position is responsible for the consistent delivery of testing services that are professional, prompt, convenient and delivered in a manner that reflects good customer service. Additionally, the Coordinator establishes the testing calendar for the center, orienting and training staff, evaluating the testing staff performance, and promoting on-going staff development. This position maintains the center's testing records, produces monthly, annual, and other reports as requested. Using this data, the Testing Coordinator will analyze departmental operating procedure and implement changes to improve operations as appropriate. This position is responsible for the receipt, security and return of highly confidential test records and files. The Coordinator of Testing ensures that students have equity of access to testing services. title: Quality Assurance Engineer - Platform
description:
Ko wai mātou – About us
Kia ora. We’re Foodies. You know New World, PAK’nSAVE and Four Square right? That’s us!
With 300+ stores and over 24,000 Foodies across Te Ika-a-Maui, our North Island Co-op has the privilege of helping New Zealanders get more out of life. Locally owned, we reflect the communities we serve, and we celebrate our people - our taonga, every day for being uniquely them.
Our Support Centre is 1,000+ people strong, which includes 300+ IT employees, who all play a vital role in ensuring the cogs of our Co-op stay turning and our systems stay ‘byte’-sized and ‘bug’-free.”
Te Tūranga – About the role
At Foodstuffs North Island (FSNI), we’re redefining digital experiences for millions of Kiwis. As a Quality Assurance Engineer, you’ll be at the heart of our Agile Delivery Squad, ensuring our platform capabilities not only meet, but exceed expectations. You won’t just test—you’ll innovate, automate, and elevate our quality standards. As part of the FSNI QA Practice, you’ll help shape best practices and push the boundaries of what’s possible in testing. Ready to make an impact? Let’s build something amazing together!
What you’ll do
- Own the quality – Collaborate with your squad to embed excellence at every stage of development.
- Think beyond testing – Design and execute high-impact test plans that tackle complex business and technical challenges.
- Automate like a pro – Build and enhance cutting-edge test automation frameworks, driving an automation-first mindset.
- Be a quality evangelist – Lead improvements, influence best practices, and drive innovation across FSNI’s QA Practice.
- Deliver value – Identify and resolve defects, optimise test environments, and proactively ensure flawless product releases.
If you’re passionate about pushing boundaries, pioneering new ways to test, and delivering world-class digital experiences, we want to hear from you!
Ngā painga - What we offer
We’re committed to providing awesome experiences for our people, including offering a range of benefits:
- Free carparking - we’ve got over 1,000 carparks including 36 free EV plugs
- Southern cross health insurance
- 5% discount at our retail stores
- Onsite café with subsidised meals and mini mart,
- Flexible working options, a day off on your birthday, long service leave
- Inhouse learning and development programmes and courses, flu vaccinations, and social network groups (we call them Tribes).
He kōrero mōu - About you
You’re a passionate QA professional who thrives in collaborative, Agile environments. You have a keen eye for detail, love solving complex challenges, and are always looking for ways to improve processes with automation. Your ability to communicate technical concepts effectively allows you to engage with stakeholders across the business, advocating for quality at every stage.
What you’ll bring:
Expertise in Test Planning - A strong ability to interpret user stories and requirements to develop targeted micro and macro test plans, incorporating pragmatic test scenarios and reusable automation scripts that drive efficient and effective validation.
Collaborative Problem Solving - A consistent approach to working closely with squad members—including Developers, Business Analysts, and Product Owners—to proactively identify and resolve gaps in understanding or requirements, ensuring alignment and shared clarity.
Sound Judgment in Test Scope - The capability to apply situational awareness and technical insight to extend testing into non-functional areas (e.g. performance, security) when appropriate, ensuring comprehensive coverage and system resilience.
Technical Proficiency in Automation - Proven experience in designing, developing, and maintaining high-quality automated test code using frameworks such as Playwright, Selenium, and BDD, with hands-on skills in Java SpringBoot, TypeScript, and NodeJS.
CI/CD Pipeline Expertise - Practical knowledge in building, configuring, and maintaining continuous integration pipelines using tools like Jenkins, Bamboo, and GitHub Actions—ensuring test reliability, stability, and consistently green pipelines.
Clear and Actionable Reporting - The ability to produce clear, traceable automated test execution reports that highlight test coverage and requirement completeness, supporting informed decision-making and continuous improvement.
Structured Defect Management - A disciplined approach to reporting and tracking software defects in line with established workflows, contributing to efficient resolution and overall product quality.
Required Skills:
- 5+ years of professional experience with hands-on delivery of test automation design and development in a full-stack environment.
- Strong experience with automating against web applications, mobile applications, and microservices
- Strong programming skills in at least one of the following OOP languages: Java, C#, JavaScript, TypeScript, NodeJS
- Strong experience with implementing and utilising any of the following common automation frameworks: Selenium WebDriver, Cucumber, Playwright, Cypress, , Appium
- Experience in managing automated testing artefacts using common Test Management toolsets (i.e. Jira, Xray, Zephyr, qTest, ADO, ALM, etc.)
Experience awesome. Achieve awesome. Be awesomely you.
We’re proud to have a focus on Diversity & Inclusion here at Foodies and welcome courageous behaviour, encourage togetherness, inspire our people to be their best selves in our Foodies whānau.

title: Senior AI Automation Engineer
description:
Alignment Health is breaking the mold in conventional health care, committed to serving seniors and those who need it most: the chronically ill and frail. It takes an entire team of passionate and caring people, united in our mission to put the senior first. We have built a team of talented and experienced people who are passionate about transforming the lives of the seniors we serve. In this fast-growing company, you will find ample room for growth and innovation alongside the Alignment Health community. Working at Alignment Health provides an opportunity to do work that really matters, not only changing lives but saving them. Together.

The Senior AI & Automation Engineer is a senior individual contributor and technical leader on the Data & Technology Solutions team, responsible for architecting, building, and scaling intelligent AI systems and enterprise automation solutions that directly improve care quality and operational performance across our Medicare Advantage business. You will serve as a go-to technical expert for AI Scientists, Data Engineers, Product Managers, Clinical Operations, and Application Engineering teams - driving end-to-end delivery of production AI systems that span claims processing, risk adjustment, prior authorization, revenue integrity, and member engagement. This role carries a higher degree of independent ownership and technical authority than the mid-level equivalent, with expectations to lead complex, ambiguous initiatives from concept through production and to actively elevate the engineering practices of the broader team.

  • Lead the build of distributed, cloud-native systems for enterprise workloads. Own the design and build of services, APIs, and microservices that run reliably at scale in a regulated environment. Set the standard for distributed systems practice on the team: fault tolerance, retries and idempotency, queuing and eventing, caching, and horizontal scaling.
  • Lead hybrid infrastructure work bridging cloud and non-cloud systems. Own the build of integrations with non-API data sources, including flat files, legacy databases, EDI feeds, mainframes, and streaming data, as well as multimodal data such as documents, images, and audio. Set integration patterns the rest of the team builds against.
  • Own CI/CD, containerization, and deployment standards. Drive adoption of Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD best practices across the team. Own infrastructure-as-code standards for the systems the team builds.
  • Own data and automation pipeline reliability. Build and govern ETL and orchestration pipelines at scale. Own automation strategy using RPA platforms and orchestration tools, including ROI governance and engineering standards for fault-tolerant workflow design.
  • Apply AI/ML to production systems and own inferencing performance (applied, not research). Own the build of inferencing pipelines (batch, real-time, streaming) that serve models handed off from AI Sciences, for workloads such as claims processing, risk adjustment, and member communication. Partner directly with AI Scientists to take models from research into low-latency, high-throughput production systems, owning the benchmarking and tuning that gets them there. This is applied integration, serving, and performance ownership, not model research or training. Own the technical approach for integrating LLMs into workflows, including prompt engineering, RAG, and multi-agent orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen).
  • Lead the Databricks build-out supporting AI Sciences. Own productionizing models and pipelines built on Databricks, including Delta Lake, MLflow, and Unity Catalog. Own the CI/CD, orchestration, access controls, and cost tuning that let Databricks-based work move reliably into production, and set standards for how the team uses the platform.
  • Define alerting, testing, and monitoring frameworks that surface degradation before it affects member outcomes, and lead post-incident reviews.
  • Mentor engineers and shape engineering culture. Provide senior technical mentorship through code reviews, design critiques, and paired problem-solving. Contribute to hiring, technical interviews, and team-wide engineering standards, including responsible AI practices such as bias detection, explainability, and governance.


Supervisory Responsibilities

Senior individual contributor role with no formal direct reports. Expected to function as an informal technical lead: mentoring, conducting code reviews, participating in hiring panels, and guiding the technical direction of junior and mid-level engineers on project teams.

Job Requirements

Required
  • 5-8 years of professional software engineering experience with a demonstrated focus on distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, or data platforms
  • Proven track record independently owning and delivering complex, production-grade distributed systems from concept through deployment and operations
  • Experience building and scaling hybrid infrastructure connecting cloud-native and non-API/legacy systems
  • Demonstrated experience serving and integrating AI/ML models or LLMs in production, including performance tuning (not model training/research)
  • Experience in a regulated industry (healthcare, insurance, or financial services) with deep working knowledge of compliance and security requirements
  • Experience building and scaling automation solutions using RPA platforms and workflow orchestration tools, including ROI governance


Preferred:
  • Experience with the Databricks platform (Delta Lake, MLflow, Unity Catalog) at a senior or platform-owner level
  • Experience applying AI/ML to complex healthcare data (claims, revenue cycle, prior authorization, medical coding, clinical text)
  • Familiarity with HL7 FHIR, ICD-10/CPT, or DICOM
  • Experience in a Medicare Advantage, managed care, or payer environment at a senior engineering level
  • Prior experience as an informal technical lead, principal engineer, or engineering lead

Education:
  • Required: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Data Science, or related quantitative field, or equivalent progressive senior-level experience
  • Preferred: Master's degree in Computer Science or related quantitative discipline

License
  • Required: None at this time
  • Preferred: Advanced or specialty cloud certification (AWS, Azure, or GCP); RPA platform certification
