title: Senior Director, Customer Innovation
description:
Senior Director, Customer Innovation

As a Senior Director, Customer Innovation, you will serve as a critical business driver and executive leader overseeing Rapid7's specialized technical sales organization, including Sales Engineering Specialists, Forward Engineering, Labs, and the Sales Engineering Center of Excellence (COE). Your primary focus will be transforming these entities into a cohesive, scalable, and highly strategic engine that directly impacts global revenue and product innovation.


About the Team

The Sales Engineering Specialist, Forward Engineering, Labs, and COE organizations collectively serve as the technical vanguard for Rapid7's global go-to-market engine. This unified group accelerates complex sales cycles, builds the integration infrastructure that binds our ecosystem together, manages high-impact demo environments, and institutionalizes global engineering best practices.


About the Role

As a Senior Director, Customer Innovation, your primary responsibility will be to drive long-term global technical sales strategy, cross-functional business execution, and leadership scaling across our specialist and operational sales engineering organizations. Specifically, your focus will be to:

  • Formulate and deliver an end-to-end macro strategy encompassing Sales Engineering Labs, COE, and Forward Engineering teams with clear, outcome-oriented milestones.
  • Develop a comprehensive 12-month organizational roadmap transitioning the team from tactical support to a unified, strategic ecosystem aligned with global business goals.
  • Transition the sales engineering integration unit from basic connector builders to an enterprise-grade platform Forward Engineering team capable of advancing architectural vision.
  • Cultivate a robust internal talent pipeline by transitioning from day-to-day management to organizational depth, mentoring successors, and formalizing execution plans for frontline leaders.
  • Build and maintain formal succession and development frameworks within the COE to raise engineering standards and leadership capabilities.
  • Partner with Worldwide Sales Leadership to explicitly define, audit, and document field requirements for specialist sales engineering resources versus territory sales engineers.
  • Present data-driven business cases highlighting the strategic necessity, ROI, and resource scaling of each specialist function ahead of annual planning cycles.
  • Maintain a highly visible executive presence in high-stakes corporate settings, driving cross-functional alignment and navigating organizational change.

The Skills and Qualities You'll Bring

  • 10+ years of experience leading technical sales or systems engineering teams within cybersecurity, with at least 4+ years managing multi-tiered organizations (managing managers).
  • Demonstrated technical operations mastery, with proven experience overseeing complex technical infrastructure groups such as Cloud/On-Prem Demo Labs, Centers of Excellence, or Technical Enablement functions.
  • High conceptual familiarity with Forward Engineering and systems architecture, including API ecosystems, security orchestration (SOAR), technology integrations, and enterprise security platforms.
  • Strong financial and operational acumen, with experience structuring headcount models, proving ROI on technical overhead, and mapping engineering performance to revenue attainment metrics.
  • High-stakes mediation skills and self-awareness to manage conflict, adapt to challenging group dynamics, and maintain an active, commanding leadership voice under pressure.
  • Ability to think big and act small — breaking massive organizational goals into time-bound milestones, executing rapidly, and pivoting effectively based on business metrics.
  • Ability to establish clear ownership, roles, and responsibilities within highly complex technical matrices, relentlessly delivering value over mere activity.
  • Exceptional resilience and communication during periods of organizational evolution, actively driving alignment and understanding the rationale for change.
  • Ability to build global internal networks and integrate diverse technical perspectives to make efficient, transparent decisions that maintain organizational momentum.
  • A commitment to embodying our core values, fostering a culture of excellence that drives meaningful impact and collective success.

We know that the best ideas and solutions come from multi-dimensional teams, because these teams reflect a variety of backgrounds and professional experiences. If you are excited about this role and feel your experience can make an impact, please don't be shy — apply today.



About Rapid7

At Rapid7, our vision is to create a secure digital world for our customers, our industry, and our communities. We do this by harnessing our collective expertise and passion to challenge what’s possible and drive extraordinary impact. We’re building a dynamic and collaborative workplace where new ideas are welcome.


Protecting 11,500+ customers against bad actors and threats means we’re continuing to push the envelope just like we’ ve been doing for the past 20 years. If you ’re ready to solve some of the toughest challenges in cybersecurity, we’re ready to help you take command of your career. Join us.


Rapid7, Inc. is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. A candidate’s salary is determined by various factors including, but not limited to, relevant work experience, skills, and certifications. We evaluate compensation decisions on a case-by-case basis, and it is not typical for an individual to be hired at the very top of the salary range.


The annual salary range for this role, depending on location, is:

United States: $210,600.00 - 285,000.00 USD Annual

Salary ranges may vary based on geographical location. This range does not include variable/incentive compensation, equity and benefits (where applicable/eligible).

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, disability, protected veteran status or any other status protected by applicable national, federal, state or local law.

title: Data Analytics Engineer
description:
Position Summary

The Data Analytics Engineer is responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining enterprise reporting and analytics solutions that support internal business operations, strategic decision-making, and data sharing with external business partners. This role partners closely with business stakeholders and analysts to build scalable data models, develop optimized SQL solutions, and expand the organization's Microsoft Fabric and Power BI reporting platform.

The ideal candidate possesses strong SQL expertise, data modeling skills, and experience building modern analytics solutions. This individual will play a key role in enhancing the organization's reporting capabilities, improving data accessibility, and delivering reliable, actionable insights to both internal and external audiences.

Key Responsibilities

  • Create, optimize, and maintain complex SQL queries, views, stored procedures, and data transformation processes.
  • Design, develop, and maintain enterprise reporting and analytics solutions using Microsoft Fabric and Power BI.
  • Design and maintain semantic models, datasets, pipelines, and reporting structures that support enterprise analytics and external reporting.
  • Develop dashboards, reports, and visualizations that provide actionable insights for internal stakeholders and external business partners.
  • Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to gather requirements and translate business needs into scalable analytics solutions.
  • Support self-service analytics by partnering with analysts and business users to develop reusable data assets and reporting solutions.
  • Identify opportunities to automate reporting processes and recommend enhancements to the organization's analytics platform.

Education & Experience

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Analytics, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field.
  • 3+ years of experience developing reporting or analytics solutions.
  • Advanced SQL development experience.
  • Experience developing reports and dashboards using Power BI.
  • Experience working with relational databases and data modeling concepts.

Preferred

  • Experience with Microsoft Fabric.
  • Experience building semantic models and enterprise reporting solutions.
  • Experience designing data warehouses, Lakehouses, or dimensional data models.
  • Experience with ETL/ELT development and data integration processes.
  • Experience within insurance, reinsurance, financial services, or other highly regulated industries.
  • Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, Azure Data, or related certifications.

Skills & Qualifications

  • Advanced SQL development and performance tuning skills.
  • Strong understanding of relational databases, dimensional modeling, and data warehousing concepts.
  • Experience developing Power BI reports, dashboards, and semantic models.
  • Knowledge of Microsoft Fabric or comparable cloud analytics platforms.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Ability to communicate technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Strong documentation and process improvement mindset.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently and collaboratively across departments.

title: Tech Architect Practitioner
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Tech Architect Practitioner based in Romania.

This is a senior technical consulting role focused on helping investors, portfolio companies, and technology leaders make effective architecture decisions that support measurable business outcomes. You will lead complex architecture engagements across applications, cloud, infrastructure, integration, data, security, and software delivery. The role combines deep technical expertise with strategic thinking, requiring you to translate business priorities into pragmatic and scalable technology solutions. You will assess current technology environments, define target architectures, identify risks and constraints, and establish practical transition roadmaps. You will work closely with senior technology and business stakeholders, communicating complex technical topics with clarity and confidence. The environment is collaborative, fast-moving, and focused on solving complex technology challenges through practical, evidence-based recommendations.

Accountabilities

  • Lead technical architecture workstreams across complex client engagements, assessing applications, infrastructure, cloud environments, integration patterns, data platforms, and technical constraints.
  • Define pragmatic target-state architectures that align business priorities with application, infrastructure, data, security, scalability, resilience, and delivery requirements.
  • Advise clients on technology platform and architecture decisions, including cloud platforms, application modernisation, infrastructure, integration, software delivery tooling, data platforms, and analytics environments.
  • Translate business and technology requirements into clear architecture principles, technical designs, transition approaches, and delivery priorities.
  • Develop and present architecture recommendations that are credible to senior technology leaders while remaining accessible and actionable for non-technical stakeholders.
  • Identify technical risks, dependencies, technical debt, architectural constraints, and delivery challenges, recommending practical mitigation strategies.
  • Collaborate with client teams and multidisciplinary specialists to ensure architecture decisions support product, engineering, cloud, security, data, and broader transformation objectives.
  • Challenge assumptions and pressure-test proposed designs, balancing strategic ambition with cost, complexity, resilience, and time to value.
  • Develop prioritised technology roadmaps that help clients move from current-state limitations toward scalable, resilient, and fit-for-purpose technology capabilities.

    • Requirements

    • Significant experience in technical, solutions, or enterprise architecture, software engineering, or related technical leadership roles, with a proven track record of designing and delivering complex technology solutions.
    • Strong practical knowledge of modern technology architectures and platforms, including cloud services, application architecture, infrastructure, integration patterns, software delivery practices, security, and reliability.
    • Demonstrated experience assessing existing technology estates and defining target-state architectures, transition strategies, and delivery roadmaps.
    • Strong understanding of cloud technologies, security, resilience, observability, performance, scalability, and operational considerations.
    • Meaningful expertise in data architecture and modern data platforms, including data warehouses, data lakes, lakehouses, integration patterns, data modelling, data governance, data quality, and analytics.
    • Ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, practical recommendations for senior business, data, and technology stakeholders.
    • Credibility when working with senior technology leaders, including CTOs, CIOs, CDOs, Heads of Engineering, Heads of Data, and enterprise architects.
    • Experience across the full technology lifecycle, from architecture and platform design through software delivery, deployment, operations, modernisation, and continuous improvement.
    • Practical and hands-on mindset, with the ability to move between architecture design, technical problem-solving, and client-facing advisory work.
    • Consulting, advisory, or multi-client delivery experience is desirable, together with the ability to operate effectively in ambiguous and fast-moving environments.

      • Benefits

      • Opportunity to lead high-impact technology architecture engagements across a diverse range of clients and business contexts.
      • Exposure to strategic technology challenges spanning cloud, applications, infrastructure, data, security, integration, and modernisation.
      • Direct interaction with senior technology and business leaders, including executive-level stakeholders.
      • Opportunity to influence architecture decisions that support measurable business outcomes and long-term technology value.
      • Collaborative environment bringing together experienced technology, transformation, commercial, and operational specialists.
      • Scope to deepen expertise across modern architecture practices while contributing to complex, multidisciplinary engagements.
      • Opportunity to work on varied, challenging projects in a fast-moving and entrepreneurial consulting environment.
      • Ability to contribute to practical technology roadmaps and solutions that balance scalability, resilience, cost, complexity, and speed to value.

There are 2.7 billion hourly workers, making up 80% of the global workforce, but this market has been heavily underserved by technology and deserves better. Workstream has been purpose-built for the hourly workforce from day one so that these businesses and their employees can thrive.

Our customers include leading brands from multiple sectors, including Burger King, Carl's Jr./Hardee's, IHOP, KFC, and Culvers. We are a high growth series B company and quickly expanding our product portfolio to deliver on our vision. We are backed by legendary VCs and industry experts like Founders Fund, BOND, and Coatue.

Values

Here are our Company Values and we’d love to have individuals who can be a culture add to our team!

What We Offer

  • Permanently Remote
  • Pay wired directly to your bank account
  • $50 Monthly Stipend
  • Annual Bonus
  • Flexible PTO
  • Enjoy company time off during some of the major US Holidays
  • Career fast track for performers and internal mobility
  • Learn from a team of Stanford, MIT, Google and Harvard alumni
Grow With Us
We are looking for a Senior Software Solutions Engineer in Professional Services (PS) to join our growing team. In this role, you will own the design, development, and delivery of complex technical integrations between our platform and enterprise client systems. You'll operate at the intersection of deep software engineering and customer partnership — leading integration architecture decisions, mentoring junior engineers, and driving technical standards across the PS organization.

The majority of your time is spent writing code, architecting scalable solutions, and solving genuinely hard technical problems. You'll bring an AI-native mindset to everything you build — leveraging LLMs, automation, and modern AI tooling to deliver faster, smarter outcomes for clients and the team. You'll work directly with enterprise clients and internal stakeholders to translate complex business requirements into production-grade software, with direct, visible impact on customer retention and satisfaction.

Day in the Life

Integration & Internal Engineering (50%)
  • Architect and build robust API integrations between our platform and client HR, payroll, and POS systems
  • Develop and maintain reusable integration frameworks and shared libraries that accelerate delivery across the team
  • Own the full software lifecycle — from design and development through testing, deployment, and production support
  • Build data migration pipelines and CSV transformation solutions for enterprise onboarding
  • Develop two-way payroll integrations with complex business logic and error handling
  • Build and deploy custom internal tools that improve team efficiency, integration observability, and customer operations
  • Own infrastructure-as-code and deployment pipelines using Terraform, GitHub Actions, and related CI/CD tooling — you ship to production, not just to staging
  • Apply AI-native development practices: using LLMs and AI tooling to accelerate development cycles, generate smarter automation, and build more intelligent solutions for clients and internal teams
Technical Leadership & Mentorship (20%)
  • Review code and provide technical guidance to junior and mid-level engineers on the PS team
  • Establish and document engineering best practices, integration patterns, and internal tooling standards
  • Champion AI best practices across the team — helping others understand when and how to use AI tooling effectively and responsibly
  • Collaborate with Product and Engineering to surface recurring customer pain points and influence the platform roadmap
Customer & Stakeholder Collaboration (20%)
  • Lead technical discovery sessions with enterprise clients to define integration scope and requirements
  • Translate complex business and compliance requirements into clear technical specifications
  • Serve as the senior technical voice in client conversations — able to communicate architecture decisions confidently to both technical and non-technical audiences
Custom Solutions & Tooling (10%)
  • Build custom reporting tools, enterprise-grade career site implementations, and AI-assisted automation for customers
  • Develop internal tooling and dashboards to improve team efficiency, reduce manual work, and scale PS delivery

Who You Are
  • Engineering Depth: You write clean, production-quality code and take ownership of what you ship. You think in systems, not just scripts.
  • AI-Native: You don't just know AI exists — you actively use it. You're fluent with LLM APIs, prompt engineering, and AI-assisted development workflows, and you have strong instincts around where AI adds genuine value vs. where it introduces risk
  • Integration Expertise: Hands-on experience with REST APIs, webhooks, OAuth, and workflow automation platforms (Workato or similar)
  • DevOps Fluency: You're comfortable with Terraform, GitHub Actions, and CI/CD pipelines — shipping and maintaining production infrastructure is part of your normal workflow, not an afterthought
  • Technical Leadership: You've mentored engineers, led code reviews, and contributed to engineering standards — not just executed tickets
  • Problem Solving: You enjoy ambiguous problems and bring structured thinking to novel technical challenges
  • Communication: You can hold your own in a technical architecture conversation and turn around and explain the same concept clearly to a non-technical customer
Requirements
  • 5+ years of experience in Solutions Engineering, Solutions Consulting, or a related technical customer-facing role
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field (or equivalent practical experience)
  • Experience designing and consuming REST APIs at scale
  • Proficiency with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform) and CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions or equivalent)
  • Demonstrated AI-native development practices — active use of LLM APIs, AI tooling, or AI-assisted workflows in prior roles
  • Familiarity with version control and collaborative development workflows (GitHub)
  • Experience with workflow automation platforms (Workato, Zapier, or similar)
  • Must be willing to work during US business hours
Nice to Have
  • Proficiency in Python and TypeScript/JavaScript; comfortable owning backend services while being capable across the stack
  • Prior experience in SaaS implementation, professional services, or a customer-facing engineering role
  • Exposure to HRIS, payroll, or POS system integrations
  • Experience building and maintaining shared internal developer tooling or libraries
  • Familiarity with MCP (Model Context Protocol) or agentic AI frameworks

Know More About Workstream

Location: TBD

Job Type: Full-Time

Job Summary:

MicroAge is seeking a Services Pre-Sales Consultant to support the qualification, scoping, pricing, and execution of internal and partner-delivered services. This client-facing role works with sales teams, technical resources, and strategic partners to turn client requirements into accurate, executable Statements of Work (SOWs) and services quotes.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead client discovery and sales engagements to gather business and technical requirements, define scope, identify risks, and determine the optimal delivery approach using internal, partner, or blended resources.
  • Develop, review, and manage client-facing SOWs, proposals, and quotes while ensuring scope accuracy, pricing integrity, margin protection, and compliance with internal approval processes.
  • Serve as the primary Services pre-sales resource by coordinating account executives, technical teams, and other stakeholders through solution development, client presentations, negotiations, and opportunity progression.
  • Build and manage strategic partner relationships by coordinating partner participation, evaluating estimates and SOWs, aligning commercial terms, and ensuring successful engagement execution.
  • Coordinate service order processing, partner procurement, invoicing requirements, and the complete handoff of approved engagements to PMO, delivery, finance, and partner teams.
  • Maintain accurate opportunity and engagement documentation, improve repeatable services processes, monitor approvals and dependencies, and ensure compliance with confidentiality and document-control requirements.

What This Role Is Not

  • This is not a quota-carrying sales or project management role, although it directly supports services revenue, opportunity progression, and a complete handoff to delivery teams.
  • This role coordinates technical and delivery resources but does not serve as the final technical authority; appropriate technical resources will review and validate proposed solutions before the SOW or solution is finalized.

Required Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in an IT services pre-sales, sales engineering, technical consulting, services coordination, or a related client-facing services role.

  • Strong communication, stakeholder management, and organizational skills with experience collaborating across sales, engineering, clients, and strategic partners.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft 365 and business applications, with the ability to manage multiple opportunities, assess risks, and produce accurate client-ready documentation in a fast-paced environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working within IT services, managed services, consulting, or technology solutions organization with an understanding of the services engagement lifecycle.
  • Experience coordinating strategic partners, developing services proposals and SOWs, and utilizing CRM, quoting, and services management platforms to support forecasting, order processing, and operational execution.

Why MicroAge

MicroAge helps organizations modernize, secure, and simplify IT operations through consulting, managed services, staffing, and technology solutions. The Services Pre-Sales Consultant plays an important role in turning client needs into clear, executable service engagements that produce measurable business outcomes.

This is a strong opportunity for a services professional who wants broad exposure to client strategy, technical services, sales execution, partner management, commercial operations, and the full lifecycle of modern IT service engagements.

title: Data Scientist
description:
Company Description

As the UK's leading parking and technology-enabled management group, we support more than 9,000 locations across housing, healthcare, education and commercial estates. We're proud to be Carbon Neutral Britain certified and committed to creating positive outcomes for our clients, communities and colleagues alike. We're growing quickly, investing heavily in technology and expanding into new sectors, creating exciting opportunities for people who want to make an impact and be part of something ambitious. Why not join us? This role is available from any of our Agena offices: Newton Abbot, Lancing, Slough or Stafford with hybrid flexibilities after probation period.


Position

We're looking for a curious, analytical, and driven Data Scientist to join our growing Technology team. This is an exciting opportunity to work with a wide range of data sources, uncover valuable insights, and help shape business decisions through data-driven thinking.


You'll collaborate with stakeholders across the business to identify opportunities, solve complex problems, and develop predictive models that deliver real-world impact. Whether you're exploring trends, building machine learning solutions, or presenting insights to senior stakeholders, you'll play an important role in helping us harness the power of data.


This role is ideal for someone who enjoys continuous learning, embraces new technologies, and is passionate about using data to drive innovation and business performance.


What You'll be Doing

  • Analyse and interpret data from multiple sources to identify trends, patterns, and opportunities.
  • Transform complex datasets into clear, actionable insights that support business decision-making.
  • Develop, test, and enhance predictive and statistical models.
  • Support the implementation and optimisation of machine learning and Large Language Model (LLM) solutions.
  • Evaluate model performance and recommend improvements.
  • Apply statistical techniques to answer business questions and solve operational challenges.
  • Work closely with stakeholders to translate business needs into analytical solutions.
  • Collaborate with data engineers and analysts to improve data quality, accessibility, and governance.
  • Communicate technical findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Maintain robust documentation and contribute to the continuous improvement of data science tools, processes, and methodologies.
  • Stay up to date with emerging technologies, data science trends, and AI developments.

Who you are

  • A degree in Data Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Economics, Engineering, or a related discipline (desirable).
  • Knowledge of statistical analysis and data modelling techniques.
  • Experience working with, implementing, optimising, or integrating Large Language Models (LLMs).
  • Experience using Python for data analysis or model development.
  • Knowledge of SQL and working with databases.
  • Experience manipulating, analysing, and interpreting datasets.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills.
  • Ability to communicate complex technical concepts to non-technical audiences.
  • Excellent attention to detail and a commitment to data quality.
  • A proactive approach to learning, development, and continuous improvement.

title: Head of Data Practitioner

This is a senior consulting leadership role focused on helping private equity investors and portfolio companies turn data opportunities into measurable business outcomes. You will lead complex data engagements from strategic diagnosis through transformation planning and practical execution. The role combines deep expertise in data strategy and modern data platforms with strong commercial judgment and executive-level communication. You will build trusted relationships with senior technology and business leaders while shaping data strategies, operating models, investment priorities, and delivery roadmaps. You will translate complex data challenges into clear recommendations and actionable plans that support value creation. This role sits at the intersection of large-scale software engineering, quantitative modeling, and digital advertising marketplace optimization. You’ll help build the systems that determine how advertising budgets are allocated, how bids are placed, and how campaigns are paced in real time. Your work will directly influence advertiser value while balancing user experience and platform revenue. You’ll apply concepts from mathematics, statistics, economics, optimization, and related quantitative disciplines to complex marketplace problems. The role offers meaningful ownership, measurable impact, and exposure to large-scale data and real-time decision systems.

title: Anesthesia Technologist - FlexStaff
description:
Participates as a member of the Anesthesia Care Team by performing pre-operative and intra-operative tasks for the patient having procedures requiring anesthesia. Assists licensed anesthesia care provider with patient assessments, evaluations, transport, positioning, insertion of intravenous and other invasive lines and routine difficult intubation/extubation. Responsible for maintenance and set-up of anesthesia and performs ancillary lab tests.

Responsibilities:
  • Assists anesthesia professional staff as requested, as well as assists in invasive monitoring line insertion, pulmonary artery catheter insertion, central venous access, fiberoptic intubation, and/or difficult airway situations
  • Performs invasive monitoring according to daily operating room schedule also performs preventative maintenance for all equipment according to established protocols, as well as assembles and assists with operation of specialized equipment such as humidification units, fiberoptic endoscopic equipment, and rapid infusion devices
  • Prepares, drapes, places BP cuff, EKG leads and Pulse oximeter for patient, also prepares and assembles transducer lines and equipment necessary for arterial, central venous, and pulmonary artery pressure monitoring, as requested
  • Sets up the operating room for cases including preparation of laryngoscope and intubation equipment, IV solution and administration sets, sets up warming devices, and assists anesthesiologist with volume infusions as directed during intra-operative volume resuscitations
  • Responds to codes throughout the hospital, also maintains and organizes the anesthesia environment, equipment and supplies to facilitate operation of the department as well as inventories and maintains supply stock, collaborates with purchasing and acts as liaison
  • Reports equipment malfunctions to management and arranges for loaner equipment when necessary as well as aids in capital equipment budget preparation, as well as coordinates equipment and supplies outside the operating room, troubleshoots anesthesia delivery systems, scavenging system gas analyzer, EKG, pulse oximeter, cell saver and rapid infusion devices and maintains all related records
  • Follows protocol for all safety and infection control practices and monitors the environment and equipment to ensure cleaning standards are maintained
  • Prepares and sets up sterile arterial line insertion and sterile introducer kits for the insertion of Swan-Ganz catheters
  • Analyzes blood samples for blood gases, sodium/potassium, glucose and hematocrit and documents all patient tests and maintains quality control, maintenance and proficiency test results and records
  • Participates in education of new staff members as well as ongoing educational programs for department
  • Performs related duties as required. All responsibilities noted here are considered essential functions of the job under the Americans with Disabilities Act. Duties not mentioned here, but considered related are not essential functions
Qualifications:
  • Associate's Degree required, or equivalent combination of education and related experience
  • Current Anesthesia Technologist Certification, and Current Advanced Cardiovascular Life Support Certification required, plus specialized certifications as needed
  • 1-3 years of relevant experience, required

Job Description:

Johnson & Johnson is currently seeking a Senior Analyst, Standards Specialist, to join our Enterprise Regulatory Intelligence function within J&J's Enterprise Regulatory Compliance organization.

Introduction to the Role

The Standards Specialist, Senior Analyst, supports the enterprise quality standards program by coordinating and facilitating timely updates to enterprise quality standards and related tools. This role manages the day-to-day execution of the standards revision process by partnering with sector subject matter experts (SMEs) to incorporate approved changes, routing documents through the document management system for review and approval, and ensuring that updates are implemented according to the agreed-upon schedule. The Senior Analyst also maintains program metrics and supports ongoing access to standards content through internal systems and the standards website.

Responsibilities/Principal Duties
  • Coordinate end-to-end revisions of enterprise quality standards, including intake and tracking of change requests, review of change assessments for completeness and clarity, and preparation of revision packages for governance review.
  • Partner with sector SMEs and standards owners to facilitate content and revision updates.
  • Route standards and related documents through the document management system for review and approval, ensuring that documents are published in accordance with applicable procedures.
  • Maintain the periodic review calendar and support scheduled reviews to ensure standards are reviewed and updated according to the defined program commitments.
  • Maintain and report program metrics (e.g., number of revisions, cycle time, on-time completion, backlog), identifying trends and opportunities to improve the efficiency and predictability of the standards program.
  • Facilitate updates to internal regulatory standards tools by documenting the regulations or guidance that drove specific standard updates and ensuring that related references and sections are updated and traceable.
  • Partner with Regulatory Intelligence managers to conduct periodic environmental scans that inform the continuous improvement of enterprise standards.
  • Ensure access to standards by coordinating updates to the internal standards website so that stakeholders can easily locate current standards and supporting resources.
  • Actively build AI literacy and fluency and apply approved AI tools to streamline standards program workflows (e.g., change-request triage, drafting and editing support, and publishing coordination) while adhering to appropriate governance, privacy, and compliance requirements.
  • Help to shape, and drive execution of continuous improvement projects that enhance effectiveness, value and efficiency of the enterprise quality standards program.


Qualifications

  • A bachelor's degree in life sciences, quality, regulatory affairs, engineering, or a related field is required.

  • Required Related Experience: At least five years of quality experience in a regulated industry; pharmaceutical or medical device experience is preferred. Experience supporting controlled-document authoring, revision, and approval workflows in a regulated environment is preferred.Working knowledge of quality system documentation concepts (e.g., standards, policies, SOPs) and fundamentals of GxP/medical device requirements.Strong facilitation and stakeholder coordination skills, with the ability to drive timelines, manage review cycles, and resolve issues in a matrixed environment.Excellent attention to detail and ability to ensure document consistency and traceability.Experience maintaining program metrics and dashboards.Proficiency in Excel and in analyzing trends such as cycle time, backlog, and on-time completion.Proficiency in data visualization applications and a working knowledge of process automation techniques.Proficiency with document management systems (e.g., Veeva) and collaboration tools (e.g., SharePoint).Strong written communication skills, including the ability to edit controlled content and coordinate updates with technical SMEs.Excellent attention to detail and commitment to data integrity and accuracy.Ability to work independently with direction, manage deadlines, and collaborate effectively with cross-functional partners.

description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Sr. Embedded Software Engineer, Robotics Platform based in Canada.

This role offers the opportunity to build and evolve the embedded software platform powering a growing fleet of autonomous delivery robots. You’ll work hands-on with modern C++ and embedded Linux to develop reliable middleware and application frameworks. The position combines deep systems engineering with real-world robotics challenges involving performance, safety, reliability, and constrained computing resources. You’ll own significant platform components from architecture and implementation through validation, deployment, and fleet operations. Working closely with autonomy, systems, hardware, and software teams, you’ll help translate system-level requirements into robust software solutions. The role also provides opportunities to influence technical architecture, mentor engineers, and improve the scalability and developer experience of the robotics platform.

Accountabilities:

  • Design, develop, test, and maintain robotics middleware and application frameworks using modern C++ on embedded Linux, with a focus on reliability, maintainability, and production readiness.
  • Own significant platform components throughout their full lifecycle, from technical design and implementation to validation, deployment, monitoring, and operation across a fleet of robots.
  • Partner with software teams using the robotics platform to identify reliability, performance, and developer-experience challenges, then build reusable solutions that improve the overall platform.
  • Collaborate with autonomy and systems engineering teams on risk assessments, failure analysis, fault-handling strategies, system architecture, and the translation of safety and reliability requirements into software behavior and verification approaches.
  • Develop instrumentation, benchmarks, logging, tracing, telemetry, and fleet-level metrics to monitor software performance, reliability, resource utilization, and overall system health.
  • Diagnose and resolve complex system-level problems involving concurrency, scheduling, synchronization, interprocess communication, networking, and constrained compute environments.
  • Evaluate technical tradeoffs and contribute to architectural decisions that improve platform scalability, reliability, performance, and long-term maintainability.
  • Lead technical design and code reviews while contributing to engineering standards, development practices, technical documentation, and knowledge-sharing initiatives.
  • Provide technical guidance and mentorship to other engineers through design discussions, problem solving, code reviews, and collaborative technical work.

    • Requirements:

    • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Robotics, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
    • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, including substantial experience developing production-grade software using modern C++17 or newer.
    • Strong experience developing and debugging systems software in embedded Linux environments, with a solid understanding of multithreading, concurrency, synchronization, interprocess communication, and systems-level programming.
    • Experience designing software for latency-sensitive, safety-related, real-time, or high-reliability systems, along with practical experience profiling and optimizing embedded software for performance and resource utilization.
    • Demonstrated ability to independently own complex software components across technical design, implementation, testing, deployment, and ongoing operation.
    • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving abilities, including the capacity to diagnose complex issues that span software, hardware, networking, and system-level boundaries.
    • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across software, systems, hardware, autonomy, and other engineering disciplines.
    • Experience with robotics middleware, autonomous vehicles, or other complex robotic systems is highly valued, as is experience deploying production software on NVIDIA Jetson or similar embedded computing platforms.
    • Additional experience with Linux internals, scheduling, resource management, device interfaces, fault-tolerant architecture, functional safety, distributed systems, networking, RPC frameworks, serialization technologies, telemetry, observability, or robotic sensors and hardware integration is advantageous.

      • Competitive Compensation: Salary range of $167,800–$204,000, with actual compensation determined by geographic location, experience, level, domain knowledge, and interview performance.
      • Remote Flexibility: Remote position available across Canada, including British Columbia, Calgary, Toronto, and Vancouver.

      • Technical Impact: Work on complex real-world robotics systems spanning embedded software, autonomy, hardware, safety, reliability, and fleet operations.
      • Cross-Functional Environment: Collaborate closely with experienced engineers across software, systems, hardware, and autonomy disciplines.
      • Professional Growth: Opportunities to lead technical design, influence architecture, mentor engineers, and contribute to engineering standards and development practices.

title: Mission Software Engineer, Mission Systems
description:
ABOUT THE TEAM

Air Dominance & Strike (AD&S) is responsible for autonomous robotics systems like the Fury unmanned fighter jet and the Barracuda family of advanced effects. The AD&S Mission Systems Software team builds the distributed infrastructure that connects these vehicles to command and control. We develop the messaging, orchestration, and networking backbone that ties individual vehicles into coordinated, multi-vehicle operations. Our engineers develop the services that integrate with Lattice OS, coordinate fleets of vehicles in the field, and task and manage mission payloads and effects. We are looking for engineers excited to own from cradle-to-grave resilient, distributed mission software that supports the full range of AD&S initiatives: from early concept simulation to live operations and large scale fleet management.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • BS, MS, or PhD in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, or related field.

  • 2-3+ years of production-grade C++, Rust or equivalent experience in a Linux development environment

  • Experience building low-latency, high performance software solutions

  • Familiarity with Kubernetes and container orchestration

  • Experience with Git & GitHub

title: Vice President, Scrum Leader
description:
Description

We’re seeking a future team member for the role of Vice President, Scrum Lead to join our Conventional Trust team. This role is located in Pittsburgh, PA or Lake Mary, FL.

The Scrum Lead for Conventional Trust is responsible for actively establishing, embedding, and strengthening Scrum practices across one or more teams and programs. This is not a passive facilitation role; the Scrum Lead is expected to challenge teams, Product Owners, stakeholders, and ways of working to drive accountability, transparency, continuous improvement, and stronger delivery outcomes.

In this role, you’ll make an impact in the following ways:

  • Ensure Scrum principles and practices are followed, and Scrum team events occur, are productive, and kept within timeboxes.
  • Facilitate and guide teams to deliver expected outcomes with high quality and focus on creating increments of value for each iteration.
  • Establish and maintain Scrum practices, facilitating understanding of Scrum practice within the Team and the organization and ensure all Scrum events take place, are productive, and kept within the timebox.
  • Remove impediments to the Team’s progress and track and resolve team dependencies.
  • Coach Teams in self-management, cross-functionality, and help focus on creating high-value increments that meet the Definition of Done.
  • Facilitate stakeholder collaboration, support Product Owners in backlog management and empirical product planning and help the organization adopt an empirical approach for complex work

To be successful in this role, we’re seeking the following:

  • Bachelor’s degree or the equivalent combination of education and experience.

  • 4-8 years of relevant experience in a similar role, preferably with technical experience.

  • Experience as a Scrum Master for software development teams on large initiatives and knowledge of Agile approaches such as Scrum, SAFe, XP, Kanban, and Spotify.

  • Proficiency with Agile techniques including User Stories, ATDD, TDD, Continuous Integration, Continuous Testing, Pairing, Automated Testing, and Agile Games.

  • Experience using tools such as Jira and Confluence.

  • Ability to quickly learn new technology and translate ambiguous topics into actionable plans with multiple stakeholders.

  • Excellent communication, mentoring, and problem-solving skills.

  • Preferred Agile certifications including CSM, PSM, SAFe SSM.

  • Talent for driving change, building consensus, and resolving conflicts across multiple parties.

title: 22755 - Operational Assurance Officer
company: His Majesty's Prison and Probation Service
description:
Working Arrangements & Further Information

The MoJ offers Hybrid Working arrangements where business need allows. This is an informal, non-contractual form of flexible working that blends working from your base location, different MoJ sites and / or from home (please be aware that this role can only be worked in the UK and not overseas). All employees will be expected to spend a minimum of 60% of their working time in an office, subject to local estate capacity.

Some roles will not be suitable for Hybrid Working. Similarly, Hybrid Working will not suit everyone’s circumstances. Arrangements will be discussed and agreed with the successful candidate(s) and subject to regular review.

For nationally advertised roles: All successful candidates will be appointed to the nearest viable office nearest to their home postcode and on its respective pay scale. This will be at either a HQ building (subject to desk allocation, a Justice Collaboration Centre (JCC) or a Justice Satellite Office (JSO) – See Map. All employees will be expected to spend a minimum of 60% of their working time in an office, subject to local estate capacity).

For current MoJ employees, your base location will need to be changed to the nearest viable office (to your home postcode), either at a HQ building, JCC or JSO within the National Office Network and moved its location’s respective pay scale (any legacy arrangements/locations will need to be amended).

Some of MoJ’s terms and conditions of service are changing as part of Civil Service reform. The changes will apply to staff joining MoJ who are new to the Civil Service. Staff joining MoJ from other civil service employers will transfer onto the new MoJ terms if they are already on 'modernised' terms in their current post or onto 'unmodernised' MoJ terms if they are on 'unmodernised' terms at their current post. Details will be available if an offer is made.

MoJ candidates who are on a specialist grade, will be able to retain their grade on lateral transfer.

All candidates who are currently in receipt of Mark Time / Pay Protection should ensure they are familiar with the new policy on permanent and temporary promotion which can be found on the employee intranet.

Flexible working hours

The Ministry of Justice offers a flexible working system in many offices. Standard full time working hours are 37 hours per week. MoJ welcomes part-time, flexible and job-sharing working patterns, where they meet the demands of the role and business needs. All applications for part-time, flexible and job-sharing working patterns will be considered in accordance with the MoJ’s Flexible Working policy.

Benefits

The MoJ offers a range of benefits:

Annual Leave

Annual leave is 25 days on appointment and will increase to 30 days after five years’ service.

There is also a scheme to allow qualifying staff to buy or sell up to three days leave each year. Additional paid time off for public holidays and 1 privilege day. Leave for part-time and job share posts will be calculated on a pro-rata basis.

Pension

The Civil Service offers a choice of pension schemes, giving you the flexibility to choose the pension that suits you best.

Training

The Ministry of Justice is committed to staff development and offers an extensive range of training and development opportunities.

Networks

The opportunity to join employee-run networks that have been established to provide advice and support and to enable the views of employees from minority groups to be expressed direct to senior management. There are currently networks for employees of minority ethnic origin, employees with disabilities, employees with caring responsibilities, women employees, and lesbian, gay, bisexual and transgender employees.

Eligibility

Staff on fixed term appointments must have been recruited through fair and open competition.

Vacancies advertised “cross-government” are only open to all Civil Service employees and employees of accredited non-departmental public bodies (NDPBs) who were appointed on merit following a fair and open competition; or were appointed to a permanent post through an exception in the Civil Service Commissioners' rules.

Support

  • A range of ‘Family Friendly’ policies such as opportunities to work reduced hours or job share.
  • Access to flexible benefits such as voluntary benefits, retail vouchers and discounts on a range of goods and services.
  • For moves to or from another employer or moves across the Civil Service this can have implications on your eligibility to carry on claiming childcare vouchers. You may however be eligible for alternative government childcare support schemes, including Tax Free Childcare. More information can be found on www. or Childcare Choices. You can determine your eligibility at .
  • Paid paternity, adoption and maternity leave.
  • Free annual sight tests for employees who use computer screens.

Working for the Civil Service

The Civil Service Code sets out the standards of behaviour expected of civil servants.

We recruit by merit on the basis of fair and open competition, as outlined in the Civil Service Commission's recruitment principles. Should you feel that the recruitment process has breached the recruitment principles you are able to raise a formal complaint in the following order

  • To Transformative Business Services (0345 241 5359 (Monday to Friday 8am - 6pm) or e mail moj-recruitment-vetting-enquiries@resourcing.soprasteria.co.uk);
  • To Ministry of Justice Resourcing team (resourcing-management-office@justice.gov.uk);
  • To the Civil Service Commission (details available here)

As a Disability Confident employer, MoJ are committed to providing everyone with the opportunity to demonstrate their skills, talent and abilities, by making adjustments throughout all elements of the recruitment process and in the workplace. MoJ are able to offer an interview to disabled candidates who meet the minimum selection criteria, except in a limited number of campaigns.

You will be able to request reasonable adjustments to the recruitment process within the application form. If you need additional help completing the application form, please contact the TBS Recruitment Enquiries Team.

For more information on applying for a role as a candidate with a disability or long-term condition, please watch our animated videos.

Diversity & Inclusion

The Civil Service is committed to attract, retain and invest in talent wherever it is found. To learn more please see the Civil Service People Plan and the Civil Service Diversity and Inclusion Strategy.

Redeployment Interview Scheme

Civil Service departments are expected to explore redeployment opportunities before making an individual redundant. The MoJ is committed, as part of the Redeployment Interview Scheme, to providing opportunities to those who are 'at risk of redundancy'.

MoJ is able to offer an interview to eligible candidates who meet the minimum selection criteria, except in a limited number of campaigns. Candidates will not be eligible for the Redeployment Interview Scheme if they are applying on promotion.

Civil Service Nationality Rules

This job is broadly open to the following groups:

  • UK nationals
  • nationals of the Republic of Ireland
  • nationals of Commonwealth countries who have the right to work in the UK
  • nationals of the EU, Switzerland, Norway, Iceland or Liechtenstein and family members of those nationalities with settled or pre-settled status under the European Union Settlement Scheme (EUSS) (opens in a new window) https://www.gov.uk/settled-status-eu-citizens-families
  • nationals of the EU, Switzerland, Norway, Iceland or Liechtenstein and family members of those nationalities who have made a valid application for settled or pre-settled status under the European Union Settlement Scheme (EUSS)
  • individuals with limited leave to remain or indefinite leave to remain who were eligible to apply for EUSS on or before 31 December 2020
  • Turkish nationals, and certain family members of Turkish nationals, who have accrued the right to work in the Civil Service

Further information on nationality requirements (opens in a new window) https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/nationality-rules

Reserve list

A reserve list may be held for up to 12 months from which further appointments may be made for the same or similar roles.

  • Must be able to climb and complete some work on ladders
  • Must be able to lift material up to 40 lbs.

title: ICT Service Desk Specialist
description:
Role: IT Service Desk Specialist (Internal Title: ICT Centre Support Specialist)

Location: Murarrie, Brisbane

Employment Type: Full-time, Permanent



Be a trusted technology partner behind Australia's largest early learning provider

Join Goodstart as an ICT Centre Support Specialist and help keep our national network of centres and support offices connected.

Working as part of our ICT Service Delivery team, you'll provide frontline technical support to Goodstarters across Australia, helping resolve a wide variety of technology issues and delivering a positive customer experience every day.

This is a fast-paced, high-volume service desk role where you'll manage a variety of tickets and calls, troubleshoot technical issues and support users with different levels of technical confidence. You'll be part of a collaborative team where strong communication, active listening, a solution-focused approach and a good work ethic are highly valued.

Across the team, we manage approximately 100-150 tickets and up to 50 calls each day, providing plenty of variety and the opportunity to work collaboratively while delivering great customer service.

Your Impact

  • Provide responsive frontline ICT support to Goodstarters across Australia.
  • Manage a high volume of tickets and calls, prioritising requests and working within service level expectations.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve a broad range of hardware, software, system and user access issues.
  • Provide clear, friendly and solution-focused support to customers with varying levels of technical knowledge.
  • Use ServiceNow or other ITSM tools to record, manage and update support requests.
  • Escalate issues when required and work collaboratively with other ICT teams and service providers.
  • Maintain accurate support documentation and contribute to knowledge sharing and continuous improvement.
  • Help deliver a consistent and positive technology experience for Goodstarters across our national network.

What Goodstart can offer you

  • Enjoy flexible work arrangements that support both your professional and personal commitments.
  • Salary packaging benefits available through AccessPay (eligibility applies).
  • Access to discounted childcare (up to 15%).
  • Fitness Passport - access to gyms and pools for you and your family at a heavily discounted price.
  • Discounted health care and access to our employee wellbeing program with BUPA.
  • Exclusive discounts on travel, gym memberships, Apple and Dell products, and more.
  • Free annual flu shot (optional).
  • Option to purchase extra leave for even greater work-life balance.
  • First Nations Support and Cultural Leave.
  • Work for a company with an aspiration to be globally recognised for early years practice and learning outcomes.
  • Grow your career through ongoing investment in learning, leadership development and meaningful work that supports children and families across Australia.

You'll bring to the table

  • 3+ years experience in an ICT Service Desk, Help Desk or Technical Support role, ideally within a medium to large or complex organisation.
  • Experience working in a high-volume support environment, with strong troubleshooting skills across Microsoft environments, end-user devices and business applications.
  • Experience using ServiceNow or another ITSM platform will be highly regarded.
  • Strong customer service, communication, active listening and problem-solving skills, with the ability to support a diverse range of customers.
  • A calm, professional and solution-focused approach when dealing with challenging or non-technical customers.
  • Strong organisational skills, a collaborative approach and a good work ethic.
  • Experience supporting users across a large or geographically dispersed organisation will be highly regarded.
  • Willingness to obtain a Queensland Blue Card and complete the National Child Safety Foundation Training.

Click ‘Apply Now' and submit your application.

Applications are reviewed as they're received, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible for the best opportunity to progress.

Have a question? Contact Faith in our Talent Acquisition Team via email vkundoorvala@goodstart.org.au

At Goodstart we are deeply committed to Reconciliation and encourage Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander people to apply. For further information and support email deadlycareers@goodstart.org.au

title: Junior Data Engineer
description:
The Junior Data Engineer helps build, maintain, and strengthen the data platform that supports dashboards, planning, and daily reporting across Kreate. The role works with data from the ERP, HR systems, and retail feeds as it moves through a Microsoft Fabric lake house using Bronze, Silver, and Gold layers. Working alongside a Senior Data Engineer, the Junior Data Engineer will gain hands-on experience building data pipelines, improving data quality, and supporting reliable, production-ready data infrastructure. The role also takes ownership of daily pipeline monitoring and troubleshooting while developing the skills needed to build data solutions end to end.

Essential Functions and Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain data ingestion pipelines and notebooks in Microsoft Fabric, including Data Factory pipelines, Python/Spark notebooks, and Delta tables.
  • Monitor the daily operation of scheduled pipelines and container jobs, triage failures, and ensure partially failed jobs are accurately reported as failures rather than successful runs.
  • Develop and maintain data quality checks for data freshness, row counts, duplicate records, and reconciliation back to source systems, including appropriate alerts for issues.
  • Migrate ad-hoc and desktop-scheduled scripts to managed, version-controlled, and monitored infrastructure.
  • Model new source tables into conformed Silver dimensions and Gold facts, with clearly documented data grain and business definitions.
  • Maintain runbooks and the data catalogue to ensure data pipelines, processes, and systems are well documented and maintainable.
  • Work alongside senior engineering team members to troubleshoot pipeline issues, understand root causes, and build reliable solutions.
  • Collaborate with data, analytics, and business teams to ensure data is accurate, accessible, and fit for downstream reporting and analysis.

Required Qualifications

  • 1–3 years of experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, software development, or a related field. Internships and substantial academic or personal projects may count toward experience.
  • Solid SQL skills, including joins and window functions, with an understanding of how joins can unintentionally multiply or "fan out" rows.
  • Working knowledge of Python, including pandas or PySpark.
  • Everyday experience using Git and version control.
  • Strong attention to detail and patience for investigating existing pipelines and determining why a data result or metric has changed.
  • A strong commitment to data accuracy and quality, with the judgment to flag discrepancies rather than deliver numbers that simply appear reasonable.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and an interest in learning data engineering practices, tools, and technologies.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Factory, Databricks, or Synapse.
  • Familiarity with Delta Lake and Parquet.
  • Basic knowledge of Azure services such as App Service, Container Apps, Key Vault, and Entra ID.
  • Experience working with ERP or manufacturing data, including Oracle, IQMS/DELMIAworks, SAP, or Epicor.
  • Experience with Power BI.

About the Role:

    We are looking for a Senior Engineering Manager to lead our Data Platform & Infrastructure team. This leader will own the strategy, execution, and evolution of the foundational data systems that power insights and our ecosystem.

    You will lead a team of highly capable engineers responsible for building reliable, scalable, secure, and developer-friendly data infrastructure. This includes data ingestion and processing, data platforms, storage and compute, orchestration, observability, and the infrastructure that enables teams across the company to efficiently build and operate data-intensive products and applications.

    This is a hands-on leadership role: you will set technical direction and organizational strategy while remaining close enough to the technology to make high-quality architectural decisions and guide the team through complex technical challenges.

Responsibilities:

    Leadership & Team Management

    • Lead, recruit, and mentor an exceptional engineering team.
    • Direct data infrastructure strategy to drive business and product success.
    • Oversee resource allocation, including headcount and vendor budget planning.
    • Establish operational rhythms, goals, and execution frameworks aligned with core business outcomes.
    • Cultivate an inclusive environment focused on ownership, technical rigor, and continuous professional development.
    • Champion team morale, engagement, learning opportunities, and delivery velocity.

    Data Engineering Strategy

    • Guide system architecture, data flow design, quality standards, and platform roadmaps.
    • Partner with Product and Data leadership to plan, sequence, and execute multi-quarter initiatives.
    • Define robust platform abstractions, APIs, and SLAs to streamline developer workflows and increase adoption.
    • Ensure infrastructure resilience through comprehensive monitoring, incident management, disaster recovery, and cost optimization.
    • Work cross-functionally with Security, Audit, and Analytics Engineering to deploy key capabilities and compliance controls.

    Cross-Functional Partnership

    • Engage with Data, Product, and Finance partners to enable machine learning, experimentation, and business reporting.
    • Establish and enforce organization-wide standards for pipeline reliability, data security, and quality.

    Technical Leadership

    • Advocate for automation, engineering best practices, and thoughtful trade-offs between execution speed and long-term scalability.
    • Thrive in fast-paced, ambiguous settings while cultivating senior technical leaders and building leadership succession through delegated autonomy, developing senior technical leaders and succession depth.

Requirements:

    Required Qualifications

    • 10+ years of experience in software engineering, SRE or infrastructure, data platform engineering, or related fields.
    • 4+ years managing high-performing technical teams, growing and developing people
    • Deep expertise with Snowflake/Google BigQuery/Databricks or equivalent modern data warehousing systems and ecosystem of tools including Airflow, DBT etc.
    • Familiarity with Git and CI/CD workflows
    • Strong understanding of data warehousing concepts and infrastructure workload management.
    • Experience defining data security, platform SLAs and governance frameworks.
    • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
    • Demonstrated ability to influence technical strategy across multiple organizations.

    Preferred Qualifications

    • Experience delivering customer-facing data products is a plus
    • Experience scaling platform organizations through rapid company growth.
    • Familiarity with event-driven data architectures, data science & product analytics computational needs and patterns is a plus.
    • Experience supporting experimentation platforms and machine learning initiatives.
    • Knowledge of metrics governance and executive KPI frameworks.

Success in your First Year:

    Within your first 12 months, you will:

    • Build strong relationships with leaders across Product, Engineering, Finance, and Go-to-Market.
    • Improve trust in data through stronger governance and controls.
    • Increase data consumptions and data-powered products across the organization.
    • Establish scalable development standards and improve engineering velocity.
    • Grow and mentor a high-performing data platform engineering team.
    • Deliver a roadmap that supports both current business needs and future scale.

title: Brow Waxing Expert
description:
OVERVIEW

Experience a perfect blend of deliberate purpose and clear-eyed vision. At Ulta Beauty, some of the industry’s most highly-esteemed beauty leaders share themselves, as well as their expertise. Building authentic community. Creating a real sense of belonging—even as they’re plotting a bold, strategic course of exciting innovations destined to revolutionize the industry.

Think robust organizational support. Ever-increasing levels of investment. And a healthy dose of personal empowerment and growth opportunity. All with a company of unwavering strength and stability.

We are the future of beauty services. Be part of the transformation.

GENERAL SUMMARY & SCOPE

The Arch Expert (AE) is responsible for maximizing sales in the Benefit brand by engaging guests to determine their individual needs, assisting guests in the selection and purchase of merchandise and performing short services, including eyebrow/facial waxing and tinting. They represent the image, products, and culture of the brand to the Ulta Beauty guest and support the Experience Manager (EM) through a focus on performance (service/retail sales and in-store events), people (guest service), and process (operating procedures and compliance standards). This position requires an active license in Esthetics or Cosmetology (as required by law), exceptional guest service, and the aptitude to learn and communicate product knowledge.

PRINCIPAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES (*Essential Job Functions)

The Brow Waxing Expert is a champion of Ulta Beauty’s mission, vision and values, and should demonstrate them skillfully and consistently by performing the following duties and responsibilities of the position (as well as all other projects/duties as assigned):

Performance

  • Meet or exceed Benefit brand sales and service goals,and contribute to meeting or exceeding the store’s goals related to retail and service sales, guest loyalty (including credit), omni-channel, and retail shrink as set by Ulta Beauty.
  • Ensure each guest receives exceptional service by greeting and engaging every guest, personalizing service to their needs, and recommending complementary products, samples, and services.
  • Perform makeup applications, skincare analysis, and product demonstrations with guests to drive sales and guest service experience.
  • Perform short services at the Brow Bar, including (but not limited to), eyebrow and facial waxing, tweezing, eyebrow tinting, strip lash applications, and threading in accordance with all of Ulta Beauty’s policies and procedures.
  • Use appointment book or system to book guests’ appointments for initial services, return services, and events.
  • Meet average sales per labor hour and sales to service ratio goal.
  • Take the initiative to stay informed regarding new and existing industry trends, products, and services during work time, and be knowledgeable about the ingredients and benefits of these trends, products, and services to better serve guests.
  • Maintain prompt, regular attendance.

People

  • Contribute to an inclusive environment that supports teammates, peers, and the internal and external guests served.
  • Regularly participate in ongoing Benefit and Ulta Beauty training, including training parties, team meetings, and brand and category education, to enable continuous professional development and drive sales performance.
  • Build and maintain strong customer relationships and an active clientele portfolio for Benefit brand services.
  • Maintain strong relationships with Benefit brand partners through participation in required trainings and the execution of in store events and promotions.
  • Create and maintain partnerships with Prestige consultants and salon professionals to promote teamwork and a high level of customer service.
  • Share the benefits of the guest loyalty program, including credit and the Ulta Beauty app, with guests on the salesfloor.
  • Collaborate with managers and associates throughout the store to help grow the business.

Process

  • Be knowledgeable of and ensure compliance with Ulta Beauty’s policies, procedures, and standards.
  • Follow all safety, sanitation, and hygienic procedures before, during and after services; always ensure compliance with state board guidelines.
  • Adhere to the Ulta Beauty and Benefit brand dress code, including wearing brand assets as directed.
  • Drive sales by keeping the Brow Bar area replenished, signed and faced, and ensuring testers are available and maintained in compliance with hygiene standards, as well as any additional assigned area.
  • Communicate supply needs to the store management team and brand representatives in a timely manner to ensure guest-readiness at all times.
  • Maintain outstanding store operational standards, including cleanliness of the Brow Bar, and any additional assigned area including, the salesfloor, restrooms, cashwrap, backroom, and break area.
  • Participate in completing merchandise resets, planograms, marketing displays, physical inventory procedures, and processing shipment using the Benefit brand’s and Ulta Beauty’s technology and best practices.
  • Protect company assets by following loss prevention best practices and providing exceptional guest service.
  • Execute other operational tasks as directed.

JOB QUALIFICATIONS

Education

  • High school diploma is preferred
  • Cosmetology or esthetics license where required by state law

Experience

  • Experience in make-up application; eyebrow and facial waxing, tweezing, and eyebrow tinting is preferred
  • Proficiency with use of equipment needed to perform technical work

Skills

  • Demonstrates significant competency in sales, products, and service
  • Ability to build and maintain strong customer relationships
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team
  • Ability to positively and proactively handle guest concerns and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment
  • Strong communication skills

SPECIAL POSITION REQUIREMENTS

  • Work a flexible schedule to include days, evenings, weekends, and holidays
  • Attend brand sponsored trainings

WORKING CONDITIONS

  • Continuous mobility during shift
  • Frequent standing, pulling, pushing, crouching, stooping, reaching, bending, and twisting during shift
  • Continuous lifting and/or moving up to 10 lbs. during shift
  • Ability to lift and/or move up to 25 lbs.
  • Continuous coordination and manipulation of objects during shift

If an associate has a disability that prevents them from performing an essential function of the job, the Company will engage in the interactive process with the associate to determine whether there is a reasonable accommodation that will enable the associate to perform the essential functions of the job.




The pay range for this position is $15.00 - $23.00/ Hour. Exact pay will be based on factors including, but not limited to relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, level, shift, geographic location, and business and organizational needs. Eligible associates may also earn overtime pay as required by applicable law and tips paid by service guests. Full-time positions are eligible for paid time off, health, dental, vision, life, and disability benefits. Part-time positions are eligible for dental, vision, life, and disability benefits. For additional information concerning our benefits, visit our Benefits and Career Development page: https://learn.bswift.com/ulta

ABOUT

At Ulta Beauty (NASDAQ: ULTA), the possibilities are beautiful. Ulta Beauty is the largest North American beauty retailer and the premier beauty destination for cosmetics, fragrance, skin care products, hair care products and salon services. We bring possibilities to life through the power of beauty each and every day in our stores and online with more than 25,000 products from approximately 500 well-established and emerging beauty brands across all categories and price points, including Ulta Beauty’s own private label. Ulta Beauty also offers a full-service salon in every store featuring—hair, skin, brow, and make-up services.

title: Product Manager - Applied AI
description:
Who is Quantium?

Quantium is a world leader in data science and artificial intelligence. Established in Australia in 2002, Quantium is a global team of more than 1,200 people across 14 locations with a unique blend of capabilities across product and consulting services to help businesses unlock value from data and analytics. Quantium partners with the world's largest corporations to forge a better, more intelligent world.

About the role

Our Product team sits at the centre of how we turn data science capability into market-ready solutions. As we scale our AI product portfolio, we are investing in rigorous, evidence-based validation to ensure we are building things that are genuinely worth building. This role sits at the very front of that process - testing and shaping new product opportunities to ensure we build the most valuable solutions for our customers.

How will you make an impact?

  • Opportunity validation: Operate at the front of the AI product funnel -- assessing incoming ideas and proofs of concept to determine whether they are worth building, using evidence and commercial rigour rather than gut feel
  • Commercial case ownership: Build and present invest-or-stop recommendations to senior stakeholders, including market sizing, unit economics, and strategic fit analysis
  • Stage-gate decision making: Make credible build-or-kill calls based on evidence gathered during validation -- including the hard call to stop something that does not stack up
  • Cross-functional collaboration: Work with engineering, legal, and operations at the right moments in the validation cycle -- pulling them in proactively rather than treating them as downstream functions
  • Methodology development: Help shape the validation framework itself -- there is no existing playbook, and this person will have a hand in building it
  • Path to market: Where opportunities survive validation, contribute to shaping the product vision and route to market

The superpowers you’ll be bringing to the team:

  • Pre-definition product experience: Demonstrated experience doing real discovery, validation, and assumption testing ahead of any committed build -- not just executing against an agreed roadmap
  • Commercial rigour: Personally built commercial cases -- market sizing, unit economics, invest-or-stop recommendations -- that reached senior stakeholders and were stress-tested in practice
  • Stage-gate discipline: Has actually recommended stopping a product or opportunity based on evidence, and can articulate the reasoning, the evidence, and what happened next

Apply now and let's forge a better, more intelligent world together!
