title: Retail Customer Experience Associate, Deerbrook Mall - Full Time
description:
Be Part of an Amazing Story

Macy’s is more than just a store. We’re a story. One that’s captured the hearts and minds of America for more than 160 years. A story about innovations and traditions…about inspiring stores and irresistible products…about the excitement of the Macy’s 4th of July Fireworks, and the wonder of the Thanksgiving Day Parade. We’ve been part of memorable moments and milestones for countless customers and colleagues. Those stories are part of what makes this such a special place to work.

Job Overview

As a Customer Experience Colleague, you will create exceptional, personalized shopping experiences for our customers. You’ll prioritize customer satisfaction by actively engaging with shoppers across all touchpoints - both in-store and online - and drive cross-category sales to support overall business goals. With a deep understanding of fashion, fit, and function, you will make tailored product recommendations and leverage digital tools to enhance the customer journey. You also will work across different departments daily, often transitioning between multiple areas throughout the day.

In this role, you’ll also play a key part in client relationship building through outreach tools like My Client and social media. Your collaborative approach with peers, store leaders, and brand partners will help identify opportunities, resolve challenges, and elevate the overall customer experience. In addition to service and selling, you’ll support operational excellence through floor readiness, event execution, merchandise setup, and opening/closing procedures.

A positive, can-do attitude, strong communication skills, and a passion for delivering high-caliber service will be key to your success in this role.

How Our Selling Colleagues Spend Their Day…

  • Our colleagues begin each day energized and ready to make an impact. They wear their name badge with pride, greet teammates with a warm hello, and help ensure the sales floor is clean, organized, and prepared for customers. Before getting started, they review their sales goals, learn about new arrivals and top-selling items, and stay up to date on current trends and promotions - so they’re fully informed and ready to engage, educate, and sell with confidence.
  • On the floor, they focus on the customer - offering a warm welcome, making eye contact, and creating friendly, personal conversations to create customer relationships to bring the customers back.
  • Throughout the day, they maintain a shoppable space by recovering the floor and fitting rooms, updating signs and pricing, and supporting any needed merchandise moves.
  • They always Finish Strong - sharing our Loyalty program benefits, making sure customers have all they need, and ending with a sincere thank-you, often walking the package around and using the customer’s name.
  • We believe service starts with each other - supporting one another with honesty, care, and collaboration so we can better serve our customers and communities.
  • And we know that excellence is a journey - we strive to improve every day, take pride in our work, achieve sales goals and learn from each other to deliver individual and store results.

Full-time colleagues are typically scheduled to work 30 or more hours per week, while part-time colleagues are typically scheduled 12-24 hours per week. All schedules contain weekend shifts as part of the requirements. Hours are dependent on business needs and colleague availability. Information regarding hours per week needed for benefit eligibility purposes can be found here.

Who You Are

  • Flexible availability, including days, evenings, weekends and holidays with regular, dependable attendance and punctuality
  • Must be able to:
    • Understand and communicate effectively with customers, co-workers, and supervisors
    • Read and understand employment policies and safety rules/procedures in English
  • Be comfortable communicating and collaborating with customers and colleagues
  • Responsible for acquiring new customers by opening credit accounts and sharing loyalty benefits
  • Meeting daily sales goal challenges
  • Enjoy meeting people, learning about them, and sharing information
  • Resourceful and eager to start a new venture and can adapt to changing priorities; you can work on your own but are great with team dynamics
  • You can handle electronic devices with no problem
  • At least 2 years of selling or customer experience preferred

Essential Physical Requirements You Will Perform

  • This position requires talking, lifting, constant moving, standing, and reaching with arms and hands
  • Standing for at least two consecutive hours, lifting at least 25lbs., stooping, kneeling, crouching, and climbing ladders, reaching, including above eye level
  • Requires close vision, color vision, depth perception, and focus adjustment
  • Frequent use of computers and other technology, necessary to perform job functions, including handheld equipment, cash register and ability to process register transactions

What We Can Offer You

Join a team where work is as rewarding as it is fun! We offer a dynamic, inclusive environment with competitive pay and benefits. Enjoy comprehensive health and wellness coverage and a 401(k) match to invest in your future. Prioritize your well-being with paid time off and eight paid holidays. Grow your career with continuous learning and leadership development. Plus, build community by joining one of our Colleague Resource Groups and make a difference through our volunteer opportunities.

Some additional benefits we offer include:

  • Merchandise discounts
  • Performance-based incentives
  • Annual merit review
  • Employee Assistance Program with mental health counseling and legal/financial advice

Access the full menu of benefits offerings here.

About Us

This is a great time to join Macy’s! Whether you’re helping a customer find the perfect gift, streamlining operations in one of our distribution centers, enhancing our online shopping experience, buying in-style and on-trend merchandise to outfit our customers, or designing a balloon for the Thanksgiving Day Parade, we offer unique opportunities to be part of some of the most memorable moments in people’s lives.

Join us and help write the next chapter in our story - Apply Today!

title: 16285 Senior nCino Developer
description:
Position Description

Build and Deliver Enterprise nCino Solutions for Financial Services


Are you an experienced nCino Developer who enjoys solving complex technical challenges and delivering enterprise solutions in the financial services industry? Do you thrive in a hands-on role where you can combine development expertise with technical leadership, stakeholder collaboration, and end-to-end solution delivery?


CGI is seeking a **Senior nCino Developer** to join our team supporting a high-profile financial services client in **Salt Lake City, Utah**.


In this role, you will serve as a key technical resource for nCino and Salesforce initiatives, working closely with business stakeholders, Product Owners, architects, subject matter experts, QA, DevOps, integration teams, offshore development teams, and third-party vendors. You will help translate complex commercial lending and business requirements into scalable technical solutions while providing hands-on development and technical guidance throughout the software development lifecycle.


This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced nCino professional who enjoys combining **hands-on Salesforce development, solution design, integration, technical leadership, and financial services domain expertise** in a collaborative consulting environment.


Location: This position is based at the client site in Salt Lake City, Utah.



Your future duties and responsibilities



  • Serve as a primary onsite technical point of contact for nCino and Salesforce initiatives.
  • Own technical delivery across the development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, solution design, development, integration, testing, deployment, and production stabilization.
  • Partner with business stakeholders, Product Owners, architects, SMEs, QA, DevOps, integration teams, offshore teams, and third-party vendors to successfully deliver complex solutions.
  • Translate business, commercial lending, and loan origination requirements into scalable and maintainable nCino and Salesforce solutions.
  • Lead technical discussions, solution walkthroughs, design reviews, code reviews, release-readiness activities, and implementation planning.
  • Coordinate multiple development and integration workstreams while proactively managing technical dependencies, risks, issues, and delivery timelines.
  • Design, develop, enhance, and troubleshoot solutions using **Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Aura Components, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, and Python**.
  • Develop solutions using **Salesforce OmniStudio**, including OmniScripts, FlexCards, DataRaptors, and Integration Procedures.
  • Design efficient Salesforce data solutions using **SOQL, SOSL, DML, Platform Events, and Change Data Capture (CDC)**.
  • Design and implement integrations using **Salesforce APIs, REST, SOAP, OAuth 2.0, JWT, SAML, and OIDC**.
  • Support integrations with enterprise and third-party platforms such as **Apache Kafka, DocuSign, Adobe Acrobat Sign, IBM FileNet, credit bureau APIs, and other banking platforms**.
  • Troubleshoot complex application, integration, data, performance, and production issues and participate in root cause analysis and remediation.
  • Apply Salesforce security and governance practices, including CRUD, field-level security (FLS), sharing rules, Custom Metadata Types, Custom Settings, and Salesforce Shield Platform Encryption.
  • Optimize Salesforce performance for large data volumes through SOQL optimization, Query Plan Analysis, and database concurrency management.
  • Support source control, release management, and CI/CD processes using tools such as **Git, Azure DevOps, Copado, Salesforce DX, and Salesforce CLI**.
  • Mentor development team members, provide technical direction, and promote consistent engineering practices across onsite and offshore teams.
  • Communicate project status, technical risks, dependencies, blockers, and mitigation plans clearly to technical and business stakeholders.
  • Support successful production implementations, post-production validation, stabilization, and hypercare activities.


Technical Environment


Core Platforms: nCino, Salesforce


  • Salesforce Development: Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Aura Components, OmniStudio, OmniScripts, FlexCards, DataRaptors, Integration Procedures, SOQL, SOSL, DML, Platform Events, Change Data Capture, Salesforce DX, Salesforce APIs
  • Programming: Apex, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, Python
  • Integration: REST, SOAP, Salesforce APIs, OAuth 2.0, JWT, SAML, OIDC, Apache Kafka, DocuSign, Adobe Acrobat Sign, IBM FileNet, credit bureau APIs
  • DevOps: Git, Azure DevOps, Copado, CI/CD, Salesforce CLI
  • Containers: Docker, Kubernetes, Helm
  • Security & Governance: CRUD, FLS, Sharing Rules, Custom Metadata Types, Custom Settings, Salesforce Shield Platform Encryption
  • Data & Performance: SOQL Optimization, Large Data Volumes (LDV), Query Plan Analysis, Database Concurrency Management


Required qualifications to be successful in this role


  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline.

title: Public Area Attendant - InterContinental Hayman Great Barrier Reef
description:

At InterContinental Hayman Great Barrier Reef, every day begins with ocean views and the spirit of true hospitality. Live, work, and thrive on one of the iconic 74 Whitsunday Islands, where a rewarding career meets an extraordinary island lifestyle—delivering and inspiring incredible experiences for our guests and colleagues alike.

Base rate $27.48 + penalties + loading

title: NETWORK ADMINISTRATOR
description:
The King David School in Armadale, is a leading independent Jewish school providing excellence and opportunity in education from Early Learning to Year 12. We foster curiosity, creativity, and a strong sense of community in a modern, inclusive environment.

We are seeking a skilled and proactive Network Administrator to play a key role in the day-to-day maintenance, technical configuration, and hands-on operational support of the School's computer infrastructure, hardware endpoints, and network environment. This is an exciting opportunity to ensure core network components, user accounts, and physical hardware are proactively maintained and secured across all school campuses to support teaching, learning, and administrative functions.

This role requires a balance of network/server administration, endpoint fleet management, and responsive user technical support.

This is a full-time position on campus commencing as soon as possible.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Reporting directly to the ICT Manager, you will:

  • Administer and maintain the School's network switching infrastructure, firewall, wireless access points, and security monitoring tools.

  • Manage domain/directory services (Active Directory/Entra ID), user accounts, passwords, storage quotas, and security permissions.

  • Perform and verify daily/weekly/monthly system backups, conduct restore tests, and enforce workstation security/Group Policies (GPO).

  • Sustain and manage the School's 1:1 hardware fleet (desktops, laptops, iPads, printers, peripherals), including lifecycle management, deployment, electronic inventory, and SOE image creation.

  • Provide responsive Level 1 and Level 2 technical support to staff and students via the ICT HelpDesk system, including classroom AV and event setups.

  • Maintain printer fleet, server infrastructure, and auxiliary security hardware (CCTV storage servers, physical access control systems).

  • Liaise with external contractors for hardware, software, and cabling support as directed.

ABOUT YOU

You will bring a strong practical background in network administration and desktop support within a multi-site environment. Specifically, you will have:

  • Practical knowledge of core networking protocols (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs), wireless networking, and firewall concepts.

  • Working knowledge of server virtualisation (VMware), Windows Server environments, Active Directory/Entra ID, and cloud ecosystems (Google Workspace & M365).

  • Strong practical experience in computer hardware maintenance, endpoint management, and SOE imaging.

  • Excellent troubleshooting, organizational, and time-management skills.

  • Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to communicate technical information clearly and patiently to staff and students.

  • A current employee Working with Children Check is essential.

Full position description available on our website www.kds.vic.edu.au

Please email your cover letter, CV and examples of recent work to hr@kds.vic.edu.au

Please complete pre-employment form by clicking on the link below. Applicants who do not complete the form, will not be considered.

Applications close: Friday 9 October 2026

Please note: We apologise in advance but only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

The King David School in Melbourne is a co-educational progressive Jewish Day School catering for 800 students from Preschool to VCE. Established on the principles of inclusion, egalitarianism and social justice, we value individuality and self-expression, a strong Australian identity, and students’ intellectual, cultural and social development within a progressive Jewish environment.

The School is committed to ensuring child safety and has a zero tolerance for child abuse. The School undertakes several screening processes to ensure the appropriate protection of children in its care. This includes reference checks, qualification checks and professional registration checks.

The King David School is an equal opportunity employer. We are dedicated to attracting, retaining and developing our people regardless of gender identity, ethnicity, sexual orientation, disability and age. Applications are encouraged from all sectors of the community, including the Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander community.

title: Senior Systems Engineer
description:
Who will you be working with?
Wabtec's Train Handling solutions include Trip Optimizer® and Locotrol®, which work together to optimize train performance and automate freight operations. Trip Optimizer creates and executes fuel-efficient operating plans that meet schedule and train-handling requirements, while Locotrol enables coordinated control of distributed locomotives throughout the train. Together, these technologies improve train handling, fuel efficiency, operational safety, and the ability to operate longer and heavier trains.

As a Senior Systems Engineer, you will serve as a technical leader across engineering, product management, program leadership, and customer organizations, influencing the future direction of train automation and optimization technologies across the rail industry.

How will you make a difference?
As a Senior Systems Engineer, you will provide technical leadership for the architecture, strategy, development, and deployment of Wabtec's Train Handling portfolio. You will drive complex system design decisions, guide technology roadmaps, lead cross-functional initiatives, and ensure solutions meet customer, business, safety, and regulatory requirements.

The successful candidate will bring an AI-native mindset and champion the adoption of AI-enabled engineering practices across the organization. You will identify and mature opportunities for intelligent automation, advanced analytics, optimization, and next-generation autonomous train operations. As a recognized technical authority, you will establish engineering standards, mentor other engineers, and help shape the strategic application of AI to create differentiated products and measurable customer value.

What do we want to know about you?

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering, Mathematics or Computer Science from an accredited college or university
  • Minimum of 10 years’ hands-on design, requirements development and implementation experience involving; Engineering Systems, Hardware / Software Engineering, and/or Data Information Systems
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Strong oral and written communication skills
  • Ability to work in a cross-functional, global environment
  • Willingness and ability to travel domestically and internationally

What will your typical day look like?

  • Provide technical leadership for the architecture, strategy, and evolution of Wabtec's Train Handling solutions, ensuring alignment with product roadmaps, customer needs, and business objectives.
  • Lead the development of complex system architectures, requirements, and design solutions that balance performance, safety, reliability, maintainability, and operational efficiency.
  • Serve as the technical authority for major programs and initiatives, driving engineering decisions across the product lifecycle from concept development through deployment and sustainment.
  • Partner with Product Management, Software Engineering, Train Control, Office Systems, Safety, Validation, and Applications Engineering teams to define technical direction and successfully execute strategic product initiatives.
  • Lead technical reviews, design reviews, trade studies, and system-level verification and validation activities to ensure robust, high-quality solutions.
  • Drive resolution of complex system and product issues, utilizing data-driven analysis, root cause investigations, and cross-functional problem-solving methodologies.
  • Collaborate directly with railroad executives, customers, industry stakeholders, and subject matter experts to understand operational challenges, influence product strategy, and develop innovative solutions.
  • Guide field testing, operational demonstrations, and customer deployments to validate performance and ensure successful adoption of new capabilities.
  • Identify, evaluate, and champion emerging technologies, advanced automation concepts, and next-generation train handling capabilities that improve customer value and competitive differentiation.
  • Establish engineering standards, best practices, and technical processes while mentoring and developing systems engineers across the organization.
  • Promote an AI-native engineering culture by driving the adoption of AI-enabled tools, advanced analytics, and intelligent automation throughout the product development lifecycle to improve engineering efficiency, product quality, and business outcomes.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Extensive experience applying systems engineering principles across the full product lifecycle, including concept development, architecture, requirements management, system integration, verification, validation, deployment, and sustainment.
  • Demonstrated success leading the technical development of complex, multi-disciplinary systems involving software, controls, automation, embedded systems, communications, or safety-critical applications.
  • Deep knowledge of systems architecture, requirements decomposition, interface management, risk management, and system integration methodologies.
  • Proven ability to influence product strategy, technology roadmaps, and engineering direction across multiple teams and programs.
  • Strong leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills with the ability to effectively engage customers, executives, and cross-functional teams.
  • Experience mentoring engineers and driving technical excellence through coaching, knowledge sharing, and engineering process improvements.
  • Demonstrated ability to evaluate and apply AI-enabled technologies, advanced analytics, optimization techniques, and data-driven decision-making to solve complex engineering and operational challenges.
  • Expertise in railroad operations, train control systems, distributed systems, automation technologies, or other transportation and safety-critical industries is highly desired.
  • Working knowledge of AAR, CENELEC, FRA, and other applicable industry standards, regulations, and safety practices.

Relocation assistance may be provided if eligibility requirements are met.

Wabtec will only employ those who are legally authorized to work in the U.S. for this opening. Any offer of employment is conditioned upon the successful completion of a drug screen (as applicable) and fitness for duty test (as applicable).

Our job titles may span more than one career level. The salary rate for this role is currently $120600-171700 The actual salary offered to a candidate may be influenced by a variety of factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, education, business needs, market demands and work location. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. More information on offered benefits, which include health, welfare, and retirement, are available at mywabtecbenefits.com. Other benefit offerings for this role may include annual bonus, if eligible.

What could you accomplish in a place that puts People First?

At Wabtec, it’s not just about a job - it’s about the impact you make. When our people come together, we’re Expanding the Possible by continuously improving what we do and how we do it - for our clients and each other.

If you’re ready to revolutionize how the world moves for future generations, Wabtec is the place for you.

Who are we?

Wabtec is a leading global provider of equipment, systems, digital solutions, and value-added services for the freight and transit rail sectors. Drawing on more than 150 years of experience, we are leading the way in safety, efficiency, reliability, innovation, and productivity. Whether it’s freight, transit, ports, logistics, mining, industrial, or marine, our expertise, technologies, and people together – are accelerating the future of transportation. With roots that date back to George Westinghouse, Thomas Edison, and Louis Faiveley, Wabtec has always built technologies and implemented solutions for a variety of sectors that are critical to meeting the needs of customers and governments alike.

Our global team of about 30,000 employees worldwide delivers performance that moves the world forward. We’re lifelong learners, obsessed with better. Learn more at www.WabtecCorp.com.

Culture powers us and the possibilities.

We believe the best ideas come from a mix of experiences and backgrounds. At Wabtec, we strive every day to create a place where everyone belongs. We’re building a culture where leadership, inclusion and your unique perspective fuel progress.


We’re proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We welcome talent of all backgrounds, experiences, and identities, including race, gender, age, disability, veteran status and more.

Need accommodation? Just let us know - we’ve got you.

description:
At Johnson & Johnson,we believe health is everything. Our strength in healthcare innovation empowers us to build aworld where complex diseases are prevented, treated, and cured,where treatments are smarter and less invasive, andsolutions are personal.Through our expertise in Innovative Medicine and MedTech, we are uniquely positioned to innovate across the full spectrum of healthcare solutions today to deliver the breakthroughs of tomorrow, and profoundly impact health for humanity.Learn more at jnj.com .

We provide an inclusive work environment where each person is considered as an individual. At Johnson & Johnson, we respect the diversity and dignity of our employees and recognize their merit.

Career Programs

Post Doc - Data Analytics & Computational Sciences

Job Category:
Career Program

Beerse, Antwerp, Belgium, Cambridge, Massachusetts, United States of America, Madrid, Spain, Spring House, Pennsylvania, United States of America

Job Description:

Our expertise in Innovative Medicine is informed and inspired by patients, whose insights fuel our science-based advancements. Visionaries like you work on teams that save lives by developing the medicines of tomorrow.

Join us in developing treatments, finding cures, and pioneering the path from lab to life while championing patients every step of the way.

Learn more at https://www.jnj.com/innovative-medicine

Johnson & Johnson Innovative Medicine is recruiting for a Postdoctoral Scientist - Multimodal Representation Learning for Predictive Biology to join the Data, Data Science & Artificial Intelligence (DDSAI) organization for a two-year fixed term position, helping advance AI/ML analytics and multimodal modeling for drug discovery. This position will be based at any of the following locations: Cambridge, MA (preferred); Spring House, PA; Beerse, Belgium; or Madrid, Spain. (No fully remote option.)

Please note that this role is available across multiple countries and may be posted under different requisition numbers to comply with local requirements. While you are welcome to apply to any or all of the postings, we recommend focusing on the specific country(s) that align with your preferred location(s):

USA - Requisition Number: R-094412

Belgium - Requisition Number: R-095646

Spain - Requisition Number: R-095648

Within DDSAI, our teams develop innovative solutions using a variety of data sources across multiple therapeutic areas. We are looking for a highly motivated and innovative Postdoctoral Scientist to work at the intersection of advanced AI/ML modeling at scale, multimodal representation learning, drug discovery and predictive biology. The successful candidate is self-motivated, creative, and an effective communicator, with a strong interest in deep learning for imaging microscopy and multi-omics. The role focuses on developing advanced models that analyze and quantify the heterogeneity of perturbed cellular systems and integrate multi-scale biological data (e.g., high-content imaging, phenomics, transcriptomics, and proteomics) to derive new biological insights that support the next-generation portfolio for drug discovery. A successful candidate should demonstrate a strong capacity to build, evaluate, and benchmark AI/ML methods, and publish findings in top-tier peer-reviewed publications.

Key Responsibilities
  • Conceive, design, develop, implement and validate innovative AI/ML solutions for drug discovery problems using multimodal data of perturbed cells.
  • Analyze and extract novel biological insights from large-scale, heterogeneous high-dimensional data (e.g., imaging microscopy, phenomics, transcriptomics, proteomics).
  • Develop and evaluate innovative computer vision solutions to quantify heterogeneity of perturbed cells.
  • Collaborate closely with both internal and external cross-functional teams of scientists and engineers to advance algorithms and product development to improve project outcomes.
  • Clearly communicate complex technical methodologies and present findings to diverse audiences and stakeholders to support informed decision-making.
  • Follow standard processes for documentation and maintaining an up-to-date code repository.
  • Draft manuscripts and disseminate research findings internally and externally (e.g., publishing in peer-reviewed conferences/journals).


Qualifications
  • Ph.D.* in Electrical Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, or a related major. (*PhD completed within the last 3 years or to be completed within the next 6 months.)
  • Strong technical expertise in AI/ML for biological applications, with excellent analytical skills in at least one domain area (representation learning, multimodal integration, computational biology, imaging microscopy) and a proven track record (publications in top-tier AI/ML conferences or journals).
  • Experience developing foundation models and/or multimodal modeling of biological data in related applications, such as Cell Painting, imaging microscopy, and multi-omics.
  • Solid working knowledge of deep-learning architectures and techniques (e.g., Transformers, CNNs, graph networks, self-supervised and multi-instance learning, etc.) and their application to multimodal representation learning, alignment, and fusion.
  • Proficiency with one or more programming languages, preferably Python, and proficiency in one or more AI frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow.
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to present analytical results on behalf of the project team in a multi-functional setting, contextualizing how the work fits within the broader project.
  • This position will be based at any of the following locations: Cambridge, MA (preferred); Spring House, PA; Beerse, Belgium; or Madrid, Spain. (No fully remote option.)

title: Barselsvikariat, Faaborg-Midtfyn Musikskole
description:
Barselsvikariat: Faaborg-Midtfyn Musikskole søger en underviser til Musik og bevægelse (0. kl.), Musikalsk værksted (1. kl.), børnehavesamarbejde, begynderbands samt soloklaver.

Om stillingen:
Faaborg-Midtfyn Musikskole søger en engageret og dygtig underviser til en alsidig undervisningsstilling på 27 timer pr. uge med opstart 1. december 2026. Undervisningen er fordelt på tre dage (tirsdag, onsdag og torsdag).

Som underviser hos os vil du blive en del af et kreativt og inspirerende undervisningsmiljø, hvor du vil undervise i musik og bevægelse (0. kl. hold), musikalsk værksted (1. kl. hold), børnehavehold, begynderbands samt nogle få klaverelever. Stillingen er et barselsvikariat og det er muligt både at søge hele eller dele af stillingen. En naturlig opdeling kunne f.eks. være at søge børnehaveholdene, musik og bevægelse samt musikalsk værksted. Eller bands og klaverelever.

Undervisningen foregår:

  • tirsdag kl. 09.15-18.05 i Ryslinge-området
  • onsdag kl. 09:00-17:35 i Faaborg-området
  • torsdag kl. 09:00-16:55 i Nørre Lyndelse-området

Arbejdstiderne vil skifte en smule hen over sæsonen alt efter hvilke børnehavehold, der er i gang.

Faaborg-Midtfyn Musikskole er en arbejdsplads med fokus på medarbejdertrivsel, faglig udvikling samt, at det skal være sjovt at gå på arbejde. Faaborg-Midtfyn Musikskole er en musikskole med undervisning i egne lokaler i Ringe, Årslev og Faaborg samt decentral undervisning på mange af kommunens skoler og institutioner. Musikskolen har ca. 35 undervisere samt en musikskoleleder, en souschef og en sekretær. Du vil indgå i musikskolens lærerteam hvor kompetenceudvikling, sparring og trivsel er i fokus.

Dine primære opgaver vil være undervisning i:

  • Musik og bevægelse: Tilbud for 0. klasse, hvor fokus er på at skabe musikalske og bevægelsesmæssige aktiviteter, der stimulerer børnenes motorik og musikalske forståelse som f.eks. puls, rytme, tempo, dynamik og klang i en legende tilgang.
  • Musikalsk værksted: Tilbud til 1. klasse. En fortsættelse af musik og bevægelse med større fokus på instrumenter og stadig med en legende og motorisk tilgang.
  • Børnehavehold: Samarbejder med børnehaver i kommunen, hvor man besøger hver børnehavegruppe 10 gange. Fokus er på sanglege og musiske lege f.eks. med rasleæg.
  • Mini- og juniorband: Bandundervisning for nybegynderelever.
  • Instrumentalundervisning: soloundervisning i klaver, tilpasset elevernes niveau og udvikling.

Herudover vil der være deltagelse i personalemøder, arrangementer og koncerter. Disse kan være placeret på andre dage end undervisningsdagene.

Vi forventer, at du:

  • Har relevant uddannelse
  • Har erfaring med at undervise børnehold (0. og 1. klasse) samt i instrumentalundervisning på mange niveauer.
  • Er i stand til at tilrettelægge undervisningen, så den er både lærerig og inspirerende for eleverne.
  • Er engageret og kan skabe en tryg og kreativ undervisningsatmosfære, hvor eleverne føler sig set og hørt.

Du får:

  • En spændende og varieret stilling med mulighed for faglig udvikling samt høj grad af selvbestemmelse
  • 35 kollegaer og et positivt og støttende arbejdsmiljø med engagerede kollegaer
  • Mulighed for faglig udvikling
  • En varieret hverdag
  • Unik mulighed for at præge stillingen
  • Gode rammevilkår og udpræget stor indflydelse på egen hverdag
  • Lydhør ledelse, der sparrer, støtter og udfordrer
  • Vide rammer for at afprøve nye ideer
  • Løn efter kvalifikationer og anciennitet

Ansættelsesvilkår

Løn og ansættelse sker i henhold til gældende overenskomst. Lønintervallet er løntrin 29 (32.427,17 kr. + pension) til løntrin 41 (39.414,09 kr. + pension).

Forventet tiltrædelse den 1. december 2026
Stillingsbetegnelse: Musikskolelærer
Stillingskategori: (MM)
Arbejdstid: 27 timer pr. uge
Arbejdssted: Faaborg-Midtfyn Musikskole, Centrumpladsen 6b, 5750 Ringe
Arbejdstid: Deltid

Yderligere oplysninger

Hvis du ønsker yderligere oplysninger om stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Musikskoleleder Jakob Popp Riis Hansen på tlf. 72532169.

Ansøgning

Send din ansøgning med bilag elektronisk via linket nedenfor. Den skal være os i hænde senest søndag 18. oktober 2026.

Samtaler forventes afholdt uge 43 eller 44.

Tilbydes du stillingen, skal du kunne fremvise tilfredsstillende straffeattest. Vi forventer også, at du har kørekort, da Faaborg-Midtfyn Kommune er en geografisk stor kommune. Det er muligt at låne kommunebiler for at komme rundt.

Vi anvender referencer i rekrutteringsprocessen, og hvis du er den endelige kandidat, vil du blive bedt om at oplyse en eller flere referencer som vi må kontakte. I forbindelse med referenceindhentning vil vi spørge ind til emner som faglighed, personlige egenskaber, mødestabilitet og samarbejde.

Faaborg-Midtfyn Kommune ønsker at fremme ligestilling og opfordrer derfor alle kvalificerede til at søge uanset alder, køn, religion, handicap eller etnisk baggrund. Vi har røgfri arbejdstid og du kan læse mere om Faaborg-Midtfyn Kommune som arbejdsplads her.

title: Project Lead Practitioner
description:

This is a senior, client-facing role focused on helping private equity investors and technology businesses create value through technology. Accountabilities

title: Director Network Technologies
description:
Who we are:

Globalstar pioneered personal safety by introducing its SPOT Satellite GPS Messenger in 2007. Today, leveraging its low-earth orbit (LEO) satellite constellation, Globalstar reliably connects and protects assets, transmits key operational data, and saves lives – from any location – for consumers, industrial companies and government agencies in over 120 countries. With a portfolio that includes SPOT GPS messengers, next-generation IoT products and modems, and cloud-based telematics solutions, Globalstar’s cost effective satellite-powered innovations give users visibility and intelligence for improving safety and operational efficiencies.

What we offer:

  • Work/Life Balance: Paid Time Off, Paid Holidays
  • Financial Benefits: 401(k) Plan with Company Match, Employee Stock Purchase Program, Voluntary and Company Paid Group Life Insurance, Short- and Long-Term Disability Insurance, Medical FSA, Dependent Care, Competitive Salaries
  • Health & Wellness: Health Insurance, Dental Insurance, Vision Insurance, Employee Assistance Program, Comprehensive and Interactive Wellness Program

Job Summary:

Globalstar operates a global satellite communications network supported by a terrestrial WAN/LAN environment connecting gateway ground stations, data centers, cloud environments, and corporate sites worldwide, under high service-level commitments to large enterprise customers.

The Director of Network Technologies serves as the company's Chief Network Architect – the senior network design authority and final technical decision maker on network architecture below the VP. This is a technology leadership role, not a people-management role: engineering staff and day-to-day operations are owned by a peer Director, while this position owns what gets built and why. You set multi-year architecture strategy, chair design review, own technical standards, and be the deepest technical voice in the room on every consequential network decision — and you defend those decisions to executives, auditors, and enterprise customers. An active CCIE is required. The right candidate has spent a career choosing the technical track on purpose and wants a seat where that depth carries final authority.

Supervisory Responsibilities:

  • None

Decision Authority:

  • This role is the final technical decision maker on network design and technology selection, subject only to the VP, Network, IT & Applications. Disagreements between this role and peer organizations on technical matters escalate to the VP; on matters of staffing, scheduling, and operations, the peer Director's authority governs. This division is deliberate and candidates should expect it to be tested in interviews. The Chief Network Architect designation is a functional title reflecting this design authority; the organizational title and grade is Director.

Duties/Responsibilities:

  • Serve as final technical decision authority (below the VP) for all network architecture: WAN, LAN, data center, cloud interconnect, and network security edge. Own the multi-year architecture roadmap and technology selection.
  • Chair the network design review process: no major change — BGP policy, EVPN/VXLAN fabric design, SD-WAN/SASE (Cato Networks) topology, Equinix Fabric and AWS Direct Connect interconnects, optical/WAVE circuit design and route diversity (KMZ review) for gateway fiber plant — ships without this role's sign-off.
  • Own technical standards, reference architectures, golden configurations, and design documentation (HLD/LLD); ensure the network is buildable and operable by the engineering team, not just elegant on a whiteboard.
  • Partner closely with the Director of Cybersecurity & Network Systems, who owns the engineering staff and operations: this role decides what and why; the peer organization owns who and when. Success requires leading through authority of expertise, not headcount.
  • Own the network observability architecture (Kentik): flow analytics, synthetic testing, BGP monitoring, and capacity planning methodology in support of enterprise customer SLAs.
  • Act as the senior technical escalation for the most complex incidents; lead post-incident architectural review and drive systemic fixes.
  • Represent network architecture to executives, enterprise customers, auditors, and third-party assessors; translate design decisions and risk into business terms.
  • Ensure designs satisfy NIST 800-171, SOC 2, and ITAR/EAR obligations by construction; partner with compliance and legal on export-controlled technical data handling.
  • Lead the technical side of network workstreams for corporate initiatives, including integration-readiness, due diligence responses, and third-party assessments.
  • Evaluate emerging technology, run proofs of concept, and drive vendor technical strategy and roadmap influence (carriers, hardware, SaaS platforms); provide technical input to budget and contract decisions.
  • Mentor senior engineers on advanced routing, fabric design, and design discipline; raise the technical bar of the organization without owning its org chart.

Skills and Competencies:

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to interact clearly and concisely with all departments and levels of management
  • Excellent organizational skills with attention-to-detail
  • Ability to meet multiple deadlines in a fast-paced environment
  • Ability to effectively manage time and prioritize tasks
  • Ability to act with integrity, professionalism, and confidentiality
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office
  • Familiarity with NetSuite

Education, Experience, and Licenses/Certifications:

  • Active CCIE certification required (Enterprise Infrastructure or Service Provider track preferred). A second expert-level certification (additional CCIE track, CCDE, JNCIE, or AWS Certified Advanced Networking – Specialty) is strongly preferred and will differentiate candidates.
  • 15+ years of progressive network engineering experience, including 7+ years in a principal, distinguished, or chief-architect level design role with demonstrable design authority at scale.
  • Expert-level BGP: policy design, route reflection, communities, traffic engineering, multi-homing at scale.
  • Deep experience with EVPN/VXLAN data center fabrics and modern spine/leaf design.
  • Hands-on experience with SD-WAN/SASE platforms (Cato Networks strongly preferred) and cloud interconnect (Equinix Fabric, AWS Direct Connect).
  • Experience with carrier services: optical/WAVE circuits, circuit diversity analysis, and carrier technical escalation.
  • Experience designing under formal compliance regimes: NIST 800-171, SOC 2, and ITAR/EAR.
  • Track record of influencing without direct authority: design governance, architecture review boards, or matrixed technical leadership across teams you did not manage.
  • Network observability fluency (Kentik or equivalent: NetFlow/sFlow analytics, synthetic testing, BGP monitoring) and SLA-driven capacity planning.
  • Strong executive communication: able to defend architecture decisions to a VP/C-suite audience and translate risk for non-technical stakeholders.
  • S. Person (as defined by ITAR/EAR) required due to access to export-controlled technical data. This is a non-negotiable condition of employment.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Multiple active expert-level certifications (multi-track CCIE, CCDE, JNCIE).
  • Satellite ground segment, carrier, ISP, or other telecom infrastructure background.
  • Security architecture depth: firewall design (Check Point preferred), micro-segmentation, zero-trust design.
  • Experience leading technical workstreams through M&A due diligence and integration.
  • Network automation fluency (Python, Ansible) and infrastructure-as-code design practices.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field; equivalent experience considered.

Physical Requirements:

  • Standard office environment. Travel to company headquarters, gateway sites, data centers, and vendor/customer locations as business requires. May require occasional after-hours availability for major incidents and maintenance windows.

Marginal Functions:

A review of this job description may have omitted some of the marginal functions of the position that are incidental to the performance of the job duties and responsibilities. This job description, in no way, states or implies that these are the only duties and/or responsibilities to be performed by the employee in this position. The employee in this position will be required to follow any other job-related instructions and to perform any other job-related duties requested by his/her supervisor.

title: Senior UC Platforms Engineer – Cisco Telephony Infrastructure
description:
About the Opportunity

We are seeking a Senior UC Platforms Engineer with strong hands-on experience supporting Cisco telephony infrastructure and the server platforms that power enterprise unified communications environments.

In this role, you will be responsible for the installation, maintenance, optimization, and lifecycle management of Cisco Unified Communications infrastructure, including Cisco Unified Communications Manager (CUCM), Cisco Unity Connection, Cisco UCS, and VMware-based telephony environments.

The ideal candidate brings a strong foundation in infrastructure engineering, virtualization, automation, and troubleshooting, along with the ability to support highly available telephony platforms and collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams.

Key Responsibilities

  • Install, configure, maintain, and upgrade Cisco CUCM, Cisco Unity Connection, and related Cisco UC application servers.

  • Perform server builds, operating system patching, cluster configuration, and failover setup for telephony platforms.

  • Manage capacity planning, resource allocation, and performance tuning across the telephony server environment.

  • Administer virtualized telephony servers using VMware and Cisco UCS, including provisioning, snapshots, and resource management.

  • Manage Cisco UCS infrastructure through Cisco Intersight Managed Mode (IMM), including server profiles, policies, and firmware compliance.

  • Develop and maintain Ansible playbooks to automate server provisioning, configuration management, and routine maintenance.

  • Monitor server health, system logs, and infrastructure performance while troubleshooting incidents affecting telephony services.

  • Support backup and disaster recovery processes, including DRS backups and restore testing.

  • Coordinate hardware and firmware maintenance, replacement, upgrades, and end-of-life planning with vendors.

  • Support integrations between telephony infrastructure and adjacent systems, including SBCs, gateways, voicemail, and call recording platforms.

  • Perform root cause analysis and provide escalation support for server-related incidents.

  • Document server architecture, build standards, and maintenance procedures.

  • Collaborate with UC Tier II/III engineers, subject matter experts, and networking teams to support broader collaboration infrastructure.

Required Qualifications

  • Strong hands-on experience installing and maintaining Cisco CUCM, Cisco Unity Connection, and IM & Presence servers.

  • Proficiency with Cisco UCS hardware and VMware virtualization for telephony workloads.

  • Experience managing Cisco UCS infrastructure through Cisco Intersight, including Intersight Managed Mode (IMM).

  • Experience administering Linux-based appliance operating systems supporting Cisco UC applications.

  • Solid understanding of telephony protocols, including SIP, H.323, MGCP, and SCCP.

  • Experience with Cisco Unified Serviceability, RTMT, and Disaster Recovery System (DRS).

  • Knowledge of clustering, redundancy, and failover design for highly available telephony platforms.

  • Experience with storage, backup, and disaster recovery practices for application servers.

  • Scripting or automation experience with Ansible, PowerShell, Python, or similar tools.

  • Strong troubleshooting and root cause analysis skills.

  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills across technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

  • CCNP Collaboration or equivalent Cisco certification.

  • VMware certification.

  • Cisco Intersight or UCS certification.

  • Familiarity with ITIL practices.

Additional Requirements
  • Eligibility Requirements
  • U.S. citizenship is required for this position based on the applicable contract requirements.
  • Applicants must be eligible to obtain a Public Trust determination.

  • Willingness and ability to travel up to 10% of the time.

Desired Characteristics

  • Demonstrated hands-on experience performing root cause analysis, failure analysis, and troubleshooting of defective products, rotating equipment, and/or heavy machinery.
  • Customer-focused with the ability to understand customer requirements, establish priorities, and deliver timely technical solutions.
  • Strong analytical and quantitative problem-solving skills, including application of statistical methods, Six Sigma, Lean, and structured root cause analysis techniques.
  • Experience manufacturing, remanufacturing, maintaining, or servicing locomotive components, traction motors, wheelsets (combos), or similar heavy industrial equipment.
  • Experience analyzing product performance, reliability, and quality data to identify trends, support corrective and preventive actions (CAPA), and drive sustainable improvements.
  • Demonstrated understanding of quality systems and continuous improvement methodologies.
  • Strong oral, written, and presentation communication skills, with the ability to effectively communicate technical findings to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and diverse activities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Familiarity with manufacturing and quality tools, including PPAPs (Production Part Approval Process), SOP development, measurement system analysis, and Gage R&R studies.
  • Knowledge of structured problem-solving methodologies such as 8D, A3, Fishbone Analysis, Fault Tree Analysis, or similar root cause investigation techniques.
  • Experience utilizing Reliance, Proficy, eServices, i360, or other Wabtec transportation, quality, operational, or supply chain data systems.

What will your typical day look like?

As a member of the Forensics Team within the Reliability Center of Excellence (CoE), the Teardown Engineer will define, develop, and execute all aspects of the Combo analytical teardown process. This role serves as a critical link between field performance, remanufacturing operations, and quality improvement efforts by transforming failure analysis findings into actionable corrective and preventive actions. Through close engagement with shop operations, the Teardown Engineer will develop a thorough understanding of the combo remanufacturing process and leverage insights from both failure analysis and production activities to improve quality, process capability, and product reliability. As a key member of the Quality organization, this role helps strengthen quality systems and drive sustainable product and process improvements.

What Success Looks Like

The successful candidate is a self-motivated, hands-on quality professional who takes initiative, embraces challenges, and is energized by solving difficult technical problems. They build trust across all three shifts, collaborate effectively with operations teams, and are comfortable stepping into the shop daily to understand issues firsthand. They are flexible, innovative, and relentlessly focused on improving safety, quality, reliability, and customer outcomes.

Essential Responsibilities

  • Ensure all teardown activities are performed in compliance with Environmental, Health, and Safety (EHS) requirements.
  • Prioritize, schedule, lead, and perform hands-on analytical teardowns and teardown reviews based on business criticality, customer requirements, and resource availability.
  • Interact directly with customers during joint teardowns and support customer investigations.
  • Provide timely and accurate technical findings to customer-facing teams through Reliance Material Returns and other communication channels.
  • Analyze Combo performance data, test results, and historical quality records to supplement physical teardown evidence, identify failure trends, and determine root causes using structured problem-solving methodologies.
  • Manage teardown workflow and resources to deliver timely, high-quality root cause analysis that supports rapid implementation of corrective and preventive actions while developing technical expertise in combo assemblies, components, failure modes, and remanufacturing processes.
  • Collaborate with Engineering, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, and Quality teams to translate failure analysis findings into sustainable product and process improvements.
  • Develop a deep understanding of shop operations and the Combo remanufacturing process to identify opportunities for improving quality, process capability, productivity, and reliability.
  • Support quality improvement initiatives through the investigation of nonconformances, identification of systemic issues, and validation of corrective actions.
  • Enhance electronic workflows and reporting capabilities within Reliance in partnership with the Reliance implementation team.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives by partnering with quality and operational leaders to identify, implement, and institutionalize best practices across teardown, quality, and remanufacturing processes.
  • Serve as a change agent by communicating investigation results, project status, risks, and improvement opportunities while promoting a culture of quality and operational excellence.
  • Mentor and provide technical guidance to team members as required.

You may also be asked to perform other duties outside of your function or trade, for which adequate training will be provided if necessary.

title: Studiejob: Digitalisering & Datakonsulent
description:
Løbende rekruttering

Vi rekrutterer løbende til vores stillinger. Dette betyder at vi ikke opererer med en fast ansøgningsfrist. Stillingerne kan dog blive besat til enhver tid, så hvis du er interesseret i én specifik stilling, så anbefales det at ansøge med det samme.

Studiejob: Digitalisering & Datakonsulent

Er du skarp til at spotte manuelle arbejdsgange og vil lære at bygge dem om til automatiserede Power Platform-flows? Vores samarbejdspartner på to par hænder, i hver sin afdeling, der kan optimere deres forretning: en travl tilbudsafdeling og en administration fyldt med gentagne opgaver. Dette er en meget attraktiv vej til en karriere indenfor automatisering, data og Microsofts Power Platform.

Hvem er Cand?

Cand skaber udviklingsmuligheder i samspillet mellem studerende og virksomheder. Vi gør det nemt for virksomheder at opnå positive resultater med studerende i studierelevante jobs - og det er her, du kommer ind i billedet. Du bliver nemlig ansat som konsulent hos Cand. Vi ansætter studerende fra mange forskellige uddannelser, og det er både for bachelor- og kandidatstuderende. Det vigtigste for os er, at du brænder for at vise, hvordan du - med din personlighed, dine talenter og din faglige profil - skaber værdi i et studierelevant job hos vores samarbejdspartnere.

Studiejobbet

Vi søger to studerende til to sideløbende roller: én i tilbudsafdelingen og én i administrationen. Begge refererer til den administrerende direktør og deres nærmeste leder i den pågældende afdeling. Opgaven handler i begge spor grundlæggende om at digitalisere og automatisere manuelle processer via Power Platform.

Det, der gør rollerne særlige, er den direkte indflydelse fra dag ét, hvor du selv er med til at bygge løsningerne op fra bunden. Går det godt, åbner det for flere digitaliseringsopgaver og et tættere samarbejde på tværs af de to spor.

Du trives i rollerne, hvis du er struktureret, dokumenterer dit arbejde tydeligt og ikke er bange for at søge hjælp, når du støder på en mur.

Opgaver:

  • Opsætte Power Automate-flows

  • Opdatere og vedligeholde data

  • Kortlægge manuelle processer med henblik på automatisering

  • Automatisere diverse manuelle processer

  • Identificere og rette fejl på tværs af de to afdelingers dataflow

  • Byde ind med nye løsninger i Power Apps og Power Automate

Virksomheden

Vores samarbejdspartner er en etableret dansk virksomhed inden for bygge og anlæg med omkring 150 ansatte og hovedkontor i Roskilde. Virksomheden løser opgaver over hele landet, mens en mindre administration sidder i huset.

Du kommer i tæt dialog med ledelsen om digitaliseringen af virksomhedens arbejdsgange, og du får en anden Cand-studerende at sparre med i det daglige. Sammen er I med til at forme, hvordan virksomheden arbejder digitalt fremover - en sjælden mulighed for direkte indflydelse og synlighed så tidligt i karrieren. Det giver dig et solidt afsæt og en kæmpe forlomme ind på arbejdsmarkedet i forhold til dine medstuderende.

Hvis du gerne vil i betragtning til det her studiejob, skal du deltage i Cands rekrutteringsevent. Vi kalder det ‘Get to Know You’. Hos Cand kigger vi hverken på dine karakterer eller dine tidligere erfaringer. Vi møder dig der, hvor du er i dit studieliv. title: Expert Team Lead, Engineering
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Expert Team Lead, Engineering based in Canada.

As an Expert Team Lead, Engineering, you will lead a team responsible for producing high-quality training data and evaluations that support advanced AI models. You will combine engineering expertise with hands-on team leadership, quality assurance, and operational excellence. The role requires you to personally review technical work while establishing consistent standards for accuracy, quality, and guideline adherence. You will coach and develop AI Tutors, manage performance, and build effective training and certification programs. Working closely with Human Data and Engineering teams, you will translate model requirements into clear labeling strategies and workflows. You will use operational metrics to identify bottlenecks, improve efficiency, and continuously raise data quality. This is an opportunity to apply engineering knowledge to the development of sophisticated AI systems while helping scale high-performing human data operations.

Accountabilities

  • Own end-to-end quality and delivery for assigned Human Data projects, personally reviewing engineering-domain work and ensuring accuracy, consistency, guideline adherence, and high-quality data production at scale.

  • Lead, coach, and performance-manage a team of AI Tutors, including full-time employees and contractors, through regular reviews, action plans, shadow sessions, and continuous improvement initiatives.

  • Oversee and actively participate in labeling and review activities to maintain high standards and demonstrate effective working practices.

  • Ensure consistent adherence to project guidelines, taxonomies, and quality assurance processes.

  • Identify operational bottlenecks and implement process improvements to increase efficiency, quality, and throughput.

  • Monitor performance through KPI dashboards, using metrics such as quality, throughput, and send-back rates to guide improvements.

  • Create, maintain, and deliver training materials, practice exercises, and certification benchmark tasks.

  • Manage certification processes and make appropriate workforce adjustments based on performance and project requirements.

  • Collaborate with Human Data Managers, other Team Leads, and Engineering teams to translate model requirements into clear labeling strategies and operational guidelines.

  • Coach and develop team members while maintaining accountability and a high-performance culture, including supporting disciplinary processes when required.

  • Document project outcomes, recommend process iterations, and communicate project status, risks, and results.

  • Represent the needs and perspectives of AI Tutors while fostering collaboration across the wider Human Data organization.

    • At least 2 years of professional engineering experience in areas such as design, analysis, testing, research and development, or systems integration; alternatively, a Master's degree or higher in engineering or a related field.

    • Experience developing scalable, high-performance technology applications is advantageous.

    • Previous experience leading small teams in data labeling, annotation, or related operational environments is preferred.

    • Proven ability to manage multiple concurrent projects, prioritize effectively, and deliver in a fast-paced environment.

    • Strong track record of reviewing technical or domain-specific work, maintaining data quality, and improving operational processes.

    • Strong analytical capabilities and experience using data and KPIs to drive continuous improvement; SQL knowledge is a plus.

title: Principal Engineer AI
description:
Application Deadline:

1630 Chicago Road

Job Description

Principal Engineer, AI Platform & Fabrics

Description

BMO is building the platform capabilities that make enterprise AI safe, governed, and scalable. We are seeking experienced Principal/Senior engineers to build and operate the core infrastructure that governs how AI runs at BMO — the AI Gateway, Policy Engine, Identity Fabric, AI Registry, Guardrails Runtime, and AI Observability.

This is a build-and-run engineering role. You will be part of the team that own Enterprise AI Platform capabilities end to end: Building, configuring and operating them in production, including on-call. You will not build the AI models or applications themselves (those are domain-owned); you build the governed platform they run on and the runtime evidence that proves they run within policy, across AWS, Azure, and Microsoft AI surfaces, under OSFI and OCC expectations.

You are a hands-on engineer who has built shared platform services at scale, cares deeply about operability, latency, and correctness, and understands that in a regulated bank the infrastructure must produce its own evidence. You are energized by taking real engineering assets that includes an existing developer portal, an AI registry, a body of policy-as-code, and gateway integrations and hardening, scaling, enhancing and governing them into enterprise-grade platform capabilities. You raise the technical bar for those around you and mentor as you build.

What You'll Build & Operate

Depending on your specialization, you will own one or more of the following capability areas:

Enterprise Control Plane

  • Portal & Registry — a federated AI Registry (agents, models, tools, channels, evaluations across 16+ asset types) with self-service onboarding and lifecycle workflows; federation with external registries (Agent 365, AgentCore, MLflow).

  • Policy Engine — policy-as-code infrastructure (Cedar/OPA), a policy compilation pipeline, GitOps-based domain-scoped bundle distribution, risk-tiered approval workflows, and a policy simulation sandbox.

  • Observability & Audit — a multi-pipeline telemetry architecture (operational + security + compliance), OpenTelemetry GenAI conventions, cross-pipeline trace correlation, lineage-stamped traces, and a 7-year tamper-evident audit lake producing regulator-ready evidence.

  • Governance & Lifecycle — certification workflows, automated compliance scoring, decommission governance, and evidence generation for architecture and model-risk review.

Domain Orchestration

  • Gateway Runtime — domain-hub deployment across AWS and Azure; an inline enforcement engine performing request-time policy evaluation, routing, residency, budget/quota, and circuit breaking within strict tiered latency budgets (Fast <5ms / Standard <25ms / Full <50ms); cross-region failover.

  • Guardrails Runtime — a multi-stage safety pipeline (input moderation → prompt-injection defense → PII → output validation → hallucination detection → policy enforcement) with bilingual EN/FR parity and behavioral guardrails for agentic workloads (goal hijacking, intent drift, excessive agency).

  • Identity Fabric — workload identity for AI (SPIFFE/SPIRE), token-exchange bridging, per-domain trust boundaries, Entra Agent ID integration, on-behalf-of identity propagation, and cross-cloud token federation with zero-trust attestation.

What You'll Do

  • Own capabilities end to end: design, implement, test, ship, and operate production infrastructure.

  • Engineer for operability and defensibility from day one: instrumentation, SLOs, latency budgets, failure modes, and runtime evidence built in, not bolted on.

  • Build the APIs, SD'able interfaces, and integrations through which domains, DevOps pipelines, and enterprise systems consume platform capabilities.

  • Implement policy enforcement, guardrails, identity attestation, and audit as first-class engineering concerns: correct, performant, and provable.

  • Ensure every capability produces runtime evidence connecting AI activity to policy enforcement, identity, and lineage for model-risk and regulatory review (OSFI E-23, OCC).

  • Assess emerging AI infrastructure, foundation-model access patterns, and standards; make deliberate, cost-aware engineering choices.

  • Mentor and raise the bar: set engineering standards, review designs and code, and grow depth across the team.

  • Partner closely with AI Developer Experience, AI Security and AI SDLC, and the Senior AI Architect in your platform build and operations.

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline (Master's preferred).

  • 8+ years of software/platform engineering experience (Principal), or 5+ years (Senior), with substantial time building and operating shared platform services at enterprise scale.

  • Demonstrated experience operating production infrastructure with real SLOs and on-call ownership, ideally in a regulated industry (financial services strongly preferred).

  • Depth in one or more of: API gateways / traffic enforcement; policy-as-code and authorization; workload identity / zero-trust; observability and telemetry pipelines; audit/compliance data platforms.

Required Core Skills

Platform Engineering Depth

  • Strong distributed-systems and platform-engineering fundamentals: latency-sensitive request paths, resilience patterns (circuit breakers, failover), multi-tenancy, and high availability.

  • Strong programming skills (Python and/or Go preferred; TypeScript/Java an asset) for building performant services, APIs, and integrations.

  • Cloud-native architecture across AWS and Azure: containers/Kubernetes, service mesh, and Infrastructure as Code (CDK, Terraform, CloudFormation/ARM).

  • Robust CI/CD, GitOps, and DevSecOps practice; Git-based workflows (Bitbucket/GitHub), Jira, Confluence.

Capability-Specific Depth (one or more)

  • Policy/Authorization: Cedar, OPA/Rego, policy compilation and distribution, risk-tiered approval workflows.

  • Identity/Zero-Trust: SPIFFE/SPIRE, mTLS, token exchange, OAuth/OIDC, federated and cross-cloud identity, Entra ID/Agent ID.

  • Observability/Audit: OpenTelemetry (incl. GenAI conventions), distributed tracing, Dynatrace/Splunk or equivalents, tamper-evident/immutable audit stores, data lineage.

  • Gateway/Guardrails: API gateway internals, inline enforcement, LLM routing/abstraction, prompt-injection and PII defenses, hallucination detection, AI evaluation.

  • Registry/Portal: service catalogues, asset registries, lifecycle workflows, federation with external registries.

GenAI & Governance Context

  • Working knowledge of GenAI platform patterns: LLM/AI gateways, RAG and agentic patterns, foundation models, embeddings, and guardrails — sufficient to build the infrastructure they depend on.

  • Familiarity with AI/ML platforms (Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, SageMaker, MLflow) and orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex).

  • Grounding in Responsible AI, AI/data governance, privacy, cloud security, and IAM as applied to AI workloads.

Certifications (Preferred)

  • AWS Certified Solutions Architect (Associate/Professional) / ML – Specialty

  • Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert / Azure AI Engineer Associate

  • Security/identity certifications (relevant to Identity Fabric roles)

  • Databricks / Google Cloud ML credentials; relevant GenAI/LLM credentials

Other Skills

  • Strong communication and collaboration across engineering, security, architecture, and domain teams.

  • A critical thinker with strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

  • Self-directed, comfortable with ambiguity and a fast-evolving mandate.

  • Able to deliver complex work under tight timelines; participates in on-call rotation for owned services.

title: Klinisk sygeplejespecialist og kommende ph.d.-studerende
description:
Klinisk sygeplejespecialist og kommende ph.d.-studerende med interesse for kvantitativ klinisk forskning søges til udvikling og validering af neurologisk deliriumscreeningsværktøj (N-DeliS Study)

Ved Afdeling for Hjerne- og Nervesygdomme, Sjællands Universitetshospital, søger vi en engageret og forskningsinteresseret sygeplejerske med kandidatuddannelse til en kombinationsstilling som klinisk sygeplejespecialist og kommende ph.d.-studerende. Vi søger en kandidat med interesse for kvantitativ klinisk forskning og udvikling af kliniske måleredskaber. Den udvalgte kandidat forventes indskrevet som 4-årig ph.d.-studerende ved Syddansk Universitet (SDU).

Ansøgninger behandles løbende, og ansættelsessamtaler afholdes løbende. Stillingen ønskes besat hurtigst muligt og senest den 1. januar 2027.

Om projektet

Projektet har fokus på udvikling og validering af et neurologisk specifikt deliriumscreeningsværktøj (N-DeliS Study) til patienter med neurologiske sygdomme og skader.

Formålet er at styrke tidlig og præcis identifikation af delirium hos neurologiske patienter og dermed understøtte rettidig behandling, forebyggelse og personcentreret pleje. Projektet tager afsæt i klinisk praksis og gennemføres som et mixed-metodeforskningsprojekt med hovedvægt på kvantitative metoder. Derfor søger vi en kandidat, der motiveres af kvantitativ forskning og ønsker at udvikle kompetencer inden for instrumentudvikling, statistiske analyser og klinisk validering.

Forskningsprojektet forventes gennemført som:

  1. Systematisk litteraturstudie
  2. Udvikling af screeningsværktøj i samarbejde med tværfagligt ekspertpanel
  3. Kognitiv validering af instrumentet
  4. Klinisk valideringsstudie

Om forskningsmiljøet

Afdeling for Hjerne- og Nervesygdomme har et stærkt tværfagligt og patientnært forskningsmiljø med fokus på evidensbaseret neurologisk sygepleje og personcentreret praksis. Sygeplejen i afdelingen tager afsæt i Fundamentals of Care og arbejder målrettet med at styrke kvalitet, sammenhæng og livskvalitet for patienter med neurologiske sygdomme og deres pårørende.

Forskningsmiljøet er tæt integreret med den kliniske praksis, og forskning, udvikling, uddannelse og kvalitetsarbejde ses som gensidigt understøttende områder. Afdelingen arbejder aktuelt med udviklingen af det sygeplejefaglige forskningsprogram ”Styrkelse af neurologisk deliriumsygepleje: En personcentreret og rehabiliterende tilgang i hospitalspraksis”, som samler sygeplejefaglige forskningsprojekter inden for neurologisk sygepleje med særlig fokus på delirium og tidlig rehabilitering.

Vi tilbyder

  • Et stærkt klinisk og akademisk forskningsmiljø
  • Tæt vejledning fra forskningsleder og tværfagligt vejlederteam
  • Kombination af klinisk praksis og forskning (25% vs. 75%)
  • Mulighed for faglig og akademisk udvikling
  • Deltagelse i nationale og internationale forskningsnetværk
  • Konferencedeltagelse og mulighed for publicering
  • Et tværfagligt miljø præget af høj faglighed, nysgerrighed og udvikling
  • Et introduktions- og onboardingforløb med fokus på læring og trivsel
  • En afdeling hvor forskning og klinisk praksis udvikles tæt sammen

Vi søger en kandidat, der

  • Er sygeplejerske af grunduddannelse
  • Har relevant sundhedsfaglig kandidatuddannelse
  • Har stærk interesse for kvantitativ forskning, statistiske analyser og udvikling eller validering af kliniske måleredskaber
  • Har interesse for neurologisk sygepleje og klinisk forskning
  • Har motivation for at gennemføre et ph.d.-forløb
  • Arbejder selvstændigt, struktureret og analytisk
  • Trives i tværfagligt samarbejde
  • Har gode kommunikative kompetencer på dansk og engelsk, både mundtligt og skriftligt
  • Har interesse for udvikling af evidensbaseret klinisk praksis

Det er en fordel, men ikke et krav, at du:

  • Har erfaring med klinisk forskning eller udviklingsprojekter
  • Har erfaring eller lyst til at udvikle kompetencer indenfor kvantitative metoder
  • Har publiceret videnskabelige artikler
  • Har erfaring fra neurologisk klinisk praksis

Hvem er vi

Afdeling for Hjerne- og Nervesygdomme på Sjællands Universitetshospital varetager neurologiske funktioner for hele Region Sjælland.

Afdelingen består blandt andet af:

  • To sengeafsnit
  • Neurovaskulært Center
  • Neurologisk ambulatorium med specialiserede klinikker
  • Neurofysiologisk Center
  • Regionalt Videnscenter for Demens
  • Klinisk Forskningsenhed
  • Tværfaglige støttefunktioner

Afdelingen har et stærkt tværfagligt samarbejde mellem sygeplejersker, læger, terapeuter, neuropsykologer, socialrådgivere og øvrige faggrupper.

Yderligere oplysninger

Du er meget velkommen til at kontakte:

Sygeplejefaglig forskningsleder Janet F. Jensen

Tlf.: 26 81 34 06

Mail: jfje@regionsjaelland.dk

Chefsygeplejerske Birgitte Wiig Mortensen

Mail: bmt@regionsjaelland.dk

Ansøgning

Ansøgningsfrist: løbende. Stillingen ønskes besat hurtigst muligt og senest den 1. januar 2027

Startløn for overenskomstansatte

Regionen er forpligtet til at oplyse dig om startlønnen for stillingen. Du får oplyst grundløn, centralt fastsatte tillæg og pension i den relevante overenskomst. Udover startlønnen, kan lønnen indeholde eventuelt forhandlede tillæg afhængigt af stillingen, dine erfaringer og kvalifikationer.

Se startlønnen på regionens hjemmeside

Om Sjællands Universitetshospital

Sjællands Universitetshospital er Danmarks nyeste universitetshospital med aktiviteter i Køge, Roskilde og Nykøbing F. Vi er et modigt og udadvendt universitetshospital, hvor vi hver dag arbejder for at skabe et sammenhængende sundhedsvæsen og større lighed i sundhed for borgerne i regionen.

Vores optageområde er præget af flere borgere med kronisk sygdom og sociale udfordringer end landsgennemsnittet. Derfor arbejder vi målrettet med innovation, nye samarbejdsformer og løsninger, der bringer behandling tættere på borgerne.

Hos os bliver du en del af en ambitiøs arbejdsplads, hvor samarbejde på tværs, høj faglighed og løbende forbedringer er en naturlig del af hverdagen. Vores ledelsesværdier er nytænkning, følgeskab, ordentlighed og fællesskab, og de sætter retning for, hvordan vi arbejder, udvikler os og skaber gode resultater – for både borgere og medarbejdere.
