title: 22778 - In-post Appointments and Exiting Team Leader, In-post Appointments and Exiting Team, Judicial HR, Judicial Office
company: His Majesty's Prison and Probation Service
description:
Working Arrangements & Further Information

The MoJ offers Hybrid Working arrangements where business need allows. This is an informal, non-contractual form of flexible working that blends working from your base location, different MoJ sites and / or from home (please be aware that this role can only be worked in the UK and not overseas). All employees will be expected to spend a minimum of 60% of their working time in an office, subject to local estate capacity.

Some roles will not be suitable for Hybrid Working. Similarly, Hybrid Working will not suit everyone’s circumstances. Arrangements will be discussed and agreed with the successful candidate(s) and subject to regular review.

For nationally advertised roles: All successful candidates will be appointed to the nearest viable office nearest to their home postcode and on its respective pay scale. This will be at either a HQ building (subject to desk allocation, a Justice Collaboration Centre (JCC) or a Justice Satellite Office (JSO) – See Map. All employees will be expected to spend a minimum of 60% of their working time in an office, subject to local estate capacity).

For current MoJ employees, your base location will need to be changed to the nearest viable office (to your home postcode), either at a HQ building, JCC or JSO within the National Office Network and moved its location’s respective pay scale (any legacy arrangements/locations will need to be amended).

Some of MoJ’s terms and conditions of service are changing as part of Civil Service reform. The changes will apply to staff joining MoJ who are new to the Civil Service. Staff joining MoJ from other civil service employers will transfer onto the new MoJ terms if they are already on 'modernised' terms in their current post or onto 'unmodernised' MoJ terms if they are on 'unmodernised' terms at their current post. Details will be available if an offer is made.

MoJ candidates who are on a specialist grade, will be able to retain their grade on lateral transfer.

All candidates who are currently in receipt of Mark Time / Pay Protection should ensure they are familiar with the new policy on permanent and temporary promotion which can be found on the employee intranet.

Flexible working hours

The Ministry of Justice offers a flexible working system in many offices. Standard full time working hours are 37 hours per week. MoJ welcomes part-time, flexible and job-sharing working patterns, where they meet the demands of the role and business needs. All applications for part-time, flexible and job-sharing working patterns will be considered in accordance with the MoJ’s Flexible Working policy.

Benefits

The MoJ offers a range of benefits:

Annual Leave

Annual leave is 25 days on appointment and will increase to 30 days after five years’ service.

There is also a scheme to allow qualifying staff to buy or sell up to three days leave each year. Additional paid time off for public holidays and 1 privilege day. Leave for part-time and job share posts will be calculated on a pro-rata basis.

Pension

The Civil Service offers a choice of pension schemes, giving you the flexibility to choose the pension that suits you best.

Training

The Ministry of Justice is committed to staff development and offers an extensive range of training and development opportunities.

Networks

The opportunity to join employee-run networks that have been established to provide advice and support and to enable the views of employees from minority groups to be expressed direct to senior management. There are currently networks for employees of minority ethnic origin, employees with disabilities, employees with caring responsibilities, women employees, and lesbian, gay, bisexual and transgender employees.

Eligibility

Staff on fixed term appointments must have been recruited through fair and open competition.

Vacancies advertised “cross-government” are only open to all Civil Service employees and employees of accredited non-departmental public bodies (NDPBs) who were appointed on merit following a fair and open competition; or were appointed to a permanent post through an exception in the Civil Service Commissioners' rules.

Support

  • A range of ‘Family Friendly’ policies such as opportunities to work reduced hours or job share.
  • Access to flexible benefits such as voluntary benefits, retail vouchers and discounts on a range of goods and services.
  • For moves to or from another employer or moves across the Civil Service this can have implications on your eligibility to carry on claiming childcare vouchers. You may however be eligible for alternative government childcare support schemes, including Tax Free Childcare. More information can be found on www. or Childcare Choices. You can determine your eligibility at .
  • Paid paternity, adoption and maternity leave.
  • Free annual sight tests for employees who use computer screens.

Working for the Civil Service

The Civil Service Code sets out the standards of behaviour expected of civil servants.

We recruit by merit on the basis of fair and open competition, as outlined in the Civil Service Commission's recruitment principles. Should you feel that the recruitment process has breached the recruitment principles you are able to raise a formal complaint in the following order

  • To Transformative Business Services (0345 241 5359 (Monday to Friday 8am - 6pm) or e mail moj-recruitment-vetting-enquiries@resourcing.soprasteria.co.uk);
  • To Ministry of Justice Resourcing team (resourcing-management-office@justice.gov.uk);
  • To the Civil Service Commission (details available here)

As a Disability Confident employer, MoJ are committed to providing everyone with the opportunity to demonstrate their skills, talent and abilities, by making adjustments throughout all elements of the recruitment process and in the workplace. MoJ are able to offer an interview to disabled candidates who meet the minimum selection criteria, except in a limited number of campaigns.

You will be able to request reasonable adjustments to the recruitment process within the application form. If you need additional help completing the application form, please contact the TBS Recruitment Enquiries Team.

For more information on applying for a role as a candidate with a disability or long-term condition, please watch our animated videos.

Diversity & Inclusion

The Civil Service is committed to attract, retain and invest in talent wherever it is found. To learn more please see the Civil Service People Plan and the Civil Service Diversity and Inclusion Strategy.

Redeployment Interview Scheme

Civil Service departments are expected to explore redeployment opportunities before making an individual redundant. The MoJ is committed, as part of the Redeployment Interview Scheme, to providing opportunities to those who are 'at risk of redundancy'.

MoJ is able to offer an interview to eligible candidates who meet the minimum selection criteria, except in a limited number of campaigns. Candidates will not be eligible for the Redeployment Interview Scheme if they are applying on promotion.

Civil Service Nationality Rules

This job is broadly open to the following groups:

  • UK nationals
  • nationals of the Republic of Ireland
  • nationals of Commonwealth countries who have the right to work in the UK
  • nationals of the EU, Switzerland, Norway, Iceland or Liechtenstein and family members of those nationalities with settled or pre-settled status under the European Union Settlement Scheme (EUSS) (opens in a new window) https://www.gov.uk/settled-status-eu-citizens-families
  • nationals of the EU, Switzerland, Norway, Iceland or Liechtenstein and family members of those nationalities who have made a valid application for settled or pre-settled status under the European Union Settlement Scheme (EUSS)
  • individuals with limited leave to remain or indefinite leave to remain who were eligible to apply for EUSS on or before 31 December 2020
  • Turkish nationals, and certain family members of Turkish nationals, who have accrued the right to work in the Civil Service

Further information on nationality requirements (opens in a new window) https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/nationality-rules

Reserve list

A reserve list may be held for up to 12 months from which further appointments may be made for the same or similar roles.

title: Expert Team Lead, Medicine
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Expert Team Lead, Medicine based in Canada.

As an Expert Team Lead, Medicine, you will lead a team responsible for producing high-quality training data and evaluations that support advanced AI systems. You will combine hands-on medical expertise with people leadership, quality assurance, and operational excellence. The role involves personally reviewing domain-specific work while setting clear standards for accuracy, consistency, and guideline adherence. You will coach and develop AI Tutors, manage performance, and build a high-accountability team culture. Working closely with Human Data and Engineering teams, you will translate model requirements into effective data and labeling strategies. You will also use operational metrics to identify bottlenecks, improve processes, and scale high-quality human data operations. This is an opportunity to contribute directly to the development of sophisticated AI systems while applying your clinical or medical knowledge at scale.

Accountabilities

  • Own end-to-end quality and delivery for assigned Human Data projects, personally reviewing medical-domain work and ensuring accuracy, consistency, guideline adherence, and high-quality data production at scale.

  • Lead, coach, and performance-manage a team of AI Tutors through regular performance reviews, action plans, shadow sessions, training, and continuous improvement initiatives.

  • Actively participate in labeling and review activities to maintain high standards and demonstrate best practices.

  • Maintain robust quality assurance processes, taxonomy management, and adherence to project guidelines.

  • Identify operational bottlenecks and implement process improvements to increase efficiency and quality.

  • Track team and project performance through KPI dashboards, monitoring metrics such as quality, throughput, and send-back rates.

  • Collaborate with Human Data Managers, other Team Leads, and Engineering to translate AI model requirements into clear labeling strategies and operational guidelines.

  • Support talent development while maintaining accountability and a high-performance culture, including participation in disciplinary processes when required.

  • Document project outcomes, recommend process improvements, and communicate project status, risks, and results.

  • Represent the needs and perspectives of AI Tutors while fostering effective collaboration across the broader Human Data organization.

  • Manage multiple priorities and projects effectively in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

    • Requirements

    • At least 8 months of hands-on experience in data labeling, annotation, AI training or evaluation, content quality, or a similar operational environment.

    • Basic understanding of artificial intelligence and machine learning concepts, particularly how high-quality training data influences model performance.

    • Bachelor's degree or higher in medicine or a clinical/medicine-adjacent discipline such as medicine, nursing, public health, health administration, or biomedical engineering; relevant graduate degrees such as an MPH or MHA are also applicable.

    • Alternatively, 5+ years of relevant professional experience may be considered in place of a degree.

    • Previous people-management or team-leadership experience is preferred.

    • Medical Doctorate (MD, DO, MBBS, or equivalent) or another completed clinical doctoral qualification, such as PharmD, DDS, or certain PhDs, is highly desirable.

    • Residency or postgraduate clinical experience is a plus, as is familiarity with clinical data and workflows involving laboratory results, medical imaging, electronic health records, and clinical documentation.

    • Demonstrated ability to review domain-specific work, maintain high data-quality standards, and improve operational processes.

    • Experience with performance management, coaching, training programs, or certification frameworks.

    • Strong analytical capabilities and experience using data and KPIs to drive operational improvements; SQL knowledge is a plus.

    • Experience managing distributed teams or teams comprising different employment types, including employees and contractors.

    • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to build relationships, communicate clearly, and align diverse stakeholders.

    • Familiarity with project management and collaboration tools such as Notion, Axiom, JIRA, Linear, or equivalent platforms.

    • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, proactive problem-solving abilities, and a continuous-improvement mindset.

    • Ability to combine strategic thinking with hands-on execution and maintain high standards in a rapidly changing environment.

    • Passion for developing high-performing teams and scaling reliable, high-quality Human Data operations.

      • Benefits

      • Competitive compensation, with international salary details provided during the recruitment process.

      • For eligible U.S.-based positions, base salary ranges from $104,000 to $170,400 USD, depending on experience, skills, education, location, and qualifications.

      • Equity opportunities as part of the overall rewards package.

      • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, subject to employment type, location, and local regulations.

      • Access to a 401(k) retirement plan for eligible U.S.-based positions.

      • Short- and long-term disability insurance.

      • Life insurance.

      • Paid sick leave for eligible U.S.-based positions.

      • Additional employee discounts and perks.

      • Opportunity to work remotely where permitted and contribute to a globally distributed organization.

      • Opportunity to work at the intersection of medicine, human data, and advanced AI development.

      • Collaborative, high-autonomy environment focused on curiosity, engineering excellence, and continuous learning.

Det kommer du til at arbejde med

Du behøver ikke kunne det hele fra dag ét. Vi går mere op i, at du er nysgerrig, serviceminded og har lyst til at udvikle dig i et team, hvor vi hjælper hinanden.

title: Project Lead Practitioner
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Project Lead Practitioner based in Ireland.

This is a senior, client-facing role focused on helping private equity investors and technology businesses create value through technology. You will lead complex engagements spanning technology strategy, due diligence, transformation, cybersecurity, AI, and operational execution. The role combines deep technical expertise with commercial thinking, requiring you to translate complex findings into clear, decision-useful recommendations. You will work directly with senior investors, boards, and management teams, building trusted relationships and guiding critical decisions. Alongside leading multidisciplinary teams, you will develop a recognised functional specialism and contribute to broader technology value-creation initiatives. The environment is collaborative, entrepreneurial, and driven by curiosity, credibility, creativity, commitment, and a strong focus on client service.

Accountabilities

  • Independently lead complex client engagements from initial scoping through high-quality delivery, balancing project management, team leadership, client service, and commercial considerations.
  • Build trusted relationships with senior investors, boards, and management teams by applying sound judgment, communicating clearly, and making complex technology topics accessible.
  • Lead technical due diligence and technology-focused engagements, identifying material risks, opportunities, and priorities for post-deal value creation.
  • Assess areas including technology strategy, product and engineering capabilities, architecture, cloud platforms, delivery performance, data and AI, cybersecurity, scalability, technical debt, and operating models.
  • Translate technical findings into commercial implications related to growth, customer outcomes, margins, investment risk, timing, capital requirements, and value creation.
  • Produce concise reports, executive presentations, and workshops that connect analysis to the decisions clients need to make.
  • Develop a recognised functional specialism while maintaining sufficient breadth to lead integrated discussions and direct multidisciplinary teams.
  • Contribute to commercial diligence, investment thesis development, and value-creation engagements where technology plays a central role.
  • Strengthen client relationships, support repeat business and proposition development, and mentor colleagues as the practice grows.

    • Requirements

    • 10+ years of relevant experience in technology consulting, technology due diligence, technology strategy, digital transformation, or technology leadership.
    • Demonstrated experience leading client-facing workstreams or engagements, managing senior stakeholders, and delivering high-quality, decision-ready outputs.
    • Strong technology fundamentals with demonstrable expertise in at least one area such as product and engineering, software architecture and cloud, data and AI, cybersecurity, software delivery, or technology operating models.
    • Significant experience within a business domain such as insurance, capital markets, healthcare, logistics, or supply chain.
    • Ability to move confidently between technical detail and business-level discussions, identifying the issues that materially affect clients and investment cases.
    • Experience with private equity, transaction advisory, corporate development, or high-growth technology businesses is strongly preferred.
    • Excellent structured thinking, written communication, presentation, and storytelling skills, with the ability to turn complex analysis into clear and compelling narratives.
    • Collaborative, action-oriented approach, with the confidence to challenge constructively and the curiosity to expand beyond an initial area of expertise.
    • Entrepreneurial mindset, commercial awareness, and enthusiasm for building client relationships, leading teams, and contributing to broader technology value-creation initiatives.

      • Benefits

      • Opportunity to lead high-impact engagements with private equity investors and technology businesses.
      • Exposure to complex, strategic technology challenges spanning due diligence, transformation, growth, cybersecurity, AI, and operational execution.
      • Senior-level interaction with investors, boards, and executive management teams.
      • Opportunity to develop and establish a recognised functional technology specialism.
      • Collaborative environment combining practitioner expertise, proven frameworks, technology-enabled solutions, and objective data.
      • Scope to contribute to proposition development, client growth, mentoring, and broader commercial initiatives.
      • Entrepreneurial environment that values service, curiosity, credibility, commitment, and creativity.

title: Senior Technical Specialist - End User Compute (EUC)
description:
Senior Technical Specialist – End User Compute (EUC)
MuraConnect is partnering with a leading Brisbane-based technology firm to identify a Senior Technical Specialist – End User Compute (EUC) to support the delivery of a major hospital project in Queensland. This is a 12-month fixed-term role.

This senior technical role provides specialist EUC expertise across planning, documentation and hands-on delivery. You will work closely with the Senior Project Manager – EUC and a broad range of technical, clinical, vendor and project stakeholders to support the successful rollout of the EUC program.

The Role
As the Senior Technical Specialist – EUC, you will be responsible for providing technical leadership and practical delivery support across a complex End User Compute environment, including:
  • Planning and delivering EUC technologies within a hospital environment, including Workstations on Wheels (WOWs), wall-mounted devices, Point of Care terminals, Downtime Viewers and other clinical devices
  • Managing SOE/MOE and device configuration, Active Directory and user/device management
  • Supporting network technologies, including VLANs and WLAN, as well as Rapid Access / Single Sign-On and Virtual Desktop Infrastructure
  • Coordinating printers, scanners, multifunction devices and other peripherals
  • Developing implementation plans, roadmaps, Bills of Materials and technical documentation
  • Providing vendor coordination, technical assurance and delivery oversight
  • Supporting testing, readiness and implementation activities
  • Translating technical requirements into practical implementation activities, ensuring the EUC solution is fit for purpose in a highly regulated healthcare environment

About You
To be successful, you will be a collaborative, solutions-focused EUC specialist who can confidently engage with both technical and non-technical stakeholders and ensure EUC requirements are understood, documented and delivered.
You will bring:
  • Significant experience in End User Computing / EUC, with strong technical knowledge across workplace technologies, devices and peripherals
  • Proven experience delivering EUC solutions in a hospital or healthcare environment
  • Experience working with Queensland Health / eHealth Queensland (highly desirable)
  • A strong understanding of SOE/MOE, Active Directory, networking and end-user technologies
  • An understanding of security requirements relating to generic accounts, rapid access and healthcare environments
  • Excellent stakeholder engagement and vendor management skills
  • Strong technical documentation skills and attention to detail
  • The ability to build effective relationships across technical, project and clinical teams, and to operate effectively in a complex, fast-paced and highly regulated project environment
For more information contact Paul Thomson at paul.t@muraconnect.com.au or on 0415 176 085, or apply now.

About Mura
MuraConnect is a profit-for-purpose organisation established to drive social benefit through good business practice. We work with contractors and professionals across a range of sectors to connect skilled talent with the right opportunities. The profit generated from our corporate engagements funds initiatives that support and develop Indigenous professionals, giving back to communities through education and professional development.

title: Product Lead
description:
Toronto or Waterloo preferred, remote across Canada considered | Full-time | Reports to the COO

Lead the product that home care organizations and partners use to keep older adults safe, at a fast-growing senior care technology company in 24 countries.

The company

We went from a lab in Waterloo to 24 countries in five years. Our sensors detect falls and track sleep, health and wellness, with no cameras, wearables or pendants. Families get peace of mind. Older adults keep their independence. Our CTO, Dr. Yihong Qi, holds 680 patents, and the next few hundred get built here.

Why now

We are nationally launched with major home care organizations across North America, and the product is becoming more complex as more of them rely on it every day. It needs someone to lead it. This is the time.

The role

You own the product for our care organizations and partners: the software they use to monitor residents and clients, the integrations their systems depend on, and the roadmap that decides what we build next. Our hardware is the moat and the vessel. Your product is the experience. You sit between customers, engineering and the sensor, and you turn what partners need into what ships. You work directly with the COO and our CTO, and alongside our Product Lead on the consumer side, so the two products learn from each other.

What you'll own

  • A product partners choose because it works, with adoption and retention that show it
  • The roadmap: what we build, in what order, and why, backed by what customers say and what the data says
  • Every release from idea to shipped, working with engineering so the software and the sensor move together
  • Integrations and partner needs that turn one deployment into a hundred
  • The voice of the partner inside the company, so sales, support and engineering are working on the same thing

What year one looks like

Partners use the product daily and say so. The roadmap is clear and shipped on time. Our largest deployments are live and their users are happy. Engineering knows what to build next, because you told them.

How we work

  • Build it right, then make it better. People's safety rides on what we ship, so we test hard and never settle for good enough.
  • Say it as it is. Kind and direct, at every level, including the CEO.
  • Small team, big scope. You'll own more here than at a company ten times our size.
  • Do what you said. Trust is built on follow-through, and we return it with real ownership.
  • Hard, and worth it. What we build keeps someone's parent safe at home. Rest well, it's part of the job.

This is for you if

  • You'd rather own a problem than be assigned a task
  • You want the mission to matter and the pace to be real
  • You're happy to be the person who just fixes it

This isn't for you if

  • You want a playbook handed to you
  • You need a big team before you can move

You'll thrive here if

  • You have owned a software product end to end, consumer or B2B, and shipped things people use
  • You make decisions from customer conversations and data, not from opinion
  • You are as comfortable in a partner meeting as in a sprint review
  • You have shipped in a small team where you had to do a bit of everything

You don't need to check every box. If this sounds like you, we'd like to hear from you.

Where this goes

As we double, this role can grow into leading Product for the whole care business.

What you get

  • A sensor for your parents, on us
  • Direct access to the leadership team. No layers.
  • Fair pay, with the opportunity for equity
  • Impact decides your pay and your path, not tenure
  • Hybrid in Toronto or Waterloo, remote if that's where you do your best work
  • Health, dental and vision benefits

The details

  • Pay: $140,000 to $190,000 CAD base salary
  • This is a new role, created to grow the team, not a backfill
  • How we hire: typically an initial interview, a short case, and a final interview in person with our CEO and members of the team. We may adjust this depending on the role
  • We leverage AI tools in our hiring process, but prioritize human input and manual review

Our Commitment

At Pontosense, we are committed to creating a workplace that is inclusive and accessible to all. We value diversity and believe that everyone deserves an equal opportunity to succeed.

If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation during the hiring process, please let us know. We will work with you to make the necessary accommodations to ensure a fair and positive experience for all applicants.

We strive to provide accessible communication and technology for our employees and customers and always look for ways to improve. If you have any feedback or suggestions on how we can improve accessibility in our workplace, please don't hesitate to contact us.

We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and welcome candidates from all backgrounds to apply for open positions at our company.

title: Systems Engineer II
description:
Who will you be working with?

Wabtec's Train Handling solutions include Trip Optimizer® and Locotrol®, which work together to optimize train performance and automate freight operations. Trip Optimizer creates and executes fuel-efficient operating plans that meet schedule and train-handling requirements, while Locotrol enables coordinated control of distributed locomotives throughout the train. Together, these technologies improve train handling, fuel efficiency, operational safety, and the ability to operate longer and heavier trains.

As a Systems Engineer, you will work closely with engineering teams, product management, and railroad customers to support the development of innovative solutions that advance automation within the rail industry.

How will you make a difference?

As a Systems Engineer, you will support the design, development, testing, and deployment of Wabtec's Train Handling portfolio. Working under the guidance of experienced engineers, you will contribute to requirements development, system analysis, verification activities, and product enhancements while adhering to established engineering processes and standards.

The successful candidate will demonstrate an AI-enabled mindset, leveraging AI tools to improve research, problem-solving, productivity, and technical decision-making. You will continuously learn emerging technologies and apply data-driven insights to help deliver high-quality solutions that meet customer and business needs.

What do we want to know about you?

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering, Mathematics or Computer Science from an accredited college or university
  • Minimum of 1-2 years hands-on design, requirements development and implementation experience involving; Engineering Systems, Hardware / Software Engineering, and/or Data Information Systems
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Strong oral and written communication skills
  • Ability to work in a cross-functional, global environment
  • Willingness and ability to travel domestically and internationally

What will your typical day look like?

· Support the design, development, testing, and enhancement of Train Handling solutions while applying sound engineering principles and established development processes.

· Assist in gathering, documenting, and analyzing customer and system requirements to support product development and continuous improvement activities.

· Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including Product Management, Software Engineering, Train Control, Office Systems, Safety, Validation, and Applications Engineering, to support project execution and successful product delivery.

· Participate in requirements reviews, design reviews, verification activities, and technical discussions throughout the product development lifecycle.

· Assist in troubleshooting technical issues, analyzing system behavior, and supporting resolution efforts under the guidance of senior engineers.

· Contribute to field testing, validation, and evaluation activities for train automation and optimization solutions.

· Support the preparation of technical documentation, reports, project updates, and engineering deliverables.

· Work with railroad subject matter experts and engineering teams to learn operational concepts and apply them to product development efforts.

· Develop knowledge of industry standards, engineering best practices, and emerging technologies relevant to train automation, optimization, and distributed control systems.

· Utilize AI-enabled tools and technologies to improve productivity, accelerate learning, support analysis activities, and enhance engineering outcomes.

Preferred Qualifications

· Foundational understanding of systems engineering principles and product development processes.

· Exposure to software, controls, automation, transportation, or embedded systems through coursework, internships, or project experience.

· Familiarity with systems architecture concepts and distributed systems is a plus.

· Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

· Interest in applying AI-enabled tools and data-driven approaches to engineering challenges.

· Knowledge of railroad operations, AAR standards, CENELEC standards, or safety-critical systems is preferred but not required.

Relocation assistance may be provided if eligibility requirements are met.

[US Only] Wabtec will only employ those who are legally authorized to work in the U.S. for this opening. Any offer of employment is conditioned upon the successful completion of a drug screen (as applicable) and fitness for duty test (as applicable).

What could you accomplish in a place that puts People First?

At Wabtec, it’s not just about a job - it’s about the impact you make. When our people come together, we’re Expanding the Possible by continuously improving what we do and how we do it - for our clients and each other.

If you’re ready to revolutionize how the world moves for future generations, Wabtec is the place for you.

Who are we?

Wabtec is a leading global provider of equipment, systems, digital solutions, and value-added services for the freight and transit rail sectors. Drawing on more than 150 years of experience, we are leading the way in safety, efficiency, reliability, innovation, and productivity. Whether it’s freight, transit, ports, logistics, mining, industrial, or marine, our expertise, technologies, and people together – are accelerating the future of transportation. With roots that date back to George Westinghouse, Thomas Edison, and Louis Faiveley, Wabtec has always built technologies and implemented solutions for a variety of sectors that are critical to meeting the needs of customers and governments alike.

Our global team of about 30,000 employees worldwide delivers performance that moves the world forward. We’re lifelong learners, obsessed with better. Learn more at www.WabtecCorp.com.

Culture powers us and the possibilities.

We believe the best ideas come from a mix of experiences and backgrounds. At Wabtec, we strive every day to create a place where everyone belongs. We’re building a culture where leadership, inclusion and your unique perspective fuel progress.


We’re proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We welcome talent of all backgrounds, experiences, and identities, including race, gender, age, disability, veteran status and more.

Need accommodation? Just let us know - we’ve got you.

title: Sundhedsfaglig medarbejder til Ringdams Kobbel 167
description:
Vil du skabe trygge rammer for voksne med et udviklingshandicap og stå i spidsen for den sundhedsfaglige praksis? Brænder du for at gøre en forskel for denne målgruppe, har du skarpe sundhedsfaglige kompetencer, og trives du i et pædagogisk miljø? Så er det måske dig, vi søger!

Ringdams Kobbel 167 søger en dedikeret social- og sundhedsassistent, som brænder for at kombinere sundhedsfaglige kompetencer med meningsfuldt pædagogisk arbejde. Du får en vigtig rolle i forhold til at sikre, forbedre og følge op på kvaliteten af vores sundhedsfaglige arbejde og samtidig varetage omsorg og trivsel for vores beboere.

Hvem er vi på Ringdams Kobbel 167?
Ringdams Kobbel 167 er en del af Bo-Vejle.
Her bor 11 borgere, hvor en er en aflastningsplads. Borgerne er i alderen 25-67 år. De har alle kognitive udfordringer, som gør, at de skal støttes i forskellige gøremål i hverdagen. Vores borgere bor i egne lejligheder beliggende i huset, hvor vi som personale hjælper, støtter og vejleder den enkelte borger. Relationsarbejde er derfor et vigtigt pædagogisk redskab.
Vi har stort fokus på at støtte borgerne i deres individuelle behov samt skabe en meningsfuld hverdag, som understøttes af faglige tilgange.
Borgerne har behov for struktur for at mestre deres hverdag. Nogle har behov for hjælp og støtte til bad, oprydning, indkøb, madlavning, rengøring, følgeskab mm.
En arbejdsdag på Ringdams Kobbel vil være fyldt med en bred vifte af opgaver, der bidrager til at gøre hver dag alsidig og interessant. I hverdagen har vi blik for at støtte og guide den enkelte borger til selvstændighed i daglige praktiske opgaver og aktiviteter. Vi arbejder målrettet med struktur fx gennem støttesystemer, boardmakers og andre visuelle pædagogiske redskaber. Der forekommer mindre opgaver med personlig pleje.

Om stillingen
Vi søger en kollega, som drives af at forbedre og sikre kvaliteten af vores sundhedsfaglige arbejde og samtidig brænder for at medvirke i det daglige pædagogiske arbejde. Det er væsentligt, at du trives med denne kombination og betragter det som en attraktiv mulighed for at anvende og videreudvikle dine kompetencer med kolleger med pædagogisk baggrund.
Som sundhedsfaglig medarbejder får du en vigtig rolle. Dine hovedopgaver bliver at:
  • Stå i front for den sundhedsfaglige praksis i huset – du får ansvaret for blandt andet oplæring af kolleger i medicinhåndtering, opdatering af instrukser, kvalitetssikring af dokumentation og faglig sparring til kollegerne
  • Være med til at udvikle og optimere sundhedsfaglige rutiner, så vi altid lever op til lovgivning og nyeste anbefalinger
  • Indgå i vagtplanen med skiftende vagter (dag og aften, samt weekendarbejde hver 3. weekend i gennemsnit)
  • Deltage i det pædagogiske arbejde med borgerne – herunder skabe struktur, guide og støtte borgerne i at kunne mestre et så selvstændigt liv som muligt og være i samspil med samarbejdspartnere og pårørende

Vi søger dig, der:
  • Er uddannet social- og sundhedsassistent
  • Har en stærk og sikker sundhedsfaglig profil og kan omsætte den i et pædagogisk miljø – du kan lære fra dig og dele din faglighed med andre, som ikke har samme faglige baggrund
  • Er struktureret, ansvarlig og god til at samarbejde
  • Er indstillet på at arbejde med dig selv og reflektere over egen praksis
  • Har mod på at være med til at udvikle nye rammer og procedurer

Vi tilbyder dig:
  • Et godt arbejdsmiljø
  • En stabil og hjælpsom personalegruppe
  • En faglig velfunderet arbejdsplads
  • En unik borgergruppe
  • Sparring med kolleger med sundhedsfaglig baggrund
  • Mentorordning

I Bo-Vejle arbejder vi ud fra vores kerneopgave, dvs. at understøtte et værdigt liv på egne præmisser for den enkelte borger. Et værdigt liv på egne præmisser er først og fremmest et liv med selvbestemmelse, hvor borgerne træffer deres egne valg. Det er også et liv, hvor borgerne selv definerer, hvad en meningsfuld tilværelse indebærer. Og det er et liv med selvhjulpenhed, hvor borgeren med tilpas støtte kan mestre mest muligt selv. Derfor er vores udgangspunkt altid med øje for borgerens ønsker.

For at du skal føle dig godt tilpas, har vi et introduktionsprogram, der er designet til at hjælpe dig med at blive fortrolig med vores arbejdsprocesser og kultur. Det er vigtigt for os, at vi sikrer, at du bliver klædt bedst muligt på til opgaverne.

Ansøgningsfrist
Vi ser frem til at modtage din ansøgning senest den 18.10.26 kl. 23.59.

Samtaler afholdes
Vi afvikler samtaler den 23. oktober 2026.

Ansættelsesvilkår
Ansættelsesdato er 1. december 2026.

Har du lyst til at vide mere?
Hvis du gerne vil vide mere om stillingen, er du meget velkommen til at kontakte afdelingsleder Rikke Gylling Jensen på mail rigje@vejle.dk eller på tlf. 21 34 28 67

Straffeattest
Vi indhenter offentlig straffeattest med samtykke ved ansættelse.

Send din ansøgning
Vi foretrækker, at du søger stillingen online ved at bruge knappen ”Send ansøgning”. Husk at vedhæfte din ansøgning og CV samt andre relevante bilag.
Når du har sendt ansøgningen, modtager du en e-mail som kvittering.

Vær opmærksom på, at mailen kan være placeret i din mappe Uønsket post.

Vejle Kommune opfordrer alle til at søge stillingen uanset køn, alder, etnisk baggrund, handicap m.v.

description:

Data Analyst – REMOTE

Auto Insurance Specialists

Job Summary

The Data Analyst will provide data and reporting support to the Data Analyst Team Lead, helping to drive data-informed business decisions. In this role, the team member will assist in identifying unprofitable risk segments and uncover opportunities to reduce premium leakage across all lines of business. The team member will also contribute to improving AIS processes and procedures by performing data analysis, creating reports, and supporting the monitoring of underwriting production and goals. This position is ideal for someone eager to develop their skills in data analytics while supporting a lead analyst and contributing to the organization's success.

Responsibilities

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:

  • Data Analysis & Reporting: Assist in generating on-demand reports as requested by the Data Analyst Team Lead and AIS management, creating standardized reporting templates, and ensuring data accuracy. Support the premium leakage initiative to increase profitability.
  • Collaboration & Support: Work independently with AIS leaders to identify and provide data support for process improvements, system changes, and innovative ideas. Present analysis needs and work within a project plan that includes business objectives, data scope, research methodology, resources, and timelines.
  • Reporting & Productivity Monitoring: Create, monitor, audit, and analyze recurring reports on CSR and Sales Agent productivity, system behavior, call handling, and AIS processes. Look for opportunities to improve efficiency and prepare reports, graphs, and charts based on analysis.
  • Tools & Systems Usage: Coordinate and execute reporting, directing and supporting AIS users and leaders in identifying data needed for reporting. Use tools such as MicroStrategy, Power BI, Winbroker II, Amazon Connect, Taske, and Mercury's Enterprise Data Warehouse to gather and present data.
  • General Support: Assist in developing and administrating current and future goals within AIS departments. Perform additional functions as the Data Analyst Team Lead assigns to support team and company objectives.

Qualifications

  • Data Analysis & Reporting: Proficient in performing data analysis and reporting using Excel, SQL, and Power BI. Ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify and address operational challenges and assist in the development of new dashboards and visualizations.
  • Excel Skills: Strong knowledge of VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, pivot tables, charts, data sorting, and conditional formatting to analyze and present data effectively.
  • Data Visualization: Experience using Power BI (or similar tools like Tableau) to create compelling visualizations and metrics. Familiarity with DAX for Power BI or VisQL for Tableau to build insightful and interactive dashboards.
  • Data Modeling & SQL: Knowledge of SQL, including inner and outer joins, lag/lead functions, case statements, and basic data modeling/design. Ability to create complex queries and support data-driven decision-making.
  • Robotic Process Automation: Basic experience with UiPath or Power Automate for automating repetitive tasks and improving data workflows.
  • Industry Knowledge: General understanding of the Property & Casualty Insurance industry, including specific product lines such as Home, Auto, and Commercial.
  • Underwriting & Analytical Skills: Strong analytical and quantitative skills with experience in underwriting practices, procedures, and data analysis related to premium and loss ratio analysis.
  • Communication Skills: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present findings on underwriting data projects clearly and effectively to management and stakeholders.
  • Project Management & Time Management: Capable of producing quality work within tight timeframes, managing multiple projects simultaneously, and working efficiently within a team setting.
  • Learning & Self-Development: Must be a self-starter who can quickly learn new responsibilities, adapt to new technologies, and learn from peers or independently. Ability to stay up-to-date with new industry tools and techniques.
  • Adaptability & Flexibility: Ability to work a flexible schedule and travel as needed, including occasional overnight or weekend stays.
  • Confidentiality & Compliance: Ability to adhere to the company’s privacy policies and ensure the secure handling of sensitive data.
  • Technical Knowledge Development: Required to learn SQL, SAS, and potentially R coding if not already familiar, to further enhance data analysis capabilities.

Education/Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree; preferably in Business Administration, Mathematics, or Statistics
  • Coursework in statistics or business analytics
  • At least 3 years of insurance-related experience, preferably in an analytical role
  • SAS and SQL training
  • Or equivalent combination of education and experience

Physical Requirements

Work-from-home requirements

  • Designated workspace free from noise and other distractions.
  • Remote office internet connection via Internet Service Provider (ISP) or Cable Modem.
  • High-speed internet access required.

Why choose a career at AIS?

Auto Insurance Specialists has been offering quality insurance products to California residents for over 55 years and since 2006 has expanded its online sales and service capabilities across all 50 states. Our team will encourage you to grow, make time to have fun, and work together to make great things happen. We embrace the strengths and values of each team member. title: Information Security Manager
description:
Overview

The Wisconsin Foundation and Alumni Association (WFAA)*, the private fundraising and alumni relations organization for the University of Wisconsin-Madison is seeking an Information Security Manager to join the Information Technology department!

The Information Security Manager is responsible for leading and continuously improving the security posture, day-to-day operations, security engineering, incident response, vulnerability management, and governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) functions, and executing the organization’s strategic direction. This role is also highly focused on operational excellence, a security-first culture, and a strong mandate to drive automation and AI adoption across security operations. This position provides direct people leadership and technical oversight across the security program, recommending and setting standards and metrics to ensure a resilient and proactive and effective security posture. The Information Security Manager partners closely with the Sr. Managing Director, Infrastructure & Security, Infrastructure & Security team members, and other stakeholders to translate organizational priorities into actionable security roadmaps, ensuring consistent operational excellence across all security functions, and to develop the engineers and administrators within the team.

The ideal candidate combines deep technical credibility in cybersecurity with proven people management skills, strong judgment under pressure, and the ability to influence security culture and provide security education across technical and non-technical teams.

Please note: We are open to hiring for this position to work remotely, with periodic travel to Madison expected throughout the year. Remote candidates must reside in one of the following states to be considered: Arizona, Colorado, Illinois, Iowa, Minnesota, New Mexico, New York, Texas, or Wisconsin.

Who is WFAA?The Wisconsin Foundation and Alumni Association is a private, nonprofit corporation that encourages individuals and organizations to make gifts to the university and to connect with the UW. In 2014, the UW Foundation merged with the Wisconsin Alumni Association® to better serve a growing population of UW alumni and donors. We believe that private support grows out of good relationships between campus leaders, faculty and program staff who need support, and the alumni and friends who want to invest in UW–Madison. We provide important engagement opportunities to link UW–Madison alumni to each other and to their alma mater, building a strong community of Badgers.

Diversity and Inclusion:

Just as the university community benefits from differing viewpoints, perspectives, and experiences, inclusion and diversity are imperative for the success of our mission. WFAA values people and the differences that they bring to the organization, and creates an environment in which all staff members and constituents feel respected and have opportunities to thrive.

Essential Functions

Security Governance, Risk & Compliance

  • Lead and oversee the compliance with regulatory frameworks and internal policy requirements including HIPAA, PCI-DSS, and NIST.
  • Ensure consistent application of security patches, vulnerability remediation, access controls, and configuration hardening across endpoints, servers, cloud workloads, and network environments.
  • Lead and oversee vulnerability management efforts, risk assessments, and compliance audits, ensuring findings are prioritized and remediated in alignment with business risk tolerance.
  • Oversee the development and maintenance of security policies, standards, and procedures across the organization.
  • Lead or oversee penetration testing efforts and coordinate remediation of identified vulnerabilities.
  • Oversee third-party risk management processes, ensuring vendor security practices are evaluated and contractual security requirements are enforced.
  • Promote a culture of security accountability and risk-informed decision-making across technical and business teams.
  • Lead and oversee the security awareness training program for the organization.

Strategic Direction & Stakeholder Management

  • Partner with the Sr. Managing Director, Infrastructure & Security to define and execute the strategic roadmap for the organization’s security program.
  • Translate organizational and business priorities into actionable project plans, resourcing decisions, and operational standards.
  • Provide architectural and operational oversight for security initiatives, ensuring alignment with infrastructure standards, compliance requirements, and scalability needs.
  • Serve as an escalation point and primary liaison with external security vendors, Managed Detection & Response (MDR) providers, third-party security partners, overseeing service deliver, performance and SLA compliance.
  • Stay current with industry trends, emerging threats, threat intelligence, and vendor roadmaps to inform security strategy, tooling, and investment decisions.
  • Report on team performance, project status, capacity, security posture and risk to the Sr. Managing Director and other stakeholders, including budget and resourcing recommendations.
  • Drive cross-functional collaboration with other Infrastructure & Security teams on security requirements and shared initiatives.

Security Optimization, Automation & AI Enablement

  • Oversee the day-to-day operations of the Security team, ensuring a reliable, proactive, and high-performing security program across the organization’s technology environments.
  • Ensure timely triage, escalation, and resolution of security incidents, acting as an escalation point for complex or high-impact security events.
  • Review and approve security changes, ensuring adherence to change management practices and minimizing operational and security risk.
  • Oversee root cause analysis, post-incident reviews, and remediation planning for significant security incidents, breaches, or degradations.
  • Ensure incident response plans, disaster recovery procedures, and business continuity mechanisms are maintained and regularly tested in collaboration with cross-functional teams.
  • Champion automation, scripting and AI-enabled security tooling to reduce manual effort and improve operational efficiency across security operations.
  • Maintain oversight of technical documentation, security configuration standards, and monitoring/alerting baselines for all security systems.
  • Manage and prioritize the security project portfolio, ensuring projects are delivered on time, within scope, and aligned with business needs.
  • Work cross-functionally within the Infrastructure & Security team to identify and assist with operational optimization for other teams

Team Leadership & Development

  • Lead, coach, and develop the security team including hiring, onboarding, performance management, and career development.
  • Set team goals, workload priorities, staffing plans, schedules, on-call rotations, and after-hours coverage to support reliable security operations.
  • Conduct regular one-on-ones, performance reviews, and development planning to build technical depth, bench strength, and succession readiness.
  • Foster a collaborative, accountable, service-oriented culture that emphasizes security excellence, customer engagement, documentation, continuous learning, innovation, and operational ownership.
  • Identify skills gaps and training needs and coordinate certifications and professional development opportunities for team members.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or relevant experience that provides equivalent knowledge, skills, or abilities.
  • 7 + years of progressive experience in cybersecurity, security engineering, or a related field.
  • 3 + years of experience directly managing or leading technical security teams, including hiring, performance management, and staff development.
  • 5 + years of hands-on experience with enterprise security tools and technologies, including SIEM, EDR, IDS/IPS, firewalls, and endpoint protection platforms.
  • 5 + years of experience with security architecture, incident response, vulnerability management, and compliance programs.
  • Experience managing relationships with Managed Detection & Response (MDR) providers, security vendors, and other third-party security partners.
  • Demonstrated experience leading cross-functional security projects using established project management methodologies.
  • Demonstrated success driving security process improvements, automation, or operational optimization initiatives.
  • Familiarity with regulatory frameworks and compliance standards including HIPAA, PCI-DSS, and NIST.
  • Deep understanding of cybersecurity principles, protocols, architecture, and best practices.
  • Proven ability to lead, motivate, and develop technical security teams.
  • Strong understanding of regulatory frameworks, compliance standards, and enterprise risk.
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills, with the ability to prioritize competing demands.
  • Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple complex initiatives simultaneously.
  • Strong communication, interpersonal, and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to present to senior leadership.
  • Ability to design, document, and maintain effective procedures, processes, and automations.

Other Qualifications:

title: Intern - Fleet Data Analytics (Summer 2027) McCarthy Improvement
description:
A member of the McCarthy-Bush family of companies, McCarthy Improvement (MCI) is a heavy highway and construction company dedicated to connecting people and communities through infrastructure development, using innovative ideas with a commitment to safety and quality. Founded in 1897, our core values center around integrity, quality, safety, and teamwork. Our vision is to continue to lead our industry through innovation and exceptional performance.


We strive to set the standard in company culture by hiring talented, committed individuals who adhere to the same principles upon which our firm was founded. Learn more about us by watching our YouTube video!


McCarthy Improvement is looking for a Fleet Data Analytics Intern for Summer, 2027. This position will be based out of our location in Davenport, Iowa.

Applicants who are pursuing any level college degree in data analytics, business analytics, information systems, or a related field are encouraged to apply. This would be a full time role scheduled 32-40 hours per week, with a flexible schedule based on school timelines.

What can you expect in this role?

At MCI, we manage a fleet of over 300 pieces of heavy equipment. We're looking for a highly motivated, data-driven intern to help us better understand how that fleet is being used - and where we can improve. This role is roughly split 50% in the office analyzing data, and 50% in the field verifying it against real equipment, so a clean driving record and valid driver's license are a must


Under the supervision of our Equipment Manager and Risk Manager, responsibilities will include:

  • Collect and analyze equipment usage data (utilization, idle time, hours logged) across the fleet
  • Build reports and dashboards to help identify underused or overworked equipment
  • Spend time in the filed confirming data accuracy against actual machine hours and condition
  • Support decisions on equipment replacement, reallocation, and purchasing
  • Collaborate with the equipment and operations teams to translate data into actionable recommendations


Here’s what it takes to get started:

  • Ability to prioritize work and meet project deadlines
  • Strong analytical skills and comfort working with data (SQL, Power BI, or Tableau a plus)
  • Proficiency using Microsoft Office products, including Excel
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills

We pride ourselves on designing an internship program that provides students meaningful work that supports your career goals while also hosting several intern-centered events with interns from across our companies. As a proud member of the McCarthy-Bush Corporation family of companies, we're united by a commitment to "Growing Together" - creating value through collaboration and delivering one-stop solutions to our customers. Overview

At Wipfli, people count.

At Wipfli, our people are core to everything we do—the catalyst behind our ability to create exceptional impact and extraordinary results.

Job Summary

Under the direction of a Senior Consultant or Manager, the Cybersecurity Consultant II develops and delivers consultative and technical cybersecurity solutions that help clients identify risk, strengthen controls, and improve business processes and information technology. The Consultant II manages assigned portions of engagements, works independently for short periods, and interacts regularly with clients and others outside of Wipfli.

Responsibilities

Essential Responsibilities

  • Execute security and risk consulting engagements, including social engineering, security assessments, and vulnerability testing services.

  • Perform social engineering consulting services, including open-source intelligence research, email phishing simulations, pretext calling, and physical penetration testing, to assess employee awareness of social engineering techniques.

  • Coordinate assigned engagement activities with clients; perform testing, analyze results, identify risks and capability gaps, recommend remediation, prepare reports, and present results to management.

title: Business Process Analyst
description:
Company Overview

VargasAndrews is a boutique international business consulting firm focused on helping businesses improve their operations, financial performance, and the quality of life of business owners. We operate across the United States, Australia, and the Philippines.

Role Purpose

The Business Process Analyst is responsible for helping VargasAndrews understand, document, improve, standardize, and govern how work is performed across the organization.

The role will independently work with process owners and subject-matter experts across different functions to discover how work is currently performed, identify gaps and inefficiencies, develop clear process documentation, and recommend practical improvements.

A key objective is to establish reliable business processes that are clearly documented, assigned to appropriate owners, maintained through proper governance, and assessed for future automation or AI opportunities where these provide a practical solution to a business problem.

This is not primarily an AI development role. The successful contractor should understand automation and AI capabilities well enough to identify opportunities, define business requirements, and work effectively with AI, automation, and other technical specialists.

Key Responsibilities

Process Discovery & Documentation

  • Conduct discovery sessions with process owners and subject-matter experts to understand how work is actually performed.
  • Independently identify undocumented, unclear, or inconsistently performed business processes.
  • Document current-state processes, including activities, decision points, roles, systems, inputs, outputs, dependencies, controls, and handoffs.
  • Develop and maintain SOPs, checklists, manuals, process maps, workflow documentation, and related operating documents.
  • Translate complex or informal working practices into clear, practical documentation that can be understood and followed by others.
  • Establish or recommend an appropriate business process register, documentation structure, and process repository.
  • Organize existing process documentation and identify missing, duplicate, outdated, or conflicting materials.

Process Analysis & Improvement

  • Analyze existing workflows to identify unnecessary steps, duplication, bottlenecks, unclear ownership, control gaps, and inefficient handoffs.
  • Look beyond how a process has historically been performed and determine whether there is a more effective way to achieve the intended business outcome.
  • Facilitate AS-IS and TO-BE process discussions with relevant stakeholders.
  • Conduct root-cause analysis to distinguish underlying process problems from symptoms.
  • Recommend practical process improvements based on business needs, risks, available resources, and expected outcomes.
  • Help determine whether activities are assigned to the appropriate function and process owner.
  • Support implementation and adoption of approved process improvements.
  • Establish appropriate measures or indicators to determine whether process improvements are producing the intended results.

Process Governance

  • Establish clear ownership and accountability for documented processes.
  • Develop and maintain appropriate documentation standards, version control, approval records, review dates, and change histories.
  • Coordinate scheduled process and documentation reviews with process owners.
  • Follow up with relevant stakeholders to ensure documentation remains accurate and current.
  • Identify outdated, duplicate, incomplete, or conflicting process documentation.
  • Recommend and help establish an appropriate process governance framework for the organization.
  • Maintain visibility over the status, ownership, maturity, and improvement opportunities of key business processes.

AI & Automation Enablement

  • Assess business processes for appropriate automation and AI opportunities.
  • Distinguish between problems that require process improvement and those where technology, automation, or AI may provide additional value.
  • Identify processes that should be standardized or improved before automation is considered.
  • Document business requirements, decision rules, exceptions, dependencies, data requirements, and human decision points relevant to potential automation.
  • Develop future-state workflows with guidance and input from relevant process owners.
  • Work with AI, automation, IT, and other technical specialists to translate business processes into clear implementation requirements.
  • Support testing, validation, documentation, and adoption of approved automation initiatives.
  • Use AI tools appropriately to support process discovery, analysis, documentation, research, and productivity.

Advanced AI development, software engineering, or building complex AI agents is not a core requirement of this role.

Cross-Functional Coordination, Reporting & Special Projects

  • Coordinate cross-functional process and operational improvement initiatives.
  • Work with stakeholders across different functions and levels of seniority to obtain information, resolve process gaps, and move agreed actions forward.
  • Maintain project plans, action registers, process trackers, documentation, reports, and follow-up activities as required.
  • Prepare management reports, process summaries, recommendations, and presentations.
  • Support special projects requiring structured analysis, documentation, coordination, reporting, and follow-through.
  • Perform administrative activities connected to process governance, documentation, reporting, and project delivery.

Required Experience & Capabilities

  • 5+ years of relevant professional experience, with demonstrated experience in Business Process Analysis, Process Improvement, Process Excellence, Continuous Improvement, Business Transformation, Operations Excellence, or a closely related discipline.
  • Experience working in BPO, outsourcing, shared services, consulting, professional services, or another cross-functional service environment is strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently conduct process discovery and stakeholder interviews.
  • Strong experience developing SOPs, process maps, workflows, checklists, manuals, or similar process documentation.
  • Experience documenting and analyzing AS-IS and TO-BE processes.
  • Demonstrated ability to identify root causes, inefficiencies, bottlenecks, duplication, unclear ownership, and process-control gaps.
  • Strong analytical and structured problem-solving capability.
  • Ability to challenge existing practices constructively rather than simply documenting how work has historically been performed.
  • Strong stakeholder management and facilitation skills, including the ability to influence without direct authority.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to independently manage multiple processes, stakeholders, and documentation requirements.
  • Comfortable working in a remote, international, and cross-functional environment.
  • Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Excel and common business productivity tools.

Education

A bachelor's degree in Industrial Engineering, Management Engineering, Business Administration, Operations Management, Information Systems, or another relevant discipline is preferred.

Industrial Engineering and Management Engineering backgrounds are particularly relevant when combined with professional experience in business process analysis, process improvement, process excellence, shared services, BPO, outsourcing, consulting, or other service-based environments.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Lean Six Sigma Yellow Belt, Green Belt, or similar process-improvement training or certification.
  • Experience with Visio, Lucidchart, Miro, Signavio, or similar process-mapping tools.
  • Familiarity with BPMN, SIPOC, Value Stream Mapping, Lean, Six Sigma, root-cause analysis, or related process-improvement methodologies.
  • Experience establishing or maintaining process libraries, SOP repositories, document-control systems, or process registers.
  • Experience with Power BI or other reporting and visualization tools.
  • Basic practical exposure to Power Automate, Make, Zapier, or similar low-code/no-code automation platforms.
  • Experience using ChatGPT, Claude, or similar AI tools to support business analysis, documentation, process improvement, or automation.
  • Experience supporting U.S. or other international stakeholders.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means VargasAndrews develops a reliable and sustainable way of managing its business processes.

Important recurring processes should progressively become:

Documented -> Standardized -> Assigned to Clear Owners -> Version-Controlled -> Regularly Reviewed -> Measured -> Continuously Improved -> Assessed for Appropriate Automation or AI Opportunities

The successful contractor will not simply produce documentation. They will be expected to understand why a process exists, what business problem it is intended to solve, whether the current approach remains appropriate, who should own it, and how it can be improved.

Where automation or AI can provide value, the contractor will help prepare the process and business requirements so that appropriate technical specialists can design and implement the solution.

• Demonstrated initiative, resourcefulness, leadership, and interpersonal skills, with an ability to influence stakeholders, solve problems, and deliver results

• Strong organizational skills and prior success in working with cross-functional teams
