title: Senior Telecomm Network Administrator
description:
About us

Itero Group is a Women-Owned Small Business focused on simplifying complex transformations. We empower clients in the private and government sectors to become more optimized, digitally enabled, and data-driven organizations through our comprehensive business consulting and innovative delivery solutions.

Itero Group's dedicated team members are experienced thought leaders, tenacious workers, and creative thinkers. We hire people who are passionate about being catalysts for change - in our company, for our clients, throughout our career- and we empower people to express their ideas, create better practices, innovate better products, and become better professionals.

We have been named a Great Place to Work for six years, and offer a competitive salary and benefits package.

Senior Telecomm Network Administrator (L3 Network Support Engineer)

Location: Annapolis, MD
Department: Network Operations
Employment Type: Full-Time

About Itero Group

Itero Group supports mission-critical technology environments where availability, reliability, and rapid problem resolution matter. We partner with major telecommunications carriers and emergency service providers to deploy and support resilient, next-generation communication networks.

We are seeking a Senior Telecomm Network Administrator who is not only technically strong, but highly resourceful. This role requires someone who can take ownership of complex problems, investigate beyond the obvious symptoms, leverage available tools and resources, and determine a path forward when a documented solution does not already exist.

Position Overview

As a Senior Telecomm Network Administrator, you will serve as a Level 3 escalation point for complex network, system, and infrastructure issues supporting emergency communication services (ECS) and carrier-grade networks.

This is not a runbook-only support position.

Successful candidates will be comfortable receiving an issue that may be incomplete, unfamiliar, or poorly defined and independently working through it. You will be expected to gather information, identify likely causes, use available documentation and diagnostic tools, test hypotheses, engage the right technical resources, and continue investigating until the problem is understood and resolved.

The position also supports the Go-Live deployment and scaling of wireless infrastructure, physical hardware, network environments, and virtualized cloud applications.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own Complex Technical Problems: Take responsibility for escalated issues from initial investigation through resolution. Look beyond the reported symptom to identify underlying technical causes and dependencies.
  • Perform Advanced Troubleshooting: Diagnose complex network, system, application, and hardware issues across interconnected environments. Develop and test troubleshooting hypotheses rather than relying solely on predefined procedures.
  • Work Beyond the Runbook: Use existing documentation, knowledge bases, logs, monitoring tools, vendor resources, command-line tools, and internal expertise as starting points. When a documented solution does not exist, independently investigate and develop a technically sound path to resolution.
  • Think Across the Environment: Evaluate how changes or failures in one component may affect routing, switching, firewalls, servers, applications, wireless infrastructure, cloud platforms, and connected systems.
  • Drive Issues to Resolution: Maintain ownership of difficult problems, including issues requiring deeper research, vendor engagement, cross-team collaboration, configuration analysis, testing, or escalation.
  • Tier 3 Escalation Support: Provide advanced support for issues that cannot be resolved through standard Level 1 or Level 2 troubleshooting within a 24/7/365 network operations environment.
  • Infrastructure Deployment: Support Go-Live activities including deployment, configuration, testing, troubleshooting, and optimization of wireless network infrastructure and physical hardware.
  • Network Administration: Configure, maintain, troubleshoot, and secure routers, switches, and firewalls supporting highly available carrier-grade environments.
  • System & Cloud Management: Support virtualized server and application environments using Red Hat Linux, OpenShift, and related technologies.
  • Root Cause Analysis: Identify not only how to restore service, but why an issue occurred and what actions may prevent recurrence.
  • Improve Team Knowledge: Document newly discovered solutions, troubleshooting procedures, root causes, and lessons learned so future issues can be resolved more efficiently.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work effectively with network engineers, deployment teams, vendors, carriers, application teams, and emergency service stakeholders to solve problems that cross technical boundaries.

Required Qualifications

  • Experience: 5+ years of advanced network or systems administration experience, preferably within telecommunications, network operations, carrier, public safety, or other mission-critical environments.
  • Advanced Problem Solving: Demonstrated ability to independently diagnose complex technical problems where the cause or solution is not immediately known.
  • Technical Resourcefulness: Ability to use documentation, logs, monitoring platforms, command-line tools, vendor resources, technical forums, lab testing, packet analysis, and other available resources to investigate unfamiliar issues.
  • Critical Thinking: Ability to break large or ambiguous problems into smaller components, identify dependencies, form technical hypotheses, test assumptions, and adjust the troubleshooting approach based on new information.
  • Ownership Mentality: Willingness to stay engaged with difficult issues rather than simply escalating them when the answer is not immediately apparent.
  • Network Infrastructure: Deep understanding of routing, switching, network protocols, and firewall technologies.
  • Juniper Environment: Strong experience supporting enterprise or carrier-grade Juniper networking environments is highly desirable.
  • Operating Systems: Strong proficiency with Red Hat Linux system administration.
  • Communication: Ability to clearly explain technical findings, troubleshooting steps, risks, and recommended actions to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent hands-on professional experience.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Juniper Certifications: JNCIS, JNCIP-ENT, JNCIP-SP, JNCIP-SEC, or higher-level Juniper certification.
  • Cisco Background: Advanced Cisco experience or certifications will be considered, particularly for candidates who demonstrate the ability to quickly adapt their networking knowledge to Juniper environments.
  • Cloud & Virtualization: Hands-on experience with Red Hat OpenShift or comparable container and virtualization platforms.
  • Troubleshooting Tools: Experience using packet capture, network monitoring, log analysis, diagnostic, and performance-analysis tools.
  • Industry Experience: Experience supporting public safety networks, emergency communication services, wireless infrastructure, network operations centers, or major telecommunications carriers.

If you are looking for a role where you will lead with integrity, create and innovate, inspire excellence, be a respected member of the team, drive results, and have fun, we look forward to connecting with you!

Benefits at Itero Group
At Itero Group, we’re proud to offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your health, financial well-being, and work-life balance:

  • Health & Wellness: Medical (BC-BS), dental, and vision plans to suit your needs.
  • Paid Time Off: Generous PTO, paid holidays, and increasing PTO based on years of service.
  • Retirement Savings: 401(k) plan with company match and auto-enrollment.
  • Company-Paid Coverage: Short-term and long-term disability, life insurance, and AD&D insurance.
  • Additional Options: Voluntary benefits including pet insurance and student loan assistance up to $1,000 annually.
  • Perks: FSAs, HSAs, wellness programs, and more to enhance your work-life balance.

Join us and enjoy a benefits package designed with you in mind!

Itero Group is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate against any employee or applicant because of race, age, sex, color, physical or mental disability, religion, sexual orientation, marital status, national origin, veteran status or political affiliation.

title: Developer - Integrations & AI
description:
Position Summary

The Developer - Integrations & AI role builds and maintains the connections between Bluum’s business systems, outside platforms, and the organization’s AI services. Working alongside senior developers, technical leads, and outside development partners, you will help build the APIs, scripts, and web application code that move data between internal applications and approved AI tools, and extend customizations in Bluum’s core business platforms. You will contribute to AI-enabled features, working from established patterns rather than building the underlying framework, while gaining hands-on experience with applied AI integration.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain web application, integration, and automation code using JavaScript, Python, and PHP, including the scripts and services that support AI-enabled features and data preparation.
  • Build and maintain integrations that connect internal systems to outside resources, including partner and vendor platforms, third-party APIs, and hosted services.
  • Serve as a technical point of contact for outside development resources, vendors, and partners, coordinating requirements, reviewing delivered work, and supporting handoff into internal systems.
  • Integrate business applications with the organization’s internal AI services and approved AI tools, working from established patterns rather than building the underlying framework.
  • Support and extend customizations, workflows, and configurations within the organization’s core business platforms.
  • Collaborate with technical leads, Business Intelligence, and business users to gather requirements and translate them into working solutions.
  • Participate in testing, debugging, and documentation of integrations, customizations, and AI-enabled features.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to business applications, workflows, integrations, and connected services.
  • Follow established version control and change control practices, and contribute to documentation of processes, code, and user guides.
  • Perform other support and development-related tasks as assigned.

Education & Skill Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field; relevant coursework or equivalent practical experience accepted.
  • Working knowledge of JavaScript and related web technologies, and of Python for scripting, automation, and integration work; experience with PHP is also applicable.
  • Familiarity with web development concepts such as HTML, CSS, JSON, and client/server architecture, with experience working with REST APIs and third-party services.
  • Exposure to AI or LLM-enabled application development, such as calling model APIs, working with prompts, or consuming an internal AI service.
  • Experience with version control tools (e.g., Git).
  • Exposure to customizing or extending enterprise business platforms, such as Oracle NetSuite, is a plus but not required, as is basic familiarity with SQL or relational database concepts.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to communicate clearly and work effectively with technical and non-technical team members, including outside vendors and partners.

Core Values

  • Own it Together - We are accountable. We do what we say we will do. We hold ourselves, and each other, accountable for results. We follow through on commitments and take responsibility for our impact on our team, our customers, and our mission.
  • Do What’s Right - We act with integrity, even when it’s hard. We’re honest, ethical, and guided by what’s best for our customers, our team, our partners, and the students we serve – always.
  • Are Always Learning - Like the educators and students we serve, we believe in lifelong learning. We embrace change, seek feedback and stay curious—because every challenge is a chance to grow stronger, smarter, and more impactful.
  • Win as a Team - We're in this together. We put the mission and the team first. We make decisions that benefit our customers and our company. We succeed by aligning around shared goals and celebrating collective wins over individual gain.

Training

  • It will be necessary to participate in upgrading courses from time to time to keep abreast of changing policy, technology, and growth.

title: Senior IAM Engineer
description:
Company Description

Fairness feels good

Make a real impact at AFCA. Where fairness drives every decision. Help us deliver world-class, independent complaints resolution for Australians. As a not-for-profit and progressive financial ombudsman, we’re championing positive change. Achieving our purpose takes progressive thinking, accountability and resilience. At AFCA, our inclusive leadership values every voice. We offer our people flexible work options, thoughtful benefits and opportunities to deepen expertise. Flourish in a diverse, caring culture. Feel the difference of belonging to an organisation intentionally designed to put people first.

Job Description

Help shape AFCA’s next-generation identity capability.

You will lead the design and delivery of modern customer and workforce identity solutions, replacing legacy platforms and improving secure access across AFCA’s digital ecosystem.

This is a hands-on senior role with genuine ownership, direct influence on technical decisions and the opportunity to grow your impact as the IAM capability matures.

What you will do:

  • Own IAM solution design and implementation across CIAM and workforce identity.
  • Define target-state architecture, migration pathways and transition roadmaps.
  • Deliver solutions using platforms such as Microsoft Entra ID, Entra External ID, Okta and Auth0.
  • Design secure integrations for applications, APIs and digital channels using OAuth 2.0, OIDC and SAML.
  • Implement identity lifecycle management, access governance, RBAC and least privilege.
  • Strengthen controls including MFA, conditional access and modern authentication.
  • Provide hands-on technical leadership and guide delivery teams through complex decisions.
Qualifications

What you will bring:

  • Strong experience delivering enterprise WIAM or CIAM solutions.
  • Hands-on expertise with modern identity platforms and authentication protocols.
  • Experience designing application, API and service authentication patterns.
  • The ability to translate architecture into practical, scalable solutions.
  • Strong technical leadership, stakeholder engagement and problem-solving skills.
  • Experience migrating from Azure AD B2C, legacy federation, directory or access-management platforms.
  • Experience operating split identity models for external customers and internal workforce users.
  • Experience with Microsoft Entra ID Governance, entitlement management, access packages, lifecycle workflows, SCIM provisioning or equivalent capabilities.
  • Experience with identity automation, infrastructure as code, CI/CD and automated integration testing.
  • Experience delivering identity solutions in regulated, high-trust or information-sensitive environments.
  • Relevant identity, cloud or security certifications, such as Microsoft Certified: Identity and Access Administrator Associate, Microsoft Certified: Cybersecurity Architect Expert, Okta Certified Professional, Okta Certified Administrator, Auth0 certification, CIAM, CISSP, CCSP or equivalent
Additional Information
  • Silver AWEI Accreditation 2025 – Recognised for LGBTQ+ workplace inclusion.
  • Accredited Family Friendly Workplace – Supporting work-life balance and inclusivity.
  • Hybrid working – Flexible arrangements with two days a week in our modern offices designed for collaboration and wellbeing.
  • Additional and inclusive leave options – Flexible public holidays, gender affirmation leave, women’s health leave, and bonus paid time off over the end of year holiday period.

To apply

If you’re passionate about fairness and believe your skills align with this role, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every single criterion.

We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, cultures, abilities, sexual orientations, and gender identities. If you require any accessibility support during the recruitment process, please reach out to our team at Careers@afca.org.au.

We believe fairness starts with people. That’s why we don’t use AI or automated tools to screen candidates. As a result, our processes may take a little longer, and we thank you for your patience.

About AFCA

The Australian Financial Complaints Authority (AFCA) was established in 2018 as a private not-for-profit ombudsman service providing free, fair and independent help with financial disputes. The original team has grown to over 1600 dedicated professionals. Since 2018, AFCA has received more than 634,000 complaints, helping to secure $2.1 billion in compensation for consumers.

AFCA is a 2026 Circle Back Initiative Employer - we are committed to responding to every applicant.

title: Vi søger en energisk social- og sundhedsassistent til dagvagt
description:
Knud Lavard Centret søger en energisk social- og sundhedsassistent til dagvagt

Knud Lavard centret, et plejecenter Midt i mulighederne.

Fanger ord som stor faglighed, individuel omsorg og empatisk kommunikation din interesse, skal du søge stillingen som dagvagt.

Hos os får du ansvar for dit arbejde og samarbejde med ledelsen. Der er rig mulighed for personlig udvikling og en masse skønne kollegaer samt beboere.

Vagten starter ud med fælles møde angående vagtens forløb. Overlevering fra nattevagt. Derefter starter vagtens praktiske opgaver med beboerne – det er aktiviteter, mad, bad og gøre klar til dagen. Der er ofte arrangementer for beboerne som personalet også deltager i.

Der foregår forskellige projekter på plejecenteret, og det forventes at du deltager aktivt. Projekterne er med til at skabe bedre livskvalitet for beboerne.

Vi forventer at du:

  • Er sød og smilende
  • Brænder for at bevare de ældres livskvalitet og værdighed
  • Deltager aktivt i aktiviteter og daglige gøremål
  • Betragter dit arbejde som ”at fejre livet hver dag”
  • Er uddannet SSA

Du vil være en del af et plejecenter, hvor faglighed, viden og udvikling er en naturlig del af din hverdag. Du vil være med til at fastholde de gode resultater, vi har opnået, som kan ses qua kommunalt tilsyn og embedslæge tilsyn samt trivselsundersøgelse.

Vi søger lige nu en social- og sundhedsassistent som til afdeling B1. Stillingen er på 37 timer ugentligt, med arbejde hver 2. weekend i lige uger.

På vores afdelinger er der plads til 19 beboer fordelt på 2 gange.
Vi har 6 afdelinger bestående af somatiske, demensafsnit og akut/midlertidige pladser.
Vi arbejder ud fra den rehabiliterende tilgang og der lægges stor vægt på pleje og omsorg ud fra den enkelte borgers ønsker og behov.

Vi arbejder i det daglige med leveregler, hvor vi som team i fællesskab udarbejder daglige ”regler” for at kunne leve sammen. Dit gode humør og smittende arbejdsglæde er med til at give et godt samarbejde i dit team.

Kan du se dig selv i ovenstående beskrivelse er det netop DIG vi mangler. Derfor ser vi frem til at modtage din ansøgning samt dit CV.

Har du yderligere spørgsmål, er du velkommen til at kontakte teamleder Louise Petersen 21 79 70 13 for mere information.

Du kan også finde flere informationer på

Samtaler afholdes i uge 43.

Du bedes medsende relevante uddannelsesbeviser til stillingen.
Løn og ansættelsesvilkår
Ansættelse og lønforhandling sker i henhold til relevant overenskomst.

Der kan blive indhentet børne- og/eller straffeattester i forbindelse med ansættelsen.

Det er en del af Ringsted Kommunes ansættelsespolitik at fremme ligelig kønsfordeling og etnisk ligestilling. Vi opfordrer både personer med dansk og anden etnisk baggrund til at søge den opslåede stilling.

Vi glæder os til at modtage din ansøgning.

title: Data Engineer Manager
description:

Accountabilities:

  • Lead the technical design, implementation, and evolution of scalable data architectures and platforms across complex environments.
  • Design, develop, and maintain high-performance, resilient data pipelines and ETL/ELT processes supporting large-scale data workloads.
  • Define architecture standards and best practices for Data Lake, Data Warehouse, and Lakehouse environments.
  • Work with different teams to ensure data integrity, quality, security, availability, and operational reliability.
  • Implement Data Quality, observability, and reliability practices across data pipelines and platforms.
  • Develop and evolve CI/CD pipelines and engineering practices for data processing and ETL/ELT solutions.
  • Define and implement relational and dimensional data models aligned with analytical and operational requirements.
  • Establish Data Governance practices, including data cataloging, lineage, access controls, and documentation.
  • Document architectures, data flows, processes, technical decisions, and relevant engineering standards.

title: Integration Project Manager
description:
Salary: 142790 191084 AUD

Company description:

About Us

'Safe journeys, every time'. This is what we strive for at Safe Transport Victoria (ST Vic).

As the safety regulator for commercial passenger vehicles, buses and maritime, what we do impacts the everyday lives of Victorians. Our role is to work with these industries and the communities they serve to ensure a transport system that inspires confidence for users.

We are focused on creating impact by being an intelligence-led regulator, agile to technological disruptions in the market and highly responsive to community expectations and needs.

We are also in the business of thinking big. We are reimagining what's possible in how we regulate, and we welcome those who are interested in reshaping and redefining how we work.

Safe Transport Victoria is committed to building a culture of ‘working as one'. This means our people share openly, question respectfully and build together. This also means we invest in our people and provide personal and professional development programs to create a workforce that is empowered, innovative and adaptable.



Job description:

About the Role

Reporting to the Senior Manager, Strategy & Architecture this role is responsible for leading the delivery of complex systems integration activities that support Safe Transport Victoria's strategic priorities and operational effectiveness as part of a business-led, technology-enabled transformation.

The Integration Project Manager will operate in a dynamic environment, bringing strong delivery discipline while remaining flexible and responsive to emerging needs, changing priorities and ambiguity. The role requires someone who can balance project management theory and frameworks with sound judgement, pragmatism and a strong focus on outcomes.

The key aspect of the role is working proactively across business, technical and external stakeholder groups to ensure integration requirements are clearly understood, dependencies are actively managed, and decisions or actions required from partner agencies are identified and progressed in a timely way.

The responsibilities of the Integration Project Manager will include, but are not limited to:

  • Leading the end-to-end delivery of complex systems integration activities

  • Establishing and maintaining appropriate project governance, planning and reporting for integration delivery

  • Managing scope, schedule, risks, issues, dependencies and delivery outcomes across multiple integration streams

  • Engaging and influencing stakeholders across business and technical areas, including partner agencies, vendors and service providers

  • Working proactively with partner agencies to ensure integration requirements, dependencies, responsibilities and timeframes are clearly understood and progressed

  • Following up actions, decisions and information requests to maintain momentum and support timely delivery

  • Ensuring Safe Transport Victoria's integration needs are clearly articulated and that information required from external stakeholders is identified early and actioned

  • Supporting shared ownership of outcomes and building strong cross-functional collaboration

  • Driving continuous improvement in integration delivery by applying lessons learnt and performance insights

  • Maintaining project documentation, governance records and knowledge management practices

  • Planning for the effective transition of project outcomes into business-as-usual operations.

You will bring demonstrated experience delivering complex technology, digital or systems integration initiatives, with strong knowledge of project delivery methodologies and agile ways of working. Just as importantly, you will know how to apply that knowledge in a practical, fit-for-purpose way to achieve results.

You will combine strong delivery discipline with the judgement, adaptability and initiative to lead work through complexity, respond to changing priorities and maintain focus on strategic outcomes.

To access the Position Description, click here

About You

You are a capable and delivery-focused project professional with demonstrated experience leading complex technology, digital or integration initiatives. You have strong knowledge of project management frameworks, governance and agile delivery approaches, together with the judgement to apply them in a practical and fit-for-purpose way.

You bring a strategic and disciplined approach to delivery, with the ability to align project activity to organisational priorities, manage complexity and support informed decision-making. You are an effective problem solver who can establish clarity, engage stakeholders and maintain focus on achieving high-quality outcomes.

You are self-motivated, adaptable and accountable, with a collaborative working style and a strong commitment to delivery excellence.

You are also confident working across organisational boundaries and building effective relationships with partner agencies and service providers. You proactively follow through on actions, clarify expectations and ensure integration requirements are understood and progressed.

Experience working with enterprise platforms such as Salesforce, and integration approaches including APIs, middleware or data exchange solutions, will be highly regarded.

Qualifications

  • Tertiary qualification in project management, information systems, business or a related discipline is desirable

  • Agile, SAFe and/or Prince2 qualifications are highly desirable

  • Equivalent professional experience in leading complex technology, digital or systems integration projects will be considered

Further Information

For further information or a confidential discussion, please email ITS_Recruitment@safetransport.vic.gov.au

It is an inherent requirement of this position that the employee is ready, willing, and able to perform work outside their ordinary place of residence, including at ST Vic workplaces.

What we offer you?

ST Vic is committed to building a culture of flexible work arrangements, providing professional development programs and supporting ways of working that help employees balance work and life. We welcome applicants from a diverse range of backgrounds, including veterans, people who identify as Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander, have a disability, are from varied cultural backgrounds and those who identify as LGBTIQ+.

A Workplace committed to safety and wellbeing

ST Vic is committed to providing a safe and healthy workplace for all its people, including contractors and visitors. We have a strong focus on initiating wellness events for our people to foster a sense of enjoyment and positive mental health. In some instances, ST Vic also offers flexible working arrangements.

Diversity and Inclusion

ST Vic's broad diversity program enables us to attract, recruit, retain and develop a diverse workforce to foster greater innovation, greater customer connection and increased wellbeing and satisfaction.

Learning and Development

We want you to grow, develop and learn with us! ST Vic provides you with access to a range of internal and external learning and development opportunities to support your performance in your role and further your career aspirations.

How to Apply

Please click the ‘Apply Now' button. As part of the application process, you will need to provide a copy of your resume and a cover letter of no more than 1 page in length addressing your skills, experience and interest in the position.

Applications close midnight 12 October 2026

If you require adjustments to the recruitment and selection process, or require an alternative format to any of the application material, please don't hesitate to get in touch with the contact person listed on this ad.

title: Insurance Verification Specialist
description:
The Insurance Verification Specialist role plays a key role in our front-end revenue cycle process, ensuring patients have a smooth start to their care experience. In this role, you will verify insurance coverage, confirm eligibility and benefits, and help ensure claims go out clean the first time.

Essential Functions and Responsibilities

  • Verify patient insurance coverage, eligibility, co-insurance, and deductibles prior to service.
  • Review all required documentation to ensure accuracy.
  • Maintain working knowledge of different payer types and coverage policies, including Medicare, Medicaid, and Commercial plans.
  • Verify mental health and behavioral health benefits, coverage limitations, visit caps, and applicable network requirements.
  • Resolve coverage issues and escalate complex cases to a manager.
  • Accurately enter patient demographic and insurance information into EMR system, including payer, authorization requirements, coverage limitations, and expiration dates.
  • Spend significant time on the phone and on payer websites confirming benefits.
  • Communicate coverage details clearly to patients, providers, and internal teams as needed.
  • Communicate with Management on an ongoing basis regarding noticed trends with insurance companies.
  • Maintain patient confidentiality and comply with HIPAA guidelines at all times.
  • Perform other related duties as assigned.

Competencies, Skills, and Abilities

  • Excellent customer service skills.
  • Analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
  • Excellent ability to communicate both verbally and in writing.
  • Proficient computer skills and knowledge of Microsoft Office.
  • Works well independently and as part of a team.
